jobs.title: Software Development Engineer — Storage
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- We're seeking a Sr.Software Development Engineer with deep storage expertise to architect, build, and operate the high\-performance storage infrastructure that accelerates silicon development at Annapurna Labs. In this role, you'll own the storage platforms—spanning Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, FSx for Lustre, and S3—that enable chip design teams to iterate faster, run regressions more efficiently, and bring transformative custom silicon to market. Key job responsibilities You will design, deploy, and operate high\-performance storage platforms—Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP (Gen1/Gen2\) and FSx for Lustre—optimized for EDA and HPC workloads. This includes managing NFS exports, ONTAP SVMs, intelligent tiering (FabricPool), snapshot policies, SnapMirror replication, and quota enforcement across multi\-tenant environments. You'll deploy all storage infrastructure using AWS CDK, architect cross\-VPC and multi\-account solutions via Transit Gateway and Route 53 private hosted zones, enable EFA for high\-throughput Lustre access, and manage data synchronization using DataSync and S3 integrations. You'll build a Storage as a Service platform with self\-service provisioning, defined SLOs, cost attribution, and automated lifecycle management that enables teams to consume storage without deep specialization. You will build monitoring and observability for storage health, utilization, and cost trends, and establish incident response processes for storage\-related failures. You'll continuously evaluate and adopt new AWS storage features—Gen2 scale\-out, NVMe\-over\-TCP, enhanced backup performance—to keep the platform at the leading edge. You'll profile I/O patterns across EDA workloads, tune file system configurations for optimal performance, and partner with silicon design and verification teams to proactively scale capacity and mentor others on storage best practices. A day in the life You might start your day reviewing storage utilization dashboards and tiering efficiency reports, identifying file systems approaching capacity thresholds or workloads that would benefit from tier migration. Mid\-morning, you could be collaborating with a verification team to provision a new FSx for Lustre file system optimized for their regression suite—sizing it based on their I/O profiles, enabling EFA access, and deploying it through your CDK pipeline. In the afternoon, you might be building the next iteration of your Storage as a Service platform—adding automated quota enforcement for a new team onboarding, implementing a snapshot policy that aligns with their project milestones, or extending cross\-VPC access to a new account. You'll review pull requests for CDK constructs, investigate a DataSync job that stalled, and discuss FSx ONTAP Gen2 migration plans with your team. Throughout the day, you'll balance immediate customer needs—expanding a volume for a team blocked on disk space, troubleshooting NFS mount latency—with longer\-term platform investments like evaluating intelligent tiering policies or prototyping NVMe\-over\-TCP access patterns. You'll engage with AWS service teams on feature requests and roadmap alignment, ensuring Annapurna Labs gets the most from the storage platform. About the team At Annapurna Labs, your storage infrastructure work directly enables breakthrough innovations in custom silicon that power AWS and transform industries. jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. ### **About the Role** Anduril is seeking a Systems Engineer for our factory systems team to build and maintain the mission\-critical technology stack that powers our connected factories. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of our on\-premises infrastructure, from racking servers to deploying virtualized workloads, using a modern, cloud\-managed approach. You will have the opportunity to work with some of the world's best engineers, implementing cutting\-edge systems in complex, high\-stakes manufacturing environments. ### **What You'll Do** * **Build and Maintain Factory Infrastructure:** Take ownership of the full stack of on\-premises infrastructure supporting factory operations, including physical server stand\-up, hypervisor installation (VMware), storage pool configuration, disaster recovery planning, and patch management. * **Implement a Modern Hybrid Environment**: Design, deploy, and manage a primarily on\-premises infrastructure that is Entra ID\-joined and managed through an Azure control plane. * **Leverage Hybrid Cloud Technologies:** Use tools such as Azure Arc for server management, Azure Files and AWS S3 for storage, and Azure Subscriptions/Resource Groups for governance and organization of on\-prem assets. * **Automate Everything:** Champion an Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) approach to automate provisioning, configuration, and management using tools like Terraform and Ansible. * **Ensure Performance and Reliability:** Monitor, maintain, and optimize critical infrastructure, including high\-performance storage (Pure Storage, NetApp, VAST Data) and virtual environments (VMware, VDI). * **Troubleshoot and Resolve:** Act as the escalation point for complex infrastructure issues and outages to maintain factory uptime. * **Collaborate and Document:** Work with development, security, and operations teams to support application deployment and maintain clear documentation of infrastructure designs and procedures. ### **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure engineering, with a strong, demonstrable focus on on\-premises systems (servers, storage, networking, virtualization). * Expert\-level knowledge of the VMware vSphere suite of products. * Hands\-on experience architecting or managing Entra ID\-only join environments and migrating away from traditional Active Directory dependencies. * Proficiency using Azure as a management plane for on\-prem resources (Azure Arc, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, Azure Files). * Hands\-on experience with AWS services (e.g., EC2, IAM, VPC, S3\) for hybrid or cloud\-managed infrastructure. * Hands\-on experience administering Pure Storage and NetApp (ONTAP) SAN/NAS solutions. * Experience with automation and scripting in PowerShell, Python, or Bash. * Proficiency with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible. * Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, load balancing) and enterprise storage technologies. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Datacenter or colocation build\-out experience. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., GitLab CI). * Experience with Linux configuration and administration. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Factory Infrastructure Deployment
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **Mission Context** ------------------- ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of Anduril's hardware enterprise. It connects the full lifecycle—from concept to build to field feedback—into one operating environment built for speed, traceability, autonomy, and continuous improvement. This isn't just software for design and planning; it's the factory\-facing infrastructure that connects operators, machines, test systems, and OT networks into a unified, adaptive Build Chain. **This is not a support function.** ArsenalOS is a strategic investment in how Anduril out\-builds, out\-adapts, and out\-scales the traditional defense industrial base. **Overview** ------------ As our factories scale and operate at increasingly high rates, the complexity of the infrastructure stack is growing just as quickly. We're deploying servers, networking, and compute environments into live production settings that cannot stop—and we need someone to own that execution at the site level. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to act as the central coordination point for factory infrastructure deployment. You'll lead the buildout of system administration, servers, networking, and OT infrastructure while ensuring alignment across internal teams and external vendors. This is not a passive coordination role. This is a hands\-on, technical execution\-focused position responsible for ensuring that the foundational infrastructure required to run the factory is deployed correctly, on time, and aligned with production needs. jobs.description: Summary Join the team redefining what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be. As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world’s most widely used AI assistants. It runs on our next generation of Apple Intelligence, with capabilities like personal context understanding and on\-screen awareness, and it is built with privacy from the ground up. We build the harness, the foundation that turns a model into an assistant that can act. This is a systems engineering role for people who understand how large language models behave. Description A model can't act on its own. The harness runs the agent loop, carries context and tools to the model, executes the tool calls it makes, and streams results back reliably. It spans models running on device and larger models in Private Cloud Compute. It handles everything from single\-turn requests to long multi\-step tasks that span apps, survive interruptions, and resume cleanly. We're looking for a strong systems engineer who is fluent in how LLMs behave. The work is real\-time and resource\-constrained: responses must start fast enough for a voice assistant to feel instant, under tight latency, memory, and power limits on everything from Mac and iPhone to Apple Watch. Failures rarely have a single cause. In a typical week you might track down why a streamed response stalls, make tool calls cancel cleanly when the user interrupts, or replay a failed request to tell whether the model, the context, or the runtime was at fault. Every change to the harness changes how the model behaves, so we measure our work with evals, not just tests. You'll join the team that owns the core runtime and work alongside senior engineers and researchers. You'll also partner closely with the modeling, tools, and context teams and with app and framework teams across Apple. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - Platforms Engineering, Enterprise Technology Services
jobs.description: Summary Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. That same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it! Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. As a Software Engineer on Forge, you'll design, build, test, ship, and run the platform Apple's engineering teams build on, working closely with those teams to find where the infrastructure beneath them gets in the way and fixing it. Forge is part of Enterprise Technology Services (ETS), within Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization, the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. Forge is building the platform Apple's engineering organizations can use to take a service from code to running in production. That path has traditionally run through a series of separate specialist systems. We are bringing it together on a common platform with a shared core, so a team goes from allocated capacity to a live production service without assembling the pieces themselves. Our job is to get teams to production quickly, on a platform that stays secure and reliable without them having to think about it. Our charter is deliberately wide and still growing, reaching from the physical fleet in the data center to the surfaces engineering teams build against, and extending into new environments and new classes of infrastructure as Apple's needs evolve. We are a small team with outsized reach, bringing an AI\-first mindset to how the platform operates and improves itself, and the best work we do takes one team's hardest problem and turns it into a capability every team inherits. Description As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer, you will embed with the engineering teams who use our platforms, then build the software that solves their problems. This is a software engineering\-first role that goes well beyond feature development: you will sit with a customer team to understand their applications and workflows, translate ambiguous requirements into a technical design, write the production code, integrate it with existing systems, and stay with it through deployment and operational readiness. We run what we build, so you will also share an on\-call rotation for the services the team owns — which is the fastest way to learn where the platform still falls short. The work spans Go backend services, React and TypeScript applications, REST and gRPC APIs, distributed systems, and automation that reaches into public cloud, private cloud, Kubernetes, virtual machines, and bare\-metal environments. You will also build AI\-assisted capabilities — LLM integrations, and agentic workflows — along with the evaluations and quality controls that make those capabilities measurable and trustworthy enough to run in production. You will move comfortably from a technical discussion with an engineering customer to designing a solution, writing the code, and validating that it works reliably at scale. You will approach loosely defined problems with curiosity and sound judgement, and you will know when a recurring customer request should become a reusable platform capability rather than another one\-off integration. You care about clean, maintainable code, thoughtful architecture, and operational reliability, and you are as motivated by simplifying an existing system as by building a new one. In a team with daring goals and real autonomy, you will take utmost ownership of what you ship — and measure your success by the engineering problems you solve and the lasting improvements you leave behind in the platforms other teams build on. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Dynamic, resourceful people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it. Do you love creating elegant solutions to highly complex problems? Do you intrinsically see importance in every detail? As part of our Silicon Technologies group, you’ll help design and manufacture our next\-generation, high\-performance, power\-efficient, system\-on\-chip (SoC). You’ll ensure Apple products and services can seamlessly and efficiently handle the tasks that make them beloved by millions. Joining the Apple GPU group means you’ll be responsible for crafting and building the technology that fuels Apple’s devices. Together, you and your team will enable our customers to do all the things they love with their devices. In this role, you will be leading block and sub\-system level pre\-silicon RTL verification of embedded graphics cores. You will also collaborate with members of other disciplines and top validation teams to ensure that system level concerns are baked into our verification flows, and that our IPs are efficiently integrated into the full system. Description As a Senior Graphics Core Hardware Verification Engineer, you will be tasked with the following: \- Lead teams of engineers in delivering well\-verified IP. \- Collaborate with architecture, design and modeling teams to converge on design specification. \- Develop and drive verification plans, schedules and reviews. Architect test benches using advanced OOP, UVM and vertical reuse techniques. \- Drive techniques to detect difficult design bugs such as cross\-block deadlock and livelock. \- Provide technical mentorship to early career engineers on DV methodology and conduct code reviews. \- Deploy Formal Verification techniques to complement simulation flows. \- Build automated verification flows such as ML\-assisted coverage closure for graphics core verification. \- Collaborate with peer IP, SW, and top DV teams to ensure that all validation aspects are accounted for. Minimum Qualifications * Experience leading design verification teams. * Cross\-functional (arch, u\-arch, design, DV, SW) collaboration experience to converge on design/DV requirements. * Experience in Computer Architecture and Memory sub\-system micro\-architecture. * Experience in architecting and building constrained random, coverage driven test benches. * BS \+10 years relevant experience. Preferred Qualifications * Experience mentoring early career engineers. * Familiarity in GPU architecture and standards (OpenGL/CL, Vulcan, Metal). * Experience with performance analysis and optimization techniques. * Knowledge of power management techniques in GPUs. * Familiarity with machine learning and AI processing in GPU architectures. * Experience with Formal Verification techniques and tools such as JasperGold. jobs.title: JavaScript Virtual Machine Compiler Engineer
jobs.description: Summary In this role, you have the opportunity to push the state of the art of JavaScript and WebAssembly performance. The JavaScriptCore team at Apple is looking for system programmers with compiler (especially just\-in\-time) and virtual machine experience. You will be working to deliver a faster and more secure web for all Apple products by improving JavaScriptCore’s already world\-class JIT compilers, runtime systems, and the garbage collector. The work is challenging, and the impact is worldwide. Join us. Description The JavaScriptCore team in WebKit is responsible for the JavaScriptCore engine, and our mission is to make JavaScript and WebAssembly execution both fast and secure. JavaScriptCore engineers work on all aspects of the engine: the compilation pipeline, the language runtime, the garbage collector, and the API for native apps. The compilation pipeline consists of the parser, the bytecode frontend, profile\-guided type profiling, and multiple optimizing compiler backend that turn JS and Wasm programs into efficient ARM and x86 machine code. In this role, you will work across all areas of the engine, improving the performance, security, and stability of the engine, as well as compatibility with other browsers. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. We are looking for a strong CVML engineer with both 3D geometry and ML background, optimally with experience in 3D rigid/non\-rigid object tracking, sensor fusion, or SLAM/VIO. jobs.title: NYC Field Tech
jobs.description: **Company Description** We are a boutique IT recruiting agency that strictly works with IT consulting companies and managed services providers. We place candidates on a permanent, full time basis (no contract or contract\-to\-hire positions). **Job Description** Field Technician – Managed IT Services (MSP) **Location:** New York City / Manhattan **Compensation:** Up to $65,000 annually \+ benefits **Employment Type:** Full\-Time The Opportunity We are recruiting for an established New York City managed services provider that is looking to add a Field Technician to its growing technical team. This is a client\-facing IT support position for someone who already has experience working for an MSP and enjoys working directly with end users. You will provide both remote and onsite support, traveling to client locations throughout Manhattan to troubleshoot issues, support users and serve as a trusted technical resource. Technical ability matters, but **communication skills are paramount in this position**. The right person must be personable, professional, patient and comfortable walking into a client’s office and interacting with everyone from individual end users to senior executives. This is also a genuine career\-development role. The company has a strong history of promoting from within, and successful Field Technicians can grow into **senior\-level Systems Administrator and Systems Engineer positions** as they develop technically and take on greater responsibility. What You’ll Do * Provide onsite and remote technical support to clients throughout New York City * Troubleshoot Windows and macOS desktops, laptops, applications and peripherals * Support Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and other business applications * Perform Active Directory and Entra ID user administration, including account creation, password resets, permissions, groups and onboarding/offboarding * Diagnose networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, VPN connectivity and LAN environments * Install, configure and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, monitors, docking stations and other office technology * Assist with workstation deployments, hardware refreshes and new\-user setups * Resolve issues remotely when possible and travel onsite when hands\-on support is required * Accurately document troubleshooting, resolutions and client environments in ticketing and documentation systems * Escalate advanced issues to senior engineers while providing complete and useful technical information * Communicate clearly with clients throughout the troubleshooting process and ensure they understand the status and resolution of their issue * Work alongside senior engineers and gain exposure to more advanced systems, networking and infrastructure projects What We’re Looking For * **Previous experience working for a Managed Services Provider (MSP) is required** * Approximately 2\+ years of professional IT support, desktop support, help desk or field support experience * Hands\-on experience supporting Microsoft 365 and Active Directory / Entra ID environments * Strong Windows desktop and laptop troubleshooting skills * Working knowledge of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi\-Fi, switches and routers * Experience supporting users both remotely and face\-to\-face * Experience with ticketing, PSA, RMM or documentation platforms such as ConnectWise, Autotask, HaloPSA, IT Glue, Datto or similar tools * Ability and willingness to travel regularly to client sites throughout Manhattan * Strong troubleshooting instincts and the ability to know when to resolve an issue independently versus escalate it Communication \& Client Service This is not a back\-office IT position. You will regularly represent the company inside client offices, so we are looking for someone who: * Communicates clearly and professionally * Enjoys working directly with people * Can explain technical problems without unnecessary jargon * Remains patient and composed with frustrated users * Listens carefully before jumping to a solution * Is comfortable interacting with executives and other high\-level users * Takes ownership of problems and follows through * Understands that providing excellent IT support is as much about the user experience as the technical fix Strong technical candidates who struggle to communicate effectively with clients will not be successful in this role. Preferred Experience Experience with any of the following would be helpful: * Microsoft Intune or other endpoint management platforms * Exchange Online administration * Group Policy * Windows Server * Network troubleshooting and switch/firewall environments * ConnectWise, Autotask, HaloPSA or similar MSP platforms * IT Glue or similar documentation platforms * Financial\-services, legal or other high\-touch professional\-services clients * Supporting executive or VIP users Career Growth This company promotes heavily from within and views the Field Technician role as a **feeder position into senior technical roles**. Strong performers who demonstrate reliability, excellent client service and continued technical development can advance into **Senior Systems Administrator, Senior Systems Engineer and other higher\-level infrastructure positions**. The goal is not for the right person to remain a Field Technician indefinitely. This is an opportunity to join the company, learn its client environments, build broader technical skills and progress into significantly more advanced systems and engineering work. If you have a solid MSP support foundation, enjoy working with clients and want a clear path toward becoming a **senior\-level engineer or administrator**, we would like to hear from you. **Salary: Up to $65,000 annually \+ benefits** **Qualifications** MSP Experience Necessary **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description: **Job Profile:** Applications Developer 4 **Job Family:** IT Applications **Time Type:** Full time **Apply before 11:59 PM Arizona time the day before the posted End Date.** **Minimum Qualifications:** Bachelor's degree and seven (7\) years of experience appropriate to the area of assignment/field; OR, Any equivalent combination of experience and/or training from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved. Job Profile Summary: Designs, develops, and troubleshoots complex software and applications in support of establishing a sustainable institutional technological infrastructure. This individual also conducts non\-routine system analysis, contributes to strategy development, and may provide training. **Job Description:** Are you an experienced software engineer who excels at creating and enhancing technology solutions for a variety of learner needs? Do you enjoy working in collaborative, mission\-driven, innovative environments? Then apply today for this Software Engineer Lead opportunity! ASU EdPlus is a dynamic unit of Arizona State University focused on the design and scalable delivery of digital teaching and learning models to increase student success and reduce barriers to achievement in higher education. We advance the economic, social, cultural, and overall health of the local, national, and international communities served by ASU. Curious about what it’s like to work at EdPlus? Watch this short video , then explore more stories on the EdPlus at ASU YouTube channel . We are seeking a motivated, self\-directed **Software Engineer** **Lead** to join our Solutions Engineering team. Every day you will make a difference in the lives of others by helping solve some of the most complex challenges facing transfer learners in higher education. You will lead the design and development of digital solutions that simplify the transfer experience, from transcript ingestion and course\-equivalency evaluation to articulation, review, and learner\-facing reporting. These solutions will use artificial intelligence, automation, and modern cloud technologies to reduce friction, improve transparency, and shorten a learner’s path to completing a degree. This role extends beyond traditional software development. You will provide technical direction, guide architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and help advance modern engineering practices across the organization, including the responsible use of AI\-assisted development tools and agentic workflows. The EdPlus Solutions Engineering team creates and enhances technology solutions for a variety of learner challenges. Working collaboratively across disciplines, the team develops thoughtful, forward\-looking experiences that support the strategies and goals of ASU and EdPlus. **Essential Duties:** * Design, develop, and support secure, scalable digital services that improve the experience and outcomes of transfer learners. * Provide technical leadership across backend services, integration layers, asynchronous processing systems, and learner\- and administrator\-facing web applications. * Architect end\-to\-end transfer workflows, including document ingestion and storage, AI\-assisted extraction, queued processing, equivalency evaluation, articulation\-system integration, human review, reporting, and document generation. * Own and evolve HTTP and event\-driven contracts between services and client applications, including API versioning, payload design, compatibility, and coordinated delivery across repositories. * Design durable integrations with University platforms and third\-party services, accounting for availability, data consistency, retries, idempotency, auditability, and operational failure modes. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, architects, institutional stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate learner needs and organizational goals into effective technical solutions; lead technical planning and architectural discussions to clarify scope, integrations, risks, dependencies, and implementation approaches. * Establish and promote engineering practices for architecture, code quality, test\-driven development, documentation, observability, security, accessibility, and production support; ensure appropriate handling of student academic records and other sensitive information in accordance with ASU data\-governance requirements, security policies, and FERPA obligations. * Maintain clear technical documentation, including domain glossaries, architecture decision records, API contracts, operational runbooks, and repository guidance for engineers and AI\-assisted development tools. * Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful technical direction, and support effective delivery within a collaborative, inclusive, agile working environment; maintain technical currency, pursue professional development opportunities, and contribute to the broader information technology and engineering community across Arizona State University. * Define res t employees, student workers seeking staff opportunities, and students applying for student worker positions must apply directly through the Workday Jobs Hub . To be considered, your application must include all of the following attachments: * Cover letter Resume or CV * Multiple documents may be uploaded in the attachments section. Please ensure your resume includes all employment information in month and year format, for example 6/04 to 8/14, along with job title, job duties, and employer name for each position. Your resume should clearly demonstrate how your experience and background meet the minimum and desired qualifications for this position. Incomplete applications or missing required materials may not be considered. **Important:** Do not withdraw your application to make edits. Once an application is withdrawn, it cannot be edited, reactivated, or replaced with a new submission. If you have questions or need assistance, please contact The Office of Human Resources Talent Acquisition before the posting close date. Graduate Assistant, Intern and part\-time positions are counted as half time for experience equivalency, meaning one year equals six months of experience. Only electronic applications will be accepted for this position. By submitting an application, you confirm that the information provided is accurate and complete. **ASU Statement:** Arizona State University is a new model for American higher education, an unprecedented combination of academic excellence, entrepreneurial energy and broad access. This New American University is a single, unified institution comprising four differentiated campuses positively impacting the economic, social, cultural and environmental health of the communities it serves. Its research is inspired by real world application blurring the boundaries that traditionally separate academic disciplines. ASU serves more than 100,000 students in metropolitan Phoenix, Arizona, the nation's fifth largest city. ASU champions inclusive excellence, and welcomes students from all fifty states and more than one hundred nations across the globe. ASU is a tobacco\-free university. For details visit https://wellness.asu.edu/explore\-wellness/body/alcohol\-and\-drugs/tobacco All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. **Notice of Availability of the ASU Annual Security and Fire Safety Report:** In compliance with federal law, ASU prepares an annual report on campus security and fire safety programs and resources. ASU’s Annual Security and Fire Safety Report is available online at https://www.asu.edu/police/PDFs/ASU\-Clery\-Report.pdf . You may request a hard copy of the report by contacting the ASU Police Department at 480\-965\-3456\. Relocation Assistance – For information about schools, housing child resources, neighborhoods, hospitals, community events, and taxes, visit https://cfo.asu.edu/az\-resources . Visit the ASU Compensation Estimator **Employment Verification Statement:** ASU conducts pre\-employment screening which may include verification of work history, academic credentials, licenses, and certifications. **Background Check Statement:** ASU conducts pre\-employment screening for all positions which includes a criminal background check, verification of work history, academic credentials, licenses, and certifications. jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description: **Building Healthcare That Remembers** ====================================== Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to. At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 285 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1\.6 million decision pathways. We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026\. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C at a $1\.2 billion valuation from investors including Menlo Ventures and Lightspeed. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list! Healthcare spends $1\.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below. **About the Role** ================== We’re looking for a Technical Recruiter to own full cycle recruiting for our engineering and Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) roles. You’ll run searches from intake to close, partner directly with technical leadership, and shape how we hire as we grow. This is not a sourcing\-only role. You’ll be involved in offer negotiations, offer strategy, hiring strategy, and interview process design. You’ll start with SWE and FDE hiring, and as the engineering team builds out new swimlanes in the coming year, you’ll have the chance to hire across a much wider range of roles. Our technical recruiting team is small today, which means you’ll have a real hand in structuring a new and growing org. The processes, playbooks, and standards you build will become how we hire at scale. **What You'll Do** ================== * Own full cycle recruiting for junior to mid\-level FDE and engineering roles, from intake through close * Partner closely with technical leadership to drive impact across the technical recruiting org * Run intake meetings with hiring managers and align on what each role needs * Source, screen, and move candidates through the process * Lead offer strategy and negotiations, and close candidates * Help shape hiring strategy, including workforce planning, role scoping, and sourcing approaches * Expand into new roles and teams as engineering grows * Work with the recruiting team, People Operations, and the tech side of the business, and help define how the technical recruiting org operates as it scales **What You Bring** ================== * 2\+ years of full cycle tech recruiting experience * Experience hiring engineers * Recent startup experience * A clear interest in full cycle recruiting, not just sourcing * Comfort working with senior stakeholders and technical leaders * Autonomy, drive, and self\-motivation, with an appetite for building structure where little exists **Nice to Have** ================ * Leadership hiring experience * Product hiring experience **Tools You'll Work With** ========================== * Ashby * Juicebox * LinkedIn Recruiter * Notion **Benefits \& Perks for Assorties** =================================== * **Competitive Compensation** – Including salary *and* employee stock options so you share in our success. * **Lifelong Learning** – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow. * **Office Setup Stipend** – We’ll outfit your in\-office workspace so comfy as it's productive. * **Top\-Tier Health Coverage** – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first. * **Flexible PTO** – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it. * **Meals \& Snacks** – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas. * **Fitness Stipend** – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health. * **Commuter Benefits** – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier. * **401(k)** – Build your retirement savings. **How We Work \& What We Value** ================================ Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide *how* we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a **Day One Drive**, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a **5\-Star Focus**, as our customers are our lifeblood, always **Answer the Call**, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with **One Pulse**, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you! **Please note:** the Assort Health Talent Team will only email you from an assorthealth.com email address. Compensation Range: $120K \- $170K

jobs.title: Quality Engineer I
jobs.description: Availity delivers revenue cycle and related business solutions for health care professionals who want to build healthy, thriving organizations. Availity has the powerful tools, actionable insights and expansive network reach that medical businesses need to get an edge in an industry constantly redefined by change. At Availity, we're not just another Healthcare Technology company; we're pioneers reshaping the future of healthcare! With our headquarters in vibrant Jacksonville, FL, and an exciting office in Bangalore, India, along with an exceptional remote workforce across the United States, we're a global team united by a powerful mission. We're on a mission to bring the focus back to what truly matters – patient care. As the leading healthcare engagement platform, we're the heartbeat of an industry that impacts millions. With over 2 million providers connected to health plans, and processing over 13 billion transactions annually, our influence is continually expanding. Join our energetic, dynamic, and forward\-thinking team where your ideas are celebrated, innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. We're transforming the healthcare landscape, solving communication challenges, and creating connections that empower the nation's premier healthcare ecosystem. The Quality Assurance Engineer I is responsible for continuously improving the quality of the company’s product line by preventing, quickly detecting, and validating product and process defects, to deliver market and customer driven business results. You will evaluate the test results, prepare change requests, and generate measures to assess the product quality. In this role you will work with an integrated team of developers, product managers, product owners, and system analysts for test planning, test Automation and execution, and product validation. Sponsorship, in any form, is not available for this position. **Location: Remote, US – Eastern/Central Time zones Preferred** **Why work on this team?** * You want to work on a high‑transactional platform that directly impacts patient experience, where quality and reliability truly matter * You are excited to be part of a team that continually improves processes and enhances platform capabilities * You approach testing pragmatically — driving complete coverage, elevating risk when needed, incorporating stakeholder input, and owning outcomes. * You are a quality evangelist who is passionate about delivering high‑performing, functional software to the healthcare industry * You want to learn new approaches to Quality at the speed of AI! **What you will be doing** * Assigned to a Scrum team, you will be developing test plans, test scenarios and test cases based on the business, user, and functional/nonfunctional requirements * Participating in daily stand ups, sprint planning and refinement meetings * Utilizing JIRA for project planning and tracking * Collaborating with the Product Owner and Engineers on a regular basis * Conducting automated tests using user\-level test As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. In this role, you will work at the intersection of polymer chemistry, physics, interface science, and AI/ML\-enabled materials development to advance our scientific understanding. You will be instrumental in transforming how we develop materials in R\&D to accelerate our innovation trajectories and translate scientific concepts into actionable, practical technology solutions for our global manufacturing footprint. Key Responsibilities * On\-site * Drive fundamental understanding and insights of complex materials and phenomena, including silicone and non\-silicone release coatings, polymeric adhesives, gels, differentiated products. * Identify and drive appropriate experimentation and/or modeling approaches to construct sound scientific structure\-property\-process\-performance fundamentals. * Work with cross\-functional teams to translate concepts to reality and construct careful experiments to prove or disprove hypotheses by blending scientifically driven experimentation with predictive computational insights. * Establish the scientific and experimental foundation for autonomous self\-driving laboratory capabilities by connecting automated high\-throughput experimentation, scientific databases, predictive models, and human scientific judgement. **Qualifications** Qualifications * PhD in Polymer or Materials Science and Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or a closely\-related discipline. * Minimum of 7 years of direct industrial R\&D experience in developing novel materials paradigms with demonstrated expertise in polymer science, coatings, or related with the use of automated high\-throughput experimentation, robotics, self\-driving autonomous laboratory concepts, or developing model\-ready scientific databases is highly desirable. * Industrial R\&D experience with silicone release coatings, release liners, silicone formulations or related technologies is highly preferred. **Additional Information** Pay Transparency The salary range for this jobs.title: Validation Engineer
jobs.description: **Title:** Validation Engineer – Systems \& Platform Validation (Lab) Job Overview BOXX Technologies in Austin, TX builds high\-performance workstations and servers to order. We’re seeking a Validation Engineer to join our engineering team. You will design, write and execute test plans in our lab to validate new platforms, components and software configurations before they are released to production. Your work ensures that what we build is stable, performant and reliable. You’ll work with engineering, production and support to find issues early and drive fixes. Duties Write detailed test plans and test cases for new hardware platforms, components (CPU, multi\-GPU, memory, storage, cooling, power), BIOS, firmware, drivers and OS images. **Execute those test plans in the lab:** functional, compatibility, stress, thermal, power, performance and long\-duration stability testing. Develop and maintain automated test scripts and tooling for Linux and Windows to make testing repeatable and efficient. Log, reproduce and root\-cause failures. Work with engineering and vendors to resolve them. Document results in clear validation reports, with a pass/fail recommendation before release to production. Support production and technical support by reproducing field issues in the lab. Maintain lab equipment, test configurations and a library of reference builds. Requirements Strong working knowledge of both Linux and Windows, including installation, configuration and troubleshooting at the OS level. Competence in scripting languages such as Python, Bash and PowerShell. You should be able to automate test runs and collect and analyze results. Hands\-on experience with PC workstation or server hardware, including GPUs, memory, storage and thermal behavior. Experience writing test plans and documenting results. Strong analytical and root\-cause skills, and attention to detail. Clear written and verbal communication. Preferred Experience with NVIDIA GPU platforms, multi\-GPU or AI/ML workloads. Experience with benchmark and stress tools and hardware diagnostics. Background in PC OEM, system integrator, or hardware validation or QA. Certifications such as A\+, MCP/MCSE, Red Hat.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer, Sr AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast\-to\-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring. *Baker Tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.* *Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.* **Job Description:** ==================== Baker Tilly is seeking a **Principal AI Engineer, Sr AI Engineer** to join the founding team of the firm's AI Product Group (APG) Agent Factory, responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI\-powered applications and intelligent agentic workflows across Tax, Assurance, and Advisory. This hands\-on, full\-stack engineering role focuses on building production\-ready AI solutions that combine advanced AI capabilities with intuitive user experiences and practical business workflows. Working directly with firm practitioners and subject matter experts, this individual will translate complex business processes into scalable AI\-enabled solutions, develop applications that support professional review and decision\-making, and deliver innovative technology that drives measurable business value. As an early member of the AI Product Group, this individual will collaborate closely with product, design, data, platform engineering, and globally distributed technical teams to develop and deliver AI solutions from initial concept through production deployment. The role emphasizes strong software engineering fundamentals, evaluation\-driven development, hands\-on execution, and direct collaboration with business stakeholders. The ideal candidate is a highly capable, adaptable engineer with demonstrated experience delivering full\-stack applications, deploying LLM\-powered features to real users, and learning emerging technologies quickly. **Responsibilities** * **Design and Develop AI\-Powered Solutions:** Build, implement, and maintain AI agents and multi\-step workflows, including task decomposition, orchestration, context and memory management, tool integration, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and failure handling. * **Deliver Full\-Stack Applications:** Develop production\-quality applications, backend services, APIs, data models, dashboards, conversational interfaces, and user\-facing workflows that enable practitioners to interact effectively with AI\-powered solutions. * **Translate Business Needs into Technical Solutions:** Collaborate directly with Tax, Assurance, and Advisory professionals and subject matter experts to understand business processes, identify opportunities for automation, and translate professional expertise into actionable requirements and working software. * **Drive Evaluation\-Based Development:** Establish measurable hypotheses, testing criteria, evaluation frameworks, and performance baselines to validate AI capabilities, assess solution quality, and inform technical decisions before production deployment. * **Develop Testing and Quality Standards:** Build and maintain  rticipate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned to advance the firm's AI engineering capabilities and business priorities. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred. * **5 years of hands\-on software engineering experience**, including demonstrated success designing, developing, and delivering multiple production\-quality applications or products from concept through deployment. * Required experience deploying at least one LLM\-powered feature or application to real users, regardless of scale. * Required experience working directly with domain experts, business stakeholders, or customers to translate requirements into technical solutions and take ownership of delivered outcomes. * Strong full\-stack software engineering experience, including backend services, data models, APIs, and modern user\-facing applications. * Deep proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language, such as Python, TypeScript, Go, or Java, with demonstrated understanding of language fundamentals, design patterns, and production\-quality development practices. * Ability to quickly learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and technologies; familiarity with Python and TypeScript preferred. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, application architecture, automated testing, debugging, performance optimization, and development of scalable, maintainable systems. * Experience developing and integrating modern web applications, APIs, authentication mechanisms, and secure enterprise services. * Demonstrated ability to validate technical solutions through measurable outcomes, including automated testing, benchmarks, experiments, evaluation frameworks, or A/B testing. * Strong analytical thinking, technical judgment, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate trade\-offs, resolve ambiguity, and develop practical solutions to complex challenges. * Experience collaborating with nontechnical stakeholders and subject matter experts, with the ability to explain technical concepts and recommendations in clear, business\-focused language. * Familiarity with LLM applications, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), AI evaluation methodologies, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) preferred. * Exposure to agentic AI concepts, including orchestration, tool use, context management, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows preferred; prior experience building AI agents is not required. * Experience with cloud\-based application development and technologies such as Microsoft Azure, containers, PostgreSQL, and React preferred. * Experience working in professional services, regulated industries, or environments serving highly specialized business users preferred; prior Tax, Assurance, or Accounting experience is not required. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical solutions, articulate design decisions, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, adapt quickly to evolving requirements, and deliver high\-quality solutions in a fast\-paced environment. * Experience using AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to enhance engineering productivity, or a strong willingness to incorporate these technologies into daily development practices. * No professional certifications or licenses required. *The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employee*s. *The national pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* *In California: pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* \#LI\-AC1

jobs.description: **Junior Software Engineer** Location: On\-site (Glendale, California) Department: Engineering Salary: $70,000 to $85,000 per year **About Us** At Bambee HR, we are fundamentally changing how organizations build, manage, and empower their workforces. Our AI is not just a tool stacked on top of existing software; its intelligence is built to cognitively work within the very fabric of an organization. We are building a future where data\-driven insights align with human potential, and we need exceptional engineering minds to help us build it. **The Role** We are seeking a curious, analytical Junior Software Engineer to join our core platform team. In this role, you will learn from experienced engineers while contributing real code to systems at the intersection of human behavior, machine learning, and scalable architecture. If you are excited by data, enjoy untangling complex logic, and want to grow in an environment built on collaborative reasoning, this is the place for you. You will work alongside data scientists, product leaders, and senior engineers to help build systems that process large datasets and deliver real\-time, actionable insights that shape the future of work. **What You'll Do** * Build and Ship: Take on well\-defined features and fixes, write clean, tested code, and see your work reach production. * Learn the Data: Help build and maintain systems that process HR and behavioral data to feed our AI models, with guidance from senior engineers. * Collaborate and Ask Questions: Join whiteboarding sessions, code reviews, and brainstorming. Bring your perspective and ask the questions that sharpen a solution. * Communicate Clearly: Explain your work and your thinking in code reviews, documentation, and team discussions. * Grow Your Craft: Learn our engineering practices, take feedback openly, and steadily take on more ownership. **What We're Looking For** * Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. * Experience: Internship, co\-op, or project experience building software. Personal and open\-source projects count. * Scrappy and Adaptable: The engineers that do best here are the ones who can be scrappy and able to adapt quickly to new information and shifting priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong Reasoning Skills: You think critically, look for edge cases, and like working problems out from first principles. * Team\-Oriented Problem Solver: You check your ego at the door. You enjoy working through problems with others and actively seek out different perspectives. * Curiosity About Data: Interest in data pipelines, databases, and data processing. Coursework or projects involving data or machine learning are a plus. * Clear Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, and a willingness to ask for help when you need it. * Technical Foundation: Working knowledge of Python or TypeScript. Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform is a plus. * Location: This is an on\-site role. You must live within commuting distance of Glendale, CA, or be able to reliably commute to our office. **Why Join Us?** * Meaningful Impact: You will be building software that directly impacts how people experience their work lives globally. * Modern Stack: Work with modern tools and AI technologies in a space where innovation is the baseline, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who is endlessly curious, stays at the forefront of AI and software technology, and knows when to think a problem through and when to settle it with a working prototype. jobs.title: Platform Engineer - AI Guardrails (OpenShift)
jobs.description: **Job Description:** At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! **Job Description:** This role engineers and operates enterprise vendor platforms in our on\-premises Red Hat OpenShift environment. You will own the deployment, configuration, reliability, and day\-to\-day support of the AI guardrails platform that sits in the request path of GenAI applications across the bank. Because the platform is inline with production traffic, availability, latency, and fast recovery matter as much as features. jobs.title: SolidWorks 3D Designer
jobs.description: Description: **About Bentley Mission Critical** Bentley Mission Critical manufactures factory\-built infrastructure for the world’s most demanding data centers. From our ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Greeley, Colorado, we engineer, fabricate, and test complete modular data center systems — pre\-integrating mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems in a controlled factory environment to deliver projects 30–50% faster than traditional construction. Our customers include hyperscale, AI/GPU compute, colocation, and enterprise data center operators. We don’t build projects — we manufacture products, and we do it quality\-driven, on time, every time. We are growing fast, and our people are the reason. This role exists to make sure that as we scale, we stay a place where skilled, motivated people want to build their careers. **Position Summary** The 3D Designer – SolidWorks is responsible for developing production\-ready 3D models, assemblies, and fabrication drawings for Bentley Mission Critical’s modular data center products, including structural frames, enclosures, skids, platforms, electrical rooms, and supporting infrastructure. This position translates customer blueprints and engineering requirements into accurate SolidWorks models that can be fabricated efficiently on our shop floor. This role is built around Design for Manufacturing. Every model and drawing must be buildable, standardized, and designed to support Lean Manufacturing and one\-piece flow through cutting, forming, welding, and assembly — so production builds it right the first time, on time, every time. **Performance Metrics** * First\-Pass Drawing Accuracy (Right First Time) * On\-Time Drawing Release * Design\-Related Shop Rework \& RFI Reduction * Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) per Project * Design Hours vs. Estimate * Material Utilization \& Scrap Reduction * Part Standardization \& Library Reuse * DFM Improvements Implemented * Quality Escapes/NCRs Attributed to Design * Support of One\-Piece Flow \& Production Throughput \*Must be 18 years or older to apply\* **Key Responsibilities** **SolidWorks 3D Modeling – Data Center Products** * Create detailed 3D part models, large assemblies, and weldments in SolidWorks for modular data center structures, enclosures, skids, platforms, and related components. * Build top\-level and sub\-level assemblies that accurately represent the complete data center product for fabrication, assembly, and installation. * Produce fabrication\-ready drawings including dimensions, tolerances, GD\&T where required, weld symbols, BOMs, cut lists, and sheet metal flat patterns. * Maintain clean model structure, file naming, configurations, and revision control per department standards. * Develop and maintain a library of standard parts, templates, and reusable design components. **Design for Manufacturing (DFM)** * Ensure every model and drawing can be fabricated with our available equipment, processes, materials, and tooling. * Design sheet metal, structural steel, and welded components with correct bend allowances, material thicknesses, hole patterns, and weld access. * Reduce part count, material waste, cutting and welding time, and assembly complexity through design. * Standardize components and hardware across projects to simplify purchasing, inventory, and production. * Work directly with fabrication and production teams to resolve build issues and incorporate shop feedback. **Lean Manufacturing \& One\-Piece Flow** * Apply Lean Manufacturing principles to eliminate waste (overprocessing, motion, waiting, rework, and defects) at the design stage. * Design parts and assemblies that move through production in one\-piece flow, minimizing batching and work\-in\-process. * Develop modular, sequenced assemblies aligned with production cells and takt time. * Participate in Kaizen events, value stream mapping, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Support visual work instructions, assembly sequences, and exploded views for the shop floor. **Blueprint Review \& Interpretation** * Read, review, and interpret engineering blueprints, architectural and structural drawings, customer specifications, and vendor submittals. * Translate customer drawings and requirements into accurate SolidWorks models and fabrication packages. * Perform design checks for dimensions, fit, interferences, tolerances, and constructability before release to production. * Identify discrepancies or missing information and communicate them through RFIs to engineering leadership and customers. **Collaboration \& Communication** * Work closely with Development, Sales, Customer, and Production \& Support Engineering to meet project schedules. * Support engineering change orders (ECOs), revisions, and as\-built documentation. * Communicate clearly with engineers, fabricators, installers, and customers in English. **Physical Demands** The physical demands and work environment described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work Environment: Work is primarily performed in an indoor office setting at a computer workstation for extended periods, with regular time on the manufacturing shop floor to review fabrication and assembly. Required PPE must be worn on the shop floor. **Benefits** Offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package: * Medical, dental and vision insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Paid time off (PTO) * Life and disability Insurance *Benefits may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.* **Equal Opportunity Employer** Bentley Mission Critical is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Requirements: **Required** * Minimum 5 years of SolidWorks 3D design experience in a manufacturing or fabrication environment. * Engineering background: degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering or related field, or equivalent engineering experience. * Advanced SolidWorks proficiency: parts, large assemblies, weldments, sheet metal, configurations, and detailed drawings. * Demonstrated portfolio of SolidWorks projects (portfolio required with application). * Strong Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA) knowledge — models that can be fabricated. * Lean Manufacturing knowledge with a strong one\-piece flow mentality. * Proven ability to review and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and specifications. * Fluent in English, written and spoken. **Preferred** * Data center or mission\-critical infrastructure design experience. * Spanish is a plus (bilingual English/Spanish). * Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma certification. * SolidWorks PDM experience and/or CSWP/CSWE certification. * Experience with nesting software and CNC, laser, or plasma cutting workflows. * Knowledge of GD\&T and AWS welding symbols; familiarity with AutoCAD or Revit.
