jobs.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer, Simulation
jobs.description: **About Bonsai Robotics** Bonsai Robotics develops affordable, vision\-based autonomy that makes off\-road equipment smarter, safer, and more productive. We are redefining outdoor autonomy with Bonsai Intelligence, a connected platform that’s inspired by biology to see, think, and act with precision like a human. We bring together advanced perception, embodied AI, integrations with equipment manufacturers, and our compact, modular Amiga vehicles to deliver reliable automation to the world’s most demanding field operations—reducing costs and increasing operational efficiencies. **About the role** We are seeking a **Senior Robotics Software Engineer, Simulation** to build and own our simulation platform. Our machines work in orchards, vineyards, and bedded crops, in changing light and weather, and across several vehicle form factors. Field time is expensive, slow, and seasonal. Simulation is how we close that gap: it is where every software release is regression\-tested, where field failures are reproduced and fixed, and where we generate synthetic data to train our perception models. This role owns that platform end to end, from vehicle, sensor, and environment models to the CI pipelines and metrics that tell us whether a change is safe to ship. Above all, we care that what passes in simulation also works in the field. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic robotics engineer who is comfortable from physics and rendering up to CI infrastructure, and who treats "we can only find out in the field" as a bug. **What you'll do** * Build and maintain simulation environments that model real field conditions, including orchards, vineyards, bedded crops, uneven terrain, and variable lighting and weather. * Own the interface between the simulator and our ROS 2 autonomy stack, and build SIL and HIL frameworks that run the full stack (perception, planning, and controls) in closed loop. * Turn field logs into simulation: replay recorded drives, reproduce field failures as regression scenarios, and grow a scenario library that covers the edge cases our machines actually encounter. * Create and maintain sensor models (cameras, GNSS/RTK, IMUs, LiDAR), including noise and failure modes, calibrated against real hardware. * Model vehicle dynamics and terrain interaction for multiple robot form factors, using system identification against real vehicle data. * Build automated scenario generation, evaluation metrics, and reporting, so every change to the autonomy stack is tested in simulation in CI before it reaches a machine. * Keep simulation fast, deterministic, and reproducible, and measure how well simulation results predict real\-world behavior. * Generate synthetic data for perception training, working with the ML team on domain randomization and generative methods. * Work with the perception, controls, and platform teams to define simulation requirements and prioritize the sim\-to\-real gaps that matter most. **Qualifications** * Strong computer science fundamentals and systems fluency * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, with 5\+ years of industry experience in robotics software engineering and a significant focus on simulation * 2\+ years building SIL, HIL, or closed\-loop evaluation systems used in production * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ and Python, and the ability to read and debug a large existing codebase * Experience building simulation environments with platforms such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or similar * Familiarity with physics engines (PhysX, Bullet, MuJoCo, oration * Deep understanding of ROS 2 * Experience integrating simulation into CI/CD pipelines for * A pragmatic approach to engineering: you choose the simplest model that answers the question and avoid over\-engineering * Strong debugging, testing, and problem\-solving skills, withendently and collaboratively **Exceptional Candidates Will Also Bring** * Rust programming experience * Exposure to agricultural, construction, or off\-road robotics * Experience with digital twins or synthetic data generation * Experience using world models (e.g., NVIDIA Cosmos or similar generative video models) for synthetic data generation or scenario augmentation * Experience with neural reconstruction (3D Gaussian Splattinon scenes from real sensor data * Familiarity with USD/OpenUSD scene formats * Experience with sim\-to\-real transfer techniques (domain ranication) * GPU\-accelerated rendering or ray tracing for camera simulation * Experience with NVIDIA Jetson or other embedded deployment **Life at Bonsai Robotics** At Bonsai, we're building the future of robotics and we know that means investing in our people. We're committed to creating a workplace where you can do your best work, grow your skills, and feel genuinely part of something bigger. **Hybrid Flexibility (for selective roles)** We operate on a hybrid model because we believe the best collaboration happens both in person and from where you work best. You'll have the flexibility to split your time between our office and home, so you can stay connected to the team while maintaining the balance that works for you. **Work\-life Balance** The best employees are those who create balance in their lives, which is why we prioritize balance and well\-being for everyone at Bonsai. We foster a supportive environment where teammates look out for each other. **Covered Lunch** On in\-office days, we've got lunch covered. It's a small thing that makes a big difference, with more time to connect with teammates and less to worry about. **Wellness and Benefits** Your health matters. We offer comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), mental health support, and wellness programs designed to help you thrive both physically and mentally. **Collaborative Culture** At Bonsai, you're not just part of a team, you're part of a community. We celebrate wins together, support each other through challenges, and genuinely enjoy the people we work with. From team events to cross\-functional collaboration, we're building something together. **Mission\-driven Work** Every day, you're contributing to advancements in robotics that matter. If you're excited about innovation and impact, you'll find it here. Bonsai Robotics is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law. **The pay range for this role is:** 180,000 \- 215,000 USD per year(San Jose, CA)

sequence modeling, pattern recognition, or vector embeddings to log classification, failure mode retrieval, or automated root cause analysis. * In\-depth understanding of autonomous driving software architectures (perception, sensor fusion, localization, motion planning, vehicle control). * Experience operating within SiL, HiL, or cloud\-based replay and simulation testing setups at scale. * Experience with distributed frameworks and data tools such as PySpark, Ray, Databricks/Snowflake, Vector DBs, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes, and AWS/GCP services. **Additional Information** We offer a competitive base salary for this position with a range in US\-California of \-$185,000 \- $215,000 along with an annual corporate bonus, and a long\-term incentive bonus designed to reward sustained impact and contribution over time. Within the salary range, the individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc. Your well\-being matters at Bosch! We offer a a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. Your Recruiter can share more details for this position during the interview process. Learn more about our full benefits offerings by visiting: https://www.myboschbenefits.com/public/welcome. **Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.** * Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug\-testing. jobs.title: WordPress Developer
jobs.description: Build Websites. Solve Problems. Grow Your Skills. Brevard SEM is a digital marketing and web development agency in Melbourne, Florida, and we’re looking for a hands\-on WordPress developer to join our in\-house team. We’re looking for someone who enjoys building websites, solving problems, learning new technology, and getting things done. You don’t need to know everything. You do need to have real WordPress experience, a solid understanding of how websites work, and the confidence to jump into existing projects. You’ll work alongside experienced designers, developers, and digital marketing professionals who can help you expand your skills while you contribute to real client projects. We care more about your ability, initiative, and willingness to learn than the number of years on your résumé. What You’ll Be Doing You’ll be involved in a variety of website projects for businesses across different industries. * Building and updating WordPress websites for new and existing clients. * Troubleshooting website problems, plugin conflicts, layout issues, and functionality. * Maintaining client websites, including updates, backups, and performance improvements. * Creating new pages, landing pages, forms, and website features. * Working on ecommerce websites, including WooCommerce and Shopify. * Making changes to existing websites, including projects built by other developers. * Turning designs and creative direction from our team into responsive, functional websites. * Working with hosting platforms, domains, website migrations, and staging environments. * Helping improve website speed, mobile usability, and overall performance. * Testing your work carefully before updates go live. * Collaborating with our team to complete projects efficiently and meet deadlines. You’ll have a mix of new builds, ongoing improvements, and technical troubleshooting. We value someone who can stay organized, move between projects, and take initiative when challenges arise. What We’re Looking For WordPress experience is essential. You should already be comfortable working in WordPress, building pages, managing plugins, making website changes, and troubleshooting common issues. Beyond that, we’re looking for someone who has: * A solid understanding of website structure, functionality, and responsive design. * Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with an interest in developing broader coding skills. * Experience building and maintaining professional websites, not just updating content. * The ability to investigate problems, research solutions, and follow through. * Good attention to detail and pride in producing polished work. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to complete assigned tasks promptly. * Clear communication skills and a willingness to work closely with a team. * The motivation to learn new platforms, tools, and development techniques. Additional skills we’d love to see, but don’t require: * Shopify and WooCommerce experience. * JavaScript, PHP, or custom WordPress development. * WordPress Gutenberg, Advanced Custom Fields, or custom themes. * Git, GitHub, and version control. * Hosting management, DNS, and website migrations. * Website speed optimization and technical SEO. * Figma or experience implementing professional website designs. * React, Next.js, or other modern web development technologies. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools. If you have strong WordPress skills but haven’t worked with every platform on this list, we still encourage you to apply. A Little About How We Work We believe good websites require more than installing a template and changing a few pictures. We appreciate developers who understand how websites function, care about performance, and are willing to learn better ways of building things. We don’t rely exclusively on drag\-and\-drop page builders, although experience with those tools can still be useful. We’re also enthusiastic about AI\-assisted development. We use modern tools to work smarter and faster, but we believe developers should understand what they’re building and be able to recognize and fix problems independently. You won’t be expected to figure everything out alone. Our experienced team is available to collaborate, provide direction, and help you expand your technical knowledge. Who Would Do Well Here? Someone who enjoys technology and naturally looks for solutions. You might be a relatively new developer with strong practical skills, or someone who’s been building websites for years and wants to work in a more collaborative environment. What matters most is that you: * Take initiative and don’t need constant reminders to move work forward. * Enjoy solving problems and learning how things work. * Ask good questions when you need help. * Can manage your time and complete work without unnecessary delays. * Communicate progress and take responsibility for your work. * Want to become better at what you do. Why Join Brevard SEM? We’re an established digital marketing agency working with businesses across a variety of industries. Joining our team means you’ll gain exposure to much more than WordPress. You’ll have opportunities to learn about ecommerce, digital marketing, search engine optimization, website performance, analytics, design, and modern web technologies. You’ll work directly with experienced professionals who are happy to share their knowledge, while gaining hands\-on experience with real client websites and meaningful projects. We encourage curiosity, new ideas, professional growth, and the responsible use of modern technology. This is a long\-term opportunity for someone who wants to develop their career and become an important part of our team. Position Details * Location: Melbourne, FL (Brevard County) * Work environment: In\-office, working directly with our team * Employment: Full\-time * Schedule: Monday through Friday, regular business hours * Compensation: $20–$30 per hour, based on experience and demonstrated skills * Start: We’re actively interviewing and looking to fill the position soon How to Apply Send us your résumé along with two or three examples of websites you’ve built or substantially worked on. Tell us a little about what you personally contributed to those projects and which platforms you used. A college degree is not required. We’re more interested in what you can do, how you approach problems, and your willingness to grow. If you enjoy building websites and want to be part of a team where you can contribute, learn, and develop your skills, we’d like to hear from you. Brevard SEM is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Benefits: * Paid time off Application Question(s): * Describe a real WordPress website you independently built, maintained, or troubleshot. What work did you personally perform, and how did you test the results? * Describe a real technical website issue you encountered. How did you investigate and diagnose it, what did you do to resolve it, and how did you verify the fix? * Provide links to 2–3 real websites you built or substantially worked on. For each, explain your specific contributions and the platforms used. * Are you available to work full\-time, in our Melbourne, Florida office, Monday through Friday during regular business hours? This is an in\-office position. Please confirm your availability. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Solutions · Full\-time · San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Remote SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ### **About the role** You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production\-grade SpaceXAI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer’s auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer’s repo and delivery system and ship an agent\-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident\-to\-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar. Either way, you measure what matters, leave the customer able to operate it, and bring the pattern back as another use case for SpaceXAI. This is not a demo role. You own the work end to end, from the first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post\-launch support, and you are responsible for systems that work in the real world. ### **What you’ll do** * Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics * Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding\-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org * Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage * Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs * Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever * Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption * Work directly with Staff\+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results * Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXAI products ### **You may be a fit if** * You have 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science * You write and review production code (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript; other languages welcome) * You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system * You’ve built and owned AI\-native workflows or agents in production, and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path) * You’ve handled production reliability: metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response * You build end to end: frontend, backend, infra, and prompt iteration * You thrive in ambiguity and don’t need a complete spec before you start building * You can talk to working engineers and to a VP ### **Nice to have** * 2\+ years in a customer\-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders * Hands\-on depth in several of: agents and tool\-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI\-native coding workflows in a real repo * Experience as a forward\-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

The work spans UI through API to data access, with real production constraints around security, multi\-tenant access, and reliability. You will own features end\-to\-end: design and ship frontend experiences, implement backend APIs and integrations, and keep the path from browser to data clean, tested, and deployable. This is a hands\-on build role with strong mentorship and direct exposure to architecture decisions. **What You'll Do** * Build and maintain frontend applications with React / Next.js — pages, components, forms, and data\-driven UI. * Design and implement backend APIs (Python) \- REST/JSON endpoints, auth\-aware access, validation, and error handling. * Integrate frontend and backend: API contracts, auth flows (JWT / session), loading and error states, and end\-to\-end feature delivery. * Work with data stores and platform services (Postgres/Prisma, BigQuery clients, Redis, object storage) as features require. * Collaborate on gateway and auth boundaries (tokens, permissions, service\-to\-service calls) with platform engineers. * Write tests and documentation for UI and API changes; land work through Git\-based PRs and CI/CD. * Instrument and debug production issues across the stack — browser, API, and dependency failures. * Support SOC 2\-aligned practices: least\-privilege access in the app layer, secrets handling, change control, and audit\-friendly logging. * Partner with data, platform, and product stakeholders on scope, trade\-offs, and delivery. * Participate in design discussions, surface trade\-offs, and propose improvements as you encounter them in the code. **Required Qualifications** * 8\-11 years as a full stack engineer (or equivalent split frontend \+ backend experience). * Strong frontend skills: React (and preferably Next.js), TypeScript/JavaScript, modern CSS/component libraries, and client\-side data fetching. * Strong backend skills: building and maintaining production APIs (Python preferred; Node or Go also fine) \- routing, auth, validation, and persistence. * Experience wiring frontend to backend: API design, auth (JWT/OAuth or similar), and debugging full request paths. * Comfortable with SQL and at least one relational database; able to model simple schemas and write efficient queries. * Working knowledge of Git, pull request workflows, and CI/CD for web apps and APIs. * Clear written communication \- PR descriptions, API notes, and design trade\-offs. **Preferred Qualifications** * Next.js App Router, React Server Components, and/or MUI (or similar design systems). * Prisma, SQLAlchemy, or equivalent ORM experience. * Go for services/gateways, or prior work with API gateways and JWT/Redis auth patterns. * GCP and/or AWS application development (Cloud Run, GKE, S3/GCS, Secrets Manager). * Experience with data\-heavy or AI\-assisted products (search UIs, dashboards, inference APIs). * Prior work in SOC 2 or similarly controlled environments. Pay: $70\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Mechanical Engineer \- Sustaining supports Cantrell\-Gainco equipment throughout its life through engineer\-to\-order (ETO) processing, product life\-cycle management, and continuous improvement. In this entry\-level role, the engineer creates new designs and modifies existing designs, solves problems, and improves products and processes, applying sound engineering practices and principles with safety, quality, and the customer in mind. Working with guidance from senior engineers and the Engineering Manager, the engineer plans and organizes assigned work, delivers accurate and complete results on time, and partners with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, service, and sales to keep customers’ equipment running well. Success depends as much on how the work is done (thoroughness, responsiveness, tenacity, work ethic, and professionalism) as on technical skill, and scope and independence grow as results are demonstrated. *All job requirements listed are requirements for the core responsibilities of this position. This position may require other activities and duties as assigned by their manager.* **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Engineer\-to\-Order (ETO) Processing** * Review customer orders and requirements, identify what is standard and what must be engineered, and clarify open questions early. * Configure, design, and modify equipment to order; create and release accurate drawings, bills of materials, and specifications on schedule. * Check every order package for completeness and accuracy before release: right part, right revision, right configuration. * Support manufacturing and assembly as questions arise during the build, and feed lessons learned back into standard designs. ### **Design \& Modification** * Create new designs and modify existing designs using 3D CAD, producing clean models and detailed drawings with appropriate GD\&T, tolerances, and stack\-ups. * Apply design for manufacturability, assembly, and serviceability, and hygienic design principles for washdown and food\-processing environments; select materials and components suited to the application. * Favor simple solutions with fewer parts and less complexity, and know when “good enough” meets the requirement. ### **Product Life\-Cycle Management** * Prepare and manage engineering changes: define the change, assess impact (fit, form, function, cost, installed base, inventory), obtain approvals, release, and verify implementation. * Maintain configuration, revision control, and documentation accuracy in CAD/PDM and ERP systems, including as\-built and as\-fielded records. * Resolve component obsolescence and supplier\-related technical issues; evaluate and qualify replacement parts and alternate sources. * Keep manuals, parts lists, and technical data current as products change. ### **Problem Solving \& Product Support** * Investigate production, field, service, and warranty issues; separate the real problem from the stated problem. * Learn and apply structured root\-cause methods (e.g., 5 Whys, fishbone, 8D, TRIZ) to find causes rather than treat symptoms. * Develop corrective and preventive actions, then confirm with data that the fix worked and the issue does not return. * Provide timely technical support to manufacturing, service, sales, and customers, including on\-site troubleshooting when needed. ### **Analysis, Verification \& Validation** * Perform engineering calculations, tolerance analyses, and basic FEA appropriate to the problem, and sanity\-check results against hand calculations and physical reality. * State the requirement up front (for example, the factor of safety required for the load case, material, and duty cycle) and report whether the result meets it, with a clear conclusion and recommendation, not just a number. * Plan and run bench, shop, and field tests; document the method, results, and conclusions. * Separate what is known, what is assumed, and what still needs to be tested, and flag gaps before passing work along. ### **Continuous Improvement** * Identify and implement improvements to product reliability, performance, cost, manufacturability, and serviceability, with priority on recurring failures. * Improve engineering processes (templates, checklists, standard work) and contribute lessons learned to engineering standards and best practices. * Participate in daily and visual management, and track measures such as change lead time, backlog aging, and repeat failures. ### **Planning, Teamwork \& Professional Practice** * Plan and prioritize assigned work, commit to realistic dates, deliver on them, keep status visible in the team’s tracking tools, and communicate schedule risk early. * Work effectively individually and in teams; give and accept constructive feedback in design reviews. * Follow safety, quality, and company procedures, and document decisions and rationale as work progresses. **Core Behaviors** ------------------ How the work g anical Engineering, or a closely related engineering field, from an ABET\-accredited program. * Entry level: new graduate or up to 2 years of experience. Internships, co\-ops, capstone projects, and student design teams count. * Working knowledge of engineering fundamentals: statics, mechanics of materials, materials selection, and engineering drawings including GD\&T basics. * Experience with a 3D CAD package (SolidWorks preferred) gained through coursework, internships, or projects. * Demonstrated ability to plan, organize, and deliver work on time, individually and as part of a team (for example, co\-op deliverables or a capstone project). * Clear written and verbal communication skills in English; proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint). **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Internship or co\-op experience in manufacturing, machine design, or product support. * Hands\-on mechanical aptitude: machining, welding, sheet metal fabrication, assembly, or equipment repair. * Exposure to PDM, bills of materials, and ERP systems; SolidWorks certification (e.g., CSWA). * Exposure to FEA, tolerance stack\-ups, structured problem solving (5 Whys, 8D, DFMEA), or statistical process control. * Familiarity with food, sanitary, or washdown equipment; basic knowledge of pneumatics, electrical, or controls. * Exposure to Lean or continuous improvement methods. **Measures of Success** ----------------------- * Order packages (drawings, BOMs, specifications) released complete, accurate, and on time, with little rework. * Engineering changes carried through documented impact assessment, approval, release, and verified implementation. * Issues closed with a verified root cause and corrective action, and fewer repeat failures. * Prompt, clear communication with internal customers; commitments met, or renegotiated early. * Steady growth in technical skill, independence, and scope. **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- The physical demands described herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Ability to work for extended periods of time at a workstation on a computer or similar device. Occasional extended periods of standing, bending, kneeling. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- This job operates in both an office setting and a manufacturing warehouse. This role routinely uses standard office equipment, hand tools, and material handling equipment. jobs.title: Associate Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Casey's, everyday interactions across our stores, digital experiences, fuel operations, supply chain, merchandising, marketing, and corporate functions generate data that can improve how the business operates and serves its guests. Marketplace Data Engineering transforms that data into governed, reliable data products used for reporting, analytics, data science, AI, and operational decision\-making. We are looking for an Associate Data Engineer who is curious, collaborative, and motivated to grow as an engineer. You will pair with experienced team members to develop data pipelines and models, test and deploy changes, troubleshoot production issues, and learn the standards behind Casey's Enterprise Data Lake. You will work with Databricks, Python, SQL, cloud services, Git\-based delivery practices, and approved AI\-assisted engineering tools while building practical knowledge of Casey's business and data ecosystem. The Associate Data Engineer contributes to the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of governed data products on Casey's Enterprise Data Lake. Working with more experienced engineers, product partners, analysts, and business stakeholders, this role develops reliable data pipelines and models using Databricks, Python, SQL, and related cloud technologies. The role learns and applies Casey's engineering, security, data governance, and software\-delivery standards while helping troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve the reliability, quality, performance, and maintainability of Marketplace data products. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop, test, deploy, and maintain end\-to\-end data pipelines and data products using Databricks, Python, SQL, and approved enterprise frameworks. * Evaluate source systems and work with engineers, analysts, product partners, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements, dependencies, and intended business use. * Contribute to data models across Raw, Protected, and Purpose zones in accordance with Casey's Enterprise Data Lake architecture, naming conventions, and governance standards. * Write maintainable, reusable, and well\-documented code using version control, branching, pull requests, peer review, and CI/CD practices. * Create and maintain automated tests and validation processes covering data accuracy, completeness, schema, business rules, and pipeline behavior. * Participate in deployment and release activities across development and production environments using approved service identities and access\-management practices. * Monitor data jobs and pipelines, investigate failures and data\-quality issues, document findings, and partner with senior engineers or Operations to restore service. * Assist with performance and cost optimization for Databricks jobs, queries, pipelines, and compute resources. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, including source\-to\-target mappings, transformation logic, operating procedures, support information, and data lineage. * Collaborate with Analytics Solutions, Data Science, Enterprise Data \& Governance, Operations, product partners, and business teams to deliver trusted data for reporting, analytics, AI, and operational use cases. * Use approved AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate learning, coding, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while validating outputs and following security and responsible\-use standards. * Participate in the team's on\-call or off\-hours support rotation based on the criticality of supported data products. * Continuously build knowledge of Casey's business domains, data architecture, engineering standards, and software\-delivery practices through pairing, feedback, and structured learning. **Compensation**: Starting pay range: $66,000 \- $90,800\. Actual pay may vary based on Casey's assessment of the candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities (KSAs), related experience, education, and qualifications. Other factors impacting pay include local prevailing wages and internal equity. This position is eligible for an annual cash bonus based on company performance. Our full salary range for this role does extend beyond the hiring range listed, allowing team members the opportunity to continue to grow within the company. Requirements: * This position requires authorization to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Casey's will not provide sponsorship or employer support for applications or petitions for F\-1 OPT, F\-1 CPT, H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, J\-1, or any other employment\-based visa. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Data Analytics, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent years of related work experience. * Experience using SQL or Python to analyze, transform, or validate data. * Foundational understanding of relational data, data modeling, or dimensional modeling concepts. * Familiarity with common data\-integration patterns involving databases, files, APIs, streams, or event data. * Understanding of software\-development fundamentals such as source control, testing, debugging, code review, and deployment. * Ability to investigate technical and data\-quality problems, evaluate available information, and communicate findings clearly. * Strong attention to detail, organization, curiosity, and willingness to learn from feedback and pairing. * Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. * Ability to collaborate across engineering, product, analytics, operations, and business teams. Qualified candidates must live within a daily commutable distance of Casey's Store Support Center in Ankeny, IA and be willing to work onsite 5 days per week. **Preferred Experience:** * Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, or Databricks Workflows. * Experience with GitHub or Azure DevOps, including branches, pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines. * Exposure to Azure services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Microsoft Entra ID, or Azure Key Vault. * Understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, or cataloging concepts. * Familiarity with monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing cloud data workloads. * Experience using AI\-assisted software\-development tools responsibly. * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification or willingness to pursue it after joining.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Delivery Engineering
jobs.description: **About CircleCI Engineering** ------------------------------ CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them. At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here. **About Delivery Engineering** ------------------------------ Delivery Engineering enables CircleCI engineers to deliver quickly, confidently, and securely. We provide the tools and resources that make standard patterns and best practices simple to adopt, and we reduce toil. Our current focus is the agentic software development lifecycle: how changes are found, planned, built, reviewed, merged, and measured as AI agents take on more of the work. We evaluate the harnesses, repository patterns, skills, and agentic tooling available, decide what our teams should standardize on, and build and support the shared tooling other teams depend on. We're a small, very senior team, and everyone on it shapes where we go. Every improvement we make compounds across the organization. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build AI\-natively.** AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved. * **Shape how CircleCI builds software with agents.** Help define the end\-to\-end agentic SDLC, from identifying a change through planning, execution, pull request, merge, and measuring impact afterward. Evaluate shared tooling and patterns, and help decide what teams standardize on. * **Start from how our teams actually work.** Spend time with engineering teams to understand their workflows and where they get stuck. Use what you learn to drive decisions and direction that teams adopt because the work fits how they operate. * **Build platforms, not one\-offs.** Build and support shared tooling that other teams depend on, and own its adoption as much as its delivery. A tool nobody uses isn't done. * **Measure what matters.** Instrument agent usage and outcomes so we know what improves throughput and quality and what just burns tokens. Treat cost, model choice, and reliability as design concerns. * **Make build\-vs\-buy calls.** Evaluate models, vendors, and open\-source tools against our needs, and choose the path that gets engineers the most leverage. * **Lead through influence.** Write the design docs, lead technical discussions across teams, and mentor engineers across the org as they adopt agentic workflows. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * **Direct experience driving agentic developer experience efforts.** You've driven an initiative that changed how an engineering organization builds software with AI agents. You can speak to what you built, how you measured its impact, how you drove adoption, and what didn't work. * **Hands\-on depth with agentic tooling.** You work daily with coding agents, agent harnesses, MCP, and skills or prompt design. You know how to evaluate agent output and reason about model and token economics. * **A platform mindset.** You've built and supported internal platforms or developer tooling that other engineers build on and rely on, and driven their adoption. * **Backend depth in Go.** You've owned production backend services in Go, including API design, data modeling, and service integration. * **A track record at staff scope.** 8\+ years of production engineering experience, including technical decisions that spanned multiple teams and accountability for whether they landed. * **Decision\-making grounded in your users.** You build direction by listening first. You turn the needs of many teams into clear tradeoffs, document your reasoning, and bring people along. This role is open to candidates based in Europe or in the Eastern time zone. **Sound like you?** ------------------- You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the engineers using your tools as much as the code behind them. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it with the people who'll use it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. **About CircleCI** CircleCI is the world's largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most\-used DevOps tools \- processing more than 3 million jobs a day \- CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture\-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. **How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring** At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you. **Where we may use AI** * *Job descriptions and messaging*: AI may help draft job descriptions and role\-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate. * *Application review*: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. * *Interview notes*: With advance notice, an AI note\-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected. * *Outreach*: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending. **Our commitment** AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change. **Your choices** You can ask for human\-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note\-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com. For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description: **ClearOne Advantage System Administrator \- Job Description** ============================================================== **PLEASE DO NOT APPLY TO THIS ROLE IF YOU DO NOT LIVE IN EITHER THE PACIFIC (PST) OR MOUTAIN (MST) TIME ZONE. IF YOU DO NOT LIVE IN ONE OF THESE TIME ZONES, YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE REJECTED.** **About the Role** ClearOne Advantage is a fully remote debt settlement company that helps consumers resolve unsecured debt. You will work helpdesk tickets directly and serve as the escalation point for Associate Systems Administrators. and Microsoft 365** * Administer Active Directory and Entra ID, including OU structure, group policy, security groups, and hybrid sync. * Own Microsoft 365 administration: licensing, Exchange Online mailboxes and mail flow, Teams, SharePoint, and conditional access and MFA policies. * Design, automate, and maintain onboarding and offboarding workflows, including SCIM\-based automated provisioning and deprovisioning from Entra ID to business applications, bulk provisioning of new agent classes, and same\-day deprovisioning of departing staff. * Administer access for business applications including Salesforce, DocuSign, GitHub, NICE InContact (CXone), and AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot, including seat assignment and licensing. * Run periodic access reviews, enforce least privilege, and approve or escalate elevated access requests. * Manage IP whitelisting for internal use and for external partners **Endpoint management** * Administer Microsoft Intune and Desktop Central (ManageEngine Endpoint Central) for device enrollment, compliance policies, software deployment, and patching. * Build and maintain standard workstation images and Autopilot or zero\-touch deployment processes for Windows and macOS. * Own patch compliance reporting and remediation across the endpoint fleet. * Oversee hardware lifecycle, inventory accuracy, shipping, and redeployment, with Associate Systems Administrators handling day\-to\-day fulfillment. * Administer and support corporate VPN and remote access, and help with the migration from VPN to Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). **Infrastructure and cloud** * Create and maintain AWS WorkSpaces and support related AWS resources, including whitelisting IPs in the appropriate security groups. * Maintain backups, verify restores, and participate in disaster recovery planning and testing. * Support network and firewall changes in partnership with networking resources, including VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and VPN configuration. * Partner with minor DevOps responsibilities, such as GitHub repository and access management, and maintaining cloud resources alongside the DevOps team. **Business applications and contact center** * Serve as administrator and escalation point for InContact (CXone), Teramind, Tableau, FTP and secure file transfer. * Coordinate with vendors on application issues, upgrades, and renewals. * Maintain the application and license inventory and drive license optimization. **Security, compliance, and audits** * Administer endpoint security and monitoring tools and respond to security alerts in coordination with IT leadership. * Review and implement security recommendations from Microsoft Defender, tracking remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations. * Support audits, policy enforcement, and evidence of collection for access and change management. * Perform regular license and seat audits across Microsoft 365, Salesforce, AI tools, and other SaaS applications, reclaiming unused seats and keeping license counts accurate. * Perform regular Active Directory audits, including stale and disabled accounts, group memberships, and privileged access. * Partner with Security Engineers on vulnerability remediation and patch compliance across endpoints and servers **Automation and documentation** * Contribute to IT automation initiatives, including SCIM provisioning across all business applications, and automate repetitive tasks such as reporting and license cleanup using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or similar tools. * Create and maintain system documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles, and keep them current as systems change. * Write new SOPs for IT processes and submit them for review and approval before publishing **Helpdesk, escalation, leadership, and on\-call** * Work helpdesk tickets in Jira Service Management as part of the team's round\-robin rotation, and act as the Tier 2/3 escalation point for complex incidents, identifying root causes of recurring problems. * Triage requests across the Jira boards owned by other pods, routing tickets to the right team and handling IT\-related work that lands there. * Support offshore users and collaborate with their local IT teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues, coordinating across time zones. * Mentor and train Associate Systems Administrators and review their work on access and endpoint tasks. * Plan and own IT projects such as migrations, rollouts, and infrastructure upgrades. * Participate in the on\-call rotation for after\-hours incidents. * Stay current on new technologies and best practices to strengthen both the team's capabilities and your own skills. **Required qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. • 5\+ years of hands\-on IT experience, including 4\+ years in a systems administration role. • Can reasonably perform all duties of an Associate Systems Administrator (L1\). * Strong hands\-on experience administering Active Directory, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online and licensing. • Experience managing endpoints with Intune, Desktop Central, SCCM, or a comparable MDM/RMM platform, including patching and software deployment. • Experience provisioning and deprovisioning users in SaaS applications such as Salesforce, DocuSign, or similar. * Working knowledge of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN, and firewalls. * Scripting experience in PowerShell or a similar language. * Experience with Jira Service Management or a comparable ITSM platform, including incident and problem management. * Ability to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical users and leadership. * Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast\-paced, rapidgrowth environment. * Willingness to participate in an on\-call rotation. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience administering NICE InContact (CXone) or another contact center or dialer platform. * Experience implementing SCIM provisioning and SSO (SAML or OIDC) with Entra ID, Okta, or a similar identity provider. * Experience administering or working with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Microsoft Copilot, including access, licensing, and usage policies. * Experience with AWS, especially AWS WorkSpaces. * Experience with Teramind or other employee monitoring tools. * Experience supporting macOS in a mostly Windows environment. * Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services. * Experience mentoring junior IT staff. * Certifications such as Microsoft 365 Administrator (MS\-102\), Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\), CompTIA Security\+, or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator. **Equal employment opportunity** ClearOne Advantage provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and job seekers without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ The IT and Security team sits within the Office of the CTO (OCTO), a small, high\-leverage group led by our CTO \& CISO. OCTO owns CloudZero's AI\-native vision, IT, security, and the economics of our internal technology. The team runs IT, data, governance, risk and compliance, and product security, and leads our Claude platform rollout, our AI landing zones, Okta as code, and our AI cost and usage reporting. The team works from an AI maturity model that describes the move from individuals using AI every day (level 2\) to teams redesigning how their work gets done around it (level 3 and beyond). It partners with AI Champions in each function and builds rather than presents. Because CloudZero is an AI cost management company, every system the team builds is a proof point for what we sell: we instrument everything for cost and practice what we preach. **The role** ------------ We are hiring a Senior AI Enablement Engineer. This is a technical role on the IT and Security team, but it is not traditional IT. Your job is to help every team at CloudZero do more with AI, and to make sure we can do it safely. You will embed with teams like Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, People, and Engineering, learn how their work really gets done, and then redesign it with AI. You will build the agents, automations, and tools that make that happen, and you will teach people to build their own. When you find that the foundations are missing, such as the right access controls, data connections, logging, evaluation, or cost tracking, you will build them or pick the right product and implement it. This is one of three related senior roles on our IT and Security team, each a single hire and each adding capacity. Our existing Senior IT \& AI Systems Engineer owns core IT systems, identity, and employee lifecycle automation. Our Senior AI Data \& Platform Engineer builds the data, retrieval, APIs, and agent runtime behind our AI. You focus on people and workflows: embedding with teams and shipping what they need on top of that foundation. An Associate AI Enablement Engineer will support all three. This posting is for one opening. You are a generalist who uses AI every day to do far more than you could alone. You like hard problems, you like people, and you would rather ship something that works than write a slide about it. We work automation first. A ticket is a signal that a system failed a person, and the third request for the same number is a data product that does not exist yet. Your job is to fix the upstream cause so the next ten people do not hit the same wall. **What you will do** -------------------- * Partner with business teams to map their workflows, find the friction, and agree on AI enablement goals and success metrics before building anything. * Design, build, and run AI\-powered workflows, agents, and automations that change how work gets done, from quick wins to production systems that teams rely on. * Integrate AI with the systems we run on (for example our CRM, finance, HR, support, collaboration, and data platforms) using APIs, MCP servers, iPaaS tools, and custom code. * Spot when a solution built for one team can help others and turn it into a reusable pattern, skill, or template. * Identify gaps in the platforms we need to deploy and govern AI safely, including identity and access, data access and classification, logging, evaluation, human review, and spend controls. Then build or buy and implement what is missing. * Own the build vs buy call for AI tooling: evaluate vendors, run trials, and make clear recommendations with cost and risk tradeoffs. * Work with Security, G\&A, and Engineering to write and maintain practical AI usage and data handling standards, and make the approved path the easy path. * Set up evaluations and monitoring so the workflows you ship keep working as models and systems change. * Track AI adoption, outcomes, and spend across the company, and report what is working to IT leadership. Use CloudZero to understand what our own AI spend is producing. * Raise AI fluency across the company through office hours, working sessions, playbooks, and one\-on\-one coaching. * Document everything you build so the work is repeatable and scalable. * Build the experience for internal agent builders: templates, deploy paths, docs, and office hours that turn one team's work into every team's capability. * Turn repeated requests into self\-serve tools and data products, working with our IT \& AI Systems Engineer on the systems and employee lifecycle automation that agents depend on. * Partner with our IT and data platform engineers so every agent runs with the permissions of the person who invokes it, never more, with no shared service accounts, and with its cost attributed to a team. **What you bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years in a technical role such as software engineering, IT or systems engineering, solutions/sales engineering, automation, or internal tools. * Hands\-on coding skills in Python, TypeScript, or similar, plus solid SQL and comfort working with REST APIs and webhooks. * Deep personal use of modern AI tools, including coding agents, LLM APIs, MCP, agent skills or custom GPTs, and retrieval patterns. You can show how your use has changed over the last year. * Ability to enable and train; confidence in facilitating workshops and trainings in an engaging manner that fosters continuous learning and development. * A track record of building tools, automations, or AI workflows that changed how a real team works, with specific examples and results. * Working knowledge of identity and access (SSO, SCIM, OAuth scopes, service accounts, least privilege) and how data permissions carry into AI tools. * The habit of defining what good output looks like, testing it, and owning the result. * Strong business sense and the ability to earn trust with non\-technical teams quickly. * Clear writing and teaching. You can explain technical ideas to a diverse set of audiences, both technical and non\-technical. * Comfort with ambiguity. You do not need a detailed roadmap to know where to start. * You reach for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or Cursor before solving a problem by hand, and you can talk credibly about which models and tools are good at what, where they fall short, and how to prompt them well. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, or consultant who had to deliver results inside someone else's organization. * Experience with iPaaS or workflow tools (for example Workato, Zapier, n8n, or Make) and enterprise AI platforms. * Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or with SOC 2 style security programs. * Experience with data warehouses, data pipelines, and retrieval systems. * Background in cloud infrastructure, cloud cost management, or SaaS spend management. * Experience leading change across skeptical teams or building internal training programs that stuck. **About CloudZero** CloudZero is the AI ROI Company. We built the financial control plane for AI: the system finance, IT, and engineering use to connect every AI dollar to the outcome it produced. Across every provider. In real time. AI spend is the fastest\-growing line on enterprise P\&Ls and the least understood. Only 14% of CFOs can prove AI ROI today. CloudZero answers the question no one else can: what did it cost to produce this outcome, for this customer, on this model. The largest cloud spenders on the planet already run on CloudZero, including Coinbase, Duolingo, DoorDash, and Shutterstock. We processed 14 trillion billing events in the last twelve months. We're the first listed partner on Anthropic's cost and usage API. We've raised over $119 million, including a $56 million Series C backed by leading venture capital firms. **Why Join Our Team?** At CloudZero, you’ll find a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where your work makes a direct impact. We’re a team that values ownership, creativity, and curiosity — and we’re tackling some of the most complex challenges in the cloud space. If you’re excited by working with cutting\-edge technology, driving meaningful outcomes, and growing with a company that’s scaling fast, we’d love to hear from you! jobs.title: Security Engineer, AI Evaluation (PhD)
jobs.description: **Job Type:** Flexible Contract (Remote) **Job Summary:** Cobalt is hiring PhD\-level security engineers to review reinforcement learning tasks and environments used to test whether frontier AI models can carry out real security work. Your job is to make sure each task is correct, fair, realistic and actually measures what it claims to measure before it is accepted. If you have built your research or career around finding the flaw that scanners miss, the patch that only looks like a fix, or the exploit path nobody planned for, this role puts that experience to work at the frontier of AI evaluation. **What you will do** * Review security tasks end to end, including the task description, environment code, containers, vulnerable code, dependencies, reference solution and automated tests or graders, and confirm that each part is correct and consistent with the others. * Run reference solutions and graders yourself to confirm that correct fixes pass, incorrect or incomplete fixes fail, and results are reproducible across runs. * Look for ways an agent could pass without doing the intended work, such as reading the expected output directly, special\-casing the grader’s test inputs, disabling a feature instead of fixing the flaw, or applying a patch that blocks the test exploit but leaves the underlying vulnerability open. Document each issue so the task author can fix it. * Confirm that graders verify real security outcomes thoroughly and deterministically, including variant inputs and regression checks that keep legitimate behavior working. * Review how a frontier AI model attempted each task and judge whether its failure reflects a real capability gap, or instead reflects ambiguous wording, a hidden assumption, a broken environment or an unfair grader. * Judge whether each task reflects how security work is actually done in industry, including realistic codebases, messy dependencies and real\-world constraints, and push back on tasks that are unrealistic, trivial or testing the wrong skill. * Write clear, specific feedback to task authors and work with them through revisions until the task meets the acceptance standard. **Who we are looking for** * A PhD in computer science, security, engineering or a closely related STEM field. PhD candidates and students are welcome to apply. * Hands\-on research or industry experience in security, such as vulnerability research, secure code review, reverse engineering, malware analysis, applied cryptography or systems security. Ten or more years of experience is ideal. * At least one publication, academic or professional, such as a paper, CVE write\-up, conference talk or technical advisory. * Expert command of Python and at least one systems or web language, and the ability to read code and explain exactly why it is or is not vulnerable. * Hands\-on experience with security tooling, such as debuggers, fuzzers, static and dynamic analysis tools or reverse engineering tools. * Deep familiarity with Linux, Docker and Git, enough to set up an environment, run a task and trace a failure. * Careful, direct written communication. Much of the job is explaining precisely what is wrong and why. **Strong advantages** * Experience designing technical assessments, CTF challenges or interview problems, writing autograders, or serving as a peer reviewer for a security conference or journal. * Significant open source security contributions, bug bounty track record or published vulnerability disclosures. * Experience with machine learning security, or with reinforcement learning, including how reward signals can be gamed. **Why Cobalt AI** * **Work on frontier AI evaluation.** Your judgment directly determines which tasks are used to measure what leading models can and cannot do in security. * **See how frontier models are trained and assessed.** Reviewing many tasks and model attempts gives you a close view of where current models succeed in security work and where they break. * **Fit the work around your other commitments.** Set your own schedule, with flexible weeks of 10 to 40 hours. * **Shape the work.** Strong reviewers can lead task design, run projects and collaborate on research. Job Type: Part\-time Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Application Engineer

existing packaging machinery, including legacy equipment, to determine appropriate electrical modernization, controls upgrades, modifications, or system replacement solutions. * Reviewing and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control panel layouts, legacy documentation, equipment specifications, and other relevant technical documentation. * Developing practical electrical and controls solutions based on existing machine configurations, customer requirements, and sound engineering principles. * Evaluating existing control systems, including PLCs, HMIs, evaluate proposed solutions, validate concepts, and align on technical requirements. * Developing electrical material, engineering, programming, installation, and other applicable cost estimates to support accurate project costing. * Preparing clear technical write\-ups that define the proposed electrical solution, scope of work, sequence of operation, system requirements, and other information necessary to support customer proposals and downstream engineering. * Serving as a technical resource to Sales Operations Engineers and Sales team members throughout the proposal development process. * Using electrical design tools, schematics, and other engineering resources to evaluate concepts, communicate solutions, and support technical decision\-making. * Supporting feasibility assessments, technical evaluations, or early\-learning activities when necessary to validate new or complex electrical applications and reduce project risk. * Communicating electrical and controls concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Supporting customer discussions and presentations when needed to ensure electrical requirements are understood and appropriately addressed in the proposed solution. * Maintaining awareness of applicable electrical technologies, automation systems, engineering practices, and developments related to packaging machinery modernization. * Traveling occasionally to customer or vendor locations as business needs require. **What You Need to Be Successful** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a related engineering discipline preferred; equivalent hands\-on electrical, controls, or industrial machinery experience will also be considered. * Strong electrical aptitude and demonstrated experience working with industrial electrical systems, machine controls, automation equipment, packaging machinery, electrical modifications, service, or a comparable technical environment. * Ability to evaluate existing electrical and control systems, identify necessary upgrades or modifications, and develop practical technical solutions. * Experience interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, control panel layouts, equipment specifications, and technical documentation. * Familiarity with industrial control systems and components, including PLCs, HMIs, variable frequency drives (VFDs), sensors, and other automation technologies. * Experience with electrical design and documentation tools, such as AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN, or comparable software preferred. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and the ability to develop or support electrical material, labor, engineering, and project cost estimates. * Strong technical writing skills with the ability to clearly document and explain proposed electrical engineering and controls solutions. * Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to interact effectively with customers, Sales, Engineering, and cross\-functional teams. * Customer\-focused mindset with the ability to listen to technical challenges, ask the right questions, and translate customer needs into actionable solutions. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work through electrical applications ranging from established solutions to new or previously unproven concepts. * Ability to collaborate across multiple functions while taking ownership of the technical integrity and accuracy of proposed solutions. * Willingness to work around manufacturing and shop environments where safety glasses, steel\-toe safety shoes, and other required PPE must be worn. **Our Offer** Coesia North America offers a competitive benefit package which includes, among other things: * 401K offering 6% company match with no vesting period. * Flexible remote work offering. * 8\-weeks paid parental leave. * Multiple health benefit \& insurance options. * PTO, sick time, and 12 observed calendar holidays. * Company paid short\-term disability (80% wager placement) \& long\-term disability. * HSA company contribution for individual \& employer family coverage. jobs.title: WordPress Developer
jobs.description: Collaborative Office Interiors (COI) is a Houston commercial office furniture dealership. We have furnished more than 10,000 Houston offices, including projects for Samsung, Apple, Foxconn, the Houston Texans, NASA and BakerRipley. Our website, https://collaborative\-office.com, is our main source of new business, and we are hiring a remote WordPress specialist to keep it fast, stable and converting. This is not a design\-from\-scratch role. The site is built and ranking. We need someone who can own the day\-to\-day technical upkeep of a WordPress/WooCommerce site, fix problems quickly, carry out well\-defined improvements without breaking what already works, and help us turn more of our visitors into quote requests, calls and chats. **What you will do** * Maintain and troubleshoot a WordPress site running WooCommerce, Elementor, a custom theme, Rank Math, Gravity Forms, LiteSpeed Cache, Perfmatters and Cloudflare * Build and edit pages and templates in Elementor, and make theme\-level changes in PHP, HTML and CSS when needed * Manage WooCommerce product pages, categories, pricing updates, shipping and tax settings, and the Stripe checkout * Conversion rate optimization (CRO): improve how the site turns visitors into leads, including quote forms, popups, click\-to\-call buttons, live chat triggers, calls to action and landing pages * Run A/B tests and track results using tools such as Google Optimize alternatives, Microsoft Clarity heatmaps and session recordings, and GA4 conversion reports * Review form drop\-off, page scroll depth and mobile behavior, then propose and build fixes that lift form submissions, calls and chats * Keep the site fast: page speed, caching, image optimization, Core Web Vitals * Keep the site healthy: plugin and core updates, staging tests before changes go live, backups, uptime, error logs, and fixing JavaScript or PHP errors * Support our SEO work: sitemaps, redirects, schema, meta data in Rank Math, internal linking and crawl issues * Keep lead tracking working: Gravity Forms, Google Tag Manager, GA4 events and call tracking, so every conversion is measured * Work from a shared task list, give clear status updates, and document what you change **What we are looking for** * 3 or more years of hands\-on WordPress experience, including at least 1 year with WooCommerce * Strong Elementor skills, including templates, popups and custom CSS * Working knowledge of PHP, HTML, CSS and basic JavaScript, enough to safely edit a custom theme and write small code snippets * Proven CRO experience on a lead\-generation or ecommerce site: you can point to changes you made and the lift in conversions they produced * Comfortable reading GA4, Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar data and turning it into concrete page changes * Experience with caching and performance plugins (LiteSpeed Cache or similar) and with Cloudflare * Familiarity with Rank Math or Yoast and with Google Search Console * Comfortable with cPanel or Hostinger\-style hosting, file managers, staging sites and backups * Clear written English and the discipline to test before pushing changes live * Available for some overlap with Central Time business hours **Nice to have** * Experience with Google Tag Manager and GA4 event setup * Experience with A/B testing tools (VWO, Convert, Optimizely or similar) on WordPress * Experience optimizing WooCommerce product pages and checkout for conversion * Experience with Google Merchant Center product feeds * Experience with lead\-generation or B2B service websites * Experience with Code Snippets, WP\-CLI or the WordPress REST API **How we work** You will work directly with the owner and with our lead developer. Tasks arrive as a prioritized list with clear acceptance criteria. Most weeks are 10 to 20 hours, with occasional larger projects. We care about reliability and communication more than speed. **Before Applying** In addition to sending your resume, it would be great if you could review the Collaborative Office Interiors website before applying and share any initial thoughts or improvements you notice. This will help us better understand your approach, experience, and how you evaluate a WordPress website. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off Application Question(s): * If you joined our team, what would be the first technical or performance improvement you would recommend for our website, and why? * Based on your experience with WordPress websites, what are the top three areas you would evaluate when improving a business website like ours (performance, SEO, UX, security, conversions, etc.)? * Did you review the Collaborative Office Interiors website before applying? If yes, what was the first issue, improvement opportunity, or area you noticed. Also, how would you maximize conversions? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: IBM iSeries Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **IBM iSeries Senior Systems Engineer** ======================================= Job Code JD07012 Location Denver / Denver County Department Office of the State Court Administrator Posted 04\-Nov\-2026 Closes 06\-Dec\-2026 Position Number 29544 FTE Level 1 **POSITION INFORMATION** ------------------------ Job Code: R44023 Full Time Salary Range: $96,735\.84 \- $140,266\.80 FLSA Status: Exempt Learn more about employee benefits This posting may be used to create a Talent Pool.
