This includes consulting, planning, designing, installing, configuring, administering, and maintaining on\-premise x86 servers, SAN hardware, on\-premise and cloud Microsoft Windows and Red Hat Enterprise Linux systems, SaaS products and other elements of the Department’s IT infrastructure. **Distinguishing Factors:** This classification is distinguished from lower level Systems Engineers by a greater need for independent judgment, decision\-making, designing and planning to assist the Lead Systems Architect and the Systems Engineering team. Work focuses on private and public cloud infrastructure. Positions are within the Information Technology Services (ITS) Division. **ADDITIONAL COMMENTS** ----------------------- ***This position is only responsible for the IBM based functions of the job description.*** * Candidate must be available for on\-call, rotated every 3 weeks within the team, and become a point person for any production issues during that time. * This is a hybrid position based in Denver Colorado **\*Please note we are unable to provide H1B visa sponsorship\*** **Desired Experience:** Experience as an Engineer on IBM Power 9 servers of higher * Demonstrated working understanding of IBMi Operating Systems (V7R5M0 or Higher) and related products. * Experience with software replication technologies (Assure MIMIX) * + Diverse experience in Disaster Recovery concepts and switch events + Would also like experience with Connect CDC (formerly MIMIX Share) * Monitor systems for performance and integrity * Excellent oral and written communication skills and strong attention to detail * + Maintain complete and current technical documentation * Ability to help plan/coordinate and execute tasks as necessary. * Ability to handle multiple projects and work activities to meet deadlines. * Ability to work effectively as a member of a team and independently. The Information Technology Services (ITS) division is part of the State Court Administrator's Office within the Colorado Judicial Branch. Judicial ITS is a separate technology organization from the State of Colorado's Office of Information Technology (OIT), which serves executive branch agencies. Judicial ITS provides technology services exclusively for Colorado's courts, probation, and judicial operations. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** ----------------------- Maintains the private and public cloud infrastructure. Acts as a resource to internal ITS staff, judicial districts, other state agencies, and/or other organizational units as directed. Displays leadership and mentoring for employees at the Systems Engineer I and II levels. Provides expertise and assistance to other employees. Assists with multi\-tier architectures including web servers, caching, application servers, load balancers, and storage. Assists with scripting and workload automation processes. Adheres to established change control procedures and assists development team during testing and deployment processes. Provides Tier 3 support for relevant systems. Develops and maintains relationships with vendors. Assists with database administration for server implementations. Assists with Java application server configuration. Provides architectural consulting expertise, direction, and assistance to other systems engineers. Conducts research on emerging technologies in support of infrastructure development efforts and recommends technologies that will increase cost effectiveness and infrastructure flexibility. Assists with duties relating to Active Directory and Office 365 infrastructure, including administration of users and groups, DNS, and PKI. Private cloud responsibilities include consulting on, planning, designing, installing, configuring, administering and maintaining x86 server and SAN hardware and related software, Fibre channel SAN infrastructure, VMware virtualization, backup infrastructure, and connectivity to other clouds and hosted services. Assists in operational duties relating to Active Directory and Office 365 infrastructure, including administration of users and groups, DNS, and PKI. Public cloud responsibilities include designing, deploying and migrating systems for IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and archiving environments. Works closely with Lead Systems Architect to identify, analyze and select cloud services for infrastructure architecture and business applications, and proposes plans for infrastructure investment. Assists Lead Systems Architect to develop and manage cloud infrastructure capacity plan. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS CONT.** ----------------------------- Monitors, administers, and maintains cloud workloads, resource consumption and archiving. May travel throughout the state of Colorado as required. Attend meetings as required. Performs other duties as assigned. **Supervisor Responsibilities:** May have supervisory accountability in the absence of the Lead Systems Architect for other Systems Engineers, volunteers, or interns. Plans, directs and coordinates activities for the Systems team. Duties include scheduling and assigning of work, training in all facets of work, and quality control. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** -------------------------- **Minimum Education:** A bachelor’s degree in a related field from an accredited college or university and three years of experience directly supporting either Windows or Linux/Unix based servers both on\-premise and in the cloud is highly desirable. Current MCSA, MCITP Server Administrator, Azure Administrator, AWS SysOps Administrator, AWS Solutions Architect, VMware VCP Cloud Management and Automation or RHCSA certification is preferred. OR Experience may substitute for education on a year for year basis as follows: graduation from high school or equivalent and four years working in computer related areas; three years of the computer experience must be directly supporting either Windows or Linux/Unix based servers. Current MCSA, MCITP,: Server Administrator, Azure Administrator, AWS SysOps Administrator, AWS Solutions Architect, VMware VCP Cloud Management and Automation or RHCSA certification is preferred. **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to sit and reach with hands and arms and perform repetitive motions with wrists, hands, and fingers. The employee is occasionally required to stand and walk. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds or more. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, depth perception, ability to adjust and focus, and the ability to see clearly at 20 feet or more. **Work Environment:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts, work in high precarious places and the risk of electrical shock. Frequently handles emergency or crisis situations and may be subject to varying and unpredictable situations and work hours. The employee is subject to frequent interruptions, multiple calls and inquiries, and may occasionally handle absentee replacement on short notice. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

jobs.title: Product Owner, Batching Hardware
jobs.description: **Title:** Product Owner, Batching Hardware **Summary of Role** Command Alkon is looking for a Product Owner of Batching Hardware to take strategic and operational ownership of our hardware offerings that support concrete production and automation across our global batching automation portfolio, including COMMANDbatch, Marcotte Mbatch, Conactive CP, Libra, and other supported platforms. Define Product Strategy: * Develop and execute a clear, forward\-looking strategy for how Command Alkon supports hardware in the batching process across its global automation portfolio, balancing internal innovation, third\-party solutions, and market needs. Collaborate on Vendor Strategy: * Work closely with Command Alkon’s centralized hardware procurement and sourcing teams to recommend vendors, evaluate products, assess costs, and help manage margin goals. Customer\-Focused Input: * Gather and analyze customer feedback on hardware usability, performance, and needs to inform future direction and roadmap priorities. **What You Bring** * 7\+ years of experience in the concrete production, construction materials, or industrial automation industry, with significant exposure to batching hardware. * Strong understanding of the full hardware stack used in batching: control panels, scale systems, sensors, PLCs, JBoxes, and other critical components across different batching automation architectures. * Experience in product management, technical project management, or a role involving ownership of a product or system offering. * Proven ability to work effectively with procurement, engineering, software product teams, and field services. * Ability to evaluate hardware trends, assess cost\-benefit tradeoffs, and support data\-driven decisions around product portfolio and vendor selection. * Experience working for a ready\-mix or precast producer in a production, engineering, or technical role. * Familiarity with COMMANDbatch, Marcotte Mbatch, Conactive CP, Libra, or other batching automation systems. * Background in electrical or controls engineering a plus. * Exposure to cloud\-connected systems or IoT technologies in plant environments. **Who You Are** Strategic Mindset: You see ahead to future possibilities and translate them into breakthrough strategies. jobs.title: Senior Applications Developer
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** ---------------- Join the Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board as a Senior Applications Developer and help build the technology behind important online ordering systems. This position offers the chance to analyze challenges, create reliable solutions, and contribute to high\-profile technology initiatives. Bring your technical skills to the Enterprise Integration QA and Testing Division and help drive continuous improvement across the agency. **DESCRIPTION OF WORK** ----------------------- In this role, you will support the development and maintenance of critical Oracle\-based eCommerce systems for the Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board. You will analyze business needs, create technical solutions, test applications, and document completed work. As a Senior Applications Developer, you will perform the following duties: * **Application Development:** Develop and enhance Oracle storefront applications that support business\-to\-business and business\-to\-customer operations * **Solution Design:** Analyze existing code and business requests to plan effective application improvements and technical solutions * **Code Testing:** Debug applications and conduct testing activities before solutions move to user acceptance testing * **Team Collaboration:** Work independently or with project teams based on the scope and complexity of development efforts * **Technical Documentation:** Document development activities within application code and the agency change management system Interested in learning more? Additional details regarding this position can be found in the position description. **Work Schedule and Additional Information:** * Full\-time employment * Work hours are 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday \- Friday, with a 60\-minute lunch. * **Telework:** You may have the opportunity to work from home (telework) part\-time. You will be required to report in\-office to the Northwest Office Building on Tuesday each week. In order to telework, you must have a securely configured high\-speed internet connection and work from an approved location inside Pennsylvania. If you are unable to telework, you will have the option to report to the headquarters office in Harrisburg. The ability to telework is subject to change at any time. Additional details may be provided during the interview. * **Salary:**Selected candidates who are new to employment with the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania will begin employment at the starting annual salary of $78,925\.00 (before taxes). * You will receive further communication regarding this position via email. Check your email, including spam/junk folders, for these notices. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, TRAINING \& ELIGIBILITY** ------------------------------------------------ **QUALIFICATIONS** **Minimum Experience and Training Requirements:** * One year as an Applications Developer 2 or Computer Programmer 4 (Commonwealth job title or equivalent Federal Government job title, as determined by the Office of Administration); **or** * Five years of information technology experience that includes three years of experience in applications development or applications maintenance; **or** * Three years of information technology experience in applications development or applications maintenance, and an associate’s degree in any information technology field; **or** * One year of information technology experience in applications development or applications maintenance, and a bachelor's degree in any information technology field; **or** * An equivalent combination of experience and training. **Other Requirements:** * You must meet the PA residency requirement. jobs.title: Estimating Engineer ( Direct Hire) ( Expansion)
jobs.description: **Estimating Engineer – Custom Machinery \& Automation** ======================================================== **Join a Growing Engineering Team \| Exciting Expansion \& Career Advancement Opportunities** **Location:** Southeast Michigan **Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| Direct Hire **Starting Salary:** $80,000–$90,000 annually, depending on experience **Industry:** Custom Machinery \| Industrial Automation \| Advanced Manufacturing **Build Your Career Where Engineering Meets Innovation!** --------------------------------------------------------- Are you a mechanically inclined engineer who enjoys understanding how machines work, developing technical solutions, and helping bring complex manufacturing projects to life? An established and growing industrial machinery manufacturer is expanding its engineering operations and looking for a motivated **Estimating Engineer** to join its team! This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a company experiencing continued growth, new project opportunities, and investment in its engineering capabilities. As the organization expands, so does the opportunity for its employees to take on greater responsibilities, develop new technical skills, and advance their careers. **This isn't just another estimating position. It's an opportunity to help shape projects from their earliest stages and see your work become real, functioning machinery.** **Position Overview** --------------------- The Estimating Engineer will play an important role in evaluating customer requirements, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing technical proposals for custom machinery, industrial equipment, and automation projects. This position combines mechanical engineering knowledge, manufacturing processes, cost analysis, and collaboration with engineering, purchasing, and production teams. The ideal candidate enjoys working with technical drawings, understanding machine components, evaluating manufacturing costs, and developing practical solutions for customer applications. **Candidates with hands\-on machine building, mechanical design, manufacturing estimating, or custom equipment experience are strongly encouraged to apply.** **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Engineering Estimating \& Technical Proposals** * Review customer specifications, technical drawings, and project requirements to determine equipment scope and feasibility. * Develop detailed cost estimates for custom machinery, mechanical assemblies, manufacturing equipment, and automation projects. * Prepare technical quotations, proposals, and supporting documentation for new equipment opportunities. * Estimate material, component, fabrication, machining, assembly, engineering, and labor costs. * Evaluate project requirements to identify potential engineering challenges, cost considerations, and opportunities for improvement. * Collaborate with suppliers and purchasing personnel to obtain accurate pricing and lead times. ### **Mechanical Engineering \& Manufacturing Collaboration** * Work closely with mechanical engineering, electrical controls, purchasing, production, and project management teams. * Interpret mechanical drawings, assembly layouts, bills of materials, and technical specifications. * Apply knowledge of machine building, machining, fabrication, and mechanical assembly to develop realistic project estimates. * Participate in technical discussions to determine appropriate equipment configurations and manufacturing approaches. * Assist in evaluating alternative components, materials, and design approaches to improve cost efficiency. * Support project handoffs from estimating and proposal development into engineering and manufacturing. ### **Project Support \& Continuous Improvement** * Maintain accurate estimating documentation, cost breakdowns, and proposal records. * Help improve estimating methods, templates, and processes as the company continues to expand. * Communicate with internal teams to ensure project assumptions, technical requirements, and estimated costs are clearly understood. * Support ongoing improvements in proposal accuracy, turnaround time, and overall customer satisfaction. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Preferred Background** * Experience in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, estimating, technical proposals, or related industrial equipment roles. * Strong mechanical aptitude and understanding of how industrial machinery is designed, manufactured, and assembled. * Ability to interpret mechanical blueprints, engineering drawings, and technical specifications. * Familiarity with machining, fabrication, mechanical components, assembly processes, and manufacturing costs. * Experience preparing estimates, quotations, bills of materials, or technical documentation. * Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple engineering and manufacturing departments. **Highly Desirable Experience** * Custom machinery or machine tool manufacturing. * Industrial automation and special\-purpose equipment. * Mechanical design or hands\-on machine building. * Capital equipment estimating or proposal engineering. * CNC machining, precision manufacturing, or mechanical assembly. * CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar engineering platforms. * ERP systems and manufacturing cost estimation. A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline is preferred. Candidates with substantial hands\-on industry experience will also be considered. **Why Join This Team?** ----------------------- **An Exciting Time to Join a Growing Organization** The company is entering an important period of expansion, creating opportunities for motivated individuals who want to contribute to its continued success. **Career Growth \& Advancement** As the engineering and manufacturing operations expand, employees will have opportunities to broaden their technical responsibilities, develop leadership capabilities, and pursue long\-term career advancement. **Exposure to Complex Engineering Projects** Work on challenging custom machinery and automation projects that require creative problem\-solving, mechanical knowledge, and collaboration across multiple technical disciplines. **A Hands\-On Engineering Environment** Unlike positions focused strictly on spreadsheets and pricing, this opportunity provides direct exposure to the equipment, engineering processes, and manufacturing operations behind each project. **Make a Real Impact** Your work will contribute directly to winning new projects, improving estimating accuracy, and supporting the company's continued growth. **Compensation** ---------------- * **Starting base salary: $80,000–$90,000 annually** , depending on qualifications and experience. * Full\-time, direct\-hire opportunity. * Long\-term professional development and career growth potential. * Additional benefits and compensation details to be discussed during the interview process. **Ready to Take the Next Step?** -------------------------------- If you're mechanically inclined, enjoy solving engineering challenges, and want to build a career with a growing industrial machinery manufacturer, we want to hear from you! jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Electrical Engineer** **Consarc Corporation \| Rancocas, New Jersey \| Full\-Time** **Engineer the Technology Behind the Materials That Shape Our World.** **Who We Are** Every time you board an airplane, drive a car, use your smartphone, or benefit from modern medical technology, you rely on advanced materials engineered to perform under extraordinary conditions. **But where do those materials come from?** Many begin their journey in specialized melting and processing equipment designed and manufactured by companies like Consarc. Since 1962, Consarc Corporation has been at the forefront of vacuum melting, vacuum casting, remelting, and vacuum heating technology. Our equipment helps manufacturers produce the high\-performance metals and alloys used in jet engines, aerospace components, medical implants, power generation equipment, and other products that people depend on every day. Today, our work extends into some of the most interesting areas of modern manufacturing. We're developing equipment for rare earth permanent magnets used in electric vehicles, wind turbines, and advanced electronics; specialized alloys for next\-generation aerospace and defense applications; and advanced metal powders used in additive manufacturing and other emerging technologies. Consarc is part of the Inductotherm Group, a worldwide family of companies specializing in induction heating, melting, thermal processing, and advanced manufacturing equipment. This gives us the resources, technical expertise, and international reach of a global industrial organization while maintaining the hands\-on engineering environment of a specialized equipment manufacturer. From our headquarters in Rancocas, New Jersey, we design and build sophisticated, custom\-engineered systems for customers around the world. With strong demand for our products and a new manufacturing expansion underway, we're investing in the people and capabilities needed for the next generation of Consarc technology. If you're an engineer who wants to see your designs become real machines, solve challenging technical problems, and work on equipment that helps make the materials behind modern technology, Consarc offers that opportunity. **The Opportunity** We are seeking an Electrical Engineer to join our Engineering team and contribute to the design, development, and implementation of electrical power and control systems for advanced industrial melting and thermal processing equipment. Our furnaces combine high\-power electrical systems, sophisticated power electronics, automation, instrumentation, and precision process control. Every project presents a different combination of engineering challenges, often involving specialized equipment designed around a customer's unique manufacturing requirements. This is a hands\-on engineering position with involvement throughout the project lifecycle, from initial design and component selection through manufacturing, factory testing, installation, and commissioning. You'll work directly with experienced engineers, manufacturing personnel, and technical specialists, gaining exposure to complex industrial systems and opportunities to develop expertise in specialized power and process technologies. **What You'll Do** · Design and develop electrical power generation, conversion, and distribution systems for industrial vacuum melting, vacuum casting, remelting, and vacuum heating equipment. · Prepare electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, bills of materials, and technical specifications using electrical CAD software. · Engineer and specify electrical components and power electronics, including SCRs, IGBTs, transformers, inductors, reactors, filters, and related equipment. · Perform electrical design calculations, including load analysis, power distribution, circuit protection, and component sizing. · Integrate electrical power systems with industrial automation, instrumentation, safety systems, and auxiliary equipment. · Collaborate with mechanical engineers, controls engineers, manufacturing personnel, and project managers to develop complete equipment solutions. · Support manufacturing, assembly, factory acceptance testing, and validation of electrical power and control systems. · Troubleshoot electrical equipment and resolve technical issues during manufacturing, testing, startup, and commissioning. · Participate in the development and improvement of electrical designs, engineering standards, and equipment performance. · Provide technical support to customers and field service personnel, including occasional domestic and international travel. **Required Qualifications** · Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering. · Two to five years of relevant experience in industrial electrical engineering, power electronics, electrical equipment design, or a related field. · Working knowledge of industrial electrical power systems and electrical equipment. · Experience with electrical schematic development and design sof f the following areas would be particularly valuable: · Design of industrial power supplies, rectifiers, converters, or other high\-power electrical systems. · SCR\- or IGBT\-based power conversion and control. · Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley or Siemens PLC systems. · Industrial automation, instrumentation, and HMI development. · Electrical panel design and industrial electrical safety standards. · PCB design and electronic circuit development. · Industrial induction heating, melting, or other high\-power thermal processing applications or other complex industrial machinery. Candidates do not need experience in vacuum melting or metallurgical processing. We are interested in engineers with strong electrical fundamentals, practical problem\-solving skills, and an interest in learning specialized technologies. **Why Build Your Career at Consarc?** **Engineering you can see in action.** You'll work on equipment that is designed, assembled, and tested at our facility, with opportunities to see your work operating in manufacturing plants around the world. **Challenging, varied projects.** Our equipment is often custom engineered, giving you opportunities to solve problems that go beyond repetitive product design. **Exposure to advanced technologies.** Our projects involve high\-power electrical systems, industrial automation, vacuum processing, advanced alloys, precision casting, and emerging materials technologies. **Professional development.** Work alongside experienced engineers and technical specialists, with opportunities to expand your knowledge and take on greater technical responsibility as your career develops. **A growing company with global resources.** Consarc combines more than six decades of engineering experience with the international capabilities of the Inductotherm Group. Our current manufacturing expansion reflects our investment in long\-term growth. **Compensation \& Benefits** Consarc offers a competitive compensation and benefits package that includes: · Base salary based on qualifications and experience. · Quarterly incentive bonus. · Retirement benefits include Company funded Profit\-Sharing Trust, 401(k) plan, and access to financial advisory services. · Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage as well as flexible Spending accounts (FSAs) and various wellness specialist programs. · Life and disability insurance. · Tuition reimbursement. · Scholarship opportunities at Rowan University for eligible employees' children. · Paid time off for vacation or illness. · Paid holidays. **Physical Requirements** The physical demands and characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. · While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to talk, stoop, hear, use fingers to handle, feel, or operate objects, tools, or controls, and reach with hands and arms. · Standing and walking for extended periods of time. · Ascending and descending stairs and/or ladders. · Ability to travel by airplane. · Ability to work on a computer for several hours at a time. **Condition of Employment** Successful candidates must submit to post offer, pre\-employment physical examination and drug screen. Consarc Corporation is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status. An E\-Verify Employer . Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Vision insurance Ability to Commute: * Rancocas, NJ 08073 (Preferred) Ability to Relocate: * Rancocas, NJ 08073: Relocate before starting work (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Managed Services Help Desk / Network Technician
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Cornerstone Information Systems, Inc. is a managed IT and cybersecurity services provider (MSP/MSSP) seeking a dependable, customer\-focused Managed Services Help Desk / Network Technician to join our technical team. This position serves as a frontline technical resource for our managed services customers, responding to customer support requests as well as alerts and service requests generated by the tools we use to proactively monitor, manage, and protect customer environments. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving problems, communicates well with customers, stays organized in a fast\-paced environment, and is eager to continue developing their technical skills. This position will work closely with other Cornerstone technicians and engineers to resolve issues efficiently while providing a professional and positive customer experience. **Primary Responsibilities** * Serve as a first point of contact for customer technical support requests and managed services alerts. * Receive, document, prioritize, and manage support requests through Cornerstone's ticketing system. * Provide remote troubleshooting and technical assistance for Windows computers, Microsoft 365, printers, peripherals, applications, and other end\-user technology. * Perform basic troubleshooting of wired and wireless networks, internet connectivity, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and related network services. * Assist with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, user accounts, permissions, password resets, and other access\-related requests. * Install, configure, replace, and deploy approved software, workstations, and other end\-user equipment. * Monitor and investigate endpoint, server, network, backup, Microsoft 365, and security\-related alerts generated by Cornerstone's managed services platforms. * Review and triage alerts to determine appropriate action, perform routine remediation when appropriate, and escalate issues requiring additional expertise. * Perform proactive maintenance activities including patching, endpoint health, backup monitoring, software deployment, and investigation of automated\-task failures. * Recognize potential cybersecurity incidents and promptly follow established escalation and response procedures. * Help maintain customer systems in accordance with Cornerstone standards, documented procedures, and best practices. * Take ownership of assigned tickets through resolution or appropriate escalation, keeping customers informed of status and next steps. * Accurately document troubleshooting, resolutions, customer communications, time, and relevant customer technical information. * Identify recurring problems, trends, or opportunities for broader remediation and improvement of customer systems or internal processes. * Work closely with other Cornerstone technicians and engineers and assist other technical teams as business needs require. * Participate in ongoing technical training and continually develop troubleshooting and technical skills. **Technical Knowledge** Candidates should have basic working knowledge of, or a strong willingness to learn, the following: * Windows 10/11 and Windows Server * Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Word, and Excel * Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, user accounts, permissions, and identity management * Desktop/laptop hardware, printers, peripherals, and physical and virtual servers * TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, wired/wireless networking, firewalls, and VPN connectivity * Remote support, monitoring, ticketing, and documentation systems * Endpoint protection, EDR/MDR concepts, phishing, common cybersecurity threats, and appropriate security\-event escalation **Qualifications** * High school diploma or equivalent required. * Technical degree, associate degree, certifications, or comparable IT experience preferred. * A minimum of two years of hands\-on IT support experience. Equivalent technical experience and demonstrated ability will be considered. * Previous help desk experience preferred. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Good verbal and written communication skills. * Strong customer service skills and a professional attitude. * Ability to explain technical issues in terms customers can understand. * Ability to manage multiple tickets and priorities while maintaining good documentation. * Willingness to ask questions and escalate appropriately when an issue is outside the individual's experience level. * Ability and willingness to continually learn new technologies. * Dependable, organized, and able to work effectively as part of a team. **Preferred Certifications** Certifications are not necessarily required for the right candidate, but the following would be beneficial: * CompTIA Network\+ * CompTIA Security\+ * Microsoft 365 Fundamentals * Microsoft Azure Fundamentals * Cisco Certified Support Technician (CCST) Networking * Other equivalent entry\-level IT certifications **What Success Looks Like** A successful Technician at Cornerstone will: * Respond to customer needs professionally and promptly. * Take ownership of issues rather than simply passing them along. * Resolve appropriate support requests independently and recognize when escalation is needed. * Keep tickets and customer documentation accurate and current. * Communicate clearly with both customers and other technicians. * Look for ways to improve the customer's overall technology experience, not just close the immediate ticket. * Continually improve technical knowledge and troubleshooting ability. * Contribute positively to the Cornerstone team and customer relationships. **Why Cornerstone** At Cornerstone, technicians work with a wide range of business technologies and customer environments rather than supporting the same systems every day. As a managed IT and cybersecurity services provider, our team works across traditional IT support, networking, Microsoft 365, infrastructure, and cybersecurity. Team members have opportunities to learn from experienced technicians and engineers, broaden their technical skills, and grow into more advanced technical and cybersecurity roles. **Work Environment** This position is intended to be primarily office\-based, providing remote help desk support to Cornerstone customers. Occasional on\-site customer assistance, equipment preparation, workstation deployment, or other technical support may be required based on business needs. Salary or hourly pay based on experience. Full benefits including insurance and 401(k). We would prefer a candidate living in or near Hopkinsville, KY or Bowling Green, KY. Candidates in other areas may still apply. jobs.title: OT Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation's growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future. At Cypress Creek Energy, we're meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build. That same commitment extends to our employees. We invest in professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams, and provide opportunities to take ownership, expand your expertise, and advance your career. Our culture is grounded in safety, accountability, respect, and a shared commitment to deliver results. Join us and help meet one of the most important energy challenges of our time while building a rewarding career. **Overview** Cypress Creek is looking for an OT Cybersecurity Engineer to protect the SCADA and operational technology systems that monitor and control our generation sites. You will maintain OT systems by keeping them patched, protected from malware, monitored for intrusions, ensuring resiliency, and you will work with the SCADA team, IT, and vendors to do it without disrupting operations. **Responsibilities** **Patch and vulnerability management** * Track vendor advisories and vulnerabilities for OT assets, including SCADA servers, HMIs, historians, RTUs/PLCs, firewalls, switches, routers, and cellular gateways. * Test and schedule patches with vendors and site teams. Document approvals, maintenance windows, rollback plans, and exceptions. * Run vulnerability scans, prioritize findings by risk, and track remediation to closure. * Report on patch compliance and open vulnerabilities across sites. **Antivirus and endpoint protection** * Deploy and manage antivirus and endpoint protection on OT\-appropriate Windows and Linux hosts, including scan schedules and exclusions that will not disrupt control systems. * Review detections, investigate suspicious activity, and remediate infected or at\-risk systems. * Manage removable media and transient asset controls for vendor and field laptops. **Network intrusion detection and incident response** * Monitor OT network traffic with intrusion detection and monitoring tools such as Dragos, Zeek, Snort, or similar, and tune rules to reduce false positives. * Triage and investigate alerts in the SIEM, determine scope and impact, and escalate or contain as needed. * Maintain and test incident response plans, including tabletop exercises with IT, operations, and vendors. * Review firewall logs, VPN activity, and remote access for anomalies. **Vulnerab****ility Assess****ment****s** * Plan and perform active vulnerability assessments of OT assets during approved maintenance windows, using validated scanning methods that minimize operational risk.. * Conduct passive vulnerability assessments using network monitoring, asset discovery, configuration reviews, and available threat intelligence without disrupting control\-system operations. * Analyze and prioritize assessment findings based on exploitability, asset criticality, operational impact, and applicable OT cybersecurity requirements. * Develop mitigation and remediation plans with asset owners, operations, IT/OT, and vendors; validate corrective actions and track findings through closure or documented risk acceptance. * Coordinate with third\-party assessors on external vulnerability assessments, including defining scope and rules of engagement, facilitating access, reviewing results, and managing follow\-up actions. **Resiliency****and** **dis****as****ter r****e****covery** * Develop and maintain site\-specific OT disaster recovery procedures, including system dependencies, restoration priorities, recovery time and recovery point objectives, and vendor contacts. * Maintain and monitor secure backups of SCADA servers, HMIs, historians, controller programs, and network device configurations, including offline or immutable copies * Perform scheduled backup restoration and disaster recovery exercises with operations, IT/OT, and vendors; document results, verify data integrity, and track corrective actions to closure. * Assess OT systems for single points of failure, maintain redundancy and critical spares, and coordinate failover testing within approved maintenance windows. * Coordinate safe restoration of OT services following outages or cyber incidents, validating system configurations, communications, and control functionality with operations before returning systems to service. **Compliance and collaboration** * Collect and maintain evidence for NERC CIP requirements covering patching, malware prevention, configuration baselines, vulnerability assessments, and incident response at CIP low and medium impact sites. * Align controls with NIST 800\-82 and NIST CSF, and support internal and third\-party security assessments. * Maintain asset inventories, network diagrams, and security documentation. * Work with regional teams and third\-party vendors on remote access, change control, and security requirements. **Education \& Experience Required** * 4\+ years in cybersecurity, security operations, or OT/IT systems security. * Hands\-on experience with patch management and vulnerability scanning. * Experience administering antivirus or endpoint protection tools and responding to detections. * Working knowledge of network protocols and traffic analysis, including Wireshark and IDS/IPS tools. * Experience with Windows and Linux system administration. * Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work across technical and non\-technical teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in ICS/SCADA or OT environments such as solar, wind, or utilities. * Working knowledge of NERC CIP requirements and compliance evidence. * Familiarity with OT protocols (DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850\) and OT monitoring platforms such as Dragos. * Experience with the tools listed below, or comparable products. * Preferred certifications: such as Security\+, GICSP, GCIP, CISSP, or CEH. * Scripting or automation experience (Python, PowerShell, Ansible). **Location:** The preferred location for this role is one of our office locations: Durham, NC. Our team operates on a hybrid schedule, with in\-office schedule of three days per week. **Benefits:** * 15 days of Paid Time Off, accrual up to 20 days, 11 observed holidays. * 401(k) Match * Comprehensive package including medical, dental, vision and health insurance * Wellness stipend, family planning stipend, and generous parental leave * Tuition Reimbursement * Phone Bill Reimbursement * Company Swag **A note to Recruiting Agencies Cypress Creek Energy Human Resources team does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. The Human Resources team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. We do not accept resumes from third\-party recruiters unless authorized by the Human Resources team and if a signed agreement is in place. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered property of CCE and we are not responsible for any related fees. All communication related to recruiting partnerships should ONLY be directed to the Human Resources team.** **Cypress Creek Energy is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive and values diversity, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.** *Please be aware of recruiting scams—official communications will only come from @ccrenew.com, we will never request personal or financial information, and any suspicious activity should be reported to* *HR@ccrenew.com**.*

In this role you will define Dow's enterprise AI architecture strategy: the reference architectures, standards, and roadmaps that enable business transformation and support Dow's corporate and business strategies. jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **What we're building** ======================= We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams. **Why join Shadow?** ==================== * **Product Ownership** You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions. * **Shape the Engineering Culture** You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring. * **Work with Challenger Consumer Brands** Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast\-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue. **The agency behind the product** ================================= Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100\+ people, runs 100\+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo. **This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).** **The role** ============ You'll sit squarely at the intersection of back‑end and front‑end, ensuring seamless integration between APIs, databases, UIs, and ML services. own RAG or fine‑tuning pipelines. * Ensure front‑end and back‑end systems interoperate flawlessly, minimize friction, optimize data flow, and enforce contracts. * Collaborate with product, research, design, and infra teams to define requirements, iterate rapidly, and ship production‑grade code. * Monitor performance, reliability, and security. * Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, architecture reviews, and shared best practices. **Must haves** ============== * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience with end‑to‑end ownership in a full‑stack role. * Deep expertise in Python, Node.js, React/TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. * Able to be hands‑on with GCP, containerization (Docker/K8s), and building/supporting high‑traffic systems. * Proven experience integrating AI/ML models (LLMs, NLP, RAG) into production apps. * Familiarity or strong interest in working with MCP servers. * Exceptional problem‑solving skills and a product mindset: you think deeply about UX, performance, and business impact. * You sweat both technical details and end\-user experience. **Nice to haves** ================= * Experience with multi‑step or agentic AI workflows. * Background in AI infrastructure or tooling companies. * Contributions to open‑source AI/ML projects. **What It's Like to Work at Darkroom** ====================================== Darkroom is not a typical agency. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. * **Unlimited PTO \+ US holidays:** Rebooting is part of the work. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain. * **Health \& Wellness:** Company\-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage. * **Finances, growth, and retirement:** Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit\-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows. * **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition. * **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for performance\-based compensation. A summary of benefits is listed above. **Equal Opportunity Statement** ------------------------------- Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 15 years of experience in engineering or related function. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with the modern LLM stack (e.g., agent architectures and harnesses, multi\-agent swarms, post\-training/fine\-tuning/RL, or large\-scale LLM evaluation). * Experience in software engineering, systems infrastructure, or AI/ML modeling using Python and C\+\+. * Experience with technical leadership and driving multi\-team, cross\-functional projects from inception to delivery. * Experience in information retrieval, search and ranking systems, clustering, or large\-scale data processing infrastructure. **About the job** ----------------- Going beyond standard long\-context retrieval, we are developing the Agera Kernel—a scalable engine designed for "pre\-computation of expertise." At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * Software Engineer$173\.8K – $212\.4K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • 10% Bonus This range is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills and experience. There may be instances where a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description. Please note that the compensation details listed on US role postings reflect the base salary only and does not include bonus, equity or benefits. **Company Overview** ==================== Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion\-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real\-time APIs for speech\-to\-text (STT), text\-to\-speech (TTS), and building production\-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. **Company Operating Rhythm** ============================ At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\. **Team Overview** The Applied AI team takes on the voice AI problems that don’t have off\-the\-shelf answers. We work directly with enterprise customers and technology partners, from conversational AI and customer experience platforms to restaurant brands, and much of the work is zero to one. Current focus areas include robust ASR in noisy outdoor environments, self\-service fine\-tuning and model adaptation, domain\-aware voice agents for drive\-thru and phone ordering, agent scoring and evaluation, real\-time operational analytics, and on\-site hardware integration. We’re a small team that works in person in San Francisco, ships to production quickly, and stays close to the customers we build for. **Key Goals** * Ship production features in live voice agent products, such as drive\-thru and phone ordering, within your first quarter. * Own customer problems end to end: hear the issue, find the root cause, and get the fix into production. * Help build reusable agent modules, like ordering and reservations, so new customers and industries launch faster. * Make agents more accurate on real\-world menus and catalogs, keeping structured data consistent across hundreds of locations. * Contribute to fine\-tuning and model adaptation so customers get accurate results on their own vocabulary and domains. * Spot problems across the product before anyone asks, then fix them or bring a proposed solution. * Run experiments that show whether new functionality improves outcomes for customers. **Minimum Skills, Knowledge \& Capabilities** * Experience building and shipping backend services that run in production in the cloud. * Operates AI\-native: you build with modern AI coding tools as your default way of working, not occasionally, and use them to move fast without lowering the quality bar. * Learns quickly and takes on unfamiliar parts of the stack with little ramp\-up. * Finds work instead of waiting for it: you recognize problems, propose solutions, and follow them through. * Has taken something from idea to production, at work or on your own time. * Communicates clearly with teammates and is comfortable working directly with customers. * Builds for the customer’s outcome, with a high bar for quality and no over\-engineering. * Comfortable working across languages. Our stack is mainly Kotlin and Python, with TypeScript on the front end. **Preferred Qualifications (nice\-to\-have)** * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning, or adapting models, through work, research, or substantial projects. * Experience building evaluation or scoring for models or agents. * Experience with audio, speech\-to\-text, or text\-to\-speech. * Experience as a founder or early startup engineer, or taking a system from zero to one. * Typically 2\+ years of engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience. ***Notice****: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @**deepgram.com* *email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.* Compensation Range: $173\.8K \- $212\.4K

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Description: Are you looking to be part of a high\-performing team of go\-getters who make a difference both on and off the court? Join the Detroit Pistons as we harness the power of basketball to unite our city, elevate our fans, and drive lasting community impact. The Data Engineer is a key member of the Detroit Pistons Business Strategy \& Analytics department, responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing the data infrastructure that supports business reporting, analytics, fan engagement, revenue generation, and operational decision\-making across the organization. This role will support the existing Microsoft SQL Server data warehouse while helping advance the organization’s transition to a modern data Lakehouse methodology leveraging Microsoft Fabric. The Data Engineer will work closely with the Senior Director of Data Strategy \& Reporting to support the department’s data architecture, governance, reporting, and integration roadmap. **What You'll Be Doing** **Data Architecture \& Engineering** * Develop, maintain, and optimize data pipelines, data models, database objects, and integration processes within a Microsoft\-based data environment. * Assist in the transition from a traditional data warehouse structure to a modern data lakehouse methodology using Microsoft Fabric. * Build scalable ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. * Support the design and implementation of Microsoft Fabric components, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, notebooks, and Power BI integration. **Data Governance \& Quality** * Support the Senior Director of Data Strategy \& Reporting in implementing data governance standards, data quality processes, and enterprise data best practices. * Develop and maintain data validation rules, reconciliation processes, and data quality checks across critical business datasets. * Ensure data accuracy, consistency, integrity, privacy, and reliability across source systems, data warehouse objects, lakehouse assets, and reporting outputs. **Reporting \& Analytics** * Prepare reliable, well\-documented, and governed data assets to support reporting, analytics, automation, and AI applications. * Support Power BI datasets, semantic models, dataflows, and reporting infrastructure as needed. * Partner with analysts and business stakeholders to ensure data models meet business requirements, reporting standards, and performance expectations. **Data Management \& Integration** * Integrate data from multiple internal and external systems into the organization’s data warehouse, data lakehouse, and analytics environment. * Work with APIs, flat files, relational databases, SaaS platforms, and cloud\-based systems to ensure reliable data ingestion and availability. * Monitor pipeline health, investigate failures, and implement long\-term solutions that improve reliability and reduce operational risk. * Maintain clear technical documentation for integrations, refresh schedules, dependencies, data transformations, and business logic. Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field preferred. * Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in data engineering, database development, business intelligence, data warehousing, or a related data role. * Experience working in a Microsoft data environment is required. **Skills \& Competencies** * Strong proficiency with Microsoft SQL Server and MS SQL data warehouse environments. * Advanced T\-SQL skills, including stored procedures, views, joins, indexing, query optimization, and data modeling. * Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple structured and semi\-structured data sources. * Strong understanding of data warehouse concepts, dimensional modeling, star schemas, data marts, and modern lakehouse methodologies. * Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Power BI, Azure SQL, Azure Data Lake, Synapse, or related Microsoft data tools. * Experience with Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, or other modern data engineering languages and frameworks. * Familiarity with preparing data for AI applications, including data quality, metadata, and secure access. * Ability to translate business needs into scalable data engineering solutions. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high\-quality work in a fast\-paced environment. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Growth)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Engagement ML team, working as part of the cross\-functional Onboarding squad in Discord's Growth organization. You'll design and build 0 1 end\-to\-end ML solutions that help brand\-new users find their place on Discord: the servers, people, and content that turn a first session into a long\-term connection to the product. If this excites you, keep reading! What You'll Be Doing Design, build, and scale the recommendation systems that connect new users to communities and content, from candidate generation and ranking through to online serving. Solve cold\-start personalization for users with little or no history on Discord, turning the limited signals available into recommendations for servers, communities, and content. Build and deploy ML models that lift new\-user retention, combining purpose\-built approaches with shared foundations such as user and server embeddings. Collaborate cross\-functionally to shape the Onboarding roadmap, balancing fast learning experiments with the long\-term complexity and scalability of the systems behind them What you should have 5\+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, or Applied Science, with a track record of shipping recommendation or personalization systems end to end. Hands\-on experience building modern recommendation systems: retrieval and ranking pipelines, embedding\-based retrieval (e.g. two\-tower models), and deep learning models (e.g. transformers, multi\-task learning). In both instances, the Receiver is responsible for conducting business on behalf of the company that has been placed in receivership. jobs.title: Embedded Software Team Lead
jobs.description: **What We Do** Dynamic Ratings is an ISO\-certified company dedicated to providing monitoring, control, and communication solutions for our customers in the utility industry. We provide condition\-based monitoring products and services to reduce outages, increase safety, and gain visibility of electrical equipment throughout the power grid, serving industries and communities worldwide. **The Role** We are looking for an Embedded Software Team Lead to guide the team that builds the software running on our embedded Linux monitoring platform. You will lead engineers across our Melbourne, Australia and Sussex, Wisconsin sites, set technical direction, and stay close enough to the code to review it, shape it and, when needed, write it. This is a role for an experienced embedded developer who enjoys growing people as much as solving hard technical problems, such as turning real\-world sensor data into analytics, alarms and insights that utilities act on. **What You’ll Do** Lead the Team* Lead the embedded software team across both sites: Work with the Engineering Director, Project Manager and other teams to set priorities, plan and track project schedules, and remove blockers. * Coach and mentor developers through code reviews, regular feedback and career development. * Take part in interviewing, hiring, performance reviews and team planning. Stay Technical* Design, develop and review C and C\+\+ applications on our custom embedded Linux platform including analytics and alarm logic. * Oversee support for industrial communication interfaces including DNP3, IEC 61850, Modbus and CAN bus. * Set coding, testing and documentation standards, and drive unit testing and performance optimization. * Collaborate with hardware, firmware, QA and DevOps teams on releases and integration. **What You’ll Bring*** BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * 7 or more years of embedded systems development experience, with a record of delivering shipped products. * Demonstrated experience leading people or projects, formally as a team lead or informally as a senior engineer who mentors and directs others. * Strong proficiency in C and C\+\+. * Solid Linux knowledge, including Bash scripting, and experience on embedded Linux platforms. * Understanding of shared memory IPC and multithreading. * Experience with software design, the full development lifecycle, and quality practices such as code review and unit testing. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work with distributed teams across time zones. * Familiarity with project tools and methods such as Wrike, Kanban and Agile. * Experience with DNP3, IEC 61850 or Modbus in a utility or industrial setting is a plus. * Scripting in Bash, Perl or Python is a plus. * Familiarity with XML and JSON configuration parsing and schema validation is a plus. * Basic understanding of power transformers, circuit breakers and electrical systems is a plus. **Why Work With Us** At Dynamic Ratings, we empower utilities and industries worldwide with cutting\-edge monitoring solutions. Our mission is to help customers predict and prevent failures before they happen. Innovation drives everything we do. From advanced analytics to real\-time monitoring, we deliver solutions that make a difference. Our team is passionate, collaborative, and committed to excellence. At Dynamic Ratings, you’ll find a culture that values growth, creativity, and teamwork. We believe in making power systems safer, smarter, and more reliable. Every day, we work to create solutions that matter. Ready to make an impact? Join us at Dynamic Ratings and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of energy. XJ6

jobs.title: IT/OT Controls Engineer
jobs.description: At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward\-thinking experts. We're one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals \& Mining, Warehousing \& Distribution, and CPG/Food \& Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site. We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced an IT/OT Controls Engineer to lead and contribute to the design and delivery of Unified Namespace (UNS) and IT/OT integration projects. This role is responsible for defining architecture requirements, developing detailed software design specifications, building and contextualizing industrial data models, and architecting DataOps solutions using platforms such as HighByte, HiveMQ, and Ignition. You will design and configure scalable, secure communications (MQTT/Sparkplug B, OPC UA, REST, and vendor\-specific protocols) that connect shop floor equipment to MES and other business systems. This is a fantastic opportunity to own projects from concept through commissioning in a regulated manufacturing environment. **Location: Remote with 20% travel expectations** **You will:** * Design, develop, and implement Unified Namespace (UNS) solutions using HiveMQ (MQTT/Sparkplug B), HighByte Intelligence Hub, and Ignition. * Model and contextualize plant\-floor data into standardized, ISA\-95\-aligned payload structures for consumption by MES, historians, and other business systems. * Integrate shop floor equipment and control systems with MES and enterprise applications using MQTT, OPC UA, REST APIs, and vendor\-proprietary protocols. * Configure and maintain edge connectivity to PLCs, SCADA, and legacy systems (including OPC DA sources) and manage the flow of data northbound into the UNS. * Utilize scripting languages such as Python (including Ignition/Jython scripting) for automation, data transformation, and integration tasks. * Collaborate with cross\-functional IT and OT teams to ensure seamless, secure integration across network layers. * Provide technical leadership and support for project implementation, testing, commissioning, and startup. * Develop and evaluate alternative architectures and system solutions that meet stated requirements. * Maintain and update project documentation appropriate to a regulated (GMP) environment and provide regular status updates to management and stakeholders. * Work successfully in a team environment focused on customer service and continuous improvement * Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates. **You have:** * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 3\+ years of experience in a similar role. * Strong understanding of Unified Namespace concepts and MQTT/SparkplugB. Hands\-on experience with HiveMQ or comparable brokers. * Experience with HighByte Intelligence Hub or similar industrial DataOps/data modeling platforms. * Experience with Ignition (gateway configuration, tag structures, scripting); Ignition certification a plus. * Experience with SQL/Postgres (For alarm/event and other interactions) * Proficiency in Python; familiarity with REST APIs, JSON payloads, and integrating web services. * Familiarity with SCADA systems and industrial data structures; experience with OPC UA and legacy OPC DA connectivity. * Experience integrating shop floor systems with MES, historians, or ERP. * Working knowledge of ISA\-95 models and terminology, particularly as applied to UNS hierarchy design and MES integration. * Familiarity with ISA\-88 batch control concepts a plus, given the biopharmaceutical manufacturing context. * Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and validation in a regulated environment; understanding of biopharmaceutical processes preferred. * Ability to work in a hybrid IT/OT environment, including an understanding of OT network architecture and segmentation (Purdue model awareness a plus). * Working knowledge of control system networks and controllers (Ethernet/IP, ControlNet, DeviceNet, etc.). * Proficiency in troubleshooting control systems and an understanding of process controls. * A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork. **Benefits \& Perks:** * 401k \+ match \+ prompt enrollment. E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry. * Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits. * Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off. * Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities. *E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable* *accommodations* *to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.* *\#LI\-HY1*

jobs.title: Lab Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** As a Lab Support Engineer, you’ll keep laboratory technology reliable and ready for use. You’ll provide hands\-on IT support, resolve hardware, software, and network issues, and guide users through clear, responsive customer service. Your impact: By restoring access to lab systems and equipment, you help laboratory teams stay focused on their work. **Responsibilities** * Deliver technical support and desktop support for Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems, computers, and mobile devices. * Troubleshoot computer hardware, software, and equipment; document issues and resolutions in help desk systems. * Manage customer support tickets, prioritize requests, communicate progress, and provide technical troubleshooting support. * Support computer networking and IT infrastructure, including LAN (local area network), TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol), DNS (Domain Name System), and VPN (virtual private network) connectivity. * Assist with Active Directory management, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), computer management, and Microsoft Office support. **Requirements** * Experience in IT support, technical support, desktop support, or a related customer support role. * Working knowledge of Windows support, computer hardware, operating systems, and equipment, software, and network troubleshooting. * Familiarity with help desk systems, customer support ticket management, Active Directory management, GPOs, VPN, TCP, TCP/IP, DNS, and LAN. * Strong customer service, communication, and analysis skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly. * Experience supporting macOS, Linux, and mobile devices is preferred. Pay: $35\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **ABOUT EARNIN** As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for people living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and excited to bring on world\-class talent to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey. EarnIn is becoming an AI\-native company, embedding AI agents into how we build, analyze, and operate across every function. Teams use AI Agents to move from ideas to execution faster. By letting agents handle repetitive tasks, our people can focus on judgment, creativity, and hard problems. We pair this experimentation with the strict review and security guardrails our regulated financial environment requires, always keeping a focus on privacy and the people who rely on our products. As a company, we are becoming AI\-native, and we encourage you to use AI tools throughout much of your interview process. If you use AI during the live interview, just say so; a quick, natural mention of how it helped and why you are using it is all we need. What we're evaluating is your judgment, reasoning, and ability to own and defend your work, not whether AI was involved. Some rounds, particularly those focused on your career history and past experiences, will not allow the use of AI, and we'll let you know of those in advance. When in doubt, ask your recruiter or interviewer directly. **POSITION SUMMARY** We seek an experienced, passionate, and resourceful Senior Staff Software Engineer to join our product engineering team.
