jobs.title: Solution Engineer (Open Ran)
jobs.description: **About Eridan** Eridan connects the robots powering the physical AI era. It's how we're delivering on our mission: connect the planet to empower a sustainable, shared future. Our patented transmitter delivers the fast, reliable wireless that robots depend on, while transforming the economics of connectivity, slashing costs and energy footprint by 10x at a global scale. Beyond robotics, our private 5G networks serve campuses, cities, industry, and defense. From our headquarters in Sunnyvale to our office in Zagreb, we're a team that owns our work, speaks candidly, and moves with focus and urgency. Learn more about our missionhere. **About the Role** **Build the end\-to\-end networks that connect today's robots and power the physical AI era.** We're looking for a Solution Engineer to join our Solutions team and own integrations between partner CU/DU stacks and Eridan's RU. You'll be the technical face of Eridan to our integration partners: explaining requirements, configuring and debugging systems, and validating that end\-to\-end performance is optimal, from the core all the way down to the radio. This isn't a coding role, but you'll live on the Linux command line. It's a systems role for someone who understands every part of a disaggregated RAN well enough to make them all talk to each other. The networks you bring up and validate are the ones robots, autonomous vehicles and smart factories will rely on, where latency and reliability decide whether a machine keeps moving. You'll split your time roughly 85% in our lab and 15% in the field, with the opportunity to travel to partner and customer sites, including internationally. **What you'll do** * **Bring systems online.** Lead end\-to\-end Open RAN bring\-up (core, SMO, CU, DU, RU). Validate new software, devices, and advanced radio variants (e.g., 4T4R, 100 MHz) in lab and field settings. Partner with internal Software and R\&D teams to integrate features and build new system capabilities. * **Prove performance across the whole chain.** Validate core CU DU RU UE performance against RF and network parameters, in the lab and in the field, including latency\- and uplink\-sensitive use cases like robotics and teleoperation. * **Own partner integrations end to end.** Run projects on your own, from first technical exchange to a complete, optimized integration. Work directly with partner engineers to explain requirements, drive debugging and keep things moving. * **Debug at every layer.** Track down issues across Linux systems, network switching and fronthaul, and RAN configuration, with tools from Keysight to Wireshark. **Why you'll love working here** * Build the wireless technology that connects robots and powers the physical AI era, with real impact on global infrastructure * Work where AI meets wireless, from robotics to AI\-native networks (AI\-RAN) * See your work ship: on our lean team, there are no layers between your ideas and the product * Grow your career on a team that owns its work, speaks candidly, and celebrates progress together * Pre\-IPO equity * 401(k) with automatic match * Health, vision, and dental insurance **Salary Range** Given our anticipated growth, we are open to hiring individuals with varying levels of experience to fill this role. Salary will be commensurate with job\-related skills, experience and other relevant factors. The base salary range for the primary location of this role is between $130,000 and $160,000 plus stock options and benefits. **Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship or visa transfers** Eridan is an equal opportunity employer. We value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history. **Job Summary** You'll be one of Etched's first Site Reliability Engineers, building the command\-and\-control layer for our fleet of frontier inference systems: the alerting, automated recovery and fleet data that keep clusters serving, and the routing that gets each problem to the right expert. Our Supercomputing and Infrastructure teams build the fleet management, rollout and telemetry backbone; but you'll decide which signals define a healthy system, set how we alert and respond, and build agentic hardware health workflows on top of it. Your job is to design and run a scalable system. Fleet SREs own detection, first response and handoff; domain SREs embedded in each team own the deep product fixes. Over time, most problems should be caught by an alert that measures what users experience, which is then triaged by agents, and sent to an engineer as needed, with the logs, dashboards and recent changes already attached. **Key Responsibilities** * **Define what a healthy inference system looks like.** In collaboration with software teams building out management and telemetry systems, identify the signals that most clearly show an unhealthy site, rack, node or chip, keep refining them as the fleet changes, and decide which actions (drain, cordon, restart, reroute, roll back) run on their own and which page a person. * **Set a common alerting standard.** Define SLOs with each team (latency such as time to first token, error rate, availability), alert on user\-facing symptoms, and verify that the metrics behind each alert measure what the alert assumes. * **Cut alert noise.** Suppress expected alerts during deploys and maintenance automatically, correlate related alerts into one incident, and retire pages nobody acts on. * **Automate recovery.** Turn runbooks into agentic hardware health recovery: service restarts, node drain and traffic shift, spare swaps. Build it with guardrails (scoped permissions, rate limits, blast\-radius checks, an audit trail).. * **Route every event to the right engineer.** Classify events by domain, page the right domain SRE with context attached, and dispatch on\-site technicians for physical work such as tray swaps, reseats and leak response. * **Shape the fleet data.** Work with Supercomputing and Infrastructure, who build the telemetry pipeline, so it captures the key signals. Set the tracing standard (OpenTelemetry) so every service can be followed end to end, and report uptime and reliability trends that drive engineering and capacity decisions. * **Run operationally excellent incident management.** Own severity levels, incident channels, communications, postmortems and corrective\-action tracking. Design on\-call rotations, handoffs and onboarding so on\-call is sustainable. * **Raise the reliability bar for services.** Review service designs with their owners for failure modes and graceful degradation before they ship, and partner with Supercomputing on canaries, rolling node\-by\-node deploys and graceful drain, so updates stop causing downtime. * **Share on\-call** in a follow\-the\-sun rotation with SREs in other time zones. **Hands\-on debug** * **Be the first line of defense.** Acknowledge, size the user impact, open the incident, and decide fast between restart, drain, rollback and escalation. * **Find where requests are stuck.** Trace a latency or throughput regression through the serving stack (queueing, prefill, decode, handoffs, cache) to the stage that's backing up. * **Triage hardware on live racks.** Work through errors: chips dropping off PCIe, firmware panic resets, chip\-to\-chip link errors, HBM ECC errors and power faults; run recovery tools and decide when a node comes out. * **Correlate across layers.** Follow a request end to end with distributed traces (OpenTelemetry), then line up deploys, firmware events, host and BMC logs, network data and facilities telemetry to tell a software bug from a hardware fault from a coolant or power event. * **Check the alert, not just the system.** When a page and a dashboard disagree, work out which one is wrong: a capped metric, a stale exporter or a failed scrape. * **Direct hands on site.** Walk on\-site technicians through reseats, PSU and tray swaps, and leak response with exact steps. * **Hand off cleanly.** Leave a timeline, evidence and current hypothesis so the domain SRE or next shift picks up without starting over. * **Close the loop.** Turn every manual fix into a runbook, then into tasks that can be executed by agents, so the same page doesn't wake anyone twice. **You may be a good fit if you have (Must\-have qualifications)** * 2\+ years in site reliability, production engineering or infrastructure for large\-scale production systems (8\+ years for the San Jose lead seat). * You've defined alerting standards that several teams adopted, using Prometheus, Grafana or similar, and you know SLOs, error budgets and alert design well enough to teach them. * Real on\-call experience for services with external users, including leading incidents and writing blameless postmortems. * A track record of debugging production incidents in systems you didn't write, under time pressure, from logs, metrics, traces and core dumps. * Experience with application and scripting languages like python, golang, rust, etc. * Hands\-on with Linux, containers, Kubernetes and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible or similar). * Fluency with Linux debugging tools (perf, strace, gdb, dmesg, journalctl, lspci, tcpdump) for when the dashboards don't have the answer. * Comfort with hardware in the loop: devices dropping off PCIe, ECC errors, power and thermal events, and failures that cross software and physical layers. * Sound judgment about when automation should act on its own and when it should page a person. * Clear writing, and the ability to get five or more teams to agree on shared standards. **Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice\-to\-have qualifications)** * Operated GPU, accelerator or HPC fleets. * LLM inference serving: prefill and decode, KV cache, batching, and latency metrics such as time to first token. * Network debugging from switch to edge: tracing problems across switches, load balancers and Cloudflare, and using edge controls like rate limits to shed or shift traffic during an incident. * Out\-of\-band management (BMC, Redfish, IPMI) and fleet\-wide firmware rollouts. * Data center telemetry: power distribution, liquid cooling and CDUs, DCIM. * PagerDuty or similar incident tooling, including event correlation and automated remediation. * Working with colocation providers and remote\-hands technicians. * Founding or scaling an SRE function at a startup. **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision packages with generous premium coverage * $500 per month credit for waiving medical benefits * Housing subsidy of $2,500 per month for those living within walking distance of the office * Relocation support for those moving to San Jose (Santana Row) * Various wellness benefits covering fitness, mental health, and more * Daily lunch and dinner in our office * Unlimited compute budget subject to ROI justification **How we’re different** Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference\-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer\-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors. We are a fully in\-person team in San Jose (Santana Row), and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, AI Accounting
jobs.description: **Overview** Exponent is the fastest\-growing financial technology platform built exclusively for franchise and multi\-location brand operators. We offer three integrated products — industry\-leading financing programs including a charge card, acquisition and build\-out loans, and an AI\-powered Accountant — giving operators a single platform to manage spend, access growth capital, and automate their financial operations. We have secured significant equity and credit capital and are backed by leading institutional investors and family offices who operate large franchise portfolios. **Role Description** The role will own core systems inside our AI\-powered Accountant — the product that ingests a franchise operator’s POS, banking, payroll, and processor data, classifies and reconciles it, and automates the monthly close. You will be hand\-on, working alongside a tightly knit, experienced engineering team that ships to production every day. This is a individual contributor role with a path to leading engineers as the team grows. **What You’ll Do** **Own systems end to end:** Design, build, ship, and operate backend systems in production \-from schema to deploy to on\-call. You own what you built after it goes live. **Make unreliable data reliable:** Integrate against difficult third\-party APIs and design ingestion that is idempotent by default — deduplication, safe replay, historical backfill — so every source can be re\-pulled and re\-processed without corrupting the ledger. **Keep every account in sync:** Own the background job infrastructure that keeps thousands of accounts in sync — scheduling, locking, retries, failure handling, and the observability to know when a sync silently stopped. A stuck job is a product bug, not an ops chore. **Put LLMs and ML into the product path:** LLMs and ML models already do the classification and reconciliation work in the product, and we are taking it from build to first pilots now — the point where the decisions about output validation, confidence thresholds, fallbacks, and failure handling actually get made. You will make them. Make a probabilistic component behave inside a system that has to be deterministic where it matters. **Help build a world class growth company:** We are a small, experienced team with broad scope. Every engineer owns what they ship and is expected to exercise judgment rather than wait for direction. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** The electrical engineer is responsible for developing and executing basic and detailed engineering for electrical systems applied to modular process packages and skids in the oil \& gas, petrochemical, and power industries. The electrical engineer will combine strong technical electrical design fundamentals, in accordance with applicable international standards and company specifications, senior\-level technical decision\-making, and mentorship of junior engineers, with the ability to provide hands\-on support during shop fabrication and in the field, including direct client interaction during commissioning and after\-sales service. **Responsibilities** * Lead the development and review of one\-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, conduit/cable tray installation drawings, and hazardous area classification layouts. * Perform and validate electrical load calculations, conductor sizing, voltage drop, short circuit, and protective device coordination studies, including review of calculations prepared by junior engineers or sub\-contractors. * Specify and select electrical equipment (transformers, MCCs, VFDs, motor starters, lighting, grounding systems) in accordance with client requirements and applicable standards (NEC, IEEE, NEMA, API RP 500/505\). * Prepare and approve technical specifications, equipment data sheets, and bid packages for electrical equipment and materials. * Develop and validate hazardous area classifications (Class I Div. 1/2, Zone 1/2\) per NEC Articles 500\-505, ensuring all specified components meet the required classification. * Review and approve vendor drawings for conformance with project specifications. * Serve as the senior technical reference for complex electrical design questions within the team. * Provide direct technical support to the shop during fabrication, wiring, and testing of skid mounted electrical systems. * Resolve field deviations and coordinate engineering changes (redlines/as\-builts) during construction. * Lead or participate in point\-to\-point checks, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and continuity/insulation verification prior to shipment. * Coordinate with the instrumentation, mechanical/piping, and structural teams to ensure proper integration of electrical systems within the skid. * Provide on\-site technical support during installation, commissioning, and start\-up of supplied electrical systems. * Diagnose and resolve complex field electrical issues (troubleshooting) on installed and operating equipment. * Document field findings and provide feedback to the engineering team for continuous improvement of future designs. * Train client personnel and junior team engineers on the operation and maintenance of supplied electrical systems. * Review installation procedures, alignment methods, and start\-up protocols. * Interface with vendors and multidisciplinary teams (process, mechanical, piping, instrumentation and controls, rotating equipment, operations and maintenance teams). * Develop and update internal specifications, guidelines, engineering standards and best practices related to rotating equipment. * Maintain technical documentation and lessons learned from equipment operation and failures. * Provide technical training and mentorship to junior engineers and maintenance staff. * Issue BOMs and work instruction releases. * Communicate effectively and consistently with internal and external clients. **Qualifications** ***Education and Experience*** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field. * Minimum 10 years of electrical engineering experience in the oil \& gas, petrochemical, or power generation industry, with a demonstrated track record of technical leadership on projects. * Proven experience designing electrical systems for modular packages/skids. * Experience with field support/commissioning at industrial sites. ***Technical Knowledge*** * Proficiency in applicable codes and standards: NEC (NFPA 70\), IEEE, NEMA, API RP 500/505, IEC (for international projects), and hazardous area classification. * Proficiency with electrical design tools (AutoCAD Electrical, SKM PowerTools, ETAP, or equivalent short\-circuit/coordination software). * Working knowledge of control systems (PLC/DCS), associated instrumentation, and their interface with electrical systems. Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - AI/ML Platform
jobs.description: Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e\-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in\-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties. At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day \- building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. **About the team** The AI/ML Platform pod builds Fanatics' internal AI platform: the paved road for every team building with LLMs, MCPs, and agents. Gateway, agent runtime, registry, retrieval, evaluation, and cost analytics, all running on a petabyte\-scale lakehouse with enterprise\-grade governance. You'll join a pod that owns this platform end to end. This is a Staff\-level role, and a hands\-on one. You will choose the architecture, define the standards other teams build to, and stay in the code, shipping the hardest parts yourself. The decisions you make are ones the organization lives with for years. **Responsibilities** * Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the AI control plane: gateway, agent runtime, registry, retrieval, evaluation, and cost. Set technical direction, sequence the roadmap, and make the build\-versus\-buy calls. * Build the enterprise LLM gateway: multi\-provider routing, failover, caching, rate limiting, token optimization, and key management, with a path to self\-hosted open\-weight models where cost, latency, or data residency call for it. * Build the Agent/MCP ecosystem on a managed runtime such as AWS BedrockAgentCore: enterprise systems exposed as governed tools over MCP, a control\-plane registry for discovery, ownership, versioning, and lifecycle, and a no\-code path from prototype to governed production agent, surfaced through a company\-wide chat portal. * Own the unified retrieval layer and the data platform behind it: the governed front door plus the ingestion, chunking, embedding, and indexing pipelines and the vector and search backends that feed it, kept reproducible, observable, and quality\-gated at petabyte scale. * Build the evaluation and feedback loop: offline evals, tracing, and regression gates in CI/CD, with production failures and user edits turning into new eval cases and root\-cause attribution across prompts, retrieval, tools, and models. * Own governance and cost: RBAC, agent identity, least\-privilege access to enterprise data, audit logging, use\-case\-level cost attribution, and the enterprise AI tool portfolio, standing up to finance, executive, and EU AI Act scrutiny. * Raise the bar: set the engineering standards, mentor engineers, and represent the architecture and its trade\-offs directly to senior leadership **Qualifications** * 8\+ years building production software, including 2\+ years on AI/ML platform. Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience. * Staff\-level impact: system design across multiple services, decisions that span teams, and platforms other engineers build on. * Strong Python and FastAPI, plus one of Java, GoLang, Scala, or TypeScript. Hands\-on with Terraform, Kubernetes, Airflow, Postgres, Grafana, and Prometheus, and familiar enough with the AWS data science toolkit and libraries like PyTorch to partner credibly with data scientists. Chat UI or internal developer portal work is welcome. * Hands\-on with LLMs and generative AI on Bedrock or Vertex: model routing, RAG, tool calling, structured outputs, and context engineering. Agentic systems and MCP server and client integrations. Agent runtimes such as AWS Bedrock AgentCore matter here, and because they are new we look for depth rather than years. Exposure to self\-hosted serving with vLLM, SGLang, or llama.cpp is welcome. * The data engineering behind retrieval: chunking, embedding, and indexing pipelines, vector or search backends such as OpenSearch, open lakehouse table formats, and a working method for measuring retrieval quality. * LLM evaluation and observability: eval dataset design, tracing, LLM\-as\-judge scoring, and regression testing, with tools such as Langfuse or Arize Phoenix. * Security and governance for AI platforms: RBAC, OAuth2/OIDC, least privilege, cost optimization, and usage metering. Familiarity with governance systems like DataHub and semantic layers, and with administering enterprise AI tools such as ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, or Glean, is welcome. * Writes clearly and holds the room with executives. Open\-source contributions or published work in agentic AI or LLMOps is welcome \#LI\-RT1 *At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset \- We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast\-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.* ***ABOUT US*** *Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.* ***ABOUT THE TEAM*** *Fanatics Commerce is a leading designer, manufacturer, and seller of licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods. It operates a vertically\-integrated platform of digital and physical capabilities for leading sports leagues, teams, colleges, and associations globally – as well as its flagship site,* *www.fanatics.com**.* *Fanatics Commerce has a broad range of online, sports venue, and vertical apparel partnerships worldwide, including comprehensive partnerships with leading leagues, teams, colleges, and sports organizations across the world—including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, Formula 1, and Australian Football League (AFL); the Dallas Cowboys, Golden State Warriors, Paris Saint\-Germain, Chelsea FC, and Tokyo Giants; the University of Notre Dame, University of Alabama, and University of Texas; the International Olympic Committee (IOC), England Rugby, and the Union of European Football Associations (UEFA).* *At Fanatics Commerce, we infuse our BOLD Leadership Principles in everything we do:* * *Build Championship Teams* * *Obsessed with Fans* * *Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit* * *Determined and Relentless Mindset* *By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our* *Candidate Privacy Policy.* *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

jobs.title: Data Scientist III
jobs.description: * Engineering * Atlanta * Full\-time ### **Description** Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model \- a proprietary AI\-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real\-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass\-box architecture, it uses market data \- not personal data \- with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry\-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. While Fetcherr initially focused on the airline industry, the company is now expanding into additional verticals, bringing its dynamic AI\-driven optimization capabilities to new industries such as travel, mobility, retail, e\-commerce, and beyond. **About the Role** This is not a pure research role but one that is actively involved in building our product. You will be joining a team of Data Software Engineers and you will be directly contributing to code. You will own well\- scoped modeling problems end to end, from exploring market data and designing features to validating models and getting them running in production, so that our pricing, inventory, and network optimization engines make better decisions in real time. This is a high\-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of applied AI and production software, working directly with other data scientists, ML and data engineers, and product teams. **What you will do:** * Develop, validate, and iterate on demand forecasting, pricing, and optimization models using large\-scale, high\-velocity market data. * Explore and analyze data from diverse internal and external sources to uncover signals, define features, and identify opportunities to improve model accuracy and business impact. * Design and run offline experiments, backtests, and online evaluations to measure model performance and profit uplift. * Write production\-grade Python code and work with ML and data engineers to productionize models, ensuring they are reliable, observable, and cost\-efficient. * Monitor deployed models for drift, accuracy, and data quality issues, and troubleshoot and fix problems quickly. * Keep our glass\-box principles front and center: build models whose logic and outcomes can be explained to commercial teams and customers. * Partner with product and commercial stakeholders to translate business problems into clear modeling approaches and communicate results. * Contribute to the technical direction of the modeling stack as Fetcherr scales across new customers, verticals, and product lines. ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of full\-time experience as a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, ML Engineer, or similar role building models that run in production. Lab, proof of concept, prototype, academic, and part\-time experience does not count toward this requirement. * Strong programming skills in Python, with production\-grade coding practices (testing, code review, version control). * Solid foundation in statistics, machine learning, and time\-series forecasting, with sound judgment on model validation and experiment design. * Strong SQL skills and experience working with large relational and non\-relational datasets. * Experience and comfort with AI\-assisted software development, along with the ability to write and reason about code yourself. * Experience with cloud platforms (GCP and BigQuery preferred) and modern data warehouse and lakehouse technologies. * Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster) and CI/CD practices for ML and data pipelines. * Strong analytical mindset and a pragmatic, get\-it\-done approach. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills, comfortable working cross\-functionally with engineering and product teams. **Nice to Have** * Experience with dynamic pricing, revenue management, or optimization problems. * Experience in travel, e\-commerce, logistics, or other real\-time decisioning domains. * Exposure to MLOps practices such as model registries, monitoring, and automated retraining. * Experience with real\-time OLAP engines such as ClickHouse. * Experience in a Software\-as\-a\-Service environment.

jobs.description: Description: At First Community Bank, we are committed to making our community, the places where we live and work, a better place each day. We offer comprehensive benefits including health, vision, and dental insurance, 401(k) plan with employer match, life insurance, and paid vacation days, holidays, and other time off options. With over 60 locations in four states, First Community Bank offers the personal service you would expect from a company that knows your community. We welcome all applicants and look forward to new colleagues joining our community! The Programmer Trainee role is designed for individuals who are eager to start a career in programming and software development. jobs.title: Research Engineer/Scientist - Dexterous Manipulation
jobs.description: **About Flexion** At Flexion, we're building the intelligence layer powering the next generation of humanoid robots. Our mission is to accelerate the transition from fragile prototypes to real\-world humanoid deployment. We are founded by leading scientists in robot reinforcement learning (ex\-Nvidia, ex\-ETH Zürich), and backed by leading international VC firms. In just months, we’ve gone from our first line of code to deploying real humanoid capabilities. **The role** We are seeking an expert in dexterous manipulation and large\-scale modeling to lead the development of our physical foundation models. The goal of this position is to leverage internet\-scale egocentric video to build Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models that enable our humanoid robots to interact with the world with human\-like fluidity. You bring a deep understanding of how to bridge the gap between observing human actions in video and executing high\-DOF (20\+) motor control. As a Research Engineer for Dexterous Manipulation at Flexion, you’ll work in our Zürich office to develop and deploy state\-of\-the\-art learning\-based controllers. You will take ownership of the model architecture, integrating egocentric priors with real\-time robot policies, to ensure our hardware can manipulate objects reliably and flexibly in unstructured environments. **Key Responsibilities** * Scalable Egocentric Pre\-training: Architect and implement large\-scale pre\-training objectives for egocentric video datasets to learn generalizable representations of hand\-object interactions and spatial\-temporal dynamics. * VLA Foundation Modeling: Develop and scale multi\-modal Foundation Models that unify visual perception and natural language instructions into actionable robotic trajectories. * Generative Policy Design: Design and optimize generative action heads using Diffusion Models and Flow\-matching techniques to capture the multi\-modal distribution of complex human movements. * Humanoid Motion Alignment: Develop novel algorithms to align human\-centric video representations with the kinematic constraints of 20\+ DoF humanoid systems, ensuring fluid and stable execution. * Reinforcement Learning \& Fine\-tuning: Utilize Offline RL and high\-fidelity simulation fine\-tuning to optimize foundation model performance for high\-success\-rate physical manipulation. * Cross\-Functional Research: Translate cutting\-edge research in scaling laws and world models into production\-ready architectures that enhance robot reliability and autonomy. **Requirements** * PhD or Master’s degree in Robotics, Machine Learning, or a closely related field, with a strong focus on data\-driven manipulation, egocentric vision, or foundation models. * Experience with Humanoid or Dexterous Manipulation, including a deep understanding of contact\-rich physics. * Excellent knowledge of Python, PyTorch, and the distributed training of large\-scale neural networks (FSDP, NCCL). * Proven expertise in Diffusion Models, Flow Matching, and Transformers. * Hands\-on experience deploying learning\-based controllers on real robot hardware. * Experience with Reinforcement Learning and simulation environments (e.g., IsaacLab, MuJoCo) **Benefits** * + Competitive compensation + Enhanced pension plan + Enhanced holiday \& paid leave perks + Relocation \& permit sponsorship + Central Zürich office with top\-tier robotics testing facilities and infrastructure + Joining Europe's leading robotics team \& exposure to never\-done\-before research + Energetic, collaborative culture with a bias for action and regular community events

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: As a Senior Data Scientist on Foley's Value Creation Office (VCO) team, you will lead Foley's research process alongside our Chief AI Officer. You will find where the value is in Foley's data, prove it, and help turn it into models, product features, and new offerings that ship. This role is consulting\-adjacent. You will work with leaders across the business to frame the right questions, and with our ML engineers and data engineers to give leadership a forward\-looking view of the business rather than a backward\-looking report. Foley holds years of driver records, compliance events, violations, screening results, and customer data, and there is significant opportunity to put that data to work. Exceptional communication and strong business analytics are central to this role. **What you'll do** ================== * **Lead the research process:** Partner with our Chief AI Officer to set the research agenda, decide which questions are worth answering, and run the process from hypothesis to evidence to recommendation. * **Partner with the business:** Work with leaders, customers, and subject matter experts to find where data science moves the business, such as driver risk, fraud and anomalies, retention, pricing, and compliance prediction. Size each opportunity, frame it, and make the case in plain language. * **Build a forward\-looking view of the business:** Work with ML engineers and data engineers to develop forecasts, leading indicators, and models that help leadership see where the business is heading and act earlier. * **Apply rigorous methods:** Learn how Foley's data is created before trusting it. Lead EDA, build and test hypothesis trees, engineer domain\-driven features, and build production\-ready models. Validate with holdouts, leakage checks, calibration, error analysis, and bias and fairness review. * **Treat data as a strategic asset:** Size the value of Foley's data, identify gaps worth closing, evaluate external data to buy or license, and help shape and price data products. * **Communicate and take insights to product:** Explain to executives, customers, and engineers what a model does, what it does not do, and how confident we are in it. Turn findings into product proposals and define success metrics before launch. **Who you are** =============== * Senior\-level, end\-to\-end data science experience: EDA, hypothesis development, feature engineering, modeling, and validation * Exceptional written and verbal communication, including presenting findings and recommendations to executives and non\-technical audiences * Strong business analytics skills: you can look at a business and a dataset, see where analysis would change a decision, and size the opportunity * Consulting or consulting\-adjacent experience, such as strategy, operations, PE value creation, due diligence, or an internal strategy or analytics team, including leading a research or analytics process from framing the question to delivering a recommendation * Strong statistics, including recognizing noise, leakage, and confounding, and communicating uncertainty clearly * Fluency in Python and SQL, and experience partnering with engineering to ship models to production **You might thrive in this role if you also have:** --------------------------------------------------- * Experience in transportation, logistics, or fleet, such as trucking, DOT/FMCSA, insurance, or safety * Experience in regtech or compliance, such as background screening, FCRA, drug testing, or other regulated data * Experience with forecasting, scenario planning, or leading\-indicator work used by an executive team * Experience turning a model or analysis into a product customers pay for * Experience with data sourcing, licensing, partnerships, pricing, or data product strategy * Experience with graph data, entity resolution, or text and document data with LLMs **Location:** **Location:** This role is primarily remote (US based), with the expectation of occasional visits to our offices for team collaboration, training, or company events. This role may be based remotely out of the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin **About us** ============ At Foley, we’re reimagining how safety\-sensitive industries hire, stay compliant, and manage risk. We’ve evolved into a modern SaaS company with an all\-in\-one, AI\-ready platform that helps transportation, construction, distribution, and utility businesses operate faster, smarter, and safer. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for curious, strategic thinkers who thrive in complexity, are motivated by making an impact, and want to join a team that’s passionate about building great products and supporting customers. Our core values — **Teammateship, Grit, and Innovation** — guide everything we do. Whether we’re collaborating internally or helping customers, we approach every challenge with optimism, humor, and a shared commitment to success. **Benefits** Foley offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off and holidays, wellness programs, and an employee assistance program. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Foley is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. **Reasonable Accommodations** If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at **careers@foley.io** **Employment Status** Employment with Foley is on an at\-will basis. Nothing in this job posting or in future communications should be construed as a contract of employment. **Massachusetts Applicants:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. **Privacy Policy:** Please see our Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how Foley processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights. Compensation Range: $140K \- $200K

jobs.title: Engineer, Software Engineer, Digital Banking
jobs.description: **COMPANY DESCRIPTION:** Forbright is a nationwide full\-service bank and commercial lender focused on helping to build a brighter future for our clients and the communities we serve. Forbright is committed to exceptional client service by providing seamless, innovative personal banking services to depositors and creative financing solutions to visionary middle market businesses and investors in healthcare, technology, financial services, real estate, and other industries. **COMPANY CULTURE:** We are a dynamic, high energy, fun, and fast\-paced organization that has an exciting growth trajectory, meaningful mission, and embedded responsible practices into our daily interactions. We offer our team members a culture of collaboration, inclusion, flexibility, recognition, and giving back. We look to hire individuals that are passionate about our mission, and who are motivated, customer and results\-oriented, innovative, adaptable, and thoughtful. **COMPANY MISSION:** We are a mission\-driven institution. We use Forbright’s capital, capabilities, innovation, and expertise to help our clients succeed and contribute broadly to building a brighter future. **JOB SUMMARY:** The Engineer, Software Engineering, Digital Banking is responsible for the build and test of integration services across the Digital Banking ecosystem. This role is a part of an Application Development team and works closely with other departments such as IT, Operations, and Business Units, to ensure seamless integration of systems and processes. ### **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Build technology features and functions to progress the product requirements of Forbright Bank’s Digital Banking ecosystem on the distributed and cloud platforms * Serve as a core member of an agile based development team, writing code and unit tests, automations, and deployments * Mentor more junior engineers and peers alike * Build microservices using Docker, Node.JS, Kafka, and Relational and NOSQL databases on the AWS cloud platform * Work on Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment using native AWS or other technologies * Work on developing observability capabilities as part of fundamental technology framework * Collaborate with peers in the development and product teams * Perform other duties as assigned ### **QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's Degree Computer Science or related field; or equivalent relevant experience required * 2\+ years of software engineering experience required * 2\+ years of Agile scrum methodology experience required * 2\+ years of CICD experience required * 2\-5 years of AWS experience preferred * Experience with AWS Cloud, Confluent Kafka, Node.js or equivalent * Knowledge of Typescript, Python and other programming languages * Proficiency in facilitation, communication, and presentation skills with tech and business audiences * Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel) * Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail * Outstanding problem\-solving and time management skills * Self\-motivated, self\-directed, and results\-oriented * Adaptable and able to multitask in a fast\-paced environment * Can work independently and within a team; solution\-oriented with a collaborative approach *The pay range for this position is below. The specific rate will depend on the successful candidate’s qualifications and prior experience. $85,000 (entry level qualifications) to $100,000 (highly experienced).* **POSITION REQUIREMENTS:** We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are capable of performing their job position. Work is primarily conducted in an office setting while certain positions may allow for remote work through the use of technology at management discretion. The functions described below are representative of those to successfully perform duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable employees to perform the essential functions. While performing duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required for extended periods of time to: * Remain in a stationary position * Use hands and fingers * Utilize a computer monitor with visual acuity * Operate technology or other office machinery such as printers, scanners, etc. * Communicate clearly verbally and/or in writing with others **ADDITIONAL DUTIES:** For Forbright Bank to remain efficient and nimble as a growing organization, team members are expected to exhibit a high level of flexibility regarding any duties that may be situationally assigned outside of this job description. **PERKS/BENEFITS:** * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans * 4 weeks PTO * 401k \+ company match * Metro SmartTrip benefits ($50/mo) * Remote or hybrid (4 days per week in\-office) work schedules for most positions * Incentives for purchasing solar panels, electric vehicles, biking to work, etc. * Paid subscriptions to Veterans Compost, Capital Bikeshare, Imperfect Foods reimbursement, and more! * The Washington Post Top Workplaces winner for four consecutive years (2023\-2026\) **CORE PRINCIPLES:** * **Excellence:** Excellence is not a goal, but a standard, reflected in the precision of our work and the quality of our decisions. Excellence is a discipline that compounds over time and creates lasting value; it must be measured and managed. * **People:** Our people are our greatest strength. We foster a culture of respect, inclusion, and ambition \- where everyone matters. We celebrate collaboration and teamwork and prize loyalty \- to one another, the company, our mission, and values. * **Innovation:** We invest boldly in technology, harnessing innovation not for its own sake but to make banking and lending better, faster, and smarter for our clients, more efficient for our team, and more profitable for our shareholders. By combining human insight with technological excellence, we strengthen our ability to serve, to adapt, and to succeed in a changing world. Innovation is a continuous investment in new ideas. * **Sound Practices:** Our foundation rests on prudence, care, integrity, and discipline. We manage credit and business risk with rigor and fundamentals\-based judgment, act with transparency, and uphold the highest standards of corporate governance and regulatory compliance to ensure sustainable growth and enduring financial strength. * **Distinct Value:** We focus our energy where we add value. We avoid the commoditized and the ordinary, choosing to compete through insight, specialization, technology and service. By concentrating on areas where expertise matters and relationships endure, we create differentiation that is defensible and lasting. * **Clients:** We exist to advance our clients’ success and to help them grow. We listen deeply, think creatively, and deliver solutions that solve problems, drive impact and add value. Every client relationship is built on partnership, performance, and purpose. * **Shareholders:** We are committed to creating exceptional value for our shareholders. We invest for the long term and view our shareholders as partners – not observers \- in value creation. We allocate capital wisely, execute with precision, and continuously adapt our business model to pursue the most attractive, risk\-adjusted returns. We work to make rational decisions, avoid unnecessary complexity, maintain strong liquidity and capital, and communicate with clarity and honesty. We measure success both by current performance and by the durability and quality of the long\-term value we build. * **Communities and the Environment:** We believe prosperity and responsibility go hand in hand. We invest in inclusive opportunity and environmental stewardship. Our goal is simple \- to do our part build a brighter, more sustainable future for the communities we serve and the world we share. *It is the policy of Forbright Bank to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals and to administer all aspects and conditions of pre\-employment and employment without regard to protected characteristics.* *Employment with Forbright Bank is at\-will, which means that either you or the Company may terminate the relationship at any time.* By applying, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our **CCPA Privacy Notice**. AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person. jobs.title: Quality Systems and Compliance Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **FII USA, Inc.,** a Foxconn Technology Group Company, is seeking a **Quality Systems and Compliance Engineer** to coordinate campus\-wide Quality Management System compliance and support internal audits, corrective actions, and ongoing audit readiness. Once a part of the team, you will be responsible for a wide variety of tasks within the Training and Development Department in a manufacturing environment and have the opportunity to display critical thinking skills to expand your career in Smart Manufacturing. The **Quality Systems and Compliance Engineer** will develop risk\-based audit programs, oversee CAPA governance and effectiveness verification, and support management review and consistent QMS implementation across facilities and assist the Training and Development Department as needed.### **Responsibilities** * Maintain and improve assigned QMS procedures, forms, checklists, audit tools, CAPA methods, governance controls, compliance calendars, and implementation standards aligned with company, customer, certification, and regulatory requirements. * Develop the risk\-based annual audit program across campus processes, buildings, shifts, products, and system elements. Plan, conduct, document, and follow up on process, system, layered, and compliance audits; coordinate scope, schedules, auditors, evidence, meetings, reports, and action deadlines. * Administer centralized CAPA and audit\-action tracking from ownership and containment through root cause, correction, verification, effectiveness, and closure. Facilitate structured investigations for systemic, cross\-functional, repeated, or high\-risk issues. * Review corrective actions for adequacy, cause alignment, risk reduction, and sustainability. Verify effectiveness through audits, data, observation, sampling, recurrence analysis, or other objective evidence before closure. * Coordinate customer, certification, regulatory, and corporate audit readiness, evidence, logistics, responses, and finding closure. * Analyze internal and external findings, customer concerns, ESD, calibration, document control, training, production quality, and other data for system weaknesses. Prepare management\-review inputs and dashboards covering audit performance, repeat findings, CAPA aging, overdue actions, risk, and improvement priorities. * Support compliance readiness for new buildings, lines, processes, transfers, and significant changes. * Guide process owners on procedures, evidence, corrective action, and audit readiness while preserving their operational ownership. Provide internal\-auditor, CAPA, root\-cause, and quality\-system awareness training as assigned. * Maintain complete, accurate, controlled records for audits, CAPAs, management review, compliance assessments, and effectiveness verification. * Lead improvements that reduce recurring findings, simplify evidence collection, improve action closure, and standardize campus practices. * Define coordinator checklists, sampling instructions, and evidence expectations; review their reports, confirm findings, initiate CAPAs when warranted, and direct follow\-up and effectiveness checks. Maintain objective review of compliance\-team work. * Other duties as assigned. ### **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Business, Science, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. * Three or more years of quality systems, quality engineering, compliance, internal auditing, CAPA, manufacturing quality, or related experience is required. Experience supporting customer, certification\-body, or regulatory audits is preferred. * Certifications and Training: Formal internal\-auditor or lead\-auditor training is strongly preferred. ASQ, ISO auditor, Six Sigma, quality engineering, or related certification is a plus. * Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems, internal auditing, CAPA, root\-cause analysis, corrective action, risk\-based thinking, and effectiveness verification. * Working knowledge of applicable ISO\-based, customer, and manufacturing quality requirements. * Ability to conduct objective audits, gather evidence, interview personnel, identify system gaps, and write clear findings and reports. * Strong facilitation and problem\-solving skills using structured methods such as 5 Why, fishbone analysis, fault\-tree thinking, or similar tools. * Ability to analyze data and identify recurring, cross\-functional, or systemic patterns rather than treating each event independently. * Strong technical writing, procedure development, presentation, project\-management, and organizational skills. * Ability to challenge incomplete actions constructively and maintain independence while partnering effectively with process owners and leadership. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office, audit or CAPA systems, dashboards, spreadsheets, and controlled\-document platforms. * Ability to manage multiple audits, corrective actions, deadlines, and escalations in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. ### **Reasons you should work for us:** * Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage. * Basic life insurance and short\-term disability coverage provided by employer. * Supplemental life insurance and long\-term disability coverage options available. * 401K with employer contribution. * Personal, Vacation, and Holiday paid time off for all full\-time employees. * Onsite Aurora Health \& Wellness Center available for all employees. * Employees are continuously encouraged to learn and grow their careers in smart manufacturing. ### **About Foxconn WI** FII USA, Inc, a Foxconn Technology Group Company, is a global leader in smart manufacturing and industrial internet services. With a strong presence in the digital economy, we offer a comprehensive range of solutions in cloud computing, industrial internet, smart home, 5G, and network communication equipment. Fueled by continuous innovation and a commitment to sustainable development, we have become a key player in the electronic manufacturing service industry and sit at the forefront of driving advanced industry development. FII USA, Inc is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment, without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first\-principles thinking with cutting\-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top\-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. We’re building a cutting\-edge AI team, and this role is for an engineer who wants to apply AI to real problems in energy. As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll help build our **Product Factory**: an agentic pipeline that takes software from requirements and design through code review, deployment and monitoring, with human review where the risk calls for it. You’ll also ship customer\-facing features using VLMs and LLMs, and build AI tools and agents that make teams across Fuse more productive, from customer support to warehouses and back office. This is an applied engineering role, not pure research: you’ll own what you build, from spec to production. ### **Responsibilities** * Ship AI features for customers, such as personalised energy recommendations and onboarding from an energy bill. * Build LLM applications and agents for support, engineering, warehouse and back\-office teams, including multi\-agent systems and durable workflows (e.g. Temporal). * Build the engineering around them: cloud infrastructure, integrations, and access control so users and agents only reach what they should. * Own evaluation: datasets, golden answers, human and LLM judges, A/B tests. Know whether a change genuinely helped. * Choose models by performance, latency and cost, and revisit as models improve. * Work with trading, operations and backend teams so models reflect real\-time market conditions, energy pricing and demand and weather forecasts. * Monitor AI systems in production and keep them reliable. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of experience, with requirements varying by role level. * Experience owning an applied AI system end to end, ideally in a startup or small team, and able to explain what broke and how you knew it worked. * A software engineer who moved into applied AI, or an ML engineer who writes production code. We value both. * Strong Python (or similar) and experience deploying LLMs or VLMs into production. * Solid understanding of cloud technologies, containerisation and scalable AI applications. * Analytical, rigorous and quick to learn. You don’t need our exact tools, just the ability to pick them up. * **Bonus:** PyTorch or TensorFlow; forecasting, weather and demand modelling; energy markets and trading; fine\-tuning or RL; vision, document or NLP pipelines; agent runtimes. **Benefits** * Competitive salary and eligibility for equity * Biannual bonus scheme * Fully expensed tech to match your needs * Private health insurance * Breakfast and dinner allowance for office\-based employees As we hire globally, benefits may vary by location.

jobs.description: Description: **Pay Range:** $70,000 \- $85,000 **Beneifts:** Medical, dental, vision, sick time and PTO after 90 days! **Summary:** An energetic and creative role responsible for designing, developing, installing, managing, and maintaining hardware and software systems used to monitor, control, and automate engineering and manufacturing business processes. This blended role requires craft\-level skill and agility to deliver controls systems and web\-based applications that drive production and operational efficiencies. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following**. jobs.description: **What We Do** ============== Gecko Robotics is helping the world’s most important organizations ensure the availability, reliability, and sustainability of critical infrastructure. Gecko's complete and connected solutions combine wall\-climbing robots, industry\-leading sensors, and an AI\-powered data platform to provide customers with a unique window into the current and future health of their physical assets. This enables real\-time decision making to increase the efficiency and safety of operations, promote mission readiness, and protect the environment and civilization from the effects of infrastructure failure. **Role at a Glance** ==================== The Software Platform team’s purpose is to empower software engineers, reduce unnecessary blockers, and increase our velocity to create exceptional products. They do this by making software effortless to build, deploy, and manage. Using automation, shared libraries, and DevOps tools, they solve the common software problems so other engineers can focus on Gecko’s unique challenges. This role will specifically focus on leveling up our cloud architecture and automation, empowering engineers to manage and own their own deployments without needing extensive cloud expertise. We are looking for someone to become the primary owner of Gecko’s Cloud, supported by the rest of the team. **What you will do** ==================== Primary owner of Gecko’s Cloud, discovering and designing solutions for a well\-architected cloud * Operational excellence (i.e. observability) * Security, privacy, and compliance * Reliability * Cost optimization * Performance optimization * Contribute significantly to the Software Platform team’s other work * Smooth, intuitive, automated CI/CD * Customer authentication * Permission management * DevOps Tool management and optimization * Optimizing the local development experience * Effective onboarding and internal training * Enable new business for Gecko by architecting solutions to achieve necessary certifications (e.g. DoD IL4/5\) **Technologies We Use** ======================= We use a variety of technologies, but we primarily operate using Python, React, and Typescript with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as our primary cloud provider. Our cloud architecture is primarily serverless, stateless, and event\-driven. This is a non\-exhaustive list and we are tech agnostic in our interview process, so we encourage you to apply regardless of your background. **About You** ============= **Required Skills** =================== * Previous experience in a DevOps role * Strong automation/scripting skills * Previous experience with one or more cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.) * Previous experience with Terraform * Previous experience with cloud automation, CI/CD, and Docker * Proficiency with Linux and command line tools * Experience in developing and maintaining technical documentation and procedures * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written * Ability to work both independently and with cross\-functional teams **Preferred Skills** ==================== * Python * Experience working with the US Government (DoD specifically) * GCP specific experience **Who We Are** ============== At Gecko, our people are our greatest investment. In addition to competitive compensation packages, we offer company equity, 401(k) matching, gender\-neutral parental leave, full medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health, ongoing professional development, family planning assistance, and flexible paid time off. Gecko values collaboration, innovation, and partnership, and we believe we do our best work when we're together in person. We’re an office\-first culture but understand that sometimes you may need to work from home. Many people are in the office five days a week, others need a bit more flexibility. Ultimately, we care about the outcomes we achieve \- and creating a culture of autonomy and trust that enables that impact. Gecko is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission to protect today’s infrastructure and give form to tomorrow’s. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Generalist** ==================== At Generalist, we are on a mission to build general intelligence for the physical world and make it useful to everyone. We believe the industries and homes of the future will depend on humans and machines working together in new ways. Robots can help us build more and get more done. We build embodied foundation models, starting with a focus on dexterity. This requires advancing the frontiers of data, models, and hardware, to enable robots to intelligently interact with the physical world. The company embraces both large\-scale AI and robotics as core to its DNA. Our team of researchers, roboticists, and company builders come from OpenAI, Boston Dynamics, Google DeepMind, and other frontier labs—with a track record of shipping AI breakthroughs. Before Generalist, we pioneered large embodied multimodal models and vision\-language\-action models (PaLM\-E, RT\-2, Gemini Robotics), launched and scaled ChatGPT and GPT\-4 to hundreds of millions of users, engineered the foundations of autonomous driving, built next\-generation robots (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) and pushed the limits of what they can do (from parkour to manipulation, and testing robustness). We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. **About the Role:** ------------------- Generalist is building AI that enables robots to do useful work in the physical world. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will turn that technology into working customer deployments, owning the engineering from understanding a workflow and designing an integration to deploying software, debugging robot behavior, and helping customers get started. You will be one of Generalist’s first Forward Deployed Engineers and help build the foundation of the function. Alongside delivering our earliest deployments, you will shape how we scope technical work, measure success, diagnose failures, and turn what we learn at one customer into tools and practices the whole team can use. This is a hands\-on cross\-functional engineering role. You will write and ship code, work directly with robot hardware and customer systems, and collaborate closely with our research, engineering, operations, and partnerships teams. You should enjoy moving between a customer conversation, a system design, and a debugging session, staying accountable until the system works in practice. **You'll be responsible for:** ------------------------------ * Owning the technical delivery of customer deployments, from understanding requirements and defining success criteria through integration, software rollout, onboarding, live debugging in the field, and ongoing improvement. * Designing and building software integrations that connect Generalist’s systems with customer APIs, applications, and workflows, with attention to reliability and maintainability. * Designing robot tasks and evaluation workflows, examining rollout data, and refining tasks when performance in the real world falls short of expectations. * Debugging across software, integrations, robot behavior, and the operating environment. Use logs, observations, and focused experiments to isolate problems, implement fixes, and verify results. * Working directly with customers to understand constraints, explain technical tradeoffs, and communicate progress clearly. Bring in the right specialists when needed while retaining ownership of the outcome. * Turning deployment experience into reusable tooling, documentation, diagnostics, and playbooks, and proposed system improvements that make each subsequent deployment easier and more reliable. **You might thrive in this role if you:** ----------------------------------------- * Have built and shipped production software and can independently take a technical problem from an ambiguous requirement to a tested, working solution. * Have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience designing integrations across APIs, services, or complex systems. You can explain your design choices and reason through failure modes. * Debug methodically: establish what should happen, gather evidence about what actually happened, test hypotheses, and check that a fix addresses the underlying problem. * Enjoy working directly with customers and users. You ask good questions, translate their needs into engineering work, and explain complex issues clearly without making promises the system cannot support. * Learn unfamiliar technical domains quickly and are curious about machine learning, robotics, and the gap between a successful demonstration and reliable operation. * Take ownership in an early\-stage environment, create structure where it is missing, and balance immediate customer needs with improvements that will serve future deployments. * Are excited to work hands\-on with robots and customer teams, including time at customer sites. Experience in robotics, machine learning, or deploying complex software in customer environments is a plus. Strong software engineers who are eager to learn robotics are encouraged to apply. Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. jobs.title: Piping Field Engineer Specialist
jobs.description: **1\. Position Summary** The Piping Field Engineer Specialist is responsible for supporting construction, quality inspections, and system turnover activities through detailed field walkdowns, system verification, and documentation readiness. This role focuses on verifying installed piping systems against design requirements, isometric and P\&ID drawings, identifying discrepancies, creating punch lists, supporting test package development, and ensuring systems are mechanically complete and ready for testing and turnover. Field walkdowns and installation verification are a core function of piping FE roles supporting turnover activities. **2\. Key Responsibilities** **A. Field Walkdowns / Line Walking** * Perform **system \& test package line walks** to verify installation against: + Isometric drawings + P\&IDs + Plot plans * Identify and document **punch items and deficiencies** * Validate examples: + Valve orientation (“PPE” Preferred Pressure End /”VE” Vent End) + Valve Accessibility and operability + Proper installation of components (valves, fittings, pipe supports) + Confirm piping routing, slope, and tie\-ins match design requirements + Field walkdowns and discrepancy identification are core daily tasks for piping FE support roles. **B. Quality Verification Support** * Support inspections ensuring compliance with: + Project specifications + Applicable standards/codes * Verify: + Flange alignment and integrity + Bolt\-up completeness + Material traceability + Pipe cleanliness requirements * Assist in **nonconformance identification and reporting (NCRs)** **C. Test Package \& Turnover Support** * Assist with **test package preparation and verification** * Ensure: + Validate boundaries and system limits + All components are installed and documented + Pressure test documentation is complete and accurate * Track: + Hydrotest / pneumatic test readiness + Flushing and cleaning activities **D. Construction Support / Interface** * Provide technical support to construction teams during installation * Coordinate with: + Superintendents + Engineering * Assist in resolving: + Field installation issues + Design discrepancies and Constructability concerns **E. Documentation \& Reporting** * Generate and maintain: + Walkdown reports + Punch lists + System readiness status * Ensure all inspection and turnover documentation is: + Complete and accurate **F. Safety and Quality Compliance** * Participate in: + Job briefs + Toolbox talks + Safety meetings * Adhere to: + Company Quality Absolutes + Project safety procedures * Support safe execution of: + Construction installation activities + Pressure testing activities System turnover operations **3\. Daily Activities (Typical)** * Conduct line walks and update punch lists * Verify valve orientation, tagging, and installation details Track system status (construction testing* turnover) * Support test package compilation and verification **4\. Required Qualifications** * 5 to 12 years piping and or mechanical engineering related field experience (preferred) * Experience in B31\.3 Process Piping construction/installation (LNG or similar preferred) * Strong knowledge of interpretation of: + P\&IDs, isometrics, and plot plans + ASME B31\.3 and applicable codes * Ability to perform field walkdowns and identify discrepancies * Strong communication and coordination skills **5\. Preferred Skills** * Experience with: + Computer literate in word processing, Excel etc. + Quality validation/inspections + Pipe pressure testing and system turnover * Knowledge of: + Flange management + Valve installation requirements + Pipe cleanliness standards **6\. Performance Expectations** * High attention to detail during Piping Installation and Testing Package line walks * Timely identification of installation discrepancies * Strong coordination with construction and field engineering teams * Support “Right the First Time” execution and turnover readiness **Additional Information:** Must be willing to work a flexible schedule as required that may include but not limited to nightshift or split shift. Work requires the physical ability to conduct field inspections including but not limited to: extensive walking in and around a construction site often in high heat and high humidity conditions, climbing ladders, climbing scaffolding, working on elevated platforms, working on uneven surfaces, and working in small or confined spaces. Some lifting may be required. Must have the ability to walk into and out of the project (enter/egress). Must be able to use appropriate standard issued Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) required for each assigned task (i.e. harness, life vest, lift buckets, etc.).

industry through AI, cloud, and data platform adoption. **Job Description** ### **What you’ll do** * Develop and maintain robust, scalable Spring Boot applications for data processing and analytics. *
