jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About Gusto** At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve. All full\-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy. AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process. **About the Role** ------------------ This is a highly customer\-facing role at the intersection of engineering, solution architecture, agentic AI, and customer delivery. You will work directly with stakeholders and own the technical discovery for our ongoing opportunities end to end. Once a deal is qualified, you scope, build, embed with the client, and build it yourself, code that holds up against real tax and jurisdiction data, not a prototype you clean up later. What you ship only counts once the client is paying for it, it's live, and it's measurably cutting the manual work they used to do by hand, hours saved, tickets deflected, risk reduced. You should be comfortable speaking with both technical and executive stakeholders, moving quickly from problem discovery to prototype, and turning complex workflows into production\-ready agents and multi\-agent systems. ### **Here's what you'll do day\-to\-day** * **Scope \& Qualify:** Give Sales a technical feasibility read early on ambiguous Enterprise opportunities, then own scoping the compliance challenge once the deal is sales\-qualified. * **Define the Problem:** Own requirements gathering on complex, ambiguous opportunities, scoping the problem clearly enough for Sales, Product, and Engineering to align on it. * **Prove It First:** Build a working proof\-of\-concept of the proposed agent when a deal needs to see feasibility before committing to the full build, tailored from a hands\-on integration engineer to a VP of Payroll Tax. * **Make the Business Case:** Translate every deployment into the business case that justifies the subscription: hours saved, risk reduced, compliance simplified. * **Own the Build:** Embed with clients and write the code yourself, work that runs their compliance decisions instead of just connecting to them. There's no fixed method yet, you figure out what each engagement needs and build it. * **Clear the Blockers:** Diagnose and fix the data issues, jurisdiction mapping, tax ID reconciliation, that stand between a client and production. * **Bridge the Gap:** Keep technical teams and business stakeholders aligned as requirements evolve mid\-engagement, so scope changes don't blindside either side. * **Own the Handoff:** Deliver the build and a runbook Client Success runs solo without the need to loop back the FDE. * **Close the Loop:** Feed structured signal from both the sales motion and the build motion back into product and go\-to\-market strategy, including infrastructure gaps. * **Create Implementation Playbooks:** solution patterns, demo flows, and deployment documentation that make future deployments faster. ### **Here's what we're looking for** * Demonstrated 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in a customer\-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, AI Engineer, Implementation Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar. * Proven track record of shipping production systems in ambiguous, client\-facing environments, with demonstrable evidence of: * + REST APIs, webhooks, event\-driven systems, auth patterns, data modeling, idempotency, and failure modes, not just happy\-path builds + Building production systems in highly regulated categories, payroll, tax, or compliance fluency deep enough to run a conversation with a client's compliance team without a translator + Agentic workflows beyond prototypes: MCP or function\-calling patterns, evaluation and reliability practices * Deep technical discovery skills with the ability to navigate a high degree of ambiguity * Ability to scope a technical solution from an ambiguous opportunity, build the business case that justifies a subscription, and ship a pattern the next engagement can reuse * Proven ability to present to and influence a range of audiences, from individual engineers to executive sponsors * Entrepreneurial, passionate about our mission, and deep empathy for the clients whose compliance work you're automating * Bonus points for experience with a specific HR/payroll platform's integration surface, enterprise pro r than only coordinate. You take responsibility for the customer outcome, communicate proactively, flag risks early, and follow through. You are comfortable being the technical adult in the room, whether you're speaking with a customer's architect, operations lead, engineering team, or VP of Payroll. We're looking for someone low\-ego, collaborative, sharp, and highly accountable \- someone who can build trust with customers while also building real technical solutions. Our total cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $88,000\-140,000 in Scottsdale, $95,000\-150,000 in Denver, and $115,000\-181,000 in New York \& San Francisco Bay Area. Stock equity is additional. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above. At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate. Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2\-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **A path for every ambition.** At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day. We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them. Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here. Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage. Your ambition has a home here. **ABOUT US** At HUB International, we are a team of entrepreneurs. We believe in protecting and supporting the aspirations of individuals, families, and businesses. We help our clients evaluate their risks and develop solutions tailored to their needs. We believe in empowering our employees to learn, grow, and make a difference. Our structure enables our teams to maintain their own unique, regional culture while leveraging support and resources from our corporate centers of excellence. HUB is a global insurance and employee benefits broker, providing a boundaryless array of business insurance, employee benefits, risk services, personal insurance, retirement, and private wealth management products and services. With over $5 billion in revenue and almost 20,000 employees in 600 offices throughout North America, HUB has grown substantially, in part due to our industry leading success in mergers and acquisitions. **Position Overview** ===================== HUB is seeking an AI Engineer to join the RPA \& Automation team within our centralized technology organization, part of HUB’s AI \& Automation organization. This is a hands\-on build role responsible for designing, building, and shipping production\-grade AI applications that deliver measurable value across HUB’s business lines. The role builds on the Claude AI platform: creating reusable skills and plug\-ins, composing them into governed AI applications, standing up retrieval over governed enterprise data, and owning the AI asset platform through which these capabilities reach the business. HUB runs Claude as its primary model today, and the stack is expected to evolve toward agentic systems. The ideal candidate is an experienced software engineer with direct, hands\-on experience building and shipping AI applications, skills, and plug\-ins in a governed, regulated environment, who is productive from the first weeks and ready to grow into agent development. The AI Engineer professionalizes experimental AI prototypes into governed, tested, enterprise\-ready applications, and owns the enterprise standards and governance for HUB’s skills, plug\-ins, and MCP wherever they are used across HUB. The role scales these capabilities to the business through HUB’s native AI ecosystem. The team builds the simple to moderate skills, plug\-ins, and MCP connections directly. Where a build requires deep engineering, such as net\-new backend, new infrastructure, or complex integration, Enterprise Engineering executes it to the team standard and returns it to the catalog to be governed and published. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Build AI Applications** * Build reusable skills and package them as plug\-ins, then compose them into governed AI applications that HUB business lines use * Configure and tune foundational models (Claude, Gemini) for HUB use cases, with system and prompt design * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and multi\-step workflows over governed enterprise data * Take business\-built AI prototypes and productionize them into reliable, governed applications **Own the AI Asset Platform** * Own and govern the skill and plug\-in marketplace and the MCP catalog: intake, publish, version, and maintain * Set and enforce the enterprise standards and governance for skills, plug\-ins, and MCP wherever they are used across HUB, on any surface including Claude Code, and including builds executed by other engineering teams * Does not build or operate the Claude Code developer\-guardrail layer day to day; that is Enterprise Engineering’s, built against the standard this role sets * Apply access control, least\-privilege, and audit to AI assets, partnering with Security and Cloud on identity and credentials * Build simple to moderate skills, plug\-ins, and MCP connections directly; route complex builds that need new infrastructure or deep integration to Enterprise Engineering, then govern and publish the result **Quality, Evaluation, and Governance** * Stand up evaluatio as the AI stack evolves toward agents * Collaborative mindset across analysts, architects, business partners, and Enterprise Engineering **What We Offer You** ===================== At HUB International, we’re invested in your success, both inside and outside of work. Our benefits include: * Competitive base salary plus performance\-based bonus * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off and company holidays * Hybrid work arrangement based out of our Chicago office * Professional development and certification reimbursement * Opportunity to shape HUB’s enterprise AI application and asset platform and build across a modern stack spanning Claude, RAG, and agentic tooling **JOIN OUR TEAM** Do you believe in the power of innovation, collaboration, and transformation? Do you thrive in a supportive and client focused work environment? Are you looking for an opportunity to help build and drive change in a rapidly growing and evolving organization? When you join **HUB International**, you will be part of a community of learners and doers focused on our Core Values: entrepreneurship, teamwork, integrity, accountability, and service. *The expected salary range for this position is $ 135,000 to $160,000 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level.* *HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HAS and 401(k) accounts, paid\-time\-off benefits such as vacation, sick, personal, floating holidays and company holidays. In addition, eligible annual bonuses, equity and commissions may be available for some positions.* **What we offer you** We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support, and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career. Benefits and programs vary based on employment status, role, location, and applicable eligibility requirements. * Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, and company\-paid life and disability plans * Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance * A collaborative, high\-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career **The HUB difference** HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** HUB International Limited is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. **Reasonable Accommodations:** HUB International Limited is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and hiring process. If you need a reasonable accommodation to access our career site, complete an application, or participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact the Recruiting Team at HUBRecruiting@HUBInternational.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and should not be used to inquire about the status of an application. **E\-Verify:** HUB International Limited participates in E\-Verify. Please refer to Our Recruiting Process \| Applicant Notices: E\-Verify Program for additional information.

jobs.description: Senior Full\-Stack Software Engineer / Technical Lead **Company:** Zolara Care **Location:** Remote **Job type:** Full time **Compensation:** Competitive salary based on experience, plus performance based bonuses About the opportunity Zolara Care develops software that helps clinics manage their operations and deliver better patient experiences. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Hike Medical** ---------------------- Hike Medical is building the defining company in musculoskeletal care. We sit at the intersection of AI, robotics, and healthcare, operating across three product lines: a proprietary AI\-vision platform that turns a 30\-second, web\-based foot scan into custom 3D\-printed orthotics; an AI agent platform that automates the entire DME workflow from pre\-visit processing through claims and revenue cycle; and SoleForge, our vertically integrated 3D\-printing factory producing custom medical devices at a scale the industry has never seen. Insoles today, full DME tomorrow, bionics by 2040\. Custom insoles are just the wedge. Our long\-term vision is bionics: AI\-designed, robotically manufactured orthotic and prosthetic devices at scale, replacing a fragmented, manual industry that hasn’t changed in decades. Read the full vision at bionics2040\.com. We've stealthily raised $22M through Seed and Series A, backed by top\-tier investors who backed companies like OpenAI, Anduril, and Mercury early. We run a fast, results\-first, high\-ownership culture out of our new SF Rincon Hill office. If you want to work at the frontier of AI, manufacturing, and healthcare, this is the place. **The Role** ------------ As a Software Engineer, you will build and ship the systems behind Hike’s AI healthcare platform, across our clinical software, AI agents, and manufacturing. You will own features end to end, from understanding the problem to running it in production. We care more about how you think and what you ship than about any specific language or framework. **Why this is career\-defining** * Your code will turn into real devices that help people move without pain. * You will own real features from day one, with the autonomy to build, ship, and see the results. * You will grow fast alongside a high\-performing team of engineers and AI researchers. * You will work at the frontier of AI, manufacturing, and healthcare. **What you will work on** * Build and ship product features end to end across backend, frontend, and mobile. * Build the APIs, integrations, and data pipelines that connect our clinical, manufacturing, and back\-office systems. * Help take AI features from prototype to reliable production. * Work directly with product, design, and customers to make sure what you build solves the real problem. **What we look for** * 2\+ years shipping production software, or an exceptional track record of building things people use. * Our core platform is TypeScript and Node.js, with NestJS APIs and PostgreSQL through Prisma, running on AWS. * Strong fundamentals in backend or full\-stack development. * Fluency with modern cloud and tooling and experience putting AI into production * Product\-minded: you think about how your work affects real users. * A strong communicator who challenges assumptions and collaborates across engineering, AI, and product. * Mission\-focused: you are not here to optimize ad clicks, you want to build technology that changes lives. **What we ask** * In person in our San Francisco Rincon Hill office, 5 days a week. * This is a hard job with a high bar. In return, you will grow faster than almost anywhere else. Compensation Range: $175K \- $225K

application owners and management. ### **Incident Response \& General** * Participate in incident response activities, contributing cloud and application security expertise to investigation, (Terragrunt a plus), ARM, and/or Bicep. * Ability to read and reason about application code in at least one of .NET, Python, Ruby, or Node.js, well enough to explain a vulnerability and its fix to a and application identity: Entra ID and AWS IAM, managed identities and service principals, d, or equivalent work experience. \#LI\-BS1 \#LI\-REMOTE **At Holman, we exist to provide rewarding careers jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description: **Controller, Oil \& Gas Investment Firm** Houston, TX \| Onsite, five days a week **About the company** Our client is a private investment firm in Houston focused on long\-term investment in the global oil and gas industry. It acquires operated and non\-operated interests in producing, development and exploration assets, along with technologies that improve production. The portfolio spans multiple legal entities across the Americas and internationally, and the business is growing quickly, with plans to roughly double in size over the next few years. **The opportunity** This is a newly created role to lead the firm’s in\-house accounting function, as accounting moves from an outsourced model to a team built internally. You’ll own the close, reporting, controls and audit across a multi\-entity, multi\-jurisdiction portfolio, and you’ll have a real hand in shaping how the function runs, including how it uses systems, automation and AI. You’ll report to the CFO, an experienced oil and gas finance leader who has built finance teams from scratch before, and you’ll build and lead a team of three. This is a great fit for someone ready to step into their first Controller role, or a seasoned Controller who wants to build something, and who’s happy to grow their scope as the company grows. **What you’ll do** *Close, controls and audit* * Own the monthly close and deliver accurate, on\-time financials, continually improving the process. * Own the general ledger, consolidations, intercompany activity and account reconciliations across all entities. * Build and strengthen internal controls, accounting policies and close discipline, including payment and cash disbursement controls alongside Treasury. * Serve as the primary contact for external auditors and manage the annual audit across jurisdictions. *Financial reporting* * Deliver financial statements under US GAAP for US entities and IFRS for international entities. * Manage accounting for international entities, including multi\-currency transactions, remeasurement and translation, and support local statutory reporting with in\-country teams and advisors. *Oil and gas accounting* * Oversee revenue and joint venture accounting, primarily for non\-operated interests, including working interest, royalty and ORRI revenue and severance and production taxes. * Oversee review of joint interest billings against JOA and COPAS terms, and reconciliation of operator statements, cash calls, prepayments and suspense. * Oversee DD\&A, depletion, ARO and impairment, and review lease operating statements for reasonableness and cost control. *Systems, AI and automation* * Act as system administrator for the firm’s oil and gas accounting platform, Quorum ODA, including integrations, upgrades, data integrity and monthly data transfers from international systems. * Champion the use of AI and automation across the function, from close and reconciliations to reporting and exception handling, and evaluate new tools for practical use. * Build and maintain advanced Excel models for reconciliation, cash flow and reporting. *Leadership and partnership* * Hire, develop and lead a team of two Accounting Analysts and a Staff Accountant. * Work closely with the investment team, operations, treasury, engineers and finance leadership on budgeting, forecasting and analysis. **What we’re looking for** * Active CPA license. * 8\+ years of progressive accounting experience with increasing scope and leadership responsibility. * Upstream oil and gas accounting experience, with non\-operated working interest accounting strongly preferred. Offshore experience is a plus. * Hands\-on ownership of the close, internal controls and the external audit. * Strong systems skills. * Hands\-on use of AI tools, automation or agentic workflows in an accounting or finance setting. * Advanced Excel skills. * A self\-starter who’s comfortable on a small team and enjoys working across the business rather than staying behind a desk. **Nice to have** * Big 4 public accounting background, ideally serving energy clients. * US GAAP and IFRS reporting experience. * International, multi\-entity and multi\-currency consolidation experience. * Experience in an investment manager or fund environment. * Experience leading an accounting system implementation or conversion. * MBA. **Compensation** Competitive base salary plus a 15% annual bonus and an excellent benefits package.

You will wire up production workflows, connect systems through APIs, and stand up MCP servers, AI skills, and agents that give teams reliable, governed access to large language models. Other days you will be out in the business, spotting the manual, repetitive work worth automating and shipping solutions that stick. Throughout, you will build like an engineer: real error handling, observability, evaluations, and guardrails — and you will keep Security and Data close so everything you ship stays compliant. You will work at the frontier of applied AI: agents, MCP, retrieval, and orchestration with the autonomy to build real things that of colleagues. If you love turning messy manual processes into elegant solutions and want to help define how a company puts AI to work, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact. **Role Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Design, build, and maintain end\-to\-end automations and integrations, connecting the company's applications, data, and AI services. * Integrate systems through APIs and webhooks — handling authentication, rate limits, retries, and idempotency. * Build AI\-powered capabilities using large language models: structured outputs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and tool / function\-calling that automate real business processes. * Develop and maintain MCP servers and reusable AI skills and agents that give teams safe, governed access to internal systems and data. * Instrument everything you build with logging, monitoring, evaluations, and guardrails, and resolve failures before users feel them. * Partner with teams across the company to identify high\-value automation and AI use cases, then scope, prioritize, and deliver them. * Work with the Security and Data teams to ensure responsible, compliant handling of data, secrets, and AI usage. * Contribute to build\-vs\-buy evaluations and help reduce software and license waste by consolidating or replacing tools with automation. * Create clear documentation, templates, and enablement materials so your work scales beyond you. * Set technical patterns, standards, and architecture for the team's automation and agent platform, and mentor other engineers. * Own the architecture of the AI and automation estate and lead the team's most complex, cross\-functional initiatives. (Applies if the role is filled at the Lead level.) * Perform other duties as assigned to meet team and organizational needs. **Required Skills / Abilities** ------------------------------- * 4\+ years building integrations, automations, or software in a professional environment including production work with LLMs or AI agents. * Hands\-on experience with workflow\-automation. * Strong API fluency (REST / JSON, OAuth, webhooks) and the ability to read and write code in Python, Go, JavaScript / TypeScript or similar. * Practical experience building with large language models: prompting, structured outputs, and at least one of RAG, tool / function\-calling, or agents. * A production mindset \- error handling, logging and observability, testing or evaluations, and secure handling of secrets and sensitive data. * Ability to work directly with non\-technical colleagues: understanding a business process and translating it into a reliable, well\-documented automation. * Understanding of data privacy, security, and responsible\-AI considerations, and a habit of partnering with Security and Data teams. **Ideal Qualifications** ------------------------ * Experience building or deploying MCP servers, AI agents, or custom AI skills. * Familiarity with the modern AI stack: orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and evaluation tooling. * A portfolio of shipped automations or agents that shows production quality, not just prototypes. * Experience integrating common business systems and their APIs (HRIS, ITSM, CRM, finance, and collaboration suites). * Exposure to enterprise AI tools (AI copilots, chat assistants) and helping teams adopt them effectively. * A track record of reducing software or license spend through automation or tool consolidation. * Experience setting standards, mentoring engineers, or owning build\-vs\-buy and platform decisions. * Strong written communication and documentation skills, and a bias toward making your work reusable. This role serves as the technical bridge between engineering and manufacturing, ensuring products are designed for manufacturability, quality, reliability, and cost efficiency while meeting customer specifications and regulatory requirements. The Senior Design Engineer collaborates closely with customers, production, quality, supply chain, and program management to drive successful product launches and continuous process improvements. Key Responsibilities Engineering Design \& Product Development * Design and develop aerospace wiring harnesses, cable assemblies, electrical interconnect systems, manufacturing tooling aids, and processing equipment to meet customer and program requirements. * Interpret customer drawings, specifications, and technical data packages to create manufacturing\-ready designs and documentation. * Develop and maintain engineering drawings, bills of material (BOMs), work instructions, and supporting technical documentation. * Apply Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles to optimize product performance, quality, and production efficiency. * Support prototype development, first article builds, design verification, and product validation activities. Manufacturing Support * Provide engineering support to production by resolving technical issues and implementing corrective actions. * Evaluate manufacturing processes and recommend improvements that enhance quality, productivity, and cost performance. * Collaborate with production teams to troubleshoot design and manufacturing challenges. * Assist with the implementation of engineering changes, ensuring timely documentation updates and effective communication across departments. * Support root cause analysis and corrective action activities related to product quality and manufacturing issues. Engineering Systems \& Compliance * Maintain engineering documentation within ERP, PLM, or document control systems. * Ensure designs comply with customer specifications, industry standards, and applicable aerospace regulations. * Participate in design reviews, process validations, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Assist in developing engineering standards, best practices, and design guidelines. * Support configuration management and revision control throughout the product lifecycle. Project Management \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Coordinate engineering activities to support customer schedules and production milestones. * Collaborate with Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Program Management to ensure successful project execution. * Communicate technical information effectively with internal teams, customers, and suppliers. * Identify project risks and recommend practical engineering solutions. * Support new business opportunities by providing technical input during quoting and proposal development. Requirements: Qualifications * Master’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline required. * Experience in manufacturing engineering, product design, or aerospace electrical interconnect systems preferred. * Aerospace industry experience, particularly with wiring harnesses, cable assemblies, or electrical routing, is highly desirable. * Proficiency with CAD software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, CATIA, or similar design platforms. * Working knowledge of ERP, PLM, or related engineering management systems preferred. * Strong project management and organizational skills. * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams. jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Ideal Vacuum is an established scientific and industrial vacuum equipment company whose products support universities, laboratories, research facilities, and aerospace customers. Its team manufactures environmental testing systems and contributes to research and technological advancement. **Job Overview** Ideal Vacuum Products is seeking an experienced embedded firmware engineer to develop and support firmware for vacuum, spectroscopy, and other scientific and industrial equipment. You will help build our next generation of products using 32\-bit Arm\-based microcontrollers, work closely with our electrical engineering team, and keep released products reliable through careful debugging, testing, and updates. Our newer PCB designs use STMicroelectronics STM32 microcontrollers. STM32 experience is strongly preferred, and we also welcome candidates with solid production firmware experience on comparable 32\-bit Arm platforms. We value strong embedded C/C\+\+ fundamentals and the ability to learn new devices and development tools. Alongside new development, you will help maintain existing Atmel\-based products and Atmel Studio projects. This includes adapting firmware when PCB components change, resolving production bugs, and verifying that updates work with the supported hardware revisions. **Responsibilities** * **Develop new product firmware.** Write clear, maintainable embedded C/C\+\+ for 32\-bit Arm\-based microcontrollers, including STM32\-based products. Implement device interfaces, measurement and control functions, and communications, and work with electrical engineers during board bring\-up. * **Troubleshoot production problems.** Reproduce failures, trace root causes, and fix existing code. Use in\-circuit debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and diagnostic logs to distinguish firmware, hardware, and interaction problems. * **Support PCB revisions.** Work with electrical engineers when a component is replaced or a board is improved. Compare device behavior and update drivers, initialization, pin assignments, timing, calibration, or communications as needed. Support firmware ports when microcontrollers change. * **Test changes thoroughly.** Verify fixes on actual hardware, test normal and failure conditions, and check for regressions. Confirm compatibility with each supported board revision and document the results. * **Make releases reproducible.** Maintain source control, build instructions, firmware version records, hardware compatibility information, and production programming instructions so the correct tested code reaches each board. * **Work closely with the team.** Collaborate with electrical engineers, software developers, scientists, technicians, and manufacturing staff. Explain findings clearly and balance new development with timely support for production. **Experience** * **STM32 development tools such as STM32CubeIDE or STM32CubeMX**, and familiarity with vendor peripheral libraries or register\-level programming. * **Bare\-metal firmware, an RTOS**, bootloaders, firmware updates, or robust handling of persistent settings. * **Maintaining Atmel/Microchip AVR or SAM** codebases and existing Atmel Studio or Microchip Studio projects. * **Production test fixtures,** automated regression testing, or Python/PC\-side tools that support firmware development and manufacturing. * Scientific instruments, industrial controls, sensor interfaces, precision measurements, or serial communications. **What You Will Bring** * Demonstrated professional experience developing and maintaining firmware for released hardware products, including 32\-bit microcontrollers. * Experience developing firmware for Arm\-based MCUs. STM32 experience is strongly preferred; comparable 32\-bit Arm experience is welcome. * Strong embedded C skills and the ability to work with C\+\+ code as needed, including memory use, interrupts, timers, state machines, and timing\-sensitive behavior. * Practical experience with peripheral interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, ADCs, or PWM, and the ability to learn unfamiliar devices from their datasheets. * Ability to read relevant schematics, follow signals through a circuit, and debug independently at the bench. * Disciplined use of Git or comparable version control, code review, documented testing, and controlled releases. * Clear communication, careful problem\-solving, and a willingness to understand existing designs before changing them. * A degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated professional embedded development experience. **Why Join Ideal Vacuum** Work alongside the people designing, building, and testing the hardware your code runs on. You will contribute to new products and see the practical results of improvements to equipment already in production. **Compensation \& Benefits** Competitive, negotiable salary based on relevant experience. * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) retirement plan. * Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave. How to Apply Email workwithus@idealvac.com with the subject **Embedded Firmware Engineer Application**. Please include your resume and a brief, nonconfidential example of a microcontroller firmware problem you personally solved. Tell us which MCU and tools you used, what you changed, and how you verified the result on hardware. New product bring\-up, a production bug, or a firmware update accompanying a PCB revision are all relevant examples. Ideal Vacuum Products 5910 Midway Park Blvd. NE Albuquerque, NM 87109 Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) 3% Match * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance Experience: * Embedded Firmware: 2 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Analyst / Engineer
jobs.description: **Quality Assurance Analyst / Engineer** **Location:** Remote **Employment Type:** Contract / Contract\-to\-Hire **Compensation:** Targeted Hourly Rates: W2 Hourly range 55\-65/hr. 1099/C2C Hourly 65\-80/hr **About the Opportunity** ========================= Intertech is partnering with our client, an established organization offering e\-commerce and online learning platforms, to hire a Quality Assurance Analyst or Engineer. This role reports to a Program Manager and works day\-to\-day alongside developers, system analysts, project managers, development team leads, and product owners to build quality into every stage of the delivery process, not just test at the end. The position is open at the Analyst or Engineer level depending on experience. Engineer\-level candidates will take on greater ownership of test automation strategy, CI/CD integration, and coaching others on quality practices. **What You Will Be Doing** ========================== **Plan: Test Strategy, Risk \& Release Readiness** -------------------------------------------------- * Take part in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and design reviews to spot risks and testability gaps early * Build risk\-based test plans and clear acceptance criteria for new features, enhancements, and bug fixes * Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects so new work doesn’t break what already works * Report test results, quality metrics, and open risks, and give a clear go/no\-go recommendation before each release * Maintain stable test environments and reusable test data in partnership with development and infrastructure **Test: Manual \& Exploratory Testing** --------------------------------------- * Run functional, regression, integration, cross\-browser, and mobile\-responsive testing across customer\-facing websites and internal applications, going well beyond the “happy path” to find edge cases and error conditions * Validate e\-commerce flows end to end, including cart, checkout, payments, promotions, and order fulfillment * Verify online learning platform features such as registration, course access, credit tracking, and certificates **Automate: Building \& Maintaining Test Suites** ------------------------------------------------- * Design, build, and maintain automated UI and API tests using tools such as Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium * Audit existing automation for coverage gaps, flaky tests, and outdated scenarios * Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines so every build gets fast, reliable feedback * Use AI\-assisted tools responsibly to speed up test creation and maintenance * Partner with developers on unit and integration testing practices that catch issues earlier **Validate: APIs, Data \& Integrations** ---------------------------------------- * Test REST APIs and third\-party integrations using tools such as Postman or Swagger * Write SQL queries to confirm the data behind the UI is accurate and consistent * Partner with vendors and internal teams to verify data syncs correctly between systems * Confirm that what customers see matches what is stored, billed, and reported **Improve: Defects, Root Cause \& Quality Culture** --------------------------------------------------- * Log clear, reproducible defects with steps, evidence, and severity, and track them to resolution * Lead root\-cause analysis on escaped and recurring defects and recommend process fixes * Document test cases, procedures, and QA standards in tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, and Confluence * Coordinate testing with contract, offshore, or nearshore resources as needed * Mentor developers and team members on testing practices and help build a culture where quality is everyone’s job **What You Bring** ================== **Quality Assurance Experience** -------------------------------- * 3\+ years of software QA experience testing web applications (Analyst level); 5\+ years for Engineer level * Hands\-on experience with at least one test automation framework (Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or WebdriverIO) * Working knowledge of SQL for data validation (Microsoft SQL Server preferred) * Experience testing REST APIs with tools such as Postman or Swagger * Solid understanding of the software development life cycle, regression strategy, and defect life cycle * Associate or bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience **Communication \& Collaboration** ---------------------------------- * Clear, direct written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical audiences * Ability to explain risk and test results so stakeholders can make good release decisions * Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams with tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira * A collaborative mindset: you see yourself as a partner to developers, not a gatekeeper at the end of the line **Curious, Detail\-Driven Mindset** ----------------------------------- * Sharp attention to detail and the persistence to reproduce hard\-to\-find, intermittent defects * Comfort working in fast\-moving environments with evolving priorities and release schedules * A love of learning new tools and a commitment to continuous improvement **Nice to Have** ================ * Familiarity with C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core/MVC, React, and TypeScript, plus scripting skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#, or Python * Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins) and working in Microsoft Azure * Experience testing e\-commerce, payment processing, or learning management systems * Familiarity with performance testing, accessibility standards (WCAG), or feature flags * ISTQB certification **You’ll Thrive in This Role If You** ===================================== * Are creative, adaptable, collaborative, and energized by learning * Ask thoughtful questions, seek advice, and stay open to feedback and debate * Can say “I don’t know” when you don’t, and “here’s why I disagree” when you do * Support ideas with data and use results to make better decisions * Take initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do next * Build strong working relationships instead of working as a lone wolf

jobs.title: Senior Project (Design) Mgr
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB221854 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position** The Senior Project Manager, PMO organizes a diverse set of activities of the Program Management Office (PMO) group within the New Product Development organization. The PMO group is responsible for leading cross functional teams in new product development and continuation engineering initiatives, and consists of project managers, program managers and project coordinators. The Senior Project Manager, PMO orchestrates the activities of their project teams to deliver compelling final product designs within demanding product release schedules. This role will support vision and intelligence products including endoscopes, light sources, and hardware and software enabled imaging modalities. jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Engineering * JOB216518 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **About the Team** Future Forward Research — Synthetic Data, builds the simulation and data infrastructure that powers Intuitive's autonomous surgical capabilities. **The Role** You'll build the virtual surgical worlds and the data pipelines that train our perception and policy models. Day to day, that means designing simulation environments, generating large volumes of labeled synthetic data, and working with ML engineers to close the sim\-to\-real gap for robotic surgery. It's a hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of 3D simulation, machine learning, and robotics. **What You'll Do** * Design and build high\-fidelity simulation environments for surgical tasks. * Generate scalable synthetic datasets including photo realistic imagery, segmentation masks, depth, optical flow, and kinematic state — and own their quality, versioning, and delivery. * Implement domain randomization and procedural scene generation to maximize sim\-to\-real transfer. * Model deformable soft\-tissue physics, tool\-tissue contact, and instrument kinematics that match Intuitive's platforms. * Partner with ML engineers to define task curricula, reward functions, and evaluation benchmarks. * Develop and refine sim\-to\-real transfer strategies, and validate simulated behaviors against benchtop phantoms and real systems. * Build reusable tools, APIs, and documentation so the broader team can spin up new tasks without deep simulation expertise. ### **Qualifications** **What You Bring** We care more about real depth in a few of these than shallow coverage of all of them. * **Strong software engineering.** You write maintainable, tested code in Python, C\+\+ and/or C\#, and you're comfortable in a Linux / Git / Docker / GPU workflow. * **Hands\-on simulation or graphics experience.** You've built things in a physics simulator, game engine, or rendering/VFX pipeline — robotics simulators, real\-time engines, and offline graphics pipelines all count. * **A feel for data and models.** You've produced data that trained an ML model (or worked closely alongside that), and you understand how data quality and distribution show up in model behavior. * **Working knowledge of 3D and physics fundamentals** — coordinate frames, rendering, rigid\-body and contact dynamics — enough to reason about why a simulated scene does or doesn't look and behave correctly. You've likely spent several years building games, simulation, graphics, robotics, or data systems — but we're far more interested in what you've built than in a specific number on your résumé. **If you don't check every box, we still want to hear from you.** Strong candidates often come from autonomous driving, humanoid robotics, gaming, or VFX rather than surgical robotics specifically. **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Graphics, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field — or equivalent practical experience. * An advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a related area is a plus, not a requirement. We've hired strong engineers from all paths, including self\-taught backgrounds and industry work in games, VFX, or robotics. **Bonus Points** None of these are required — they're signals, not gates. Any one of them is a nice plus. * Deformable\-object simulation: FEM, position\-based dynamics, or differentiable physics * NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab * Surgical robotics simulation: ORBIT\-Surgical, dVRK\-based environments * Sim\-to\-real techniques: domain randomization, system identification, privileged learning, residual policies * Vision\-language or vision\-language\-action models, and how simulation data supports them * Procedural/generative asset creation: NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting, or diffusion models * Distributed compute at scale: Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm, multi\-GPU/multi\-node * Medical imaging or surgical video pipelines * Publicatio *What Success Looks Like in Your First Year** * Simulation environments for several core surgical tasks are operational and integrated with the ML training pipeline. * Synthetic data delivers measurable model lift on targeted perception or policy metrics. * A quantitative sim\-to\-real correlation is established on benchtop phantoms. * Parallelized infrastructure reliably generates thousands of training episodes per hour with automated dataset delivery. * A reusable task\-creation framework lets ML engineers define new surgical skills without deep simulation expertise. **Shift** * Day **Workplace Type** * Onsite \- This job is fully onsite in the Sunnyvale campus. ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. cloud services. * **Resiliency \& Disaster Recovery:** Develop and improve backup, recovery, redundancy, and disaster\-recovery capabilities to maintain critical services. * **Infrastructure Projects \& Modernization:** Lead and support infrastructure upgrades, migrations, technology evaluations, and long\-term lifecycle planning. * **Collaboration \& Technical Support:** Work closely with IT, OT, Cybersecurity, Operations, and external partners to troubleshoot complex issues and implement effective solutions. ### **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's or associate degree in information technology, cybersecurity, networking, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in IT infrastructure, networking, systems administration, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting complex infrastructure solutions. * Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, servers, virtualization, identity and access management, backup and recovery, and Microsoft cloud technologies. * Ability to manage multiple projects, solve complex technical problems, and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical teams. * Experience in a utility, industrial, public\-sector, or critical\-infrastructure environment is a plus. * Valid Wisconsin driver's license. ### **Why Kaukauna Utilities?** At Kaukauna Utilities, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the technology systems that help deliver safe and reliable electric and water services to our community. You'll join a collaborative team where your technical expertise, ideas, and problem\-solving skills will contribute directly to the reliability, security, and future of our utility operations.

jobs.title: Sr. Solutions Architect/Sales Engineer-AI Infrastructure (GPU) -West Coast
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Liqid is doing for AI infrastructure what VMware did for x86 servers, bringing the agility of the cloud to the on\-prem datacenter to dynamically allocate and share GPUs, memory, and other resources. This functionality is critical in running AI and advanced\-data workloads in production (a.k.a. Inference). Liqid Matrix software enables global organizations to accelerate the adoption of AI, HPC and VDI by unlocking the bottleneck of GPU utilization and availability through dynamic pooling and sharing of AI resources for higher performance with less total cost, less power, and less hardware. **Reinvent How The World Runs AI Infrastructure** AI infrastructure is being rebuilt in real time. GPUs are scarce and expensive, HBM is supply\-constrained, and the economics of inference are forcing every serious operator to rethink how they architect compute. Liqid is one of the few credible answers at scale: we pool GPU and memory resources and assign them in software, so customers get 10x the tokens per second, 5x the tokens per dollar, and 2x the tokens per watt out of the infrastructure they already own. We are hiring a **Sr Solutions Architect** to lead technical pre\-sales engagement for Liqid’s most important customer opportunities. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can earn credibility with technical buyers, shape the solution architecture, lead proof\-of\-concept work, and turn complex infrastructure challenges into clear customer value. **Why Liqid, Why Now** AI infrastructure is being rebuilt in real time. GPUs are scarce and expensive, HBM is supply\-constrained, and the economics of inference are forcing every serious operator to rethink how they architect compute. Liqid’s pooling platform is one of the few credible answers to that problem at scale. This role is the technical front line of that conversation working with demanding customers across AI, federal, and HPC, on a small senior team where your work is visible and your field signal reaches the people who build the product. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing position. **About the Role** This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing position. You will partner closely with account executives on discovery, design, PoCs, RFP responses, and executive technical conversations. You will own the technical strategy across your territory from early qualification through technical close, reporting to the SVP of Worldwide Solutions Engineering and working directly with a small, senior SA team. **The location is primarily California with west mid\- west travel.** The right person can whiteboard a GPU inference cluster with a customer’s principal engineer, run a disciplined PoC against agreed success criteria, and translate the technical outcome into business language that resonates with a CFO, CIO, or program office. Customers will rely on this role to help them rethink GPU infrastructure as HBM, power, and utilization become primary constraints. The Solutions Architect translates Liqid’s capabilities into practical customer architectures, turns ambiguous requirements into deliverable solutions, and feeds field insight back into the evolution of the product. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the technical relationship for accounts across your territory from first discovery through technical close to deployment. * Partner with your AE on every meaningful opportunity: technical discovery, solution design, PoC scoping, RFP/RFI response, and executive technical engagement. * Run technical discovery that gets to the real requirement GPU utilization targets, workload mix, fabric constraints, and the economics behind the decision not just the stated spec. * Be accountable for technical win rate and PoC conversion in your territory, with clear visibility into where deals are won, lost, or stuck. * PoC’s will be delivered physically with Liqid hardware at a customer or partner venue. Also via a remote lab environment, hosted by Liqid. * Full ownership of the PoC process is expected including installation, configuration and testing. * Scope, run, and win proofs of concept against explicit, customer\-agreed success criteria and drive them to a decision. * Build and deliver compelling demos of Liqid Matrix tailored to the workload in front of you: AI training, inference at scale, HPC, and virtualization / VDI. * Contribute to and reuse the team’s library of reference architectures, sizing tools, TCO models, and PoC playbooks so the team scales faster than headcount and what worked once is repeatable. * Maintain credible working knowledge of the demo and lab environment and feedback what the field needs from it. * Operate as a true partner to sales. Help qualify hard, shape the technical strategy on a deal, and know when to walk away from a poor\-fit opportunity. * Carry a territory\-ownership mindset: understand your accounts, your competitive landscape, and your pipeline well enough to be proactive rather than reactive. * Engage credibly across the customer org from a principal engineer or chief architect to a CIO or CFO buying committee and adjust the message to the audience. * Be a structured voice of the customer back to Product and Engineering translating field signal into prioritized, evidence\-backed input rather than one\-off anecdotes. * Working closely with support, marketing and our OEM partners to educate, optimise and develop capabilities. * Surface roadmap gaps and integration priorities (e.g. SLURM, Kubernetes, virtualization / VDI, northbound integrations) clearly and early, with the customer context that makes them actionable. * Help close the loop between field PoCs and engineering on early\-access and design\-partner work. * Ensure a clean technical hand\-off from pre\-sales to deployment, customer success, and support so what the customer was sold matches what gets delivered. * Stay engaged on your most strategic deployments to protect against technical churn and to surface expansion opportunities. **Requirements** **What You Bring** **Experience** * 5\+ years in technical pre\-sales, solutions architecture, or field engineering at a B2B infrastructure, systems, or AI infrastructure company. * A track record of personally owning the technical work on competitive deals discovery, architecture, PoC, and technical close. * Experience working alongside or through tier\-one OEMs (Dell, HPE, Cisco, Supermicro, Lenovo, or equivalents) is a strong plus. **Technical depth** * Solid, current knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure: GPU systems (H100/H200/B100/B200 class and successors), the memory hierarchy, and cluster\-scale architecture for training and inference. * Working command of the modern data center stack: server platforms, fabric and networking (CXL, PCIe Gen5/6, NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCE/Ethernet), and storage. * Hands\-on familiarity with virtualization and VDI (VMware and equivalents) and orchestration / scheduling (Kubernetes, SLURM) and an honest sense of where each is mature and where it isn’t. * Credible on the economics of infrastructure GPU utilization, cost\-per\-token, TCO not just the bits and bytes. **How you operate** * Consultative by instinct you listen for the real problem before you reach for the product. * A genuine sales partner you make your AE better, qualify honestly, and treat the number as partly yours. * Owner, not passenger you take responsibility for your territory and don’t wait to be told what the next move is. * Curious by default you stay current on the AI infrastructure landscape because you find it interesting, not because someone made you. * A clear communicator who can explain a composable architecture cleanly to an engineer, a CIO, or a CFO. **Benefits** **Join Us** Embrace the opportunity to be part of a dynamic team, driving innovation in a thriving industry. Apply now to shape the future of IT infrastructure with Liqid. We look forward to receiving your application and exploring how you can contribute to Liqid's growth. jobs.title: Network & Voice Operations Support Technician I (Floater)
jobs.description: We need a flexible, hands\-on Level 1 technician who can easily split their time between desk work and field visits. In this role, you’ll act as our primary floater—some mornings you’ll sit in the NOC handling ticket queues and phone calls; other afternoons you’ll throw your gear into a company truck to mount gear, run patch cables, or swap hardware at client sites across Tucson. You don’t need to know everything on day one, but you must be dependable, quick to learn, and comfortable switching gears throughout the day. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ ### **What the Job Looks Like Day\-to\-Day** NOC \& Help Desk Queue * Field incoming calls, emails, and tickets with a level head and a customer service focus, letting clients know what to expect and when. * Run initial connectivity checks using standard utilities (ping, traceroute) and monitoring dashboards (Zabbix, InControl, UniFi); document what you see and escalate cleanly when a problem needs senior eyes. * Address everyday VoIP tickets: dead handsets, bad call quality, SIP registration drops, extension reassignments, or basic call tree updates. * Log all notes, customer details, and config changes into our ticketing system as they happen—not hours later. * Help our managed services crew with everyday desktop tickets, including local printer issues, basic account lockouts, and workstation connectivity. Field Support \& Site Work * Act as on\-site "smart hands" for senior engineers—power\-cycling rack equipment, reseating transceivers, tracing patch cords, or reading out switch port status LEDs over the phone. * Physically rack, mount, cable, and test hardware on\-site: routers, switches, wireless access points, PoE gear, IP phones, and ATAs. * Run quick site readiness checks against our install checklists; upload clean photos and site notes to the ticket before leaving. * Handle de\-installs when clients offboard, safely box up gear, and log it back into inventory (Sonar). Gear \& Inventory Prep * Tag incoming hardware, log serial numbers, and keep track of where loaned gear goes. * Unbox, label, and stage hardware on the bench so it’s configured and ready for scheduled rollouts. * Keep install kits and company vehicles stocked with zip ties, RJ\-45 heads, patch leads, and basic hand tools. ### **Who We're Looking For** * Foundational Tech Sense: You understand IP addressing, subnets, DHCP, DNS, and the basics of how an IP phone talks across a local subnet. * Troubleshooting Instincts: You know how to isolate a bad cable or port before guessing at complex software bugs. * Customer Skills: You can talk someone through a reboot without sounding frustrated or speaking entirely in jargon. * Hands\-on Comfort: Fine with crimping Cat5e/Cat6, testing basic punch\-downs, running patch lines neatly, and working with common hand tools. * Adaptability: You don't mind starting a project in an air\-conditioned operations center and finishing your afternoon troubleshooting an AP on a 10\-foot ladder. * Requirements: High school diploma or GED; a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record; must be able to pass a standard background check. ### **Helpful Extras (Not Required)** * 6–12\+ months in an MSP, ISP, NOC, or help desk environment. * Entry certs like CompTIA A\+, Net\+, or basics from Cisco, MikroTik, or Ubiquiti. * Prior work inside hosted PBX or SIP admin panels. * Practical structured cabling or low\-voltage experience. * Bilingual Spanish/English is a definite plus in the Tucson market. ### **Physical Requirements \& Environment** * Split role: Operations center desk environment mixed with on\-site client visits across Tucson. * Field environments vary—you will occasionally work in warm server closets, drop ceilings, rooftops, and outdoor Arizona weather. * Must be comfortable carrying gear up to 50 lbs and working safely from ladders (up to 12 ft). * Must be open to occasional maintenance windows, after\-hours shifts, or being on\-call for sudden regional outages. * Company vehicle provided for all work\-related driving.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Engineering - Data Science
jobs.description: LTK's mission is to empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. We have a huge opportunity ahead of us and we're looking for team members who want to create, innovate and disrupt an industry. We empower our team members to drive innovation, create value, and continue to spearhead the creation of this industry — a game changer when it comes to career growth. **Position Title**: Sr Manager, Engineering \- Data Science **Location:** Remote from the U.S. **Reports to**: CPTO #### **About the role** We are hiring a Senior Data Science Manager to lead the team building LTK's foundational AI capabilities. This team develops shared models, services, tools, and evaluation frameworks that enable teams across LTK to build and deploy AI effectively. You will help define the AI platform roadmap, identify capabilities that can serve multiple teams, and turn promising approaches into reliable production services. The work spans areas such as embeddings, semantic understanding, retrieval, model evaluation, and access to large language models, supporting applications across search, recommendations, catalog, and other product and business workflows. We are looking for a technically strong people leader who can connect AI with practical platform development. You will partner closely with engineering and product teams to make shared AI capabilities easy to adopt, operate, and improve. Success means helping those teams deliver better experiences faster, with measurable quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. Building a high\-performing team is central to this role. You will set clear expectations, provide direct feedback, coach team members, and manage performance. ### #### **How you will make an impact** * **Build shared AI capabilities.** Lead a team developing reusable models, services, and tools that address common needs across LTK. * **Shape the platform roadmap.** Partner with engineering, product, and data leaders to prioritize foundational investments based on business value, demand across teams, and technical dependencies. * **Enable other teams.** Work with internal partners to understand their needs, support integration, and provide clear documentation and technical guidance. * **Deliver production\-ready systems.** Partner with engineering on deployment, monitoring, versioning, and ongoing operation of AI services. * **Make evals foundational to AI development.** Own the team's approach to evaluating AI systems, from shared evaluation tooling and representative datasets to release criteria and production quality monitoring. Enable partner teams to measure whether AI capabilities work reliably for their use cases and improve them with evidence. * **Manage quality and cost.** Guide decisions about models, providers, and architecture, balancing accuracy, latency, reliability, and operating cost. * **Own execution and outcomes.** Set clear priorities, manage dependencies, and measure success through platform adoption, service performance, and the outcomes enabled for partner teams. * **Develop the team.** Hire and retain strong talent, support career growth, give regular feedback, and address performance issues directly. #### **What you will bring to LTK** #### **Data Science and AI** * 7\+ years of experience in data science or machine learning * 3\+ years of direct people management experience leading data science or machine learning teams, including hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management. * **Experience shipping AI systems.** You have delivered LLM\-powered capabilities into production and owned their performance after launch, including quality, reliability, latency, and cost. Your experience includes operating AI systems beyond prototypes and traditional ML projects. * **Strong experience building and operating AI evaluations (evals).** You have created representative evaluation datasets, defined task\-specific quality criteria, and built automated evaluations with human review where needed. You have used evals to guide model and prompt selection, catch regressions, establish release criteria, and monitor quality in production. * **Experience building shared AI capabilities.** You have built AI services, tools, or platforms that multiple teams have adopted and used in production. You understand how to make those capabilities reusable, reliable, and easy to integrate. * **Strong technical foundations.** You bring a solid grounding in machine learning, applied statistics, and experimentation. You use that knowledge to choose practical approaches, test assumptions, and measure results. #### **Platform and Technical Leadership** * **Platform strategy and ownership.** You can translate needs across teams into a focused AI platform roadmap. You prioritize investments that solve shared problems, accelerate delivery, and create lasting value. * **Production service leadership.** You have partnered with engineering to deliver reliable AI services, shaping service interfaces, deployment practices, observability, and operational readiness. You establish clear ownership and measurable expectations for quality, latency, availability, and cost. * **Adoption and developer experience.** You treat internal teams as customers. You make shared capabilities easy to discover, integrate, and operate through clear interfaces, documentation, and practical support, and use adoption and feedback to guide improvements. * **Sound architectural judgment.** You make informed decisions about what to build, buy, or adopt. You evaluate models, providers, and tools against demonstrated quality, integration effort, operating cost, and long\-term maintainability. * **Hands\-on technical leadership.** You stay close enough to the work to review code and architecture, challenge assumptions, and resolve difficult technical problems. You set clear standards while developing your team's judgment and ownership. A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent practical experience is equally valued. #### **Nice to have** * Experience with large\-scale or real\-time data and inference systems. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation or AI workflow orchestration. * Experience in marketplaces, social commerce, or recommendation\-driven products. \#LI\-CW1 ### **What we offer for full\-time salaried employees** * The opportunity to be part of the leading global company in creator commerce * A remote\-first, productivity\-first environment * Competitive compensation and benefits package to meet the needs of you and your family * 401(k) with LTK company matching * Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance, Dental Insurance * Paid Maternity Leave and Paid Paternity Leave * Summer Fridays and Flexible PTO * For temporary full\-time employees, benefits eligibility may vary ### **About LTK** Founded in 2011, LTK is the global technology platform purpose\-built to empower lifestyle creators to monetize their content. The full\-service platform connects brands, creators, and shoppers with a world\-class shopping app and trusted tools and technology that make content instantly shoppable. Today, premium lifestyle creators in 160\+ countries drive more than $5 billion\+ in annual retail sales through their LTK Shop profiles. More than 40 million consumers turn to LTK Shops in the LTK shopping platform each month to find inspiration and instantly shop the styles recommended by their favorite creators. More than 8,000 retailers and 1M brands partner with LTK to gain access to its global creator network for content that converts against performance\-driven, cross\-channel KPIs. LTK is headquartered in Dallas, TX, and currently operates on five continents. ### **Our mission** To empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. ### **Our values** * Here to win * Commit to the journey * Work well ### **Commitment to diversity** LTK believes diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental obligations that strengthen our team. We employ a diverse, multi\-disciplinary team to build a meaningful company and culture. *For US\-Based Roles: We are not offering new sponsorships opportunities at this time for persons requiring employment visas, such as an H\-1B; authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.* *Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of LTK are considered the property of LTK and are not subject to payment of agency fees*. *LTK is an Equal Opportunity Employer.* \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer for Marketplace
jobs.description: ##### **Project description** We're building a platform that companies use to create marketplaces that help people find the right kind of provider and book an appointment. Consumer apps, health systems, payer and employer partners deliver it to their members through embeddable experiences, SDKs, an API, and an MCP server. You'll own how schedule inventory gets into the marketplaces. You'll integrate health systems and telehealth networks through batch feeds and real\-time APIs, normalize their data into standards\-conformant FHIR, and keep availability fresh enough that every booking either confirms or fails gracefully. You'll take each new supplier from zero to production, then own it once it's live. This is a hands\-on, AI\-native role on a small team. You'll use coding agents and reusable AI skills to move faster on mappings, tests, and boilerplate. ##### **Responsibilities** Build and operate supplier integrations through batch channels (EHR exports, SFTP extracts, Delta Sharing) and real\-time APIs (telehealth network APIs and others). Normalize supplier data into FHIR Slot, Schedule, Location, PractitionerRole, and HealthcareService resources Build idempotent, incremental loads with freshness metrics, and the confirm\-at\-booking flow that handles stale inventory, taken slots, and expired holds. Keep production healthy with orchestration, alerting, on\-call, and root cause analysis Handle PHI and encrypted files safely, and write the unit and integration tests that keep pipelines trustworthy. Build reusable supplier adapters, and AI skills others can build on. ##### **Skills** Must have 6\+ years in data engineering, data integration or health IT Experience owning production pipelines end to end, including on\-call. You've been the person who takes a new source from zero to production. Experience integrating external partner data through both batch file feeds and APIs. Strong Python and SQL, with solid ETL/ELT (Apache Aifrlow), change data capture, and incremental, idempotent processing. Experience with API authorization (OAuth 2\.0 etc) and file ingestion (SFTP, decryption). Experience working with PII and/or PHI under HIPAA. Daily use of AI coding tools like Claude Code, with the judgment to know when a deterministic rule beats an LLM call. You hold a high bar in review and say no to integrations that aren't ready, kindly and clearly. You drive work to landed, not merged, and you own the result. Nice to have Experience in healthcare technology, working with PHI under HIPAA. Strong working knowledge of FHIR models, APIs, and implementation guides such as Experience with FHIR platforms and tools, whether commercial or open\-source (e.g.,HAPI, Smile, Medplum), or having built your own. Participation in the FHIR community, such as HL7 or non\-HL7 working groups, Connectathons, IG contributions, or presentations at events like DevDays or HIMSS. FHIR training or certifications, such as FHIR Implementer or Advanced Developer. Experience with the IHE ITI Scheduling IG, SMART Scheduling Links, Epic Open Scheduling, Oracle Health FHIR scheduling, or athenahealth APIs. Experience with HL7 v2 SIU scheduling messages, telehealth network integrations, or provider reference data such as NPPES. Experience with Prefect framework, Apache Spark, Databricks, or Apache Kafka. ##### **Other** Languages English: C1 Advanced Seniority Senior Remote United States, United States of America Req.
