jobs.title: Founding GTM Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Magic, we're personalizing real world experiences. Our first product, Loyalist, is an agentic CRM for restaurants. We partner with 1,000\+ venues across 180\+ cities, from Carbone to 4 Charles to Eleven Madison Park. We're expanding into members clubs, hotels, and more. We sell in person. Our team walks into restaurants, hosts dinners for operators, and shows up at the industry's events. We're looking for a founding GTM engineer to build the system behind that motion. You'll own the data, tools, and AI agents that tell our team which groups to meet, who runs them, and what each event and conversation actually produced. This is a builder role. You'll run our enrichment and programmatic outbound, and you'll build the internal tools that sales, customer experience, and growth use every day. You'll report to our Head of Growth and work closely with the marketing and growth team, as well as founders, sales, and customer experience. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build and manage our internal GTM platform. Develop our data enrichment processes and build the agents that power our go\-to\-market motion * Build and run programmatic outbound, including cold email, end to end: targeting, sequencing, and reply handling, plus the infrastructure behind it (sending domains, warmup, and deliverability) * Own lead scoring and lifecycle. Score every account on signals like new openings, chef and GM changes, and groups switching reservation or POS systems, then build the lifecycle automations that move it from first touch to closed, onboarded, and expanding * Build tools that make sales and customer experience feel superhuman, e.g. a context transfer layer between the two teams or a meeting scheduler for the sales team * Partner with marketing and growth to turn our data into campaigns, events, and programs that drive pipeline, and support on SEO / AEO * Own GTM reporting and connect our tools, so sales, customer experience, and growth work from the same data and can see what each channel and event produced **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years of experience across GTM engineering, engineering, demand gen, or RevOps * Some background in marketing and growth preferred * Experience with data enrichment. You know the providers, waterfalls, and how to get a clean, verified list * You can build distributed systems * Experience running programmatic outbound, including cold email at scale, with the deliverability to match. You understand the statistics of domain, IP, and copy health * High competence with Claude and Clay. You've built real workflows and tools with both, not just prompts in a chat window, and you have a strong point of view on the best tools and integrations for each task * You enjoy supporting teammates. You turn what sales, customer experience, and marketing ask for into tools they actually use * You care about data quality. Duplicates and wrong location counts bother you * High ownership and a bias toward shipping * Bonus: experience in or around restaurants or hospitality **Who thrives here** -------------------- * You want to be early and own a system end to end * You'd rather ship a working tool this week than a perfect one next quarter * You like being close to the field. You'll join walk\-ins and events to see how the data gets used **What we offer** ----------------- * Salary range $150,000\-$190,000 and equity * We work in person 5 days a week in our SoHo office * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and all your dependents (FSA and HSA plans available) * Lunch daily from the best restaurants in NYC; you choose all the restaurants your first week * A day trailing a restaurant, so you see what our customers live every day * Unlimited PTO Compensation Range: $150K \- $190K

jobs.title: AI Governance Engineer
jobs.description: As MISO's **AI Governance Engineer**, you will help build and evolve the enterprise AI governance framework as the organization expands its use of generative and agentic AI. In this role, you will develop practical guardrails, controls, processes, and oversight mechanisms that enable responsible and secure use of AI while supporting innovation. You will help create a scalable, risk\-based approach for registering, evaluating, monitoring, and governing AI solutions, including internally developed, purchased, and vendor\-embedded technologies. Working closely with partners across technology, security, compliance, HR, and business teams, you will help establish governance practices that can be adopted across the organization. Because AI technologies and risks continue to evolve rapidly, this position requires ongoing learning, curiosity, and continuous refinement of governance processes and standards. The ideal candidate brings experience in AI engineering, software development, data engineering, or related disciplines, along with a collaborative, hands\-on approach to solving complex challenges and balancing innovation with risk management. Some of the impactful contributions you’ll make as MISO’s **AI Governance Engineer** include: * Owning the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for the enterprise AI governance platform, building and operating it as a scalable internal product. * Defining a repeatable, risk‑tiered governance framework (including measurement, evaluation, monitoring, and incident response) to ensure teams can apply the right controls to any AI solution. * Delivering a central AI registry and intake process that identifies, registers, and tiers high‑risk and high‑visibility AI systems across the enterprise. * Building automated capabilities for registration, observability, and evidence capture, ensuring traceability across data, models, prompts, versions, and evaluations from deployment onward. * Creating reusable evaluation tooling for ML, generative AI, and agentic systems, and validate that governance measures and model‑based evaluations are accurate and continuously improving. * Defining monitoring thresholds, incident‑response protocols, and rollback runbooks for AI failure, degradation, or policy violations, validating them through exercises such as tabletop tests. * Providing transparency to leadership through reporting on AI quality, usage, cost, and value, while collaborating with security, privacy, compliance, risk, and the AI Working Group to drive consistent governance adoption. You’ll need the following skills to be successful as **AI Governance Engineer**: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field; a master’s degree, relevant certifications, or equivalent experience may also be considered. * 8\+ years of experience in software, data, or machine learning engineering, including at least 3 years building or evaluating production ML or AI solutions. * Experience designing, building, and operating shared platforms or internal products used across multiple teams. * Solid understanding of model training, evaluation, and failure modes, with the ability to design sound evaluation approaches. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools. Experience in two or more of the following: * Evaluating or monitoring ML, generative AI, retrieval\-augmented, or agentic systems. * Observability, telemetry, or alerting for production systems. * Test automation or quality engineering for non\-deterministic systems. * MLOps/LLMOps, including experiment tracking, versioning, and model or artifact registries. * Data quality and validation practices for AI‑relevant datasets. * Cloud cost management or usage analytics. Preferred Experience: * Master’s degree or other advanced degree * Familiarity with AI governance or risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001 * Background in statistics or experiment design. * Experience in the energy industry. * Relevant certifications, including: IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP), Microsoft Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI‑103\), Microsoft Azure Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate (AI‑300\), or ISO/IEC 42001 certification. Appropriate level will be determined based upon experience and knowledge. Transformative innovation is happening in the electric industry, from digitalizing homes and distributed resources to renewable energy and an ever\-changing grid. MISO manages the electricity superhighway in the Central U.S. and through use of groundbreaking research and advanced technology, our highly skilled employees ensure power flows reliably to 45 million Americans. Operating the electricity grid, running a robust energy market, planning for a bright future – it’s what our immensely hardworking and dedicated team does every day. The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $173,000 – $198,000 USD annually. Base salary range for this position is included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, and qualifications/experience. Position is also eligible for an annual bonus if individual performance and company objectives are met. At MISO we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including 401k, vacation, sick and safe time, available on your first day of employment. \#DiscoverMISO \#MISOCareers \#lifeatMISO \#weareMISO MISO, What We Do (https://vimeo.com/935124142/5c8d23402d) \#LI\-ONSITE \#LI\-JH1 #### **Experience** Preferred* 8 year(s): Software, data, or machine learning engineering. #### **Education** Preferred* Bachelors or better in Data Science or related field * Bachelors or better in Data Analytics or related field * Bachelors or better in Software Engineering or related field * Bachelors or better in Computer Science or related field Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit and Lending ML
jobs.description: About a week before Hurricane Sandy made landfall, the two leading forecast models flatly disagreed: the American one carried the storm safely out into the Atlantic, the European one turned it hard left into New Jersey. The European model wasn't running a better simulation, it was running an ensemble. Hundreds of thousands of people were evacuated on the strength of the spread in forecast distribution, days before any single forecast could have justified moving them, and on October 29th, 2012, Sandy came ashore almost exactly where the models had put it. At Mercury, we're building the future of financial infrastructure for startups and growing businesses. We're extending credit to those businesses, and we're doing it with proprietary access to some of the best data for understanding a borrower's business, from bank transactions to financial reporting to payroll. jobs.description: Merge Labs is a frontier research lab with the mission of bridging biological and artificial intelligence to maximize human ability, agency and experience. We’re pursuing this goal by developingfundamentally new approaches to brain\-computer interfaces that interact with the brain at high bandwidth, integrate with advanced AI, and are ultimately safe and accessible for anyone to use. **About the team** The Delivery team develops the viral and non\-viral delivery technologies that enable Merge's next\-generation neurotechnology platform. By partnering closely with bioengineering, neuroscience, and in vivo teams, we create delivery systems that support rapid preclinical testing while advancing the platform toward safe and effective human translation. We work across disciplines to come up with creative ideas and solve some of the most challenging problems in biotechnology. **About the role** As a Scientist in the Delivery team, you will engineer and validate viral gene delivery approaches to enable the expression and function of novel molecular biosensors and actuators of neural activity in preclinical models. Your work will serve as the critical bridge between molecular engineering and in vivo functionality and enable the ultimate clinical translation of molecular BCI. You will collaborate closely with protein engineers, cell and synthetic biologists, machine learning engineers, physicists and neuroscientists. We’re hiring for complementary roles across the Delivery team. We encourage you to apply for the role that best aligns with your experience. **In this role, you will:** * Design, build, and test AAV and other viral vectors for gene delivery to the CNS, spanning serotype selection, cargo and regulatory element design, dose, and route of administration. * Design, run, and interpret in vivo studies in rodents and, where appropriate, large animal models, iterating rapidly from results to the next round of optimization. * Evaluate and benchmark routes of administration for viral gene delivery to the brain, including pairing of viral vectors with focused ultrasound blood\-brain barrier opening. * Build or adapt the assays and readouts needed to quantify delivery, expression, cell\-type specificity, and tolerability in brain tissue. * Evaluate emerging delivery technologies and help shape the team's longer\-term delivery strategy. jobs.title: Software Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Mill is a waste prevention technology company reimagining what it means to eliminate waste, starting with food. We build smart systems and infrastructure for homes, businesses, and municipalities that transform food scraps from landfill\-bound waste into valuable resources, including chicken feed. Tens of thousands of Mill's residential food recyclers are already helping households divert millions of pounds of food scraps every year, paving the way for our upcoming launch of Mill Commercial—the industry's first end\-to\-end solution for managing, understanding, and preventing food waste in commercial environments (e.g. grocery, restaurants, food services). At Mill, we are passionate about building easy\-to\-use, beautifully designed technologies that keep food in the food system and out of landfills. As a Software Quality Engineer, you will join a small team to own quality for the consumer and enterprise experiences our customers rely on: our website, our iOS and Android mobile apps, our e\-commerce flows, and the enterprise software behind Mill Commercial. You will work cross\-functionally with software, hardware, and product teams. AI\-assisted development is core to how we build software, not a peripheral tool. We expect daily fluency with tools like Claude Code, for example to write and maintain test automation, generate test cases from requirements, and triage failures. As a senior engineer, you will also help set the team's standards for using these tools well, including how AI\-generated tests are reviewed. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Work with leaders across the company to define requirements and feature requests, and translate them into comprehensive test plans. * Design and execute test cases and test plans for consumer web, mobile app, and e\-commerce features. * Design and execute test plans for enterprise software, including multi\-user accounts, roles and permissions, reporting and data accuracy, integrations, and scale and reliability for business customers. * Test our iOS and Android apps across devices, OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions, and validate app releases before they ship. * Test web experiences across browsers and devices, including responsive layout, accessibility, and performance. * Build and extend our test automation framework, and write automated tests for web, mobile, enterprise, and full\-stack scenarios that mimic real\-world customer behavior and give broad coverage. * Validate how the apps and web experiences work with our cloud services and connected devices end to end. * Partner with SDET, software, cloud, firmware, and hardware teams and Technical Program Managers on validation, bug triage, and improving the end\-customer experience. * Partner with Product Managers to develop and validate customer scenarios, analyze failures, and review device metrics from field trials. * Champion product quality at every stage of development, including CI/CD and deployment. * Help set team practices for using AI\-assisted tools in testing. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * B.S. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years in software development and quality assurance. * Experience testing consumer\-facing web, mobile (iOS and/or Android), and e\-commerce products. * Experience testing enterprise or B2B software. * Strong foundation in software quality fundamentals: test planning, test design, and automation. * Hands\-on experience with Python and/or Java. * Proven ability to write your own automation framework and automated tests using pytest and other tools (for example Playwright or Appium), and to drive increased test coverage. * Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation and test architecture diagrams. * Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code in your workflow. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience testing with our specific stack: React Native (mobile), AWS Lambda with CDK (TypeScript) * Experience testing connected or hardware\-paired consumer products. * Experience at startups or in rapid prototyping environments. * Familiarity with Agile methodologies, version control systems (for example GitHub), and CI/CD pipelines. *The estimated base salary range for this position is $150K to $170k, which does not include the value of benefits or a potential equity grant. A wide range of factors are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets, market conditions, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and business and organizational needs.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud SaaS - IE&A
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Why This Role** Miller is building a new software\-as\-a\-service business from the ground up: cloud software for the welding and fabrication industry, backed by nearly a century of industry leadership and the resources of ITW. You’ll be one of the first engineers on a small, senior internal team, helping set how we build, ship, and run software, including how we adopt AI\-assisted engineering as those practices take shape, and you’ll see your work used by real customers on real shop floors. **Location:** Remote \-Occasional travel to our Appleton, WI facility. **Job Description** The Senior Software Engineer owns delivery of features and projects end to end on Miller’s cloud SaaS platform, from refining requirements with Product, through design and code, to operating what they build in production. Working alongside our Software Architect, product leaders, and contract development partners, you’ll raise the bar for quality and speed, mentor others, and help establish the engineering practices a modern SaaS business runs on. **Key Responsibilities** * Own delivery of projects end to end * Take high\-level, often ambiguous problems, break them into well\-defined work, and deliver independently. * Design and build cloud services, APIs, and web applications on Microsoft Azure using C\#/.NET and modern front\-end frameworks. * Partner with Product to refine requirements and propose simpler alternatives that deliver the same value faster. * Engage directly with customers, support, and design partners to understand how our software is used, and ship features with the telemetry needed to show usage and value. * Review code and designs from contract development partners, raising quality and velocity concerns with data. * Define monitoring, alerting, and runbooks for what you own; take part in on\-call and incident response and contribute to blameless postmortems. * Build with infrastructure as code and CI/CD, and apply security and compliance controls (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001\) in day\-to\-day work. * Use time\-boxed spikes and prototypes to test ideas and make deliberate calls on when to throw a prototype away versus harden it. * Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing, and knowledge sharing. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) to speed up design, coding, testing, and documentation, while reviewing AI\-generated output critically and following ITW AI usage policy. * Stay current as AI tools evolve, understand their trade\-offs and risks, and share what works with the team. * Deliver software enhancements * Reviewing code from external development partners * Improve software development, testing, and deployment processes. **Minimum Qualifications** * 4\+ years of professional software development experience. * Hands\-on experience building and operating cloud\-hosted web applications or services in production (Azure preferred). * Strong proficiency in C\#/.NET or a comparable modern language, including REST APIs and relational databases. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and monitoring production systems. * Demonstrated ability to own delivery end to end, work through ambiguity, and debug and improve code written by others, including AI\-generated and partner code. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools in professional work, with a clear view of where they help and where they don’t. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience at a SaaS product company (multi\-tenant architecture, subscription products). * Infrastructure as code (e.g., Bicep, Terraform) and containers (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps). * Experience working with or reviewing the work of contract or outsourced development teams. * Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or secure software development practices. * IoT, connected equipment, or industrial and manufacturing data experience. * Modern front\-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, Blazor). * Experience building AI or LLM\-powered features into products. * Agile/Scrum experience and familiarity with delivery metrics such as DORA. * Curiosity about welding, fabrication, and the people who do the work. **Why ITW Welding?** Join a collaborative and growth\-focused team where your expertise will directly impact the company’s financial health and operational success. We value innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. Here’s what we offer to help you build the future you want: * **Generous Retirement Benefits –** 401(k) match PLUS an additional retirement contribution to help you plan for the future. * **Paid Time Off –** 11 paid holidays, 5 sick days, and vacation time to take time for what matters. * **Company\-Paid Insurance –** Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term \& Long\-Term Disability insurance to give you peace of mind. * **Family\-Friendly Benefits –** 4 weeks of paid parental leave and adoption reimbursement to support your family journey. * **Education Assistance –** tuition reimbursement because we believe in investing in your personal and professional development. At ITW Welding, we’re not just a place to work – we’re a community that empowers you to grow and make a real impact. Join us and build a career that makes a difference! *ITW is an equal opportunity employer. We value our colleagues’ unique perspectives, experiences and ideas and create workplaces where everyone can develop their careers and perform to their full potential.* *As an equal employment opportunity employer, ITW is committed to equal employment opportunity and fair treatment for employees, beginning with the hiring process and continuing through all aspects of the employment relationship.* *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Embedded Enablement & Agentic AI
jobs.description: **AI Engineer – Embedded Enablement \& Agentic AI** --------------------------------------------------- *Embed with business teams to deliver practical AI solutions, help employees use AI confidently, and build internal knowledge systems. Work under a senior AI lead while owning department engagements, training cohorts and the systems you build.* Full Time · MinCloud IT · AI Engineer I/II (Early Career) · Wixom, MI Reports to: NA IT Director · FLSA Status: To be confirmed by HR**Requisition ID: Salary Range:****KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Embedded AI Delivery – Partner with business departments to identify high\-value workflows and rapidly build, test and deploy AI solutions using Codex, Claude Code and the Claude API, targeting working solutions in days where scope permits. * Employee Training – Lead role\-based sessions, office hours and workshops on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex and Copilot; develop department AI champions and support practical, responsible adoption. * AI Enablement Hub – Maintain learning paths, tool guides, prompt libraries and a solutions showcase; keep resources current and track employee engagement and adoption. * Knowledge Systems – Build and operate retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over SharePoint, Teams, CRM systems and internal documents, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings and vector or hybrid search. * Evaluation and Access – Evaluate retrieval relevance and answer quality, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and implement permission\-aware retrieval that respects source access controls. * Agentic AI Governance – Help develop and apply agent registration, risk tiering, tool and data permissions, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, logging and rollback procedures under senior technical guidance. * Solution Ownership – Document, monitor and maintain deployed solutions; coordinate testing, user feedback, support and escalation with business stakeholders and the senior AI lead. * Outcome Measurement – Establish baselines and report hours saved, cycle\-time improvements and adoption for every deployment; use results to prioritize improvements. **REQUIREMENTS** * Hands\-on LLM project experience through work, internships, coursework or personal projects, including at least one demonstrable solution built with Codex, Claude or a similar coding agent. * Solid Python and SQL skills, with exposure to JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs and a cloud platform; Azure experience is preferred. * Experience building an end\-to\-end RAG prototype, including content ingestion, retrieval and response evaluation. * Working understanding of agentic AI patterns, including tool use, orchestration and guardrails. * Ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences through teaching, tutoring, training, documentation or user support. * Awareness of responsible AI and governance concepts, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and basic data privacy and access control principles. * Strong communication, collaboration and problem\-solving skills, with a practical focus on delivering useful solutions and learning from feedback. * Willingness to work on\-site with business teams in Wixom, Michigan. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (A PLUS)** * Manufacturing or automotive experience, including exposure to SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365\. * Experience with vector databases, LLM evaluation tooling, Power Platform or SharePoint development. * Azure or AWS AI certifications, or a public portfolio or GitHub repository demonstrating relevant projects. **MINIMUM EDUCATION / FIELD OF STUDY** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML or a related field, completed by the start date; OR an associate degree or technical certificate plus at least two years of software, data or IT experience. **KEY TO BEING SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE** * Translate business needs into clearly scoped AI solutions and deliver working results quickly with appropriate testing and review. * Build trust with department stakeholders, manage engagements independently and escalate technical or governance risks promptly. * Teach employees in practical, accessible ways and help AI champions sustain adoption within their teams. * Use measurable business outcomes and user feedback to improve solution quality, usability and value. * Apply sound judgment to sensitive information, permissions and human oversight while collaborating with a multicultural team. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT** * Work performed primarily in an office setting in Wixom, Michigan, with on\-site collaboration across business departments. * Regular computer use for software development, data analysis, documentation and virtual meetings. * Frequent communication with employees and stakeholders through individual coaching, group training and workshops. * Responsibilities may include visits to manufacturing areas; follow site safety requirements and wear required personal protective equipment when applicable. * Manage multiple department engagements, training activities and solution support priorities. * Ability to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation. **WHY WORK FOR MINTH?** Join Minth’s North American team and help business departments put AI to work through practical solutions, accessible training and responsible implementation. * Business impact – Build solutions that improve everyday workflows and deliver measurable results across departments. * Collaborative team – Work with business partners, IT colleagues and a senior AI lead to turn ideas into useful tools. * Professional development – Grow your skills in LLM applications, agentic AI, knowledge retrieval and employee enablement. * Diverse working environment – Collaborate in a multicultural, multinational workplace that values different backgrounds and perspectives. * Career opportunity – Develop your AI engineering career while contributing to Minth’s internal AI capabilities. *Minth North America, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Intermediate Equipment Maintenance Engineer** ----------------------------------------------- *Keeps production equipment running reliably — executing preventive maintenance, resolving mechanical, electrical and automation faults, and driving reliability improvements across the Lewisburg plant.* Full Time · Engineering · Equipment Maintenance · Minth Big and Beautiful Alabama, Gadsden, AL · FLSA Status: Exempt **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Equipment Maintenance – Develop and execute equipment inspections, preventive maintenance and planned repairs; maintain equipment histories and maintenance records. * Troubleshooting – Independently resolve routine mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic faults; investigate recurring failures and coordinate escalation of complex issues. * Installation and Commissioning – Support equipment installation, commissioning, acceptance and production handover, including maintenance requirements, technical documentation and spare parts readiness. * Automation Support – Diagnose faults involving PLCs, HMIs, sensors, variable frequency drives, servo systems and robots; make authorized adjustments and maintain program backups. * Utility Maintenance – Maintain production\-related water, electrical, compressed air and cooling systems, coordinating specialist service providers as needed. * Spare Parts and Cost Control – Maintain critical spare parts lists, recommend purchasing and stocking levels, and control maintenance expenditure and parts consumption. * Continuous Improvement – Monitor downtime, MTBF and MTTR, and implement improvements in equipment reliability, maintainability and energy efficiency. * Safety and Training – Follow lockout/tagout and safe maintenance procedures; train operators and maintenance technicians in inspections, basic maintenance and fault recognition. **REQUIREMENTS** * Five to eight years of manufacturing equipment maintenance experience. * Knowledge of mechanical drives, pneumatic and hydraulic systems, and electrical controls, with the ability to read mechanical drawings and electrical schematics. * PLC and HMI troubleshooting skills. * Knowledge of preventive maintenance, root cause analysis and spare parts management, with the ability to resolve routine equipment issues independently. * English communication and maintenance documentation skills appropriate to the role. * Ability to support shift work, planned shutdowns and urgent breakdowns as required. * Regulated work must be performed by appropriately qualified personnel or under applicable federal, state and local requirements. * Must be at least 18 years of age and legally authorized to work in the United States. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (A PLUS)** * Automotive component manufacturing or automated production line experience. * Experience with robots, servo systems or welding equipment. * Mandarin communication skills, an asset for collaboration with group and China\-based technical teams. **MINIMUM EDUCATION / FIELD OF STUDY** * Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. **KEY TO BEING SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE** * Ability to work independently on routine faults and to know when to escalate complex issues. * A data\-driven approach to reliability, using downtime, MTBF and MTTR to prioritize improvements. * Strong safety discipline, including lockout/tagout and safe maintenance practices. * Clear maintenance documentation and the ability to coach operators and technicians. * Good teamwork and communication skills in a multicultural team. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT** * Work performed primarily on the manufacturing floor, including standing, walking, bending, climbing and working in confined or elevated areas; hearing protection, safety glasses, safety footwear and other required PPE are worn. * Exposure to noise, moving equipment, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, and energized electrical equipment under lockout/tagout procedures. * Occasionally lift up to 50 lbs. * Some computer use for PLC/HMI troubleshooting, program backups and maintenance records. * Shift work, weekend and on\-call availability for planned shutdowns and urgent breakdowns as required. * Ability to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without reasonable accommodation. **WHY WORK FOR MINTH?** Minth Group is a global leader in automotive trim and structural components, and you can build your career in equipment maintenance and automation with a growing North American team. * International development platform – Be part of a global automotive supplier with 78 plants worldwide and a regional North American headquarters in Wixom, Michigan. * Dynamic and efficient team – Work with production, engineering and supply chain colleagues to keep automated lines running. * All\-round personal improvement – Grow your skills in automation, robotics, reliability engineering and root cause analysis. * Diversified working atmosphere – A multicultural, multinational workplace where different backgrounds and perspectives are valued. * Competitive compensation package – Competitive pay and benefits for a full\-time, stable manufacturing career. *Minth North America, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity), national origin, age (40 and over), disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Minth provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, for pregnancy, childbirth or related conditions, and for sincerely held religious beliefs, in the application process and in performing the essential functions of the job. To request an accommodation, please contact Human Resources.*

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: The Embedded Firmware Engineer I will support the development and sustaining engineering of embedded systems used in radiation measurement and medical\-device instrumentation. This early\-career role works at the intersection of firmware, electronics, instrumentation, and software. The engineer will begin with well\-defined firmware, hardware abstraction layer (HAL), driver, debugging, test, and documentation assignments under the mentorship of a senior firmware engineer, then grow into broader ownership of embedded platforms and legacy product knowledge. however, periodic in\-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business\-critical meetings*** **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** * Create innovative cloud solutions by designing and automating infrastructure using AWS CDK, TypeScript, and APIs \- bringing ideas to life with Infrastructure as Code. * Partner with teams across the organization to uncover challenges, accelerate delivery, and make the developer experience seamless through modern self\-service tools. * Apply engineering excellence to solve complex infrastructure problems \- driving automation, self\-healing capabilities, and reusable components that scale. * Lead lifecycle automation for distributed cloud platforms, ensuring smooth configuration, deployment, and monitoring for a stable, secure environment. * Build and optimize secure cloud networks, including load balancers, firewalls, and VPN connectivity, to keep our systems resilient and reliable. **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:** * **Production Software Engineering:** 5\+ years of software development experience in an object\-oriented language, with a ***strong preference for TypeScript or JavaScript (including advanced types, interface design, and asynchronous patterns).*** * **Production Infrastructure as Code Experience:** 2\+ years of hands\-on experience authoring, deploying, and debugging infrastructure as code. ***AWS CDK v2 in TypeScript is strongly preferred; Terraform module authoring will also be considered.*** Experience should include ***writing custom L3 constructs or reusable Terraform modules with proper scoping and lifecycle controls.*** * **Advanced IaC and State Management:** Strong experience managing complex infrastructure as code deployments, such as ***CDK aspects, escape hatches (modifying underlying L1 CloudFormation structures), cross\-stack references, and structural deployment barriers, or Terraform remote state, workspaces, and module dependency management***. * **Testing and CI/CD Pipelines:** Experience ***implementing automated testing for IaC infrastructure (e.g., aws\-cdk\-lib assertions, Terratest) and integrating IaC synthesis / deployment into automated pipelines*** (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline). * **Operational Engineering:** Strong background in cloud architectural design, testing, and operational support. Proven track record of building highly reusable, modular code components and implementing cloud governance or security compliance (such as cdk\-nag, AWS Config Rules, or policy\-as\-code tools). * You promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do. * Able to work remotely with access to a high\-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico. **PREFERRED:** * Experience with both AWS CDK and Terraform. * Ability to challenge the authenticity and effectiveness of team processes where opportunities for improvement exist. * Learn quickly when facing new problems and are a relentless and versatile learner, open to change. * Enjoy the challenge of unfamiliar tasks and ambiguity. **We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. jobs.title: Junior AI and Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Who You Are** You are a curious, hands\-on early\-career engineer who enjoys learning new technologies and using AI, automation, and software to solve practical business problems. You have built projects through coursework, internships, personal work, or a first technical role and are ready to apply those skills in a business environment. You ask thoughtful questions, communicate clearly, and are comfortable seeking guidance. You take feedback well, pay attention to detail, and follow through on your work. You're excited to join Myriad360's AI \& Automation team, learn from experienced engineers, and take on more responsibility as your skills grow. **About The Role** As Myriad360's Junior AI \& Automation Engineer, you will report to the AI \& Automation Lead and work alongside the AI \& Automation Engineer to build, test, and support AI\-powered applications and workflow automations across the organization. You will help turn defined business requirements into reliable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve day\-to\-day operations. You will work within our Microsoft 365 environment using platforms such as Microsoft Power Platform, ChatGPT Enterprise, StackAI, and Zapier. With guidance and review from the team, you will contribute to GPTs, agents, integrations, and internal tools while developing your engineering skills. **Must be based in the United States. Travel up to 10% may be required.** **Other responsibilities include:** * Build and update workflow automations, scripts, and integrations using established designs and development standards. * Configure and refine GPTs, AI agents, prompts, and tools with guidance from the team. * Connect applications through approved connectors, APIs, and webhooks, and assist with data preparation and transformation. * Help prepare internal knowledge sources and test retrieval results for AI applications. * Test solutions, document results, support user acceptance testing (UAT), and incorporate stakeholder feedback. * Monitor existing automations, investigate failures, resolve routine issues, and escalate more complex problems. * Document workflow logic, configurations, dependencies, and support procedures; assist with user guides and training. * Participate in discovery sessions, capture requirements, and share progress, questions, and blockers with the team. * Assist with deployments and ongoing improvements, following team review and approval processes. * Complete required security awareness training and comply with all company information security policies, standards, and procedures. * Identify, document, and escalate security risks to the appropriate Executive Leadership Team member and contribute to remediation efforts. * Perform other duties as assigned **Desired skills and experience:** * 0\-2 years of relevant experience in software development, automation, AI, or a related technical area. Internships, coursework, and personal projects count toward this experience. * Foundational programming skills, preferably in Python, with the ability to read, write, and debug simple scripts. * Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, and how applications exchange data. * Practical familiarity with generative AI tools and prompting, including reviewing outputs for accuracy and usefulness. * A methodical approach to troubleshooting, attention to detail, and willingness to learn version control and team development practices. * Clear communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to document work and explain questions or issues to technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Awareness of data privacy, access permissions, and the importance of handling business information securely. **Additional experience that is a plus** * Exposure to Power Automate, StackAI, Zapier, or similar automation and agent\-building platforms. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure, or Copilot Studio. * Exposure to Git, JavaScript/TypeScript, PowerShell, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or Model Context Protocol (MCP). **A Little About Us** Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things. **We live and breathe our core values:** * **We Before Me:** We demonstrate empathy through our actions and solicit diverse voices and opinions. We put ourselves in each other's shoes, readily admit our mistakes, and generously share our time and knowledge. * **Dare To Be Great:** We are big\-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best. * **Own It:** We set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and follow through on our commitments. We take pride in the experiences we create and the outcomes we deliver. We are personally invested in the success of our team and our clients. We iterate to deliver ever better results. We are consistently listed among Inc \& Crain's "Best Places to Work" and we're proud of our accessible \& engaged executive team. We believe in cultivating an atmosphere of inclusion and providing an environment that enables every employee to work to the best of their ability. **Some of Our Benefits** * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Incentive compensation plans for all employees * Company\-funded 401k contributions * Zero\-cost employer\-covered health insurance * Annual BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) reimbursement up to $500 * Paid Parental Leave * Transparent, candid culture with 1:1 coaching, performance reviews, and a consistent feedback loop * Quirky, diverse, respectful, high\-performing coworkers you'll want to achieve greatness with! **Must be based in the United States.** **Pursuant to the NYC Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range in New York City for this position is** **$85,000\.00****. Compensation in other geographies may vary.** Myriad360 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

defined requirements * Develop and refine prompts, system instructions, and model interactions to improve application performance and reliability * Build integrations with internal systems, tools, and data sources using APIs, MCPs, and other technologies * Support monitoring, testing, and evaluation of AI\-powered features. * Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate requirements into working features and improvements. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent professional experience. * 1 \+ years of professional software development experience, including experience developing and delivering software to production. * Programming experience with Python and JavaScript/TypeScript. * Experience developing modern web applications and backend APIs using frameworks such as Next.js, FastAPI, or comparable technologies. * Hands\-on experience developing applications or features using large language models through APIs. * Experience integrating APIs, backend services, and third\-party systems. * Experience working with relational databases and SQL. * Familiarity with modern software development practices including source control, testing, debugging, and code review. * Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field. * Experience building LLM\-powered workflows using LangChain or similar frameworks * Familiarity with multiple LLM providers and model platforms such as OpenRouter. * Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar technologies. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, or semantic search. * Experience developing cloud\-based applications, preferably using AWS. * Familiarity with video technologies, streaming media, content protection, cybersecurity, or digital rights management. * Interest in emerging AI technologies and their practical application in software development. **Additional Requirements:** **Hybrid:** This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of **four** days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in\-office requirements at any time. This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $62,000 \- $80,000\. **Additional Information** As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in\-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Track record of adopting AI\-assisted development tools to meaningfully improve team productivity, with concrete examples. History of growing engineers into senior ICs or leads, and building diverse, inclusive teams with strong retention. * NVIDIA's Object Storage Platform and data movement tooling form a critical layer in keeping NVIDIA's GPU fleet productive — every model trained, every checkpoint saved, and every dataset staged passes through the systems this team builds and operates. jobs.description: Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today! **Job Description** ------------------- Do you want a career supporting the world's best Navy? The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is seeking a Data Engineer to join a growing team dedicated to collecting and transforming data from the United States Nuclear Navy for analytics throughout the Laboratory. As a Data Engineer, you will be part of a team responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining the Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) process for incoming shipboard data used in naval nuclear propulsion systems. You will evaluate new and emerging technologies to deliver scalable solutions to transforming shipboard data in an enterprise\-wide data warehouse from which operational metrics and support analytics can be easily and reliably generated. **Required Combination of Knowledge and Skill** ----------------------------------------------- Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Knowledge of distributed technologies, such as Spark. * Experience in Linux shell scripting and software development using languages such as SQL and Python. * Experience in optimization and performance tuning of ETL workloads and understanding of database internals. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * Health, Dental, Vision \& Voluntary Benefits * Disability, Life \& Accident Insurance * 401(k) Savings program \& Capital Accumulation Plan * Personal \& Medical Time Off * Paid Parental Leave * Flexible Work Schedules * Tuition Assistance for Eligible Employees * Student Debt Benefit Personal Time Off Sell Program * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Wellness Program * Visit us online to view all NNL benefits! **Pay Range** ------------- $70,900\.00 \- $108,500\.00 annually Salary information provided is a general guideline only. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is a national asset solely dedicated to the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program. jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are building AI capabilities that improve important human workflows across the company. As AI Architect, you will set the technical direction for how we design, evaluate, integrate, and operate AI systems. You will help teams choose the right approach for each problem—from conventional software and deterministic workflows to retrieval\-augmented systems and agents—and ensure those systems meet clear standards for quality, reliability, safety, and value. This is a strategic, hands\-on role. You will establish reusable architecture and evaluation practices, guide cross\-functional teams, and prototype or validate key patterns where needed. You will partner with product and engineering leaders to turn high\-value opportunities into systems that can be measured and operated in production. **What You'll Do** * Set AI architecture direction: define reference architectures and design principles for AI services, agents, model integrations, data and context flows, tools, and human review. Make trade\-offs among quality, autonomy, reliability, latency, cost, and complexity. * Build the evaluation discipline: help teams define expected behavior and success measures; design representative datasets and evaluation methods; write and maintain evals; establish regression checks and quality thresholds; and use results to prioritize improvements. * Guide production readiness: shape shared practices for tracing and observability, versioning, monitoring, incident response, privacy, security, and lifecycle management of AI systems. * Enable teams to ship: create reusable patterns, reference implementations, and practical guidance. Coach engineers through architecture reviews and help teams move valuable work from prototype to production. * Connect architecture to outcomes: partner with product, operations, and domain teams to identify workflow needs and measure whether AI improves completion, quality, time, or other agreed outcomes. * Stay close to implementation: prototype high\-risk or foundational designs, review critical implementations, and use production evidence to refine architecture. * Track the evolving ecosystem: evaluate models, agent runtimes, orchestration approaches, and evaluation tooling against our requirements, and recommend adoption based on evidence. **What We're Looking For** * At least 8 years of experience in backend software development. * At least 3 years of experience in AI architecture with demonstrated organization\-wide impact. * Strong experience designing and delivering production software systems, with substantial work on AI/ML\-powered products or services. * A track record of setting technical direction across teams and influencing decisions through evidence and collaboration. * Practical understanding of LLM applications, including retrieval and context construction, tool use, agent patterns, model selection, and failure handling. * Experience defining quality expectations and building evaluations for AI behavior; able to connect offline evaluations to production outcomes. * Sound judgment about where AI is appropriate and when a simpler deterministic approach is better. * Experience with production concerns such as observability, privacy and security, reliability, cost, latency, and safe human escalation. * Clear communication across engineering, product, and executive audiences, with a builder's mindset and comfort prototyping and reviewing implementation. **Helpful Experience:** * + Establishing shared AI platforms, service patterns, or architecture standards across multiple teams. + Creating evaluation datasets, test harnesses, regression suites, or quality dashboards for LLM or agent systems. + Operating AI products with measurable user or business outcomes. + Working with cloud AI platforms, model APIs, agent frameworks, tracing/evaluation tools, and data platforms. Adaptable judgment matters more than one vendor's tools. jobs.title: Staff Silicon Photonics Engineer, Receiver (Rx)
jobs.description: **About Neurophos** =================== The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach. Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large\-scale AI inference. We’ve assembled a world\-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others. Join us and shape the future of computing! **Location:** Austin, TX or Sunnyvale, CA. Full\-time onsite position. **Reports To:** Director of Silicon Photonics **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Position Overview** --------------------- Neurophos is looking for a Silicon Photonics Engineer to lead the receiver (Rx) photonic integrated circuit for our OPU platform, including the T100 optical AI inference chip. You will own the Rx PIC from photodetector device design through chip\-level architecture: how light reaches the chip, how it is coupled and routed, and how large photodetector arrays convert it into clean, high\-speed electrical signals for the TIAs. You will take designs through tapeout and silicon validation. Working closely with the electronic IC, optics, and packaging teams, you will balance bandwidth, sensitivity, noise, density, and power at the system level. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Define the Rx PIC architecture, including optical input coupling (free\-space and waveguide), routing, demultiplexing where needed, and the layout of dense photodetector arrays, all against system\-level link and power budgets. * Design and optimize high\-speed photodetectors (e.g., Ge\-on\-Si PIN and avalanche, waveguide\-coupled and surface\-normal) for responsivity, dark current, capacitance, bandwidth, linearity, and saturation. * Model the device and receiver with optical, electrical, and RF simulation (e.g., Lumerical FDTD/CHARGE/INTERCONNECT, HFSS, TCAD), including photodetector equivalent circuits for co\-design with the TIA. * Work with the electronic IC team on the PD–TIA interface (pad and interconnect parasitics, bias, input\-referred noise, sensitivity), including flip\-chip, 3D, and co\-packaged integration. * Analyze array\-level effects such as optical and electrical crosstalk, uniformity, thermal behavior, and yield, and define test structures and design\-for\-test features to measure them. * Lead layout, verification, and tapeout of Rx PIC test vehicles and product blocks in foundry silicon photonics PDKs. * Support die\- and wafer\-level characterization with the test team (responsivity, dark current, O/E bandwidth, sensitivity, BER), and use the measurements to calibrate models and improve the next design. * Evaluate new detector materials, structures, and coupling approaches that could improve receiver performance or density beyond what the current platform supports. **Qualifications** ------------------ * PhD in a relevant field, such as Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or Physics. * 3 years of relevant experience in high\-speed silicon photonics, focused on photodetectors and receiver PICs. * Hands\-on design experience with Ge\-on\-Si (or equivalent) high\-speed photodetectors, including the trade\-offs among responsivity, bandwidth, capacitance, and dark current. * Proficiency with photonic and device simulation tools (e.g., Lumerical/Ansys, COMSOL, Synopsys TCAD, or equivalent) and with circuit\-level modeling of photodetectors. * Experience laying out and taping out in a silicon photonics foundry PDK (e.g., KLayout, gdsfactory, Cadence Virtuoso, or equivalent). * Working knowledge of optical receiver fundamentals: TIA interfacing, noise, sensitivity, and PAM4 signal integrity. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * 5\+ years of experience developing high\-speed silicon photonics receivers or photodetectors. * Experience taking devices through the full design\-to\-tapeout\-to\-fabrication\-to\-test cycle. * Experience designing large or dense photodetector arrays, or free\-space and surface\-normal optical coupling to photonic chips. * Experience co\-designing PDs with CMOS/SiGe TIAs in monolithic, flip\-chip, or 3D\-integrated receivers. * Experience with advanced detector platforms (e.g., avalanche photodiodes, III\-V/Si heterogeneous detectors) or a track record of publications or patents in photodetectors and receivers. **What We Offer** ================= This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in an innovative startup redefining the future of AI hardware. Work on game\-changing technology at the intersection of photonics and AI as part of a collaborative, brilliant team. You’ll contribute to a platform that redefines computational performance and accelerates the future of artificial intelligence. Come help us bring this transformative technology to the world. **Benefits** ------------ Join a team that invests in your future and your well\-being. At Neurophos, we offer: * 100% coverage of base health plan premiums for you and your dependents, plus HSA contributions. * Unlimited PTO. No rigid vacation banks, just a focus on delivery. * 401(k) matching and stock option opportunities to ensure our success is your success. * Full suite of voluntary benefits, including Dental, Vision, Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident insurance. * Personalized Benefits. Choose the plans that fit your life and take the cash back for those that don’t. Compensation Range: $230K \- $280K

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist - Ads Marketplace
jobs.description: #### **\#TeamNextdoor** Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at **nextdoor.com**. #### **Meet Your Future Neighbors** As a Data Scientist at Nextdoor, you will help design and oversee product experiments and own complex analyses to drive company and product strategy. We use a semi\-embedded team structure, in which a group of data team members works on a specific product or pillar, interfacing directly with product and engineering stakeholders. The Data Science group consists of people from a diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives, trained in fields as wide\-ranging as economics, physics, statistics, and operations research. We are an integral part of the product development organization and play an active and collaborative role in building and improving the product. At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI\-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we're looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI\-assisted outputs. We also offer a warm, inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model and provides flexibility for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London. #### **The Impact You'll Make** As a Staff Data Scientist on the Monetization Team, you will drive revenue growth and advertiser value by focusing on the machine learning auction ads delivery layer. You'll directly contribute to growing and improving our core Ads products and help lead us into the future of data and revenue at Nextdoor. Responsibilities will include shaping ranking models and objective functions, establishing an explainability layer for model feedback loops, and performing auction measurement. The role offers the opportunity to drive the roadmap and explore potential applications for artificial intelligence and large language models. We are looking for an entrepreneurial and driven candidate to accelerate our efforts and be a major part of our data\-centric culture. This person will work closely with various cross\-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Sales \& Finance to develop and deliver metrics, analyses, solutions, and insights, with actionable recommendations to business partners. **Your responsibilities may include:** * Design and develop algorithms and models to optimize Ads Marketplace performance, driving value for both end\-users and Advertisers * Experiment design: Make sure we run experiments efficiently and accurately, including monitoring early feature development through tracking post\-release follow\-ups * Develop and share key strategic insights through data analysis, including designing experiments and evaluating the performance and impact of data\-driven content * Partner with cross\-functional teams to support product development efforts (including product, design, engineering, marketing, and operations) * Participate in in\-person Nextdoor events such as trainings, off\-sites, volunteer days, and team\-building exercises * Build in\-person relationships with team members and contribute to Nextdoor's company culture #### **What You'll Bring To The Team** * 7\+ years of relevant Data Science experience * Experience in Ads Marketplace and/or Monetization experience * Experience architecting, debugging, and executing complex SQL queries * Excellent knowledge of Python, including common scientific computing packages and data science tools such as numpy, pandas, and scikit\-learn * Experience formulating, running, and sharing complex analyses, including different types of experiments, causal inference studies, and other exploratory analysis work * Innate curiosity around finding meaningful insights that inform the way we think about and develop both our product and our business strategies * Eagerness to explore and apply AI and emerging technologies to reimagine how work gets done #### **Bonus Points** * Work experience related to social or community\-based products * Work experience related to small businesses and marketplaces * Work experience related to advertising and auction systems * Experience with agentic coding platforms such as Cursor or Windsurf #### **Rewards** Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. The starting salary for this role in the San Francisco area is expected to range from $190,000 to $283,000 on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate's geographic location. We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date. When it comes to benefits, we have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of health plans, including a 100% covered employee\-only plan option, and we also provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care. At Nextdoor, we empower our employees to build stronger local communities. To create a platform where all feel welcome, we want our workforce to reflect the diversity of the neighbors we serve. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we always consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. For information about how we collect and use applicants' personal information, please see Nextdoor's Personnel Privacy Notice, found here.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nimble:** ----------------- Nimble is the company leading the AI web search category. Our products are used by leading businesses in financial services, retail, market intelligence, and coding to build best\-in\-class AI agents with accurate, auditable programmatic access to the web. We've raised over $70 million from Norwest, Databricks Ventures, Target Global, Square Peg, and others to build expert\-level web search for AI. Hundreds of enterprise customers already run on Nimble, and we're forming a world\-class team of engineers, researchers, designers, marketers, sellers, and operational experts to achieve our mission. **Why join Nimble?** * Work on a deeply technical platform powering real\-time AI and enterprise decisions * Help define the future of Web Search Agents and live web intelligence * Build alongside a sharp, mission\-driven team that moves fast, ships often, and takes ownership **About the Role:** ------------------- This is the founding Forward Deployed Engineer role at Nimble. You build AI agents and search integrations with our customers and take them to production. After qualification, you partner with the Solution Consultant and customer engineers to refine the architecture and agree on success criteria. You build the first working version against the customer's real queries, workflows, and codebase, and prove it on their evaluation set. You lead the implementation through production deployment and an agreed handoff, equipping the customer's engineers to operate and extend what you build. A typical engagement lasts 12 weeks. On each engagement, you own these technical decisions: * Refining the implementation architecture. * Choosing the appropriate orchestration approach. * Defining evaluations with the customer. * Negotiating technical scope and sequencing. * Deciding what can be reused and what needs to remain customer\-specific. As the first member of the team, you help craft the strategy for the FDE function. That covers how we scope and run engagements, the playbook the team works from, and who we hire next. The role is based in New York or San Francisco, 3 days a week in the office. This role reports to the Director of Solution Consulting. You do not carry a sales quota. Base pay is $170K to $235K, depending on level. The package adds 10% to 15% variable pay and equity. **What You’ll be Doing:** ------------------------- * Turn the customer's goal into a working flow of Search, Extract, and Web Search Agent calls, wired into the customer's own code. * Build the first version on the customer's real queries, side by side with the customer's engineer. * Define representative evaluation sets and success criteria with the customer. Benchmark quality, latency, and cost as you iterate, and instrument production workflows to detect failures and regressions. * Write the orchestration code that keeps the flow stable in production, with fan\-out, dedupe, retries, and cost caps. * Embed Nimble in the customer's agent through our MCP server, our SDKs, or the API, on a schedule or on demand. * Present results to the customer's engineers and executives, and record the technical win with the Solution Consultant. * Write the runbook, train the customer's engineer, and hand the account to Customer Success. * Identify recurring customer needs and turn successful implementations into reusable integrations, evaluation tools, reference applications, and product improvements. * Shape the FDE function: the engagement model, the entry and exit criteria, the playbook, and the profile of the next hires. **What You Should Have for the Role:** -------------------------------------- ### **Technical expertise** * You write production Python and can read and change TypeScript. * You have shipped and operated LLM\-powered applications for real users, and can explain how you handled failures and managed latency and cost at each step. * You have designed or improved evaluations for an LLM or other nondeterministic system, and used the results to make engineering decisions. * You have built tools for an agent to call, through MCP, function calling or an equivalent. ### **Experience and skills** * You have 4\+ years of software engineering and can show LLM or agent work you shipped, such as a repo, a live product or a case study. * You have worked directly with customers or external partners to scope and deliver technical projects, whether as an FDE, software engineer, solutions engineer, consultant, or founder. * You can run a discovery call with a VP and debug a failing run with an engineer on the same day. * You are comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change in a fast\-paced startup. ### **Bonus points** * You have worked on retrieval and RAG, including hybrid search, reranking, and freshness. * You have built with LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, or the Claude Agent SDK. * You have delivered data to Snowflake or Databricks. * You have worked with web data, such as scraping, anti\-bot systems, and structured extraction. * You use AI development tools effectively and take responsibility for reviewing, testing, and maintaining the code they produce

Preferred Skills * Experience with routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, or IS\-IS. * Familiarity with Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking. * Experience with Linux networking, distributed systems, or network automation. * Knowledge of Python scripting, Git, and software testing tools. * Exposure to cloud networking, virtualization, or container technologies.
