jobs.title: Senior Field ABM & Events Manager
jobs.description: **About Norm** Norm builds AI\-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale. Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services. Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management. Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI\-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters. **AI Fluency:** Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day\-to\-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem\-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end\-to\-end. Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands\-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. **This Role** The most impactful opportunities are often the hardest to get in front of. As our Senior Field ABM and Events Manager, you’ll partner directly with stakeholders across Norm Ai and Norm Law to run high\-impact field programs for our key audiences and execute 1:1 ABM plays for our most strategic clients. You’ll challenge the status quo in field marketing to create unique experiences and moments that identify new opportunities, build brand trust, and move deals forward. The role will build the strategic field \& ABM events program from the ground up. Expect increasing scope, budget, and responsibility as we scale. **What You’ll Do** * **Design the strategy:** Define the go\-to\-market strategy for field programs: what we do, where we show up, and how we win in this market * **Own end to end execution:** Develop programs from scratch, execute flawlessly, and create meaningful engagement opportunities with leaders that drive pipeline growth and revenue. * **Drive cross\-functional collaboration:** You'll partner directly with ADs, and FDLEs (Forward\-Deployed Legal Engineers) to run high\-impact field programs across segments and execute 1:1 ABM plays for our most strategic accounts. * **Build the programming:** Design 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many field marketing experiences (conferences, client workshops, executive dinners, etc) that align to active opportunities and target accounts. * **Partner and collaborate with executives:** Drive executive Partner with senior executives, including C\-Suite, Advisory Board, and Partners, to understand account dynamics, GTM strategy, and programming gaps — actively shaping deal strategy, not just executing events * **Identify new opportunities:** Drive both strategy and execution: identify existing and net\-new conferences, owned events, and field tactics that reach legal leaders most effectively, then run point from creative brainstorming through post\-event follow\-up * **Deliver results:** Own outcomes across executive access, account penetration, opportunity acceleration, and pipeline growth **What We’re Looking For** **Core Qualifications** * 5\-7\+ years of experience in field, events, or ABM marketing * A track record of building an events strategy vs. simply managing an established calendar * Creative and strategic thinking, you can turn a vague idea or goal into a concrete, compelling plan and see it through to execution * Exceptional executive presences. You have the confidence to engage senior leaders as a peer, not just a planner, and you build credibility fast. * Strong ownership of programming, where to prioritize, how to move projects forward, and work quickly **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with AI, legal technology, regulation and policy, or another complex enterprise category * An established network across vendors, production, and other teams to help execute events. * Managed an events program for a fast\-paced, growing enterprise business **What Success Looks Like** **30 Days** * Develop a strong understanding of Norm’s GTM model, business priorities, audiences, and existing event commitments. * Build relationships with key internal stakeholders and assess current partners, processes, and capabilities. **60 Days** * Present a prioritized field and ABM events strategy, including where Norm should host, partner, sponsor, and build net new programming. * Define initial concepts, target audiences, content packages, budgets, and success measures for priority programs. **90 Days** * Establish a clear roadmap for Norm’s strategic event programming * Move the first priority program into execution with aligned stakeholders, ownership, timelines, and measurement. **Compensation and Benefits** **Base Salary:** $140K \- $180K The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new\-hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **Equity:** Included **Benefits:** 401(k) with employer match; health, dental, and vision coverage; unlimited paid time off; free lunch in the office daily; and an employee referral bonus program. **Relocation:** *\[If applicable]* Financial support to ease your move to New York City, designed to make the transition smooth and stress\-free. **Work Location** ----------------- * Location: New York City * Work model: Hybrid * In\-office expectation: 3\-4 days per week * Travel expectation: Occasional (30%) travel for events, conferences, partnerships, and on\-site production. To learn more about Norm, visit our **website**.

jobs.description: ### **WE ARE A FEDERAL IT COMPANY ON A MISSION TO MAKE CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE (CX) THE CENTER OF EVERY GOVERNMENT SOLUTION.** ### **TECHNOLOGY IS OUR PASSION. technical direction across multiple teams without relying solely on organizational authority. * Ability to communicate complex data architecture and performance trade\-offs clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and technical leadership. * Ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams across multiple time zones. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep production experience with SingleStore/MemSQL, particularly with large\-scale analytical workloads. * Advanced experience with pipeline performance tuning, partitioning strategies, memory management, and optimization of large distributed workloads. * Experience designing platforms that support a combination of high\-volume ingestion and low\-latency analytical queries. * Experience building or operating distributed job We are studying every aspect of strawberry production and finding ways to beat the status quo. **What you’ll be responsible for:** * Hands\-on lead, develop, maintain, and enhance the software stack powering autonomous robotic strawberry harvesting. * Build and support software across the robotics stack, including perception, motion planning, data analysis tools, and robotic controls. * Leverage and further develop existing AI Agentic development processes using offline sim, recreation, and visualization into features that are pre\-tested before they land on the physical robots * Quickly ramp up on the existing codebase and contribute through targeted development projects. * Validate new features and bug fixes through simulation, smoke testing, and field testing. * Own and continuously improve key areas of the codebase, such as perception, motion planning, robotic interfaces, or controls. * Partner with Operations to troubleshoot field issues, prioritize software improvements, and drive system reliability. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with robotics, hardware, controls, and operations teams to deliver scalable automation solutions. #### **Who will love this job:** *Individuals who identify with our Core Values and exhibit skills within those values will thrive at Oishii.* * ***One Team, One Fight!*** + *Ability to quickly shift priorities to meet deadlines and effectively communicate, both verbally and in writing, clearly, concisely and with purpose at various levels of the organization.* + *Ability to work cross functionally at all levels including across locations, and collaborate with a focus on supporting \& understanding the evolving business needs of a startup environment.* + *Ability to lead through others and develop teams with a diverse level of experience to succeed.* * ***Focus.*** + *Ability to remove obstacles in order to prioritize which could include problem solving, working through ambiguity and using fact based or sound judgment in the absence of process or policy. We are building it, but need to manage through the process with good judgment and a bias for action.* + *Ability to synthesize information quickly to aid in the troubleshooting process.* * ***GSD (Get Sh\*\* Done!)*** + *Possessing an entrepreneurial mindset with the tenacity to develop ideas, process, and policy and implement them rapidly.* + *Capable of prioritizing tasks and considering the resources available when doing so.* + *A bias for action! Ability to hold yourself accountable and take ownership of driving results that impact company outcomes.* + *Track record of effectively handling complex employee relations issues, and addressing sensitive information and difficult situations with tact, discretion, and confidentiality.* **What we look for in a Senior Software Engineer, Robotics:** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. * 5\+ years of backend software engineering experience in any of Python, Rust or C\+\+ with the ability to design and implement scalable solutions for complex technical challenges. * Experience translating operational issues, code traces, and system data into effective software improvements. * Proficiency with Linux, shell scripting, and modern software development tools (Git, Jira). * Experience leveraging AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity while maintaining software quality. * Demonstrated complex problem solving process in fields similar to robotics. jobs.title: Applications Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Applications Engineer translates customer equipment challenges and application requirements into practical, manufacturable polymer component solutions. Serving as a technical partner to customers and the sales team, this role evaluates application conditions, recommends materials and manufacturing methods, develops or refines 3D designs, and supports feasibility, quoting, prototyping, and production launch. The position works closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Sales to deliver solutions that meet performance, lead\-time, quality, and cost expectations. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Partner with customers and Sales to define application requirements, operating conditions, performance targets, drawings, specifications, and project constraints. * Evaluate customer equipment and component applications, including wear, abrasion, chemical exposure, temperature, load, motion, sanitation, and service life as applicable. * Recommend appropriate polymer materials, durometers, additives, tolerances, and manufacturing processes based on application needs and technical feasibility. * Develop, modify, and review 3D CAD models, component designs, assemblies, and engineering drawings for custom molded or machined solutions. * Conduct Design for Manufacturing (DFM) reviews with tooling, machining, molding, and production teams to improve feasibility, repeatability, quality, and cost. * Provide technical input for customer quotations, including concept evaluation, material and process selection, tooling requirements, assumptions, risks, and cost estimates. * Prepare and communicate technical recommendations, product concepts, design alternatives, and supporting documentation to internal teams and customers. * Coordinate prototypes, samples, trials, testing, and validation; evaluate results against customer requirements and recommend design adjustments. * Support new product introduction from inquiry and concept through design approval, tooling, production readiness, and initial customer feedback. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Plastics Engineering, or a related engineering field required. * 3–10 years of relevant engineering experience in manufacturing, product development, applications engineering, or technical customer support. * Advanced proficiency with 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or comparable platform) and interpretation of engineering drawings and tolerances. * Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturing (DFM), component design, tooling, and production processes. * Ability to evaluate technical customer requirements and communicate clear, practical recommendations to both engineering and nontechnical audiences. * Knowledge of engineered polymers, urethanes, silicones, elastomers, material properties, or custom molding processes preferred. * Experience supporting RFQs, technical quotations, feasibility reviews, prototypes, and product launches.

jobs.title: AI Software Developer (Hybrid)
jobs.description: **ARE YOU THE TOP 1% DEVELOPER?** **Billion\-Dollar AI Ambitions. No Guarantees.** Seven\-day workweeks. Extraordinary challenges. Uncertain outcomes. Potentially life\-changing rewards. We're building what we believe could become one of the most important AI companies of the next decade. Our ambition? Build a multibillion\-dollar company by April 2027\. We believe there's a 60% chance we'll achieve it. That's our own conviction, not a guarantee. We're looking for a handful of exceptional developers who believe in something just as strongly: themselves. **We're Not Starting From Zero** * We're six entrepreneurs, engineers, and builders. * We've been operating for over a year. * We generate six figures in monthly revenue. * We're profitable. * Our team includes a master developer we recruited from Facebook. * We've attracted serious interest from Stanford\-affiliated doctors who want to work with us. We're not sharing this to impress you. We're sharing it because the people you build alongside matter. We're assembling a team of extraordinary individuals who believe AI will fundamentally change how the world works. And we intend to be among the people building that future. **The Opportunity** We're developing AI agents that don't just answer questions. They investigate. Collaborate. Make decisions. Execute complex work. They turn human intelligence into extraordinary productivity. And we're building something even more important: a company where exceptional people can accomplish what previously required entire organizations. For developers who prove themselves and earn a place on our team, we're offering: * A healthy six\-figure annual salary. * Up to 0\.5% company equity, subject to agreed terms and vesting. * Competitive benefits. * Extraordinary technical freedom and ownership. * The opportunity to help build a company with multibillion\-dollar ambitions. * The chance to work alongside exceptionally talented people. But we're offering something else that matters just as much: the freedom to think, invent, and take action. **We Don't Want to Manage You** We don't believe in spying on employees. We don't want to monitor your screen, count your keystrokes, or constantly ask what you're doing. We don't want to tell you what to think. We want people who don't need to be told what to do: * People who wake up with ideas. * People who identify problems before anyone assigns them. * People who see an opportunity and act. * People who challenge existing approaches, question assumptions, and propose better solutions. If you need someone looking over your shoulder to be productive, this isn't the place for you. If you do your best work when you're trusted to take ownership, you might belong here. **The Best Developers of Tomorrow Won't Just Write Code** AI is changing software development at an extraordinary pace. We believe the value of manually writing code will continue to decline as AI becomes increasingly capable. The most valuable developers won't necessarily be those who type the fastest. They'll be the ones who think the best. The people who can: * Identify opportunities others overlook. * Invent better architectures and solutions. * Direct AI agents to execute complex work. * Critically evaluate, challenge, and improve AI\-generated code. * Refactor systems for simplicity, performance, and reliability. * Make exceptional technical and product decisions. * Turn ambitious ideas into working products. We aren't looking for developers who compete with AI at writing code. We're looking for developers who can make AI extraordinarily productive. Your judgment, creativity, initiative, and ability to solve problems matter more to us than how many lines of code you personally write. **Seven Days a Week. Because the Opportunity Won't Wait.** We're not going to pretend this is a conventional nine\-to\-five opportunity. We're building at an extraordinary pace. Our founders and team members are making enormous personal sacrifices because we believe in what we're creating. We're looking for people who share that intensity: people willing to work seven days a week during critical periods because they genuinely want to move the mission forward, not because someone is watching them. We value ownership, initiative, and extraordinary output, not performative hours. No surveillance. No micromanagement. No corporate theater. We want people who choose to give their best because they believe the opportunity is worth it. Sustainable performance, necessary rest, and applicable employment requirements still matter. But if your primary goal is a predictable, low\-intensity job, this probably isn't the right opportunity. **But There's a Catch** We're asking candidates to make a short\-term sacrifice. Our selection process includes a demanding 30\-day evaluation, with compensation terms agreed in advance and structured to comply with applicable employment laws. * There are no guaranteed job offers. * No promises that we'll become a billion\-dollar company. * No certainty that the next 30 days will lead to a permanent position. But if you demonstrate exceptional ability, contribute meaningful value, and earn a place on our team, we're prepared to offer a healthy six\-figure annual salary, equity of up to 0\.5%, and competitive benefits. We're not asking you to tell us you're exceptional. We're asking you to show us. **Who We're Looking For** We're not particularly interested in your university, certifications, or how impressive your résumé looks. We care about what you can accomplish. We want developers who: * Think independently and act without waiting for permission. * Constantly generate ideas for improving products and systems. * Understand how to leverage AI to multiply their productivity. * Have exceptional technical judgment and problem\-solving ability. * Challenge bad decisions, including ours. * Take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks. * Build quickly, intelligently, and with high standards. * Are ambitious enough to want ownership in what they create. We don't need another employee who waits for instructions. We need another entrepreneur who happens to be an exceptional developer. **One Final Question** Most developers will spend their careers working on someone else's vision. Some will help build companies worth billions. A much smaller number will have the opportunity to own a meaningful piece of what they helped create. We're six people. We're profitable. We're ambitious. And we're convinced that AI is creating one of the greatest opportunities in the history of technology. We might succeed spectacularly. We might fall short. But we're going to find out. And we're looking for a few extraordinary people who want to find out with us. Are you one of them? **How to Apply** Send us your résumé and a short introduction. Tell us: * **What have you built?** Show us your most impressive work. * **What would you improve?** Tell us about an idea, system, or product you've made significantly better. * **Why are you exceptional?** What makes you confident you belong among the top 1% of developers? * **Why this opportunity?** What excites you about building an AI company with extraordinary ambitions? Include your GitHub, portfolio, or examples of your work. No lengthy cover letters. No corporate nonsense. We don't care how good you are at applying for jobs. We care how good you are at building the future. **ARE YOU THE 1%?** Billion\-Dollar AI Ambitions. No Guarantees. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Windermere, FL 34786

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Power Generation

Onward Energy does not offer visa sponsorship now or in the future. **THE RESPONSIBILITIES** **Event Diagnosis, Restoration \& Root Cause Analysis** * Reviews plant trip events using relay records, COMTRADE files, and plant reports to diagnose the cause of the issue and recommends actions to restore availability. * Provides real\-time, interactive technical support to sites during events, including fault location and protective relaying recommendations. * Determines root causes of electrical events and recommends longer\-term corrective actions to prevent recurrence. * Provides on\-site support during outages, overseeing contractors performing electrical work and helping resolve issues in real time. **System Protection** * Performs relay settings optimization and develops relay setting recommendations. Reviews and approves settings developed by third\-parties. * Develops relay upgrade designs and reviews third\-party protection and control designs. * Performs power system studies (short circuit, load flow, coordination) using ETAP. **Electrical Safety** * Performs arc flash hazard analysis and supports arc flash and other electrical hazard mitigation across the fleet. * Optimizes protection and coordination to reduce arc flash incident energy where practical. * Reviews switching, isolation, and lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures. * Supports sites and the safety department with electrical hazard identification and mitigation. **Maintenance, Reliability \& Operations Support** * Performs contingency planning for critical assets such as main power transformers and high\-voltage breakers. * Assists in developing substation and electrical distribution maintenance scopes. * Reviews maintenance and test results and provides recommendations. * Assists with troubleshooting electrical issues affecting day\-to\-day operations, such as transformer alarms, relay alarms, and breaker issues. **NERC \& Regulatory Compliance** * Performs NERC PRC\-019, PRC\-024, PRC\-025, and PRC\-027 studies, and assesses PRC\-002 and PRC\-028 compliance. * Reviews power system events for mis operations and unexpected changes in output under NERC PRC\-004 and PRC\-030\. * Performs MOD\-025 testing and oversees contractors performing MOD\-026 and MOD\-027 testing. * Performs FAC\-008 studies and develops the PRC\-005 Protection System Maintenance Plan, including identifying plant equipment covered under PRC\-005\. * Reviews MOD\-032 data prior to submittal. * Assists with responses to stakeholder and regulatory RFIs, periodic data submittals, self\-certifications, and audits, and prepares technical reports and evidence packages. **Development \& M\&A Support** * Provides operations engineering input on development and M\&A activities, including technical review of electrical systems and identification of operational and reliability considerations for prospective and new assets. **General** * Develops and applies broad knowledge across all of the group’s technical domains, learning and performing studies as workload requires. * Supports the development and improvement of group processes, procedures, and tools. * Provides plant support when events occur. * Other duties jobs.title: SecOps Engineer
jobs.description: **SECOPS ENGINEER** **Location:** Burlington, VT **WHO WE ARE** Open Approach is a values\-driven, client\-focused IT services company based in Burlington, Vermont. We deliver exceptional managed technology and phenomenal client support to organizations across New England and beyond. Our focus is on long\-term partnerships built on trust, transparency, and shared success, not sales quotas. We earn our client's business every month by staying relentlessly focused on their success. From the very first interaction to ongoing evolution, we aim to provide seamless experiences grounded in understanding, integrity, and practical solutions. We believe in making thoughtful, informed decisions and creating a lasting impact instead of quick fixes. This translates into long\-term relationships with our clients that are rewarding on many levels. At our core, we value equity, humility, excellence, accountability, innovation, and openness. These guide everything we do, from how we collaborate internally to how we support clients through complex technical challenges. We are continually refining our team, enhancing our capabilities, and investing in talent to drive forward meaningful change. We embrace candid feedback, own our outcomes, and strive to improve every day. If that sounds like the kind of company you want to grow with, we would love to hear from you. **THE ROLE** This isn't a traditional SOC role where you sit and watch dashboards all day. Yes, you'll be involved in incident response, but your real focus is on building, improving, and evolving the security systems and processes behind everything we do at Open Approach and for our clients. You'll serve as the primary escalation point for our Security Operations Analyst. When things get complex, they will come to you. You will own the deeper investigations, lead advanced response efforts, and ensure we deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes every time. Outside of incidents, you'll spend your time designing, implementing, and optimizing our security stack: SIEM, EDR, vulnerability management, and the rest. You'll tune out the noise, sharpen detection, and make our tools work the way they should. A big part of this role is research and automation. We want someone who looks at a manual process and immediately thinks, "How do I make this faster, better, or unnecessary?" You'll identify gaps, evaluate new tools, and build the automation that makes the whole Security Operations team more effective. You'll also support compliance work, including the technical implementation and validation of controls across frameworks such as CMMC, HIPAA, and CJIS. Not the paperwork side. The hands\-on, make\-it\-actually\-work side. You should be someone who enjoys building better systems, not just reacting to alerts. Specifically: * Highly technical and genuinely passionate about cybersecurity * Curious, always poking at systems and looking for ways to improve them * Comfortable digging into complex problems and owning them from start to finish * A strong collaborator who works well alongside others * Motivated to automate and optimize, not just maintain * Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical audiences **A note on experience:** We need someone with a solid technical foundation, but if you're the right person and you're missing a few of the skills listed below, that's okay. We're happy to train, guide, and invest in you. What we can't teach is the mindset. **THE SPECIFICS OF THE JOB** **Responsibilities** * Act as the escalation point for complex security incidents and investigations * Design, implement, and optimize security tools and platforms (SIEM, EDR, vulnerability management, etc.) * Lead advanced incident response investigation, containment, remediation * Develop automation and improve processes to reduce manual effort and increase efficiency * Research and evaluate new security tools and technologies * Tune alerts, cut false positives, and sharpen detection capabilities * Support compliance initiatives through technical control implementation and validation * Collaborate with internal teams to ensure security solutions are properly deployed and maintained * Create and maintain documentation, standards, and repeatable processes * Contribute to the ongoing maturity of the Security Operations program **Job Requirements** * A working understanding of firewalls, IDS/IPS, endpoint protection, and other core security technologies. * The ability to look at security events and incidents and connect the dots by identifying threats, patterns, and vulnerabilities. * Security work lives and dies in the details. Incidents need to be thoroughly investigated and properly resolved. * You uphold our operational and security standards and have a sharp eye for where they're not being met. * This field moves fast. You need to genuinely enjoy keeping up with new technologies, trends, and best practices. * The ability to prioritize effectively, especially when multip  hybrid identity environments and synchronization between on\-prem AD and Azure/Entra ID. Ability to spot and fix common identity and access risks. * Solid grasp of core networking (DHCP, DNS, routing, switching) and how it all ties into security. Familiarity with remote access technologies (SSL VPN, IPSec VPN). Understanding of segmentation, least privilege, and traffic flow analysis. Ability to troubleshoot network related security issues across layered environments. * Strong understanding of M365 and Intune security capabilities such as device management, policy enforcement, Conditional Access, authentication methods, identity protection. Familiarity with email security, mail flow, and integration with security platforms. Ability to assess and improve security posture across Microsoft cloud environments. * Hands\-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and vulnerability management tools. Ability to analyze alerts, investigate incidents, and track threats across platforms. Understanding of alert tuning, noise reduction, and detection and response fundamentals. Familiarity with vulnerability assessments and risk analysis. Basic understanding of cryptographic concepts and their practical applications. * Experience with IR processes: triage, containment, investigation, and recovery. Ability to analyze complex incidents, determine root cause, and drive remediation. Understanding of the IR lifecycle and how to reduce impact while improving future response. **Additional Experience and Skills** * Familiarity with platforms like Hyper\-V or VMware. Understanding of how virtualized environments affect security isolation, snapshotting, and investigation workflows. Comfortable using virtualization tools for testing and validating security configurations. * Understanding of firewall technologies, rule creation, and policy management. Ability to implement rules aligned with best practices and troubleshoot traffic to catch misconfigurations or threats. * Understanding of public vs. private DNS architecture. Knowledge of common record types (A, CNAME, MX, SPF, DKIM, TXT) and their role in email security. Comfortable troubleshooting DNS issues using command\-line and diagnostic tools. * Working knowledge of NIST, CIS, and ISO frameworks. Familiarity with compliance driven environments and how technical controls map to regulatory requirements. Ability to support implementation and validation of controls for CMMC, HIPAA, or CJIS. **Experience \& Certifications** We require at least 3 years of cybersecurity experience, preferably with an MSP or past MSP experience outside of cybersecurity. Life in an MSP demands deep, wide technical knowledge, and it can be overwhelming without the right foundation. We want this to be the right fit for you, not a sink\-or\-swim situation. Certifications aren't required, but they're strongly encouraged and show commitment to growth. Relevant certifications include Security\+, Microsoft Security (SC\-series), or similar foundational cybersecurity and cloud certifications. More advanced certs like CISSP or CCSP are a plus for experienced candidates. **BENEFITS** * Health, dental, and vision coverage with generous employer contributions * Company\-sponsored Life, STD/LTD Disability, and Workers’ Compensation * 401(k) with 4% match starting day one * Generous PTO (starting at 16 days, plus paid holidays. 20 days on your 1 year anniversary) * Fully paid parental leave * Smartphone stipend for on\-call rotation * Weekly company lunches, coffee, snacks, and a pet\-friendly office **HOW NOT TO APPLY** * Forget to write a good cover letter, so that we have no way of knowing how articulate you really are * Include a lot of grammatical and structural errors in your letter and resume * Hide your personality so we can’t tell a thing about you, other than that you are highly efficient in Microsoft Word Thank you for your interest, and best of luck in your search for work. Learn more about us at www.openapproach.com

jobs.title: Observability Engineer
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. **About the Role** OpenLoop runs on a lot of systems, and many of them don't tell us when they're about to break. We need to know when a tool goes down, when we're hitting capacity or concurrency limits, and when an end\-to\-end business process is failing, before our clinicians, patients or clients feel it. We're hiring an Observability Engineer to build our observability practice from scratch. This is not a role where you inherit a mature stack and a team of specialists. You'll build dashboards and alerting in Datadog and PagerDuty, and where a system has no visibility at all, you'll find a way: pulling logs, wiring up APIs, or building something new. **What You'll Do** * **Build the observability practice.** Define what we monitor, how we alert, and how we measure uptime and reliability across enterprise systems. * **Instrument our systems in Datadog.** Build dashboards and monitors for availability, capacity, performance and concurrency limits across SaaS and internal tools. * **Own alerting and escalation in PagerDuty.** Design alert routing and escalation so the right people know about issues quickly and without noise. * **Create visibility where none exists.** For systems with little or no native observability (e.g., Zoho), pull logs, use APIs and build lightweight integrations or tools to close the gap. * **Monitor end\-to\-end business processes.** Track critical workflows across multiple systems so we can see and fix process failures, not just individual outages. * **Partner with IT Service Management.** Work with incident and change management to feed observability into incident response, root\-cause analysis and change validation. * **Automate and iterate.** Use scripting and AI\-assisted development to build quickly, and keep improving signal quality as the practice matures. **Who You Are** You're a builder. When someone says 'there's no tool for that,' you start figuring out how to make one. You're comfortable in a fast\-moving environment with disparate systems and incomplete visibility, and you'd rather ship something useful this week than wait for the perfect platform. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 3\+ years of experience building observability functions, including dashboards, monitors and alerting. * Hands\-on experience with Datadog. * Hands\-on experience with PagerDuty. * Scripting and API experience (e.g., Python) to pull logs and data from systems without native integrations. * A track record of building observability or monitoring where little existed before. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Startup or high\-growth company experience. * Experience monitoring SaaS business applications, not only infrastructure. * Experience with OpenTelemetry or other log and metrics pipelines. * Experience with ITSM tools and incident or change management (e.g., Jira Service Management). * Experience using AI\-assisted development to build internal tools. In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for: * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts * Flexible PTO * 401(k) \+ Company Match * Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more **Our Company** --------------- We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work. Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

You'll become the expert on every pharmacy's software stack, make sure no prescription gets stuck, keep our workflows compliant, and onboard new pharmacy partners as we grow. **What You'll Do** * **Build and maintain prescription and pharmacy integrations.** Own e\-prescribing and order\-routing integrations between the EHR and clinical apps (e.g., Healthie) and partner, mail\-order and compounding pharmacies, including e\-prescribing platforms (Surescripts, DoseSpot), NCPDP SCRIPT standards and partner APIs. * **Keep prescription systems reliable.** Maintain the integrity of the software lifecycle to ensure patients receive the accurate medication in a timely manner, and build alerts and dashboards that catch stuck or failed orders before they delay a patient's medication. * **Keep pharmacy workflows compliant.** Support EPCS (electronic prescribing of controlled substances), PDMP checks, state pharmacy rules and HIPAA controls on PHI. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. **About the Role** Forward Deployed Engineering is how we build our platform with real clients instead of guessing. An FDE embeds with a client, works in their codebase, and builds their integration against OpenLoop’s production API. Anything the platform can’t do yet is filed as a gap and built once, centrally, so every client inherits it. The real work product isn’t the integration. It’s the reusable asset that client forced into existence. As Senior Engineering Manager, you own this team and you’re measured on two things: clients going live with a clean handoff, and a team that gets better at it every quarter. The team is already delivering and growing fast. Your job is to turn strong individuals into a function, and to scale it without lowering the bar. This is a player\-coach role, coaching first. You stay technical through review, not by owning a client yourself. You read integration designs, adjudicate platform gaps, and stay credible with both client engineering leaders and our platform engineers. If you want to stop reviewing code entirely, or to write code instead of managing people, this isn’t the role. You’ll report into Engineering and work daily with platform, implementation, customer success and sales. **What You'll Do** * **Own client outcomes across the portfolio.** Every client in build has a named owner and a go\-live date. Spot a troubled deployment before the client does, and report it with the date, impact and trade\-off. * **Allocate capacity.** Assign new clients on the day they arrive, with an owner and a clear statement of what they displace. When client, migration and platform work compete, you make the call. * **Lead pods through their architects.** Each pod has an FDE acting as technical architect. Give them clear ownership, real decision rights, and a habit of escalating early. * **Migrate existing clients onto the Partner API.** Move them in cohorts with implementation, platform engineering and the client’s team. Respect change calendars, and measure each move by its first production patient. * **Own the seam with platform teams.** Each gap names the capability it stands in for. Decide who builds it, and escalate stalled reviews with a date. * **Give every go\-live an exit.** Clients leave hypercare on a set date, documented and signed off, so the team doesn’t become the support desk. * **Hire and develop.** You’re the hiring manager for FDEs and Deployment Strategists at every level. Coach toward scope, run hard conversations on time, defend leveling decisions, and run reviews with no surprises. * **Own the agent roster.** The team runs deployments on agents (readiness, conformance, seeding, docs, gap filing, client comms), and a human approves every output. You own adoption, measurement and where the human sits. * **Protect the discipline.** Never wire around the platform. Make changes additive or explicitly superseding. Anything that would break a live client becomes a proposal, not a merge, even under deadline pressure. * **Partner with go\-to\-market.** Be in the room before commitments are made. Distinguish “can’t,” “shouldn’t” and “won’t fit the timeline,” and turn the prioritized client list into a dated plan. * **Write the playbook.** Turn how your best engineers deploy into how the team deploys, so each new deployment needs less of you. **Who You Are** * 8\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years managing engineers: hiring, performance, leveling and promotions, and growing a team. * You’ve led teams delivering in customers’ environments, and you can talk through deployments that went badly and what you changed. * You’ve run a migration or re\-platforming program with customers who could say no, and you’ve allocated a team against more demand than supply. * You’re still technical: deep in integrations (APIs, auth, webhooks vs. polling, idempotency, schema drift, reconciliation) and able to change a design with one question. * You build with AI agents and have a view on human\-in\-the\-loop design, evaluation, and handling confident errors. * You’re security\-first with sensitive data and treat compliance as a design input. * You’ve told customers or sales “no” or “not in that timeline” and kept the relationship, and you can name things you descoped and why. * You’ve had impact beyond your own team through tooling, practices or platform changes. **Preferred** ------------- * Healthcare or other regulated\-domain experience; jobs.title: Lead AI Architect ( Agentic SDLC )
jobs.description: Orion Innovation is a premier, award\-winning, global business and technology services firm. Orion delivers game\-changing business transformation and product development rooted in digital strategy, experience design, and engineering, with a unique combination of agility, scale, and maturity. We work with a wide range of clients across many industries including financial services, professional services, telecommunications and media, consumer products, automotive, industrial automation, professional sports and entertainment, life sciences, ecommerce, and education. **Build the systems that change how software gets built.** We're looking for an exceptional, hands\-on Applied AI Engineer who combines deep software engineering expertise with creative thinking about developer productivity. You're already a power user of AI coding tools, have customized your own development workflow, and are building toward a future where agents take on meaningful engineering work across the software development lifecycle. In this role, you'll design and build agentic workflows that connect requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, code review, deployment, and maintenance. You'll turn promising prototypes into reliable systems that engineering teams trust and use. You'll partner directly with engineering leaders, developers, and customers to identify high\-value opportunities, ship working solutions, and measure their impact. This role blends hands\-on engineering, technical architecture, product judgment, and customer\-facing leadership. What you'll Do * **Build coding agents that deliver real engineering outcomes.** Develop agents that understand repositories, implement features, diagnose defects, write and run tests, address review feedback, and prepare changes for human approval. * **Design agentic workflows across the SDLC.** Connect issue trackers, repositories, developer environments, CI/CD pipelines, documentation, and observability tools into coordinated workflows with clear ownership and approval points. * **Engineer reliable agent execution.** Build context management, tool integrations, orchestration, isolated execution environments, state persistence, retries, and recovery mechanisms for complex engineering tasks. * **Use AI coding tools as part of your daily craft.** Apply tools such as Codex, Cursor, Claude Code to prototype, implement, debug, and refine the systems you build. Turn effective personal practices into repeatable team capabilities. * **Build compelling demos and production\-ready implementations.** Create prototypes, reusable integrations, reference architectures, and automations that demonstrate value and support adoption. * **Evaluate quality and productivity rigorously.** Develop benchmarks and evaluation harnesses that measure task completion, code correctness, regression rates, security findings, latency, cost, and engineering effort. * **Make autonomy safe and practical.** Implement scoped permissions, secrets handling, audit trails, sandboxing, and human review controls appropriate to each workflow. * **Lead technical discovery and enablement.** Work alongside engineering teams to understand their constraints, run hands\-on workshops, and guide adoption from initial experiments through production rollout. * **Shape product direction through evidence.** Translate deployment experience into actionable product requirements, model feedback, technical guides, and reusable engineering patterns. What You Bring * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, applied AI, developer tooling, platform engineering, or technically intensive solutions engineering, with a strong record of shipping working systems. * Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or another widely used language, and confidence navigating unfamiliar codebases. * Deep practical experience with AI coding tools and concrete examples of workflows, integrations, or agents you have built and used. * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications with tool calling, structured outputs, context retrieval, and iterative execution. * Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including architecture, Git, automated testing, code review, CI/CD, debugging, and production operations. * The judgment to distinguish tasks that benefit from agents from those better served by deterministic automation—and to decide where human review is essential. * A disciplined approach to evaluating generated code and diagnosing failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and execution environments. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain architectural tradeoffs and lead hands\-on technical sessions. * Comfort with ambiguity, fast experimentation, and ownership from problem discovery through delivery and adoption. What sets you apart * You've built agents that complete multi\-step engineering tasks against real repositories. * You've developed agent evaluation frameworks, repository context systems, custom tools, MCP integrations, or orchestration infrastructure. * You've integrated coding agents into enterprise environments with meaningful security and operational requirements. * You've contributed developer tools, open\-source projects, technical guides, or reference implementations. * You can demonstrate measurable improvements in engineering throughput or quality without shifting hidden work onto reviewers. * You bring a strong product instinct: you identify a valuable problem, build the smallest useful solution, and improve it based on evidence. What Success looks like Engineering teams adopt the workflows you build because they reliably help them ship better software. Agents complete clearly scoped tasks with measurable quality, failures are visible and recoverable, and successful experiments become reusable capabilities across teams. **Show us what you've built.** A repository, live demo, technical walkthrough, or concrete example of an agentic development workflow will help us understand how you think and execute. Orion is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Candidate Privacy Policy Orion Systems Integrators, LLC and its subsidiaries and its affiliates (collectively, "Orion," "we" or "us") are committed to protecting your privacy. This Candidate Privacy Policy (orioninc.com) ("Notice") explains: * What information we collect during our application and recruitment process and why we collect it; * How we handle that information; and * How to access and update that information. Your use of Orion services is governed by any applicable terms in this notice and our general Privacy Policy.

The second is to take what works and turn it into AI services and consulting packages that clients buy. You'll lead the AI engineering team, report to the EVP of Innovation, and work closely with Technology, who owns infrastructure and DevOps. **Job Responsibilities:** ***Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions*** * Shape the AI vision and strategy with the EVP of Innovation. Decide where OuterBox is going with AI, inside the company and in the market, and what we build, buy, or skip. Models change fast, and a service built around today's gap can be dead in months. * Find the gaps in the market and build the bridge to delivery. Set scope, pricing, delivery owners, and the sales pitch. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Orders Platform
jobs.description: **About Owner** Owner is the AI\-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants. We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business. It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more. **Product philosophy** Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically. Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it. Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you. **Our vision** We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online. But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive. Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type. In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age. **Our traction** Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website. More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees. **Our team** Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe. We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth. **Where we work** Owner is a remote\-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in\-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location! **Role Overview** Owner is the leading all\-in\-one platform for independent restaurants. Orders Platform is the system that takes, tracks, and settles every order a restaurant handles with the upmost reliability (even through internet outages). We're looking for a Staff Engineer to help own and evolve the core of that platform as we scale to more and more restaurants. You'll work on problems that look very different from a traditional backend role: event\-sourced data storage, data reconciliation, cost\-effective observability, code distribution across thousands of devices via Kotlin Multiplatform, and restaurant workflows that must behave correctly even when part of the system disappears halfway through an operation. This is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role. You'll be a technical anchor for the Orders Platform team, setting platform direction, raising the bar on correctness, and helping the team move fast on a system restaurants depend on every day. **Why we’re looking for you** Orders are the heartbeat of a restaurant. Our tier zero platform is built on patterns such as event sourcing and conflict\-free replicated data types (CRDTs) to support an offline\-first point of sale and ordering via Owner’s online and white\-labeled app experiences. It relies on a small group of people, with high agency, who understand those patterns deeply. We need another Staff\-level engineer who can reason about this kind of system quickly, share the architectural load with the rest of the team, and make the platform more resilient as the team and the business grow. **Our Tech Stack** * **Core patterns:** Event sourcing, Fog/cloud distribution (we run a version of our server code in every restaurant on a point of sale device), caching of critical data to support offline mode, app distribution, and device configuration. * **Languages:** Kotlin, Typescript, React/React Native * **Infrastructure and observability:** Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Datadog, Postgresql, SQLite, OpenTelemetry Collectors, Kafka. **The impact you'll have** * Act as an architect within the Orders Platform team, setting technical direction for how orders are modeled, stored, replicated, and reconciled * Design and build event\-sourced and replicated\-state systems that stay correct under retries, network partitions, concurrent edits, and partial failure * Partner closely with Product, Payments, Reporting, and the engineers on our point of sale and mobile surfaces to ship reliable ordering flows end to end * Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and help the team build deep fluency in these patterns * Improve observability, replay, and recovery so we can find and fix order\-state problems quickly while minimizing costs. * Reduce bus factor risk by sharing context and documenting how the platform works **What we’re looking for** You have a track record of building correctness\-critical distributed systems. **Required experience** * Hands\-on experience with event sourcing, CRDTs, or comparable approaches to replicated and offline\-first data (for example, sync engines or conflict resolution layers) * Experience with idempotency, optimistic concurrency, event replay, projections, and reconciliation * Comfort reasoning about "what happens if this node disappears halfway through the operation?" and designing for it * Ability to pick up a specialized technology quickly and make it more robust * Staff\-level experience leading technical direction without losing touch with the code * Clear written and verbal communication, and a habit of making complex systems easier for others to understand **Payments and ordering backend experience preferred** * Backend experience in payment or ordering systems * Ability to partner with our payments and reporting team while owning the order side of money\-moving flows **Customer Obsession \& Empathy** * Being unafraid to work directly with restaurants to solve their needs (including in person visits, phone/text communication, and more). * Ideally, but not required, you have experience working in restaurants, retail, or IT at some point in your career. **Compensation and benefits** * The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $240K\-$260K USD depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre\-IPO equity package * Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, work from anywhere (remote\-first workplace), unlimited PTO \- plus extra fun perks! **Notice \- Employment Scams** Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address. We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond. \#LI\-AB1

jobs.title: Data Scientist

Responsibilities * Design, build, and deploy intelligent agents to automate team and departmental workflows * Implement and extend agents using Copilot and related GenAI tooling * Develop internal tools and automation solutions that improve data access, analysis, and decision\-making * Apply statistical analysis and data mining techniques to support agent logic, insights, and recommendations * Manage and prepare data pipelines to support both analytical and GenAI\-driven use cases * Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities where automation and agents can drive efficiency or scale * Integrate agents and tools with existing platforms and business processes * Support and continuously improve deployed agents through monitoring, tuning, and iteration * Document solutions and share best practices to enable broader adoption across teams Qualifications \& Skills * Experience building or implementing intelligent agents or automation solutions * Familiarity with leveraging Copilot to design, configure, or extend agent\-based workflows * Strong foundation in statistical analysis and data mining techniques * Experience working across data management and analytics use cases * Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI) * Comfort working with structured and unstructured data sources * Ability to translate business needs into automated, data\-driven solutions * Strong problem\-solving skills and a bias toward practical, scalable implementation PNC is an in\-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be: * **Customer Focused** \- Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. * **Managing Risk** \- Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework. **Qualifications** ================== Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- Analytical Thinking, Competitive Advantages, Data Analytics, Data Mining, Data Science, Machine Learning (ML)**Competencies** ---------------- Data Architecture, Data Mining, Disruptive Innovation, Information Capture, Machine Learning, Modeling: Data, Process, Events, Objects, Prototyping, Query and Database Access Tools**Work Experience** ------------------- Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 3\+ years of relevant / direct industry experience. Certifications are often desired. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.**Education** ------------- Masters**Certifications** ------------------ No Required Certification(s)**Licenses** ------------ No Required License(s)**Language Assessments** ------------------------ No Required or Preferred Language Assessments**Pay Transparency** ==================== Base Salary: $86,250\.00 – $158,125\.00 Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible with the payment based upon company, business and/or individual performance.**Application Window** ====================== Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 10/14/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.**Benefits** ============ PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future.
