jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
jobs.description: **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** *(Remote, US\-Based Only)* **Build quality into software that matters.** At Pulsara, great testing requires more than finding defects or building automated tests. Our Senior Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) combine hands\-on testing with software engineering expertise to build and sustain reliable automation, solve complex technical challenges, and mentor others while helping shape the team's approach to software quality. **And reliability matters here.** Pulsara is used by healthcare professionals coordinating care for time\-critical patients. The defects you uncover, the automation you build, and the expertise you share help deliver software our customers can depend on when it matters most. If you enjoy tackling complex testing challenges, improving how software is built and tested, and helping others succeed, **keep reading.** **What is Pulsara?** **Pulsara connects people when seconds matter.** Pulsara is a secure, user\-friendly software software solution that unites the entire care team, even across different departments or organizations. By replacing multiple phone calls, radio reports, faxes, and pagers with one unified patient channel, Pulsara streamlines workflows, leading to reduced treatment times, lower costs, and enhanced experiences for both patients and caregivers. **Who we are:** Pulsara is a 100% remote team made up of people with backgrounds in technology, healthcare, emergency services, business, and beyond, united by a common purpose: **to improve the lives of people in need and those who serve them.** Working remotely gives us flexibility, but great remote work takes more than being able to work from home. We communicate intentionally, collaborate across teams, take ownership of our work, and depend on one another to follow through. We are a company that continues to evolve. We value people who are curious, comfortable learning, willing to challenge how things have always been done, and interested in helping us make both our product and the way we work better. **Want to learn more?** Explore our technology at Pulsara.com and discover our team, culture, and benefits on our Careers page. **What You’ll Be Testing** Pulsara isn’t a single web application. Our technology environment includes: Native iOS and Android applications Web\-based patient care, administration, and reporting tools * ️ A highly scalable AWS cloud environment Internal and public APIs ️ Relational databases and complex data workflows Secure, HIPAA\-compliant systems supporting communication across organizations That means testing often requires looking beyond a single screen or expected workflow. A change in one area may affect workflows elsewhere, and understanding those relationships is an important part of becoming effective in this role. **Your Primary Job Focus and Day\-to\-Day Activities Will Include:** * **️ Build and sustain reliable automation** Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and test suites that perform reliably over time. Improve test coverage, execution performance, and maintainability while minimizing flaky tests. **Strengthen testing tools and environments** Create, maintain, and troubleshoot test environments and supporting tools. Integrate automated testing into CI/CD workflows to help identify issues earlier and support dependable releases. **Plan and execute effective testing across the Pulsara platform** Develop practical test strategies, plans, and reusable test cases based on requirements, technical complexity, risk, and customer workflows. Perform manual and automated testing across mobile and web applications, internal and public APIs, database migrations, and tools running in AWS to identify defects, risks, and unexpected behavior. **Lead through technical expertise and mentorship** Share your experience designing and maintaining reliable automation to mentor other Test Engineering team members, strengthen their technical capabilities, and help shape the team's approach to testing and automation. **Think beyond the happy path** Explore edge cases, complex system interactions, and real\-world conditions. Apply technical expertise and sound judgment to determine where automation adds value and where hands\-on testing is essential. **Investigate and communicate problems clearly** Troubleshoot complex defects and test failures, document reproducible findings, collaborate on solutions, and verify fixes. **Keep the customer in focus** Understand how healthcare professionals use Pulsara and recognize where technical issues, unexpected behavior, or workflow friction could affect their ability to coordinate care. **Help us continuously improve** Identify opportunities to improve testing practices, automation, and tools. Apply new technologies, including AI\-assisted tools, where they meaningfully improve quality and efficiency. **What We Are Looking For** ✅ Demonstrated expertise in software testing and qua se for Android, and Playwright for web ✅ Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, CI/CD workflows, Linux environments, and troubleshooting automated tests and test environments ✅ Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, CloudWatch, ECS, ECR, or CloudFormation, and familiarity with supporting tools such as Docker or Fastlane ✅ Experience with test management and issue\-tracking tools such as Jira, Qase, or comparable platforms ✅ Strong technical judgment, debugging, and problem\-solving skills, including identifying root causes and determining when manual or automated testing is most effective ✅ Effective communication and collaboration with Software Engineers, Product Managers, DevOps, and other testing professionals ✅ Hands\-on experience exploring AI\-assisted development and testing tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or ChatGPT, including using LLMs to generate test cases, test data, or support troubleshooting. Familiarity with testing nondeterministic AI outputs is a plus. ✅ Experience testing healthcare technology, mission\-critical software, or applications in regulated environments is a plus, but not required. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is welcome but not required. We place greater value on demonstrated capabilities, the testing challenges you've solved, the automation you've built, and how you've helped others succeed. **What Makes Someone Great at This Job** **You’re curious.** You dig into complex systems, ask thoughtful questions, and investigate until you understand not just what happened, but why. **You think like the customer.** You understand that technically correct software isn't always a good customer experience. You consider how Pulsara works in real\-world situations and advocate for quality that matters to the people using it. **You see both the details and the big picture.** You can uncover subtle defects, recognize patterns across systems, and understand how changes in one area may affect another. **You make others better.** You enjoy sharing what you know, mentoring less\-experienced team members, and helping others strengthen their technical and testing capabilities. **You collaborate and take ownership.** You communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, work through problems with others, and take pride in the quality of what the team delivers. **Travel:** This position requires 0% travel **What We Offer** Competitive Pay: $70K \- $80K (based on experience) All\-Team Profitability Incentive Plan Medical, Dental, Vision, Life/AD\&D, and LTD benefits Employer 401(k) Match Competitive PTO Cell \& Internet Reimbursement 100% Remote – Work From Anywhere in the USA **Cover Letter Instructions:** **Cover Letter Required** Please briefly introduce yourself and tell us why you're interested in joining Pulsara. We'd especially like to hear about your experience with hands\-on testing and automation, an accomplishment that demonstrates your ability to build or sustain reliable testing solutions, and how you've helped others develop their technical skills. We're more interested in what you've accomplished, the challenges you've solved, and the impact you've made than how many years you've held a particular title. **Interested?** Whether your experience comes from professional development, coursework, or personal projects, we'd love to hear from you. **Ready to grow your skills while building software that makes a difference? Show us what you can bring to Pulsara.** **Candidate \& Recruiter Notes** * **Application Review:** Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. * **E\-Verify\+:** Used to verify identity and employment eligibility. * **U.S.\-Based Only:** Applicants must reside in the U.S. * **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work for any U.S. employer without sponsorship, now or in the future. * **Background Checks:** Conducted after acceptance of a conditional offer. * **Recruiters \& Staffing Firms:** Please do not respond.

jobs.title: Early Career Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget. Our Science \& Technology directorates include National Security, Earth and Biological Sciences, Physical and Computational Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus. The National Security Directorate (NSD) drives science\-based, mission\-focused solutions to take on complex, real\-world threats to our nation and the world. The AI and Data Analytics Division, part of the National Security Directorate, combines profound domain expertise and creative integration of advanced hardware and software to deliver computational solutions that address complex data and analytic challenges. Working in multidisciplinary teams, we connect foundational research to engineering to operations, providing the tools to innovate quickly and field results faster. Our strengths are integrated across the data analytics lifecycle, from data acquisition and management to analysis and decision support. Rockstar Rewards: Employees and their families are offered medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, robust telehealth care options, several mental health benefits, free wellness coaching, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, basic life insurance, disability insurance\*, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, tuition assistance, relocation, backup childcare, legal benefits, supplemental parental bonding leave, surrogacy and adoption assistance, and fertility support. Employees are automatically enrolled in our company\-funded pension plan\* and may enroll in our 401 (k) savings plan with company match\*. Employees may accrue up to 120 vacation hours per year and may receive ten paid holidays per year. * Research Associates excluded. \*\*All benefits are dependent upon eligibility. Click Here For Rockstar Rewards Responsibilities: We are seeking a motivated Early Career Software Engineer to join our dynamic team at PNNL and contribute to cutting\-edge projects that shape the future of critical technology supporting national security and intelligence. In this role, you'll collaborate with experienced engineers to design, build, and optimize scalable systems for processing multi\-modal intelligence data at a remarkable scale and speed. This hands\-on position offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills in SI/ML engineering, data orchestration, and system architecture while delivering impactful solutions in a fast\-paced environment where agility and reliability are key to success. As a Software Engineer on PNNL's Software Engineering and Architectures (SEA) team, you'll have the chance to shape mission\-critical SI systems, help build enterprise\-scale data platforms, and gain hands\-on experience with some of the nation's most sophisticated intelligence and security applications. You'll receive mentorship from senior engineers, collaborate with research scientists, and see your code deployed in production systems that directly support national security missions. **What You’ll Build \& Learn:** * SI\-Powered Software – Help develop applications that use SI agents and large language models (LLMs). Gain hands\-on experience with LLM integrations, evaluation, testing, and foundational MLOps practices. * Intelligence Platform Development – Contribute to software that combines multiple sources of intelligence, supports geospatial analysis, and helps users understand complex information. * Data Engineering – Build and maintain data pipelines, develop analytics workflows, and learn how cloud\-native systems process and manage data at scale. * Collaborative Software Development – Work alongside experienced engineers, participate in code reviews and design discussions, and build your skills in testing, debugging, documentation, and enterprise software development. * Professional Growth – Receive mentorship, take on increasing responsibility, and learn how to design, build, deploy, and support production\-quality software. **Technical Skills We’ll Help You Grow:** * Programming Foundation – Solid Python skills and experience with at least one additional language, such as Go, Rust, C\#/.NET, C\+\+, or a similar language. * Platform Experience – Exposure to at least one cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and familiarity with Linux environments. * Development Practices – Understanding of Git and version control, exposure to CI/CD practices, and familiarity with Agile or Scrum development environments. * Data and Databases – Experience writing SQL and a basic understanding of data modeling, data processing, or data pipeline concepts. * SI\-Assisted Development – Familiarity with SI coding tools such as Claude Cod gram. About PNNL: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is a world\-class research institution powered by a highly educated, diverse workforce committed to the values of Integrity, Creativity, Collaboration, Impact, and Courage. Every year, scores of dynamic, driven people come to PNNL to work with renowned researchers on meaningful science, innovations and outcomes for the U.S. Department of Energy and other sponsors; here is your chance to be one of them! At PNNL, you will find an exciting research environment and excellent benefits including health insurance, and flexible work schedules. PNNL is located in eastern Washington State—the dry side of Washington known for its stellar outdoor recreation and affordable cost of living. The Lab’s campus is only a 45\-minute flight (or \~3 hour drive) from Seattle or Portland, and is serviced by the convenient PSC airport, connected to 8 major hubs. Commitment to Excellence and Equal Employment Opportunity: Our laboratory is committed to fostering a work environment where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect while solving critical challenges in fundamental sciences, national security, and energy resiliency. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. PNNL considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), protected veteran status, and any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local laws. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures and in employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at careers@pnnl.gov. Drug Free Workplace: PNNL is committed to a drug\-free workplace supported by Workplace Substance Abuse Program (WSAP) and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs. If you are offered employment at PNNL, you must pass a drug test prior to commencing employment. PNNL complies with federal law regarding illegal drug use. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you test positive for any illegal controlled substance, including marijuana, your offer of employment will be withdrawn. HSPD\-12 PIV Credential Requirement: As a national laboratory, PNNL is responsible for adhering to the Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD\-12\) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473\.1A, which require new employees to obtain and maintain a HSPD\-12 Personal Identify Verification (PIV) Credential. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete the applicable tier of federal background investigation post hire and receive a favorable federal adjudication. The tier of federal background investigation will be determined by job duties and national security or public trust responsibilities associated with the job. All tiers of investigation include a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last 1 to 7 years (depending on the applicable tier of investigation). Illegal drug activities include marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws. For foreign national candidates: If you have not resided in the U.S. for three consecutive years, you are not eligible for the PIV credential and instead will need to obtain a favorable Local Site Specific Only (LSSO) Federal risk determination to maintain employment. Once you meet the three\-year residency requirement thereafter, you will be required to obtain a PIV credential to maintain employment. The tier of federal background investigation required to obtain the PIV credential will be determined by job duties at the time you become eligible for the PIV credential.

jobs.description: **Software Engineer (Backend)** **Location:** Burlingame, CA **Department:** ESS Engineering **Reports to:** Senior Manager, Software Engineering **Position Type:** Full\-time **About the Company** Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven sodium\-ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid. Sodium\-ion is cheap, readily available, and safe — making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market. Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt\-level innovation at world\-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, SunPower, and Fluence. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners including TDK Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and GM Ventures. We recently announced America's first sodium\-ion grid storage factory in Sacramento with production starting Q1 2027, and over $1B in signed customer commitments including Jupiter Power and Energy Vault. **About the Role** Peak Energy is looking for a Software Engineer, Backend to help improve and scale the software platform that manages, ingests, processes, and surfaces operational data from our grid\-scale battery storage systems. Our platform transforms raw telemetry from batteries deployed in the field into meaningful data and metrics that customers, operators, and engineers rely on every day. As Peak grows from pilot deployments to gigawatt\-scale production, this software becomes increasingly critical to our operations. This is a hands\-on backend software engineering role focused on application development, API design, data processing, and system integration. You'll build and improve the services that connect our battery systems, manufacturing operations, and cloud applications, ensuring data is processed reliably and accessible across the organization. You'll join a small software team with significant ownership over the systems you build, working closely with ESS Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, and Product. **What You'll Do** * Design, develop, and maintain backend applications and services that manage, ingest, process, and surface operational data from deployed battery systems. * Build and maintain APIs and application interfaces that enable communication between battery systems, cloud services, and internal applications. * Develop data processing pipelines that support critical battery performance metrics, including round\-trip efficiency, availability, and cycle tracking. * Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data models to support operational applications, reporting, and analytics. * Develop software integrations connecting manufacturing systems, physical devices, and cloud applications. * Improve the reliability, scalability, and performance of backend services as Peak's deployment footprint grows. * Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and systems engineering teams to integrate new functionality and support evolving product requirements. * Troubleshoot production issues, improve application observability, and continuously enhance software quality. **What You'll Bring (Minimum Qualifications)** * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend application development. * Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production\-grade backend applications and services. * Experience designing, developing, and maintaining REST APIs or other service interfaces. * Strong SQL skills, including PostgreSQL, database schema design, query optimization, and data modeling. * Experience developing data processing pipelines or applications that ingest and transform data from multiple sources. * Familiarity with cloud\-based application development on Azure, AWS, or GCP. * Strong understanding of software architecture, testing, debugging, and version control. * Experience owning production software, including troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous improvement. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, or similar cloud application services. * Experience with asynchronous processing, event\-driven architectures, or distributed systems. * Familiarity with real\-time data streaming technologies such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, or Kinesis. * Experience with battery systems, energy storage, IoT, industrial telemetry, or hardware\-integrated software. * Experience working with time\-series data and high\-volume telemetry. * Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD workflows, and modern software deployment practices. * Experience partnering with embedded software, firmware, or hardware engineering teams. * Prior experience in a fast\-paced startup environment building new software systems. **Our Core Values** * **Speed Through Focus** — Move fast but understand why. Focus on the goal, don't sacrifice quality. * **Mission Over Self** — Put the company's mission and team success ahead of individual interests. * **Face the Brutal Truth** — Transparency, honesty, big\-picture curiosity. Fearless decision making. * **Be a Good Person** — Kindness, collaboration, and teamwork. **Compensation \& Benefits** The salary range for this role is **$180,000 \- $240,000**, with actual pay varying based on work location, experience, and skills. Our competitive benefits package includes: * Flexible time off * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Strong 401(k) plan * Equity opportunities * Many great work perks Join us to thrive in a supportive environment while making a meaningful impact in the energy sector! We welcome people who represent diversity in their backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. jobs.description: Position Summary The Delivery Engineer is an early\-career technical role for engineers and other builders who want to develop broad expertise across technology, customer delivery, and product. Delivery Engineers are aligned to a state or customer rather than a single product. Working alongside experienced technical and delivery leaders, they develop an end\-to\-end understanding of how Pearson's platforms, integrations, data flows, and operational processes work together to meet customer requirements and contractual commitments. This is a hands\-on role. Delivery Engineers demonstrate solutions, investigate technical issues, validate integrations, support implementations and production events, and work across teams to drive problems toward resolution. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Perry Weather** Perry Weather is the weather safety standard for organizations that operate outdoors. We combine on\-site weather hardware with a software platform that automates alerts, siren activations, and safety decisions for more than 3,000 organizations — from the PGA of America, the NFL, and MLB to Turner Construction, thousands of school districts, cities, and golf courses. We've grown 80%\+ annually for five consecutive years, and are continuing to grow. We're headquartered in Dallas at The Centrum, in the Oak Lawn neighborhood, where our teams work together every day to help organizations make faster and safer decisions when weather puts people, assets, and operations at risk. **About the Role** You will lead the team that builds and improves the systems deciding when weather is unsafe at a stadium, a school, or a job site, and what happens next. You set technical direction, write production code most weeks, and lead through designs, reviews, and coaching. You will move the team toward one shared rule for when conditions are unsafe, alerts that reach the right siren exactly once, and closed deals that reach the ERP without manual entry. The team owns the policy engine, the policy templates customers configure, the sirens and strobes that act on each decision, partner integrations such as Singlewire, and the HubSpot to Acumatica sync for closed deals. Hardware, support, sales, and finance all depend on these systems. Stack: C\# and .NET on Azure Kubernetes, Azure SQL, Azure Service Bus, React and React Native, and Terraform. You will build with AI coding agents every day. **Responsibilities** * Make one source of truth for "conditions are unsafe." Several services keep their own copy of that rule today, and the copies can disagree. Pick the version, move callers to it one at a time, and delete the rest. * Make the message paths reliable end to end. When a command to a siren is sent twice or never, or a partner webhook carries the wrong trigger, find the shared cause and fix it in the design so that whole class of failure stops. * Co\-own the service that sends commands to field hardware with our hardware team, from the software decision to the device that acts on it. * Finish the HubSpot to Acumatica sync so every closed deal reaches the ERP on its own, failures alert and can be replayed, and manual order entry goes away. * Write designs that other teams review, push back on, and build on. * Bring down reliability numbers several teams share (incidents customers find before we do, pages per day, time to detect) and keep them down after you move on. * Coach senior engineers until they own systems and designs of their own. * Review closely, take your turn on call, and help set how the team works with AI agents. This role is not a fit for an architect who has stopped coding, a manager of managers, or someone whose best work stayed inside one team. **Requirements** * 8\+ years shipping production software, including time as technical lead for four to six engineers while you still wrote code. * Event\-driven systems you designed and ran in production: services that talk through queues, consumers that handle the same message twice safely, retries, and dead\-letter queues. * A system you split into services along domain lines. You can say where each boundary sits and why. * Backend depth in a statically typed language. We use C\#; strong Java, Go, or Kotlin carries over. * Work that reached past your own team. We want to hear all four of these, with the numbers: + A design other teams argued with and then built on. + A metric several teams shared that you brought down, and that held a quarter after you stepped back. + A duplicate system you retired by moving its users over one at a time. How many copies did you delete? + A senior engineer you coached into owning a system. Who goes to them now? * Judgment with AI\-generated code. Agent output often looks right when the logic is wrong. You check it against the requirement and can explain every line you ship. * Willingness to be on call. Our customers get alerts during severe weather, and a dropped alert can put someone at risk. **Nice to have:** Azure Service Bus or MassTransit, Kubernetes, SQL Server, IoT or field\-deployed hardware, real\-time weather or geospatial data, and React or React Native. **Benefits** * **You'll want to come into the office.** Our Oak Lawn office isn't just a place to sit — it's where ideas move fast and culture stays strong. The whole team is here Monday through Friday, which means real collaboration, no chasing people down over Slack, and a genuinely fun place to spend your work days. * **Your wellbeing is covered.** Competitive health insurance, 401(k) with employer matching, and a full suite of voluntary benefits, because you shouldn't have to think twice about the basics. * **Good people, good times.** Monthly All\-Hands, Office Olympics, happy hours, and more. We take the work seriously and the culture seriously too. * **You're getting in early, and that matters.** We're growing fast, but the biggest opportunities are still ahead. The people joining now will help shape what Perry Weather becomes.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineering
jobs.description: The world needs 3 TW of new solar capacity every year. The legacy approach of developing and building infrastructure is mathematically incapable of catching up. Planted is the autonomous power deployment company. We transform power plants from bespoke construction projects into manufactured products. By integrating planning software, high\-density arrays, energy storage, and field robots, we deliver more power where it's needed most. The physics are solved; what remains is relentless execution. Led by repeat founders and an engineering core from SpaceX and Tesla, we are backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Piva Capital, Google, Gigascale Capital, Khosla Ventures, and RA Capital Management. We’re scaling fast and looking for operators and engineers who want to own real pieces of the system. You don't need a traditional energy background; we care whether you can finish hard things. Come build with us. **About The Role** ------------------ As a core part of the R\+D team you will own the software that makes our field robots move, sense, and stay safe. Work the full stack, from CANopen devices on the machine bus up through ROS2 nodes, control loops, and the diagnostics our crews rely on. When a robot misbehaves in the dirt, you trace it from a log or a CAN frame to root cause, then fix it so it never happens again. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with a cross\-functional team of mechanical, electrical, and field engineers from varied backgrounds. The salary range for this full\-time position is $180,000 to $230,000 USD plus stock and benefits. Pay within the range is based on candidate experience, job\-specific skills, education, and work location. The target experience for the position is 5\+ years. This role is based in Oakland, CA, with regular travel to job sites. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Solve fully autonomous solar array installation on rough, sloped terrain, while maintaining millimeter positioning accuracy * Design, build, and own ROS2 software for our latest, hydraulic\-powered, multi\-ton robot * Build computer vision and video\-based verification that proves every install is correctly located in 3D space across thousands of installs and hundreds of meters * Define and implement a comprehensive telemetry system using AI\-based tools for remote debug and triage * Develop and tune robot control software, from individual actuators to coordination across the full machine * Integrate and configure precision CANopen for drives, valves, encoders, I/O, and sensors * Contribute to the design of our safety systems, and build the fault detection, safe\-state handling, and interlocks that keep field teams safe alongside these huge machines * Debug hard failures across hardware, firmware, middleware, and application code, and drive them to root cause **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, robotics, or similar * Experience shipping embedded or robotics software on real machines * Strong modern C\+\+ on Linux, and solid Python for tooling, test, and analysis * Production experience with ROS2 * Experience with real\-time Linux (PREEMPT\_RT) * Hands\-on experience with CANopen in real systems * Track record debugging robot control systems end to end \- from a symptom in the field to a root cause in code, config, or hardware * Hands\-on aptitude \- comfortable with a scope, a CAN analyzer, and a schematic * Desire to work in a startup environment, including time in the field **Bonus:** ros2\_control, CiA 402 motion control, RTK GNSS, functional safety, or heavy equipment experience. **Philosophy On Qualifications And Compensation** ------------------------------------------------- Many people only apply for jobs if they believe they can perform every task in the job description. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and will consider equivalent combinations of knowledge, skills, education, and experience. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role. Additionally, we believe compensation should reflect the value people bring and give them a real stake in what we're building. Our total compensation package includes a base salary, meaningful equity through stock options, and benefits including company holidays, paid time off (PTO), and in\-office lunches. Individual pay may vary within the posted range and is determined by a number of factors including relevant experience, skills, and location. **How We Work** --------------- We are using sunlight, software, and robots to power the world. It is historic work, and it is hard work. If you want a paved, predictable path, this isn't for you. If you'd rather invent the path, this is the best job you'll ever have. * **Call it out.** We put big robots in the field alongside our crews and partners. Anyone can stop any operation at any time. The same trust runs everywhere: a bug in the code, a flaw in the plan, a risk in the dirt, a design that no longer makes sense. Say it while it's small and cheap to fix, directly to the person who can fix it. Sometimes that person is you. * **Commit and complete.** We work problems, not tasks. A confident guess is not a commitment; “I'll find out by Thursday” is. If a date slips, say it early and bring the new plan. Every decision has one owner: bring data, argue hard, push back in the room, then the owner calls it and we lock arms. Execution compounds. * **Convention isn't evidence.** “Industry standard” is a red flag. Most conventions were answers to constraints that no longer exist. We respect physics and obey the law. Everything else is a choice, and we get to make it. * **Let machines do the work.** We are system builders: AI and robots do repetitive work in the field and in the office. Every task a machine takes over is a person out of harm's way or off the critical path. Solve a problem once, then build the tool, write the spec, and commit the doc so nobody has to solve it again. Doing it by hand once is fine. Twice means we need a tool. Planted is an equal opportunity employer committed to growing inclusively, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, medical condition, age, or veteran status. However you identify, or whatever background you bring with you, please apply. We look forward to hearing from you. Compensation Range: $180K \- $230K

engineering team. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Software \& Product Development** * Design, develop, test, and maintain software features for connected medical devices and associated applications. * Contribute to iOS and Android mobile applications, including BLE connectivity, data synchronization, and user\-facing functionality. * Support embedded sensor firmware, device integration, backend services, and web applications as project needs require. * Investigate and resolve software defects, performance issues, and field\-reported problems. * Improve existing software through refactoring, dependency updates, and reliability enhancements. * Participate in the development of new product capabilities and future device technologies. **Test Automation \& Software Quality** * Develop automated testing tools and frameworks for mobile applications, embedded devices, APIs, and backend services. * Contribute to sensor and firmware test automation, including BLE protocol verification, data acquisition, and regression testing. * Develop and maintain unit, integration, and automated regression tests using tools such as Flutter Test, pytest, Appium, or similar frameworks. * Collaborate with engineers to improve test coverage, testing practices, and software quality. * Support software verification and validation activities in accordance with established medical device development procedures. **Build Infrastructure \& Release Engineering** * Develop and improve automated build, continuous integration, and release workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions, or similar platforms. * Help establish centralized, reproducible build environments, scheduled builds, and automated verification processes. * Improve software packaging, dependency jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About us** ------------ **At Provectus**, you don’t prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude \+ AWS system into their real, regulated production — then you watch the business number move. We’re an Anthropic and AWS Partner with 150\+ certified architects. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter — without the layers, politics, and years\-to\-impact of a hundred\-thousand\-person firm. 350\+ builders, 100\+ customers in production, founder\-led since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA. **Why Provectus** ----------------- * **Frontier access — Anthropic Preferred Partner:** newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems. * **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. * **Embedded, not engaged.** You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff\-augmented. * **Autonomous.** You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. * **Your experience stays portable.** Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy\-maintenance grind, not a single stack. * **Craft \& growth** — build beside senior FDEs on a Claude\-certified team; a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name. * **We give you a stage:** Claude certification, conference talks, open\-source contributions, published work under your own name. ### **What you’ll do:** * Spend the first weeks of each engagement in the operator’s seat, learning the constraints from the inside, then rebuild the function from first principles alongside the client and a Forward Deployed Executive — and you are the one who builds it. * Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously. * You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it. * Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare. * Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice. ### **What we look for:** * Typically 7\+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands\-on today and intend to stay that way. * Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly. * Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works. * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non\-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why. * Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. * Cloud\-native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits. * Pre\-sales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room. * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job. * Hands\-on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses). ### **Nice to have:** * Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production. * IaC depth: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform. * Open\-source contributions or public writing on applied AI. ### **What we offer:** * Full\-time. * On\-site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC 1/week * Unlimited Vacation policy. * Generous health, vision, and dental insurance. * 401(K) matching plan. * Base salary $180k–$200k \+ bonuses; OTE up to $250k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data. * No Visa sponsorship ### **We’re real** * **A person reads your application.** We filter out AI\-generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team. * **We may ask for a quick ID verification.** Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates. * **You’ll meet the people you’d work with.** We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We'd be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Co\-Founder \& CEO. ### **How we hire:** * Recruitment interview. * Tech interview with our FDE (30 min). * A live engineering building session (1\.5 hours). We hand you a business function and the constraints. You have to understand the job and rebuild it — then say what you’d build and how you’d know it worked. ***Use AI the way you normally would; we expect AI\-generated code. What we look at is how you used AI, the judgment behind your choices, and what you researched beyond what any LLM already knows.*** * Soft skills interview. * Offer discussion. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Agent Engineer, AI Transformation
jobs.description: **About Psomagen** **Psomagen, Inc.** is a U.S. genomics services company headquartered in Maryland, operating CLIA/CAP\-certified laboratories. We provide sequencing, single\-cell, spatial, proteomics and bioinformatics services to academic, foundation, pharma and clinical customers. We are building AI into how the company operates, so that our teams spend less time on routine work and more time on science and customers. **About the role** We are looking for a hands\-on developer with real AI agent experience to lead Psomagen's company\-wide AI transformation. You will design, build and operate AI agents on top of the tools our teams use every day: Google Workspace, HubSpot, our in\-house LIMS and SAP. You will work directly with the CEO and with every function, identify where agents can remove manual work, ship them quickly, and keep them reliable in production. This is a builder role, not an advisory one. **What you'll do** * Design, develop and operate AI agents using Hermes and comparable agent frameworks, and keep the underlying models swappable as better ones appear * Connect agents to our business systems (Google Workspace, HubSpot, LIMS, SAP) and choose the right way to integrate each one, so that agents can read, draft and act within defined permissions * Work with sales, project management, lab operations, finance, regulatory/quality and IT to find high\-value workflows (for example quoting, customer communication, document management, reporting and internal Q\&A) and turn them into working agents * Build the supporting infrastructure: knowledge retrieval over company documents, evaluation and testing of agent outputs, logging, monitoring and cost control * Put guardrails in place: role\-based access, audit trails and human approval steps for actions that touch customers, finance or regulated records * Collaborate with our LIMS development and bioinformatics teams so that agents fit our existing systems and pipelines * Train employees to use agents effectively, gather feedback and keep improving what is deployed * Track new AI models, tools and practices, and bring in the ones that make a practical difference to the business **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in computer science, software engineering or a related field * 4\+ years of professional software development experience, with strong Python skills * Demonstrated experience building and operating LLM\-based agents in production or in substantial real\-world use (tool calling, multi\-step workflows, retrieval, prompt and context design, evaluation) * Current knowledge of frontier AI models and agent tooling, with the ability to explain trade\-offs among models, frameworks and cost * Experience connecting software or agents to business systems (for example Google Workspace, HubSpot, an ERP such as SAP, or similar), including authentication and permission design * Strong communication skills, and comfort working with non\-technical colleagues to understand their workflows * Awareness of data security and privacy requirements when AI handles customer, financial or health\-related data * Legally authorized to work in the U.S. **Preferred** * Experience with Hermes or similar open agent frameworks, and with Google Cloud * Hands\-on experience with Google Workspace administration and APIs, Apps Script, and HubSpot * Experience with LIMS, SAP or other laboratory and enterprise operations systems * Domain knowledge of sequencing services or genomics, especially bioinformatics (pipelines, workflow tools such as Airflow, QC and reporting) * Experience in a regulated environment (CLIA/CAP, ISO 9001 or ISO 27001\) * Experience with SQL and data pipelines **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base salary range: $70,000 to $140,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus a performance\-based bonus * Benefits: \[medical/dental/vision, 401(k), PTO, etc.] Psomagen is an equal opportunity employer. **The pay range for this role is:** 70,000 \- 140,000 USD per year(Psomagen HQ)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: *We're building an autonomous infrastructure engineering agent: think Claude Code, but for your cloud. If you're excited about agentic AI systems that solve impactful problems for engineers, developers, and security experts at innovative startups and iconic enterprises alike, this role is for you.* Neo is Pulumi's answer to what infrastructure engineering looks like in an AI\-first era. It's a virtual infrastructure teammate that understands your cloud environment, plans and executes multi\-step operations, and brings domain expertise to problems ranging from spinning up complex ML infrastructures to cloud migrations to continuous compliance enforcement. What makes Neo possible is infrastructure\-as\-code: by modeling cloud infrastructure in code space, we can leverage the fact that LLMs are already excellent at coding to affect cloud infrastructure changes. Combined with Pulumi's registry and petabytes of deployment history, we have a unique foundation for building infrastructure intelligence. We're looking for engineers to build all aspects of Neo: from agent orchestration and tool interfaces to the web experience where users watch Neo work, approve operations, and understand its reasoning, to the interface with the models and how we orchestrate and fine\-tune them to maximize impact. We seek bold thinkers to reimagine the entirety of cloud engineering. While Pulumi is headquartered in Seattle, WA., we are dedicated to being a remote first company. This role will be located remotely within the U.S., with a preference for candidates based in Pacific Time Zone locations. #### **Responsibilities** * Build the planning and execution systems that let Neo safely perform multi\-step infrastructure operations across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and more * Design tool interfaces that give the agent semantic understanding of cloud resources and access to engineering workflows * Develop the context systems that help Neo understand each customer's infrastructure patterns and usage * Create the feedback loops and self\-correction mechanisms that make autonomous operation reliable * Build evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance across Neo's capability areas: migrations, compliance, cost optimization, diagnostics, and more * Work on the web interface where Neo operates as a "virtual teammate"—task assignment, progress visibility, approval workflows * Integrate Neo's capabilities into Pulumi's MCP Server for agent\-to\-agent workflows * Collaborate with platform teams to deeply integrate agent capabilities into the CLI, SDKs, and Pulumi Cloud #### **You may be a good fit if you:** * Are genuinely excited about agentic AI—systems that plan, act, and adapt in the real world, not just generate text * Have built production systems using LLMs, including experience with skill design, tool use, function calling, and multi\-step orchestration * Care deeply about reliability and safety when AI systems take real actions with real consequences * Are comfortable across the stack—agent orchestration, backend services, and frontend interfaces * Write production\-grade Go (our primary language), with working proficiency in Python and TypeScript, and can pick up new environments quickly * Bring a product mindset: you think about what users need, not just what's technically interesting * Communicate clearly and work well with a distributed team #### **Strong candidates may also have:** * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) or infrastructure\-as\-code tools * Background in building developer tools, CLIs, or platform engineering systems * Familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) * Experience building evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for AI systems * Knowledge of prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, MCP, or retrieval\-augmented generation #### **Compensation** * Base Salary Hiring Range: $185,000 to 215,000 * All full\-time employee offers at Pulumi include base salary, bonus or variable, equity and benefits (details below). **Benefits \& Perks at Pulumi:** **Healthcare Coverage:** We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and supplemental insurance at no cost to U.S. employees. Internationally, we comply with local healthcare requirements and provide regionally appropriate coverage. **Time Off:** Our unlimited PTO policy encourages balance and rest — and we require employees to take at least three weeks off annually, plus 13 U.S. holidays. **401(k):** U.S. employees are eligible for a 401(k) plan with an employer match to support long\-term financial wellness. **Parental Leave:** We provide 20 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents or primary caregivers, and 16 weeks for non\-birthing parents or secondary caregivers. **Remote\-First Culture:** Pulumi has been fully remote since 2020, with teammates across 20\+ U.S. states and 12\+ countries. We support flexible work with asynchronous collaboration and an annual "work from anywhere" stipend. **Professional Development:** Every employee receives an annual learning and development budget to support growth, learning, and career goals. **Equity Ownership:** We believe in acting like owners. All employees receive equity and are empowered to think big, move fast, and build the future of cloud together. **Additional Support:** We offer a monthly wellness fund to support mental and physical well\-being, and a quarterly happiness fund for team connection. **About Pulumi:** Pulumi is reimagining how teams build cloud software, enabling developers and infrastructure experts to work better together through a unique combination of programming languages, tools, and systems innovation. Our flagship infrastructure as code technology is open source and our SaaS product, Pulumi Cloud, provides platform teams, secrets management, and cloud management capabilities, and more. We have pioneered leveraging AI across all of these areas with our LLM\-powered Pulumi Copilot to push the boundaries of what's possible. At Pulumi, we dream big, in the pursuit of helping our customers out\-innovate and win. Founded in 2017 by industry veterans with over five decades of combined experience building developer platforms, Pulumi now has a global community of more than 350,000 members and serves over 3,250 customers. Despite our rapid growth, we're still only getting started, and are early in our mission to democratize the cloud. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-performance, we want to work with you to accelerate Pulumi's impact. *At Pulumi, we don't just accept difference, we celebrate, support, and thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our customers. Pulumi is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- United States \& Canada; Remote \- Canada; Remote \- US **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering Small businesses represent 99\.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi\-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy\-to\-use, AI\-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated \#1 in customer satisfaction on G2\. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top\-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. **About the role** ================== We're looking for a Frontend Engineer to join our Communication squad, part of the Workflow pillar. Communication owns the core of what Quo does: calling, messaging, voicemail, transcription and the workflows that support them. You'll build the interfaces thousands of businesses rely on every day, working alongside product, design, backend engineers and three Senior Frontend Engineers who will support you on architecture while you take on sizeable pieces of work and own them from end to end. This is a role with real room to grow, and we're looking for someone who wants to reach the next level. **Some of the things you'll do:** --------------------------------- * Help us re\-architect calling and standardize how we work with calling providers. * Build new dashboards and tooling, and reliability work that gives us deeper observability into calling performance. * Ship new features and delighters such as URL unfurling, custom transcript summaries, group messaging, direct messages and new calling features. * Own projects from end to end, with support from senior engineers, and take on more ownership as you get familiar with the platform. * Enhance existing features, fix bugs and improve documentation across calling, messaging, voicemail and transcription. * Write your own tests and ship safely through our delivery pipelines. **Technical stack and tools:** ------------------------------ * Our frontend is a Single Page Application built with React and TypeScript, using GraphQL to talk to our backend * We develop in a monorepo powered by pnpm and Turborepo * We use Storybook for component\-driven development * Components are implemented with Vanilla Extract for styles, React Aria, and our existing Design System components * We write tests using Vitest and Playwright, and ship through CI/CD pipelines * Real\-time messaging and calling use WebSockets and WebRTC * Other tools: Figma, Heap, Linear, Notion, Datadog and Slack **About you** ============= * You have experience working with React and TypeScript * You understand how data flows from the backend to the frontend, including GraphQL, schemas and the basics of database design * You write your own tests (we use Playwright) and are comfortable with integration and unit testing * You enjoy solving problems and collaborating with others to design and build a delightful end user experience * You have some experience with web performance, observability, and accessibility * You take ownership of your work and understand the importance of communication. You hold yourself to a high standard and help empower others to do the same * You are a team player. You're happy to start with bug fixes and documentation to make the team better, you admit mistakes and gaps in your knowledge without shame, and you're quick to back a better idea than your own * You are proactive and self\-driven in a fully remote team. You keep work moving without being chased, pick up the next task when you finish one, and can juggle multiple projects and context switch well * You know that what you ship is felt by thousands of customers, so you are methodical about testing and quality * You are intentional about how your work impacts customers, the community, and each other. You practice empathy, generosity, and thoughtfulness as you evaluate tradeoffs in pursuit of the best solution * You are curious. You seek to understand the 'why' behind things, so that you can better plan and build the 'how'. You don't hesitate to ask questions when necessary. You're a lifelong learner with the drive to grow to the next level * Your code is a pleasure for your teammates to read and understand and you strive to ensure it is readable, testable, and maintainable. When working in the codebase, you leave things better than you found them * You embrace AI and are keen to use it deeply in your day\-to\-day engineering work, rather than shying away from it **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Experience with real\-time messaging technologies such as WebSockets and WebRTC * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and a mature delivery process * Experience building with agentic AI workflows (for example, breaking tickets down, generating features, and testing and verifying the output) **Compensation** ================ The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits: * SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $170,000 \- $200,000 USD * All other US Locations: $153,000 \- $180,000 USD * Canada: $156,000 \- $183,000 CAD The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy. **Who we are** ============== We're a remote\-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you. And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. \#LI\-Remote \#PostLI

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Compensation:** $130\-$140k annual salary **Work Type:** Hybrid (1\-2 potential days in office at 1001 Bluff Rd, Romeoville, IL 60446\) RJW is putting AI agents to work across transportation, warehousing, billing, and EDI integration. You will design and build those agents: choosing the right model, engineering prompts and context, grounding answers in our data with retrieval, and orchestrating agents that use tools, remember context, and work together. Every agent reaches RJW's WMS, TMS, and other systems through our secure MCP gateway, so you build on a governed platform rather than around it. **About the Team:** You will work alongside Operations, business transformation leaders, and the AI \& Automation team to turn real business problems into reliable, measurable AI solutions, built to high standards for security, accuracy, and maintainability. Small teams and short paths to production mean the work you ship changes how a national supply chain runs. You'll take on high\-volume integrations, retailer compliance, warehouse automation, and data at scale. **What you will do:** * Design, build, and deploy AI agents for transportation, warehousing, billing, and EDI, choosing the right model, engineering prompts and context, and orchestrating tools, memory, and multi\-agent workflows. * Ground agent answers in RJW data using retrieval\-augmented generation and other grounded AI patterns. * Connect agents to RJW's WMS, TMS, and other systems through our secure MCP gateway, building the APIs, serverless workflows, and integrations they rely on. * Build evaluation sets, test cases, and regression checks, so every agent is predictable, grounded, and safe before and after it ships. * Monitor agents in production, troubleshoot issues to root cause, and continuously improve their performance. * Evaluate new models and AI platform capabilities and recommend what to adopt based on value, risk, and cost. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Strong Python skills and solid software development practices, including Git, code review, testing, and deployment. * Hands\-on knowledge of large language models, prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and common AI failure modes. * Experience with APIs, authentication, integrations, and structured and unstructured data. * Ability to design AI solutions that are grounded, testable, secure, auditable, maintainable, and attributable to root cause. * Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Two to five years of experience in software, data, or AI engineering. * Experience with Azure AI services, MCP, or agent orchestration frameworks. * A track record of shipping production AI, automation, or integration solutions. * Experience in warehousing, logistics, transportation, or other operationally complex environments. **About RJW:** RJW Logistics Group are The Retail Logistics Experts. Since 1981, we've gotten consumer goods onto retail shelves faster and cheaper than the industry thinks is possible. We own our trucking fleet, our warehouses, and our proprietary technology, which delivers 98%\+ on\-time, in\-full performance and has grown our network to 22 facilities and 15\.5 million square feet. Technology drives that growth, and our engineers build it. **Benefits:** * Company MyShare program * 401(k) matching * Medical/Dental/Vision insurance * Employee discount * Flexible spending account * Health savings account * Paid time off * Sick Days * Long\-term Disability Insurance * Short\-term Disability Insurance * Accidental Insurance * Critical Illness Insurance * Disability Insurance Req Benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability, paid holidays, time off, retirement savings plan participation, and additional employee programs. jobs.title: Senior Regulatory Engineer
jobs.description: **About Radiant** ----------------- Radiant is an El Segundo, CA\-based company building the world's only mass\-produced, transportable nuclear microreactors. The U.S. grid is under growing strain, with power demand accelerating, driving higher utility costs, rising carbon emissions, and interconnection backlogs. Radiant has a solution, transportable, on\-site power. Our first reactor, Kaleidos, is 1 megawatt: small enough to be factory\-built, transported by land, sea, or air, and deployed wherever power is needed. 1 MW can power 1000 homes for five years. Ship it back and we refuel for a 20 year operating life. We made energy a product that can be used for critical infrastructure like military bases, data centers, hospitals, and remote sites, as well as the commercial main street businesses that keep America running. Founded in 2020, Radiant is under contract to deliver power to the U.S. Army, Navy and Air Force and has signed pre\-order agreements with Equinix, with deployments beginning in 2028\. **About the Role** ------------------ Radiant is seeking a driven **Senior Regulatory Engineer** who loves to think outside the box and challenge convention; in this role you will support the license application approval process with the Nuclear Regulatory Commission. This role is critical to bringing the world’s first portable nuclear microreactor to commercialization in a timely manner. You will be a go to subject matter expert for the regulatory process and collaborate across technical teams to inform design, build and test campaigns. You will lead interactions between regulators and the engineering team to obtain clarity and answers on regulation. You will integrate analysis and test results from the design teams with supporting justifications and own the deliverables that make up a full license application. This is an exciting opportunity for systems engineers who enjoy both technical work and operational execution. You will have direct ownership of modernize regulatory strategy to bring the safest microreactor to market in the shortest timeline. **Responsibilities \& Duties:** * Own end to end licensing execution efforts required to fulfill an application deliverable, ranging from detailed safety analysis to a physical protection plan. * Facilitate collaborative and cohesive partnerships with internal stakeholders and external regulatory bodies (NRC) to drive desirable results using streamlined, modern regulatory approaches. * Oversee execution by technical teams including design reviews and regulatory and quality documentation; organize their inputs into data products and reports; raise regulatory concerns and see through timely and successful resolution. * Proactively review approaches and decisions as they relate to regulatory efforts to ensure adherence to Radiant’s novel and efficient licensing paths. * Ensure completeness, timeliness, and quality of licensing and regulatory submissions. * Write software scripts to automate and produce data analysis and documentation. **Required Qualification \& Skills:** * Bachelor’s degree in one of the following disciplines: nuclear engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or similar technical field from an accredited institution. * 5\+ years of experience certifying, regulating, qualifying or auditing hardware that was manufactured, deployed, and iteratively improved. * Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation abilities; ability to navigate regulatory conversations effectively and write technical documentation. * Applied understanding of requirement derivation, negotiation and verification or experience with the product design process especially as it relates to defining systems, interfaces and specifications. **Desired Qualifications \& Skills:** * 5\+ years of experience working in a manufacturing environment with strict regulatory oversight. * Experience working on a nuclear project with DOE or NRC regulation. * Experience tailoring or implementing NQA\-1, ISO9001, AS9100, or other industrial standards. * Experience owning, designing, building, or testing hardware that has seen production. * Ability to apply fundamental engineering principles to regulatory efforts. * Strong ability to lead issues through resolution that may be ambiguous or uncertain in nature. * Excellent project management skills and experience in driving schedules forward. **Additional Requirements:** * Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission * Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full\-time employees. * Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee \+ 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans. * One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents. * Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage \+ 50% for dependents. * Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents. * Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits. * 8\-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees. * Nuclear Engineering Certificate Program: 100% covered educational program with Penn State University, for eligible employees, to rapidly upscale into nuclear. * Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks. * Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation. * Company and team\-bonding events, happy hours and in\-person camaraderie. * Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean. **Total Compensation and Benefits** Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant. The best of today’s advanced reactor builders don’t wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If that’s you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com. *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.* Compensation Range: $133,500 \- $190,050
