jobs.title: Senior Piping Designer
jobs.description: ### **About Re:Build** At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions. We operate an advanced, end\-to\-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full\-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation. The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)* **About Re:Build Optimation** ----------------------------- At Re:Build Optimation, we specialize in delivering custom\-engineered process equipment and automated systems to clients across the globe. With nearly 40 years of experience in complex chemical process systems, we have built a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation. Our multidisciplinary team of 70\+ engineers, designers, and programmers, combined with 150,000 square feet of fabrication space and over 70 skilled tradespeople, allows us to provide full turnkey solutions—from initial concept through fabrication, installation, and commissioning. As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we leverage the strength of a national industrial powerhouse while maintaining the agility and personalized service of a niche firm. We serve industries ranging from traditional and green energy to chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food \& beverage, glass, and advanced manufacturing, offering tailored solutions that optimize efficiency and performance. At Re:Build Optimation, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with our clients to develop solutions that align with their unique operational goals. Our deep industry expertise and end\-to\-end capabilities make us the ideal partner for companies seeking cutting\-edge automation, process control, and engineered systems. **Who We Are Looking For** We are looking for an experienced Senior Piping Designer who turns P\&IDs and process requirements into buildable, code\-compliant piping for skid\-based, modular and containerized systems. You own piping design from early layout through detailed isometrics and release for fabrication, and you know when to bring in engineering for stress, supports and nozzle loads. Whether your background is in chemical, pharmaceutical, energy, food and beverage, water treatment or other process industries, you understand how piping is fabricated, installed and maintained, and you design with that in mind. You are comfortable working directly with clients. You communicate clearly, ask the right questions, and turn their input into clear, documented project requirements the team can build from. You take ownership of your systems, check the work of other designers, and help raise our piping standards while staying hands\-on. This position is based onsite in Rochester and/or Rush, NY, with occasional travel to customer and supplier locations, typically less than 25%. **What You Get To Do** * **Lead** piping design for skids, modules and containerized systems, from P\&IDs through detailed design and release for fabrication. * **Develop** piping layouts and routing in 3D, and produce plans, sections, isometrics, spool drawings and piping bills of material. * **Select** and specify pipe, fittings, flanges, valves, supports and in\-line instruments to project pipe specs and ASME B31\.3 (or B31\.1 as applicable). * **Design** pipe supports and work with engineering on stress, thermal growth, flexibility and nozzle loads. * **Collaborate** with mechanical, electrical, controls, and manufacturing teams to develop integrated equipment and system designs. * **Lead** technical design reviews, evaluate design solutions, and provide guidance to project teams and customers. * **Partner** with fabrication and assembly teams to resolve technical challenges and support successful equipment builds and installations. * **Support** project planning, technical proposals, and engineering estimates. * **Mentor** junior designers and drafters, providing technical guidance and reviewing design work. * **Improve** design standards, tools, and processes to enhance quality, consistency, and efficiency. **What You Bring To The Team** **Required** * 7\+ years of piping design experience in an industrial process, chemical, energy or engineering\-services environment. * Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD 2D/3D and a 3D plant design tool such as AutoCAD Plant 3D, CADWorx or SolidWorks Routing. * Strong working knowledge of ASME B31\.3, pipe specifications, P\&ID interpretation, and valve and fitting selection. * Experience producing fabrication\-ready isometrics, spool drawings and piping bills of material. * Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, manufacturing processes, dimensioning, tolerances, and fabrication requirements. * Ability to independently manage complex design assignments from concept through detailed design and release. * Experience reviewing technical drawings, solving design challenges, and collaborating with engineering and manufacturing teams. * Strong communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to provide technical guidance to other designers. * An associate degree, bachelor's degree, technical certification or equivalent experience in Drafting/Design, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering or a related field. * Commitment to safety, quality and continuous improvement. * Ability to work onsite in Rochester and/or Rush, NY, with travel up to 25%. **Preferred** * Pipe stress analysis experience (Caesar II) or close work with stress engineers. * Experience with skid\-mounted or modular process systems and their fabrication. * Experience with 3D laser scans and point clouds. * Familiarity with pressure vessel design (ASME Section VIII) and SolidWorks. * Experience developing technical estimates, supporting proposals, or participating in customer design reviews. * Experience mentoring junior designers or leading technical design activities. * Knowledge of industrial safety standards and equipment design requirements. CloudFront, WAF and ArgoCD/Helm\-based deployments. * Familiarity with event\-driven architectures using Kafka and caching patterns with Redis. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI) and observability tooling (New Relic, Splunk). * Experience using AI and LLM\-powered tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to speed up engineering work, including code generation, automated code review and test coverage. * Strong empathy for consumers and a passion for making secure experiences feel effortless. * A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Experience retiring a legacy identity or authentication system, or migrating users between identity providers. * Experience with consumer profile, preference or customer data platforms. * Experience running login or registration experiments with tools like Amplitude. * Familiarity with AI\-driven threat and anomaly detection for identity security, such as bot detection, credential stuffing identification and behavioral anomaly signals. * Experience setting team standards for AI\-assisted development workflows. engineering practices, architecture, and technical priorities as our team grows. **Who You Are** We're looking for a curious, resourceful engineer who enjoys building products, solving challenging jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Ledger
jobs.description: Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. **What You'll Do:** Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy. We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero\-balanced, double\-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026\. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature. **You Have:** * 4\+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs). * Strong problem\-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems. * Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams. * Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field. * Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non\-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double\-entry system at another company is a strong plus. * Experience with large\-scale data or analytical systems (OLAP, event\-driven pipelines, or similar) is a plus but not a requirement. **You will**: * Work closely with Finance, product, and other economy engineering teams to make every movement of value correct at the source. * Architect, design, implement, and operate the ledger services that record every movement of value on Roblox. * Proactively identify and address correctness, performance, auditability, and operational risks in systems where a single bad entry is a financial incident. * Design idempotent, exactly\-once write paths, plus the reconciliation that proves the books balance and the precision guarantees other teams build on. * Own both sides of the ledger: the write path that records value, and the read path that serves balances, history, and analytics from the same source of truth. * Uphold high standards for code quality, test coverage, and maintainability, fostering the culture of engineering excellence. Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). jobs.title: AI Engineer, Customer Success
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Samsara's Commercial Customer Success team supports hundreds of customers who depend on our platform every day to manage their fleets, equipment, and operations. These customers don't just need software — they need a partner who helps them get to value fast, identifies and mitigates risk, and keeps finding new ways to put Samsara to work for their business. We're building the AI infrastructure to make that possible at scale. And we need an applied AI specialist to build it — and own it. As an embedded AI Engineer in Customer Success, you'll design, build, test, deploy, and continuously maintain agentic solutions that power this next chapter. You'll own the full lifecycle: from the first prompt through production, from launch through every iteration as our Customer Success playbooks evolve, and as our product ships new features and real\-world performance data surfaces what needs to change next. The agents you build will only be as good as the care you put into keeping them relevant and reliable over time. **This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US** **except** **the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.** **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. * **You thrive the most when solving problems:** Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. * **You are a natural relationship builder:** Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross\-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. **Your core responsibility is the full lifecycle of Samsara's customer\-facing AI agents** **In this role, you will:** * **Build:** Design agent architectures, write prompts, integrate with external systems (Salesforce, Samsara platform, Customer Success tools), and write clean Python code that the team can maintain. * **Test:** Define success criteria and evaluation frameworks before you write the first line of code. Build automated test suites that cover real\-world scenarios, edge cases, and known failure modes. * **Deploy:** Own the deployment, versioning, and rollback plan for every agent. Ensure agents are production\-ready before they reach CSMs or customers. * **Monitor:** Track agent performance in production — monitor accuracy, latency, failure rates, and customer outcomes. Detect drift before anyone has to tell you something's wrong. * **Maintain \& Iterate:** Update agents continuously as Samsara's product evolves, Customer Success playbooks change, and real\-world data indicates what needs improvement. * **Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles** (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices **WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH** **In your first 30 days** * Embed with the Commercial Customer Succes systems * Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar CRM and Customer Success platforms **WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW** * **You'll be first:** This function doesn't exist yet. You'll define the role, the standard, and the playbook for ing in Customer Success * **The problem is real:** A Customer Success Manager managing 350\+ accounts can't do everything manually. AI agents aren't a nice\-to\-have — they're what makes this motion sustainable at Samsara's scale. * **The timing is right:** The models have caught up to the use cases. Samsara has the customer data, the platform context, and the Customer Success team to make these agents genuinely powerful. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

You'll own the infrastructure behind these products, across our own clusters and customer clouds on GCP and AWS. Today, ML engineers handle it alongside feature work. Because of this, we're prepared to offer a competitive salary, equity\-based compensation, and a wide range of benefits that include healthcare (with dental and vision), a 401k, pre\-tax commuter benefits, a flexible work schedule, and a parental leave program. We have a company culture that is relaxed, but engaged, and over a month of paid vacation time. Our Office Management team also plans a myriad of fun company\-wide events. confidence intervals, significance testing, inter\-rater agreement. * Familiarity with at least one eval or observability tool (e.g., Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo, LangSmith, Langfuse, MLflow, or We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work\-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Tools & Al Enablement
jobs.description: At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses. The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity. ### **Who We Are** We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real\-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end\-to\-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully. **JOB OVERVIEW** Build practical software that makes Robotics Operations more effective. We are looking for a proactive engineer with a product and entrepreneurial mindset: someone who discovers opportunities, anticipates pain points, and turns them into useful, reliable software. You will deliver improvements quickly and own the tools we rely on, including applications originally built with Al\-assisted coding. You will be an engineer embedded with Operations, taking initiative to understand how teams work and where software can make the biggest difference. You will observe workflows, ask questions, and use feedback and data to uncover unmet needs, including problems users have learned to work around. You will help shape what gets built, rather than wait for a fully defined task list. Think like a product owner and execute as an engineer. Connect everyday friction to the bigger picture: delivery quality, operator effectiveness, and the ability to scale. Choose focused improvements that create meaningful value, test assumptions early, and adapt as you learn. We value initiative, product judgment, and demonstrated impact over the length of an engineering résumé alone. Some solutions will start as lightweight prototypes or Al\-generated applications. Your job is to bring the engineering judgment needed to make them dependable: understand the code, fix defects, improve the design where needed, add appropriate tests and monitoring, and support the application as operational needs and underlying systems change. You will personally build, ship, and maintain production code. Al\-assisted development is encouraged, but you must be able to evaluate the output, debug it independently, and take responsibility for its behavior in production. You will work across several programming languages. Our primary system is Elixir\-heavy. Previous Elixir experience is not required, but you should be ready to learn quickly and become productive developing and maintaining Elixir applications. You will also work with applications and services on Google Cloud Platform (GP). You will work cross\-functionally with Operations, Product Engineering, and other technical teams to make sure local improvements work with the wider system. Build shared understanding, surface dependencies early, and drive decisions through completion. You will know when a small Operations tool is the right answer, when an existing solution can be reused, and when a problem requires a coordinated change to shared services or core product functionality. **JOB DUTIES** * Discover needs before they become urgent. Proactively explore workflows with Operations, identify recurring friction and emerging failure points, and propose improvements before teams need to escalate a problem. * Prioritize and deliver quick wins. Connect opportunities to operational goals, assess user impact, effort, and risk, and choose the smallest useful solution. Make clear recommendations about what to build, improve, reuse, or leave alone. * Build iteratively with users. Deliver small, useful changes, gather feedback early, and refine solutions based on how people use them. Keep the scope focused while ensuring the result is safe and fit for its intended use. * Own Operations applications. Maintain and improve internal tools, dashboards, automations, and integrations, including applications initially created through Al\-assisted coding. Diagnose issues, resolve bugs, and keep tools working as dependencies and requirements evolve. * Develop across our stack. Contribute in several languages, ramp up quickly on our Elixir\-heavy core system, and build, deploy, troubleshoot, and support applications on Google Cloud Platform. \&X. Metaview * Bring engineering discipline to Al\-built software. Review generated code, understand its dependencies and data access, address security and reliability gaps, and add tests, documentation, monitoring, and maintainable structure appropriate to the appl m experience. You have built, deployed, or supported applications and services on GCP and can troubleshoot their behavior in a cloud environment. * Ability to learn and contribute across languages. You can become productive quickly in an unfamiliar stack. Prior Elixir experience is not required; learning it quickly and contributing to our Elixir\-heavy system is an expectation of the role. * Experience building useful applications, internal tools, automations, or integrations for business or operational users. * A proactive, self\-starting approach. You can find a worthwhile problem, investigate it independently, propose a path forward, and take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions. * Product and entrepreneurial judgment. You understand user needs, challenge assumptions, balance speed with quality, and focus effort on solutions people will use. You can create clarity and momentum when the problem or solution is not yet well defined. * Big\-picture thinking. You connect a local workflow improvement to broader operational goals, recognize upstream and downstream effects, and avoid optimizing one tool at the expense of the wider system. * Sound judgment about testing, code review, access controls, sensitive data, dependency management, observability, and production support. * A practical, iterative approach: you can deliver a small improvement quickly without losing sight of reliability, maintainability, or user needs. * Ability to work directly with non\-engineering users, clarify ambiguous requests, explain tradeoffs, and turn feedback into working improvements. * Cross\-functional leadership through influence: you can bring operational and engineering perspectives together, explain tradeoffs, secure alignment, and keep work moving through release and adoption. * Interest in Al\-assisted development and workflow automation, paired with the ability to validate results and recognize limitations. * Previous experience managing an operations team is not required. This role is centered on building and supporting software for Operations, rather than managing a program or coordinating other engineers' delivery. Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills * Experience with operator\-facing applications, workflow automation, dashboards, or fleet and robotics tools. * Full\-stack development experience, including user interfaces, services, APls, and data integrations. * Previous experience developing applications in Elixir. * Experience taking a prototype or lightly engineered application into dependable operational use. * Effective use of Al coding assistants, with examples of reviewing, correcting, testing, and maintaining their output. * Experience owning a product or internal tool from discovery through adoption and iteration, or building useful solutions in an entrepreneurial environment. * Experience helping non\-technical teams adopt Al tools responsibly. * Robotics, autonomous vehicles, logistics, delivery, or other technology\-enabled field operations experience. What success looks like * Operations receives useful improvements in short iterations, with feedback shaping subsequent work. * Important needs and risks are surfaced early, with solutions initiated before they become urgent requests or recurring incidents. * Tools are adopted and deliver measurable value, with low\-value ideas changed or stopped based on evidence. * Cross\-functional partners have clear ownership and fewer surprises as tools and underlying systems evolve. * High\-value internal applications have clear technical ownership and dependable support. * Al\-built tools become easier to understand, test, change, and maintain. * Changes to shared engineering systems cause fewer avoidable disruptions to Operations tools. * Teams spend less time on repetitive work and recurring software issues. * Al adoption produces practical benefits without compromising data handling, reliability, or engineering standards. Compensation Range: $180K \- $200K

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description: **About SkyPilot** ------------------ SkyPilot accelerates the world's most ambitious AI teams. SkyPilot turns fragmented AI compute across clusters into one optimized, highly available and easy\-to\-use pool: a single AI supercomputer. SkyPilot (10k\+ GitHub stars, 18M\+ downloads) manages the GPU fleets of 100s of companies, from Fortune 500s to top AI\-natives like Abridge, Applied Compute, Mistral, Unconventional AI, H Company, and Nubank, with usage growing exponentially. Born in the UC Berkeley lab behind Spark and Databricks, our growing team includes top\-tier talent from Databricks, Google, Berkeley, MIT, CMU, and Cornell. To date, SkyPilot has raised over $20M in seed funding from top investors (incl. Lux, Coatue, Amplify) and operators (incl. Ali Ghodsi, Jeff Dean, Guillermo Rauch, Amjad Masad, Clem Delangue, Aaron Levie). **The role** ------------ SkyPilot already runs inside some of the most advanced AI teams in the world, and we're hiring our Account Executive to turn that adoption into revenue. You'll own the full cycle — sourcing the pipeline, running technical sales, and closing net\-new business with AI\-native companies, foundation labs, and enterprises. You'll build SkyPilot's sales motion from the ground up, partner directly with the founders, and write the playbook the whole sales org will run as we scale. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the full cycle**: prospect, qualify, run technical evaluations alongside our Forward Deployed Engineers, and close net\-new business. * **Win the frontier AI teams**: land and expand the kinds of accounts already running SkyPilot — Abridge, Applied Compute, Mistral, and others — where the buyer is a technical leader choosing the backbone for their most important workloads. * **Wear many hats**: source your own pipeline, build the deck and the process, and own every lever of the deal from first touch to signature. * **Write the playbook**: turn what closes into a repeatable motion — messaging, qualification, pricing feedback — that the growing GTM team runs. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * A track record of closing net\-new business, ideally selling technical infrastructure or developer and data platforms to technical buyers. * **Strongly preferred:** you've sold compute, GPUs, or infrastructure to frontier AI teams or large GPU\-consuming organizations. * You've carried a number without a big machine behind you and want to build the next one from scratch. * Genuinely fluent with engineers and technical leaders — you can run a credible conversation about infrastructure. * Comfortable co\-owning the motion with founders and bringing field signal back into the product. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation and equity. * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision coverage for you and your dependents. * Company 401(k) plan. * The chance to work with some of the best minds in cloud, distributed, and AI systems — with significant autonomy and ownership. * A front\-row seat at the latest open\-source infra startup from Berkeley. * Gourmet lunch \& dinner for the team to do their best work. **Location:** San Mateo, CA. Remote will be considered for exceptional candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Application Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Senior Electrical Application Engineer is the senior technical authority for Slingco's lineman tools and equipment, including live\-line tools, temporary protective grounding, voltage detection, and related equipment used by utility line crews. The position applies electrical engineering expertise to how these products perform in the field, protect the lineworker, and meet utility and industry standards. It supports product definition and the NPD process, leads resolution of complex field and customer issues, and represents Slingco in the technical organizations that establish the company as a key player in the utility market. **KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Technical Authority \& Field Support** * Serve as the go\-to technical resource on the electrical application and performance of Slingco lineman tools and equipment * Lead root\-cause investigation of escalated field failures and customer issues, with emphasis on electrical failure modes (fault\-current damage, dielectric performance, connection integrity) * Provide technical guidance to utility customers, distributors, and the Sales team on product selection and application * Support product quality assessments and corrective actions **Product Definition \& Development (NPD)** * Provide electrical engineering input to product definition and the product roadmap * Alongside the Product team, interface with utility end users to capture market requirements for new products * Drive the NPD process through Stages 0 and 1, including: * Defining electrical performance criteria and ratings * Analyzing competitor products * Reviewing compliance requirements * Conducting the initial patent search * Preparing the initial project budget * Collaborate with Design Engineers to ensure final designs meet electrical and safety requirements * Support value engineering, reverse engineering, and product enhancements **Standards \& Compliance** * Lead technical work to register and qualify Slingco products against utility and industry standards * Ensure operation and maintenance manuals are compliant with national and local requirements * Serve as an active member of relevant technical organizations (IEEE, ASTM) **Training \& Knowledge Sharing** * Develop technical training for internal teams, distributors, and utility customers * Mentor Application Engineers on electrical topics * Attend trade shows and customer meetings as needed **PERSON SPECIFICATION:** * Electrical engineering applied to utility T\&D systems (required) * Working knowledge of fault current / short\-circuit current (symmetrical RMS amps, duration, and clearing time) and how temporary protective grounding assemblies are sized to carry fault current until protective devices clear * Understanding of temporary protective grounding (TPG) systems, including ground clamps, cable assemblies, ferrules, and cluster bars, and their withstand and current\-carrying ratings * Familiarity with how utility line crews work, including live\-line and de\-energized work practices in T\&D field environments * Familiarity with IEEE 1048: Guide for Protective Grounding of Power Lines * Working knowledge of manufacturing techniques (machining, casting, molding, stamping) and materials (metals, plastics, rubber, insulating composites) as they apply to lineman tools and equipment * Familiarity with Autodesk Inventor or similar solid\-modelling software (helpful, not required) * Proficient using MS Office software * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting technical content to customers * Self\-starter, able to prioritize workload and operate with minimal direction * Hands\-on approach to product evaluation, testing, and reverse engineering **EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS:** * BSEE desired. Candidates with equivalent utility electrical or power\-systems experience will be considered in lieu of the degree * Experience in utility T\&D, power systems, or electrical engineering for products used by utility line crews * Experience with utilities, lineman tool and equipment manufacturers, or utility test and standards bodies strongly preferred * Applied experience with arc flash hazard analysis: incident energy, arc flash boundary, and the relationship between fault current, clearing time, and worker exposure * Working knowledge and demonstrated experience applying ASTM F855: Temporary Protective Grounds for use on de\-energized electric power lines and equipment * Working knowledge and demonstrated experience applying NFPA 70E / IEEE 1584: Electrical safety in the workplace and arc\-flash hazard calculation * Working knowledge and demonstrated experience applying OSHA 1910\.269: Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution **COMPANY BACKGROUND:** SLINGCO is an award\-winning supplier of high\-quality tools and accessories for the installation and handling of cable, with over 40 years of industry heritage. We serve customers in over 70 countries worldwide from our head office in Lancashire, UK, and bases in Georgia, USA, and Bengaluru, India. Our products are used in safety critical applications for a wide range of markets. With sectors including oil \& gas, civil engineering, aerospace, transport, utilities, marine/offshore and the military – there’s no room for error. That’s why we do everything with the utmost care and precision. We design and manufacture to the highest specifications and test to destruction. If our products don’t meet and exceed the most stringent national and international standards, they’re not good enough for our customers. At Slingco, our goal is to create innovative high\-quality products that our customers can depend on, whilst providing a positive experience for our customers and our employees. Every aspect of our work, culture and commitment to innovation is driven by our core values. **LOCATION** * Smyrna, GA **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** * Competitive base salary * Health and retirement benefits * PTO

Your expertise in modern back\-end technologies, cloud computing, and the full software development lifecycle will be essential in delivering high\-quality solutions in a fintech and proptech ecosystem. The salary range for this position is $140,000 \- $155,000\. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **About You** * 4\-6 years of experience as a full\-stack engineer with a strong focus on back\-end technologies * Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript for front\-end and back\-end development * Strong experience with Node.js for building server\-side applications * Expertise in PostgreSQL (or similar) and database design * Experience with cloud computing platforms, specifically AWS Lambda * Extensive experience working with Claude Code (or similar) to build tools and workflows that accelerate the development lifecycle; not just individual chat use or vibe coding * Hands\-on experience working with Infrastructure\-as\-Code using Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation * Experience implementing and working with modern analytics tools for event tracking and reporting (Mixpanel, Posthog, Google Analytics, etc) * Strong experience working with testing and quality engineering tools such as Playwright, Jest, and/or Mocha * Solid understanding of modern cloud computing pipelines and the full software development lifecycle * Proven experience working directly with product and QA teams to ensure high\-quality software delivery * Experience with Heroku Connect and Salesforce platforms is a plus * Candidates must be located in the United States. Working timezone in PST or MST preferred. * Ability to break down complex technical problems and deliver high\-quality solutions. * Effective communication skills and a track record of collaboration with cross\-functional teams. * Desire to participate in fast\-paced early\-stage startup * Adaptability: Embraces changing circumstances with resiliency and positivity * Team\-Oriented: Prioritizes collaboration, inclusivity, and teammate support **About Us** Millions of homeowners in today's economy are sitting on substantial home equity they are unable to access due to rising interest rates and strict qualification requirements of traditional lenders. That means millions of homeowners can't convert their hard\-earned equity into cash to pay off debt, start a home renovation, or pad their retirement to better their lives. Splitero co\-founders Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler witnessed the problem firsthand throughout their real estate careers. They set out to create a win\-win product that could help those homeowners access their home equity but not make monthly payments like traditional financing options. And thus, Splitero was born. As part of our team, you will join our quest to revolutionize the real estate industry while helping families in need. We offer a suite of benefits designed to help you thrive in all areas of life. * **OneTeam Culture \-** We foster a culture of transparency, innovation, and inclusivity, where every voice is heard and every team member is valued. We believe in celebrating our successes, doing the right thing, and helping each other so we grow as a team and as individuals. * **Generous Resources \-** We want to ensure you are set up to do your best work. In addition to a solid tech stack, and access to any WeWork location, you will receive a monthly cell and internet stipend. * **Premium Healthcare \-** We offer comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family, which employees are eligible for on their first day. * **Flexible PTO and Parental Leave \-** We offer a generous PTO and encourage employees to take time off to recharge. We're proud to offer a parental leave policy that allows you to welcome your new addition without worry. We are a workforce composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds, abilities, minds, and identities. In keeping with our commitment to inclusion, we will ensure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are required when applying, interviewing, or performing the essential functions of this position, please contact People Operations, at peopleops@splitero.com.

jobs.description: Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user\-friendly, cost\-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention. Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. jobs.title: Jr. Staff Android Engineer
jobs.description: Job ID: 2022704 Career Area: Software Electric \& Electronics Position Type: Salaried Location: Headquarters \& Technology Center – Auburn Hills 48326, US Date Posted: November 4, 2026 Brand: FCA Group **The Mission:** We are building the next generation of connected digital cockpits, bridging high\-performance vehicle hardware with intuitive, cloud\-connected experiences. In this role, you will initially tackle critical platform security and connectivity challenges: establishing hardware\-backed trust with Qualcomm silicon, securing backend communication channels, and tuning network routing inside a virtualized Android environment. At the same time, we don’t believe in rigid silos. While your initial focus will be anchoring these core platform and security foundations, you will be part of an adaptable engineering team. As the platform matures, you will have plenty of room to flex across the broader Android stack—collaborating on core system services, framework features, and user\-facing capabilities across the digital cockpit. **What You Will Work On:** Initial Platform \& Security Focus: * **Hardware\-Backed Trust \&** **mTLS****:** Connect Android’s Keystore / KeyMint layer with Qualcomm TrustZone hardware to safely manage certificates, keys, and token lifecycles for secure mutual TLS (mTLS) communication with the backend. * **Network \& Multi\-APN Routing:** Configure Android networking pipelines, cellular APN policies, and DNS whitelisting to cleanly route private telematics, cloud APIs, and consumer traffic through their intended channels. * **Hypervisor Network Integration:** Work with virtual network interfaces (virtio\-net, bridging) spanning the host hypervisor and the guest Android OS to ensure reliable, high\-throughput data transport. * **Platform Hardening \&** **SELinux****:** Write and refine SELinux policies (sepolicy) and define clean Binder IPC boundaries to keep platform services secure, stable, and compliant. * **Identity \& Secure Transport:** Support user profile isolation (IAM), secure storage for JWTs and session tokens, and reliable telemetry messaging using protocols like MQTT over TLS. Looking Ahead (Generalist \& Platform Evolution): * Build, extend, and maintain Android framework services and system applications that power core cockpit experiences. * Collaborate across teams on modern Android development—from IPC and background services to application logic and developer tooling. * Help shape architecture, code quality, and engineering standards as our software footprint continues to grow. **What We Are Looking For:** * **Strong Android Foundations:** Solid, hands\-on experience developing in Android—comfortable working with Kotlin, Java, and navigating the Android framework. * **Platform \& Systems Curiosity:** Practical experience with, or a strong desire to dive deep into, AOSP internals, native C/C\+\+ services, and Binder/AIDL IPC. * **Security \& Crypto Awareness:** Familiarity with TLS/mTLS, PKI/certificates, token\-based authentication (JWT, OAuth2\), and leveraging Android’s KeyStore or hardware security modules (Qualcomm TrustZone / KeyMint). * **Networking Fundamentals:** A solid grasp of IP networking, DNS, routing concepts, and socket communications in Linux or Android environments. * **Pragmatic Generalist Mindset:** You enjoy solving tough infrastructure and security puzzles, but you’re equally excited to pivot and build feature\-level Android code as team priorities evolve. **EOE/Disability/Veteran** At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome applications from all people without regard to sex, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any characteristic protected by law. We believe that diverse teams reflect our identity as a global company, enabling us to better address the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future. jobs.description: About the Role: We are looking for a motivated Junior Software Engineer – Connectivity to join our automotive engineering team. In this role, you will help develop and integrate cutting\-edge connectivity solutions that enable seamless communication between vehicles, mobile devices, cloud services, and infrastructure. You will contribute to the future of connected vehicles, supporting features such as over\-the\-air updates, telematics services, V2X, and infotainment systems. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain embedded software for in\-vehicle OTA * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including hardware, systems, cybersecurity, and cloud services to deliver robust OTA features. * Support diagnostics, logging, and troubleshooting of connectivity issues in bench and vehicle environments. * Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and continuous integration. * Ensure compliance with automotive standards such as ASPICE, ISO 26262, and AUTOSAR where applicable. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * A minimum of 2 years of experience as a cloud or embedded engineer * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ and scripting languages such as Python. * Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and issue tracking tools (e.g., JIRA). * Exposure to embedded systems **Preferred Qualifications:** * A minimum of 1 year of experience in embedded software development, preferably in the automotive domain. * Exposure to telematics, V2X, or over\-the\-air (OTA) update systems. * Familiarity with automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, UDS) and tools (e.g., CANoe, CANalyzer). * Understanding of wireless communication technologies (Bluetooth, Wi\-Fi, LTE/5G). * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and vehicle data pipelines. **Our Benefits \- Designed with You in Mind** **Comprehensive Health \& Well\-being Coverage** From your very first day, you'll have access to medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage \- ensuring you and your family stay healthy and protected. **Generous Paid Time Off** We believe in work\-life balance. That's why we offer: 17\+ paid holidays, including shut\-down from December 24th through New Years Day every year. Vacation, float \& wellbeing days, sick time and fully paid parental leave when your family needs you most. **Competitive Retirement Savings Plans** We help you plan for the future with: * An employer match on contributions to your 401k, Roth, and Catch\-Up plans * An employer contribution, even if you don't contribute **Income Protection \& Insurance Options** Benefit from included and optional disability, life, and other insurance programs \- because your peace of mind matters. **Company Vehicle Lease Program** Eligible employees and their immediate families can enjoy company vehicle lease options with included insurance, maintenance, and unlimited mileage. Plus, take advantage of exclusive discounts on Stellantis products. **Family Building Benefit** We proudly support all paths to parenthood\- including fertility and infertility treatments, adoption services, and gestational surrogacy. **Support for Your Growth and Giving Back** We believe in investing in your future and your passions: * Tuition reimbursement * Student loan refinancing programs * 18 paid volunteer hours each year to make a difference in your community **And so much more!** When you join us, you're not just building a career \- you're joining a company that supports you, inside and outside of work.

jobs.title: Principal, Cybersecurity Automation - Remote
jobs.description: ### **Why join Stryker?** Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture. We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description** We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits. The Principal Security Automation \& AI Engineer is the senior technical leader responsible for automation and AI across Cyber Defense. This role designs, builds, and operates scalable automation and AI solutions that reduce repetitive work, accelerate security operations, and allow analysts to focus on higher\-value decision\-making. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will write code, establish technical standards, and build the foundational patterns others use. You will determine where AI can safely improve security operations, where human oversight is required, and measure the impact of solutions in production. All automation must be reliable, auditable, secure, and appropriate for the data it handles. Preference will be given to candidates located in Eastern or Central time zones to support effective collaboration during core business hours. **What You Will Do** -------------------- **Security Automation** * Own and prioritize the Cyber Defense automation roadmap based on analyst capacity gained, risk reduction, business impact, and implementation effort. * Design, build, and operate automation for alert triage, enrichment, containment, case management, and notification. * Extend automation across vulnerability management and threat intelligence, including asset context, remediation tracking, and indicator handling. * Build and maintain integrations across endpoint security, detection engineering, security data platforms, asset inventory, threat intelligence, and ticketing systems. **AI \& Agentic Security** * Identify and implement high\-value AI use cases across security operations, including triage, investigation summaries, detection development, and reporting. * Design, build, and operate AI agents and assistants using least privilege, scoped tool access, and human approval for consequential actions. * Develop evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, reliability, consistency, and failure modes before and after deployment. * Implement safeguards against risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and excessive agent permissions while keeping regulated data within approved environments. * Evaluate vendor AI capabilities against internally developed solutions and provide clear build, buy, or wait recommendations. **Engineering Excellence** * Treat automation, detections, prompts, and AI configurations as code using version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, and appropriate change controls. * Operate production automation with monitoring, error handling, runbooks, rollback capabilities, and ongoing performance management. * Partner with Security Architecture, Privacy, Legal, and IT teams to support jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Core AI
jobs.description: **About Sycamore** ================== Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need. We are a small, engineering\-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders. **Where you could focus** ========================= Core AI owns the horizontal runtime, intelligence, and improvement capabilities that Product and Infrastructure both depend on, along with the Sycamore Forge experiences that make them usable. Engineers here own end\-to\-end slices, from cloud service and API design through the React interface. The team covers four related areas, and you do not have to pick one to apply. Tell us what you have built and we will work out the fit together. **The agent runtime.** Multi\-turn sessions, model routing, tool execution, memory, durable workflows, and the APIs that expose them. The hard part is correctness across long horizons: surviving retries, provider interruptions, partial failure, and context growth without losing the thread. **Harnesses and environments.** An agent that writes and runs code needs somewhere to do it. That environment has to start fast, isolate genuinely untrusted execution, reach only the services it legitimately needs, and carry credentials it can use but never read. The same area owns the verification layer that decides whether what an agent produced actually works rather than only appears to. **Evaluation.** Agent quality is genuinely hard to measure. A change that looks better on a handful of examples often is not, and a judge model can be confidently wrong in the same direction as the system it grades. This is where the offline suites, replay corpora, and statistical discipline that gate a release come from. **Self\-improving systems.** Every agent run produces evidence, and almost all of it is currently thrown away. This area turns it into improvement: structured trajectories at fleet scale, failure clusters surfaced from production rather than guessed at, and proposed changes that are versioned, measured, staged, and reversible. **What you will do** ==================== * Develop the learning data plane around agents: structured trajectories, feedback and outcome signals, offline datasets, lineage, privacy controls, and reliable links between an agent version and its behavior. * Create evaluation systems for task completion, tool use, long\-horizon behavior, safety, latency, and cost, and own the credibility of the numbers they produce. * Design experiment and versioning systems for comparing changes through replay, shadow traffic, canaries, or controlled rollouts, with clear promotion and rollback criteria. * Build durable orchestration for long\-running tasks, checkpoints, approvals, handoffs, and human\-in\-the\-loop interactions, with typed tool interfaces, protocol\-based execution, and memory retrieval that enforces tenant, user, and project visibility boundaries. * Own the execution environments agents run in, including isolation, startup performance, resource limits, and cost, and the policy layer that gates self\-modification so a proposed change is staged and tested rather than applied silently. * Publish reliable APIs, event\-driven interfaces, and reusable libraries that work across agent categories and enterprise deployments. **The environment you will work in** ==================================== Our current Core AI environment includes Python cloud services; React and TypeScript product surfaces in Sycamore Forge; asynchronous and streaming systems; typed APIs and data models; relational and vector data; durable workflows; protocol\-based tool execution; multiple model providers; and cloud\-native deployment. We use coding agents, automated tests, traces, evaluations, browser automation, offline replay, cost and latency signals, and production feedback as part of everyday engineering. We are building toward a governed collect, learn, evaluate, and apply loop rather than a single monolithic training system. This is context, not a checklist. We do not require previous experience with every language, framework, model provider, cloud platform, database, or infrastructure tool in our stack. Comparable experience building distributed runtimes, experimentation platforms, retrieval or recommendation systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or production AI systems is highly relevant. **What we are looking for** =========================== * 5\-12 years of software engineering experience. We will make exceptions for exceptional people in either direction. * Strong backend and distributed\-systems fundamentals, including typed API design, asynchronous workflows, persistence, reliability, and production debugging. * Real depth in at least one of the areas above, and genuine interest in working across the others. * An empirical approach to AI quality: you can form a hypothesis, design a useful evaluation, interpret noisy evidence, and distinguish a real improvement from movement in a proxy metric. * The ability to reason about retries, idempotency, partial failure, long\-running state, concurrency, latency, cost, experiment design, and safe rollout. * A security\-minded approach to multi\-tenant systems, identity, authorization, credentials, tool execution, privacy, and auditability. * Product judgment. You can find a durable abstraction behind a real requirement without generalizing too early or freezing customer\-specific behavior into the platform. * AI\-native. You use coding agents and modern models as a force multiplier while still owning architecture, correctness, evidence, and operational outcomes. * Comfort building product\-facing software. You can work in React and TypeScript when a capability needs a great interface, and reason about streaming state and accessibility. * Comfort with startup ambiguity, fast feedback loops, and broad ownership. None of the following is required, and any of them is a strong signal for a particular area: production Kubernetes work deep enough to have written controllers rather than only configured them; a real understanding of isolation boundaries and what each one does and does not contain; comfort with statistics, including the ways an experiment can mislead you; trajectory or event data at scale, including the joins, lineage, and privacy handling that make it usable; or reinforcement learning, post\-training, or large\-scale experimentation. We care more about the systems you personally built, measured, and operated than a particular company, school, language, or model vendor. **Interview process** ===================== * A 30\-minute introductory conversation. * Two 60\-minute technical interviews, one focused on systems design and one on coding. * A take\-home assignment where you build and present a real solution using the tools you would use on the job. **Why join** ============ * Build the cloud services that help enterprise agents learn from production experience. * Ship Core AI capabilities end to end in Sycamore Forge, from cloud service and API design through the React experience customers use. * Turn production outcomes into governed improvements used across customers. * Shape how feedback\-driven learning, agent evaluation, and safe self\-improvement work in a high\-trust enterprise setting. * Join early enough to shape the Core AI architecture and engineering team. * Receive competitive cash compensation and meaningful equity in the company you are helping build.

Lead improvement efforts across the full range of plant equipment and inclusive of all departments to ensure the plant’s needs are fully understood and met. * Develop/maintain standards for PLC/HMI code, alarm philosophy, naming conventions, documentation, backups, and change control. * Support and improve process control for temperature/pressure/vacuum curing processes, ovens/autoclaves, resin mixing \& handling, material handling, and material storage systems. * Maintain up\-to\-date Interlock Matrices, SIF Testing systems, documentation, and records and utilize change management for applicable situations. * Work with plant Operations, Quality, and Reliability personnel to implement, maintain, and upgrade data collection and traceability improvements (historians, batch/recipe data, OEE/downtime tagging, etc.). Coordinate with outside agencies and contractors to develop plans and processes to ensure efficient, effective, and safe performance of preventive, predictive, and repair efforts for plant controls and electrical systems. **You will bring:** * A minimum of a 4\-yr degree in an information technology related field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics/Industrial Automation, and 5\+ years hands\-on experience with OT systems and controls or 8\+ years of hands\-on OT/controls experience in industrial manufacturing environments (PLC/SCADA programming, commissioning, and support). * Strong safety mindset * Strong communication skills, written and verbal * Demonstrated expertise with PLC programming, troubleshooting, and industrial controls design/support * Experienced with automation devices (controllers, drives, HMI’s, sensors, controls, etc.), HMI/SCADA configuration and support * Knowledgeable with Rockwell software including Studio 5000, FTView, FT Optix). * Panel design and building experience. * Experience implementing change, versioning/backup practices, and documentation standards * CMMS system experience. SAP experience is a plus. * Self\-motivated, able to follow directions and meet deadlines * Strong background in control systems, ladder logic, and drive systems * Ability to create, read, and update blueprints, P\&ID’s, schematics, and other drawings * Develop creative and innovative approaches to addressing issues * Strong problem\-solving abilities for controls and electrical applications **You will get:** * Competitive salary and benefits package. * The U.S. base salary range reasonably expected to be paid for this position is $99,000\.00 \- $123,000\.00 per year. Since actual compensation packages are based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted base salary range. Total compensation for this role also includes bonus and/or other incentives. * 16, or more, weeks of maternity/paternity and co\-parenting leave, according to local regulations * Training platform for all employees * Free well\-being sessions (physical and psychological) About us * Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. Our innovation power enables us to deliver on the ambition of a circular economy and explore breakthrough technologies that advance humanity. * At Syensqo, we seek to promote unity and not uniformity. We value the diversity that individuals bring and we invite you to consider a future with us, regardless of background, age, gender, national origin, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, ability or identity. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description: ### **About Takt** Takt is a warehouse intelligence platform that unifies labor, automation, and robotics data so 3PLs, retailers, and e\-commerce companies can run more efficient operations. Warehouses generate enormous amounts of data and most of it never reaches the people doing the work. We build the software that closes that gap, giving supervisors and frontline employees the information they need, when they need it, on the floor where decisions actually get made. Our software runs every shift, every day, in real facilities for leading brands including Macy’s, Target, Stitch Fix, Flexport, ODW Logistics, and CarParts.com. ### **About the Role** We’re hiring a senior backend engineer to design and build the distributed systems at the core of the Takt platform. Warehouses produce large, fast\-moving datasets from labor systems, automation, and robotics, and our backend turns that stream into the real\-time operational views our customers run their shifts on. Our services are written in Go, Python, and Node.js and run on Google Kubernetes Engine across multiple regions. You’ll work across all three, picking the one that fits the problem. This is a senior role with real architectural ownership. Our engineering team is small and works together to solve problems; you’ll work directly with our CTO and Director of Engineering, shape how the platform scales, and mentor other engineers as the team grows. Security is top of mind in everything we build: our customers trust us with operational data from their facilities, and we design for that trust from the first line of code. ### **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and operate scalable backend services in Go, Python, and Node.js that power the Takt platform. * Build integrations that bring in data from warehouse management, labor, automation, and robotics systems, and keep them reliable when upstream systems change or fail. * Deploy and run services on Google Kubernetes Engine across multi\-region environments, designing for availability, failover, and data locality. * Model, store, and query data at scale with Google Cloud Spanner and Google BigQuery, working with large operational datasets from real warehouse systems. * Design APIs and data pipelines that serve real\-time views to web, TV, kiosk, and mobile experiences on the floor. * Build with security top of mind: least\-privilege access, safe data handling, and designs that hold up in SOC 2 and GDPR audits. * Own services end to end, from design and documentation through deployment, monitoring, and incident follow\-through. * Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code review, and pairing as the team grows. ### **How We Build** We’re an AI\-forward engineering team. Every engineer gets a monthly AI tools budget for Claude, Cursor, and whatever else makes you better, and we expect you to use it. AI\-assisted development isn’t a shortcut here; it’s how we work. As a senior engineer, you’ll help set the standard for using these tools well: reviewing generated code critically, understanding what ships under your name, and building guardrails so the whole team can move fast safely. ### **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience. * Deep, hands\-on experience building production services in at least one of Go, Python, or Node.js (TypeScript), and the willingness to work across all three. * A track record of designing and operating scalable distributed systems, and reasoning clearly about consistency, latency, and failure modes. * Experience running services on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, ideally GKE on Google Cloud. * Strong SQL skills: writing, optimizing, and debugging queries against large production datasets is a must. * Experience with large datasets and the databases that serve them; Spanner and BigQuery experience is a strong plus, as is depth in comparable systems. * A security mindset applied by default: least privilege, safe handling of customer data, and pragmatic risk trade\-offs. * Ownership and drive: you take ambiguity and run with it, communicate clearly, and leave systems better documented than you found them. ### **Nice to Have** * Production experience in more than one of Go, Python, and Node.js. * Experience with multi\-region architectures and the trade\-offs of replication, failover, and data residency. * Experience with streaming or batch data pipelines, such as Dataflow. * Familiarity with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and infrastructure as code. * Prior startup experience, or comfort owning a domain rather than a slice of one. * Curiosity about logistics, warehousing, or how physical operations actually run. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this role is $150,000 – $180,000, depending on experience. Benefits include: * Health, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) with employer match. * Unlimited PTO. * A monthly AI tools budget for every engineer. * A top\-of\-the\-line MacBook Pro, dual 4K monitors, and your choice of keyboard and mouse at your desk in the office. ### **Interview Process** Two phone screens, followed by an onsite in our Reston office with four to five interviews. We’ll keep you informed at every step; no black holes. ### **Location** Takt is based in Reston, VA, with our office located next to the Wiehle\-Reston East Metro station on the Silver Line. We’re looking for local candidates who can be in the office at least four days a week; we build together. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. ### **Our Commitment** Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is core to Takt’s values. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a supportive place to work. Takt will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits of employment. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

quality: Establish service level objectives (SLOs), implement monitoring and alerting, and build automated data quality checks to ensure data remains accurate and available. * Strengthen engineering
