jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: This is a hybrid role and in\-person work is required in Livermore, CA. Our technical teams rack, power, cool, cable, configure, and troubleshoot the GPU clusters that customers train and serve models on. We are hiring an AI Infrastructure Engineer to be the technical depth of that team. This role spans the full stack of a GPU deployment: you will install and commission the hardware, configure the Linux hosts and the InfiniBand or RoCE fabric that connects them, and own the Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets that no one else can close. When a node fails repeatedly, you are the person who finds out why. This is a hands\-on role. You will still be in the aisle with a torque wrench during deployment windows. You will also write the runbook that prevents the next escalation, tune the fabric that shaved 8% off a customer’s job time, and sit in the vendor call explaining why their firmware is the root cause. The work is hybrid. Deployment windows, hardware break\-fix, and physical layer work happen on site. Configuration, diagnostics, ticket ownership, automation, and documentation can happen from wherever you work best. What you’ll do Escalation and root cause ownership * Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets end to end — accept escalations from Tier 1 and support teams, drive them to resolution, and close them with a documented cause rather than a reboot. * Perform root cause analysis on server hardware failures: correlate IPMI/BMC event logs, MCE and EDAC records, kernel messages, thermal and power telemetry, and vendor diagnostics to distinguish a genuine component failure from firmware, configuration, environmental, or workload causes. * Identify recurring failure patterns across the fleet — a DIMM slot that fails repeatedly, a firmware revision correlated with GPU falloff, a rack with marginal airflow — and drive the systemic fix. * Lead or contribute to post\-incident reviews; translate findings into monitoring, runbook, and standards changes. * Serve as the technical escalation point for vendors: build the evidence package, defend the diagnosis, and manage RMA and field\-service engagements through to closure. * Communicate directly with customers during open incidents and maintenance windows, not only after the fact: status while the issue is live, the notice before a window, and the confirmation after it closes. Concise and factual, with no speculation about cause before it is established. * Direct colocation remote hands in writing, to the level of cabinet, rack unit, port, and cable label, and verify the result remotely before accepting the work as done. * Participate in a shared on\-call rotation for infrastructure incidents. **GPU systems and troubleshooting** * Administer and troubleshoot GPU compute nodes — NVIDIA H100/H200/B200/B300 SXM and PCIe platforms, AMD Instinct, or comparable accelerators. * Diagnose GPU\-level faults using vendor tooling: nvidia\-smi, DCGM and DCGM diagnostics, XID error interpretation, NVLink and NVSwitch health, ECC and row\-remapping events, thermal and power throttling analysis. * Install, update, and validate GPU drivers, CUDA toolkits, fabric manager, and container runtimes; manage version compatibility across the fleet. * Run and interpret node validation and burn\-in — NCCL tests, bandwidth and all\-reduce benchmarks, GPU stress tests — before handing capacity to customers. * Investigate performance degradation that is not an outright failure: straggler nodes, reduced collective bandwidth, PCIe link width or speed downgrades, NUMA and topology misconfiguration. **Network administration: AI fabric and tenant connectivity** * Configure and administer high\-performance AI fabrics — InfiniBand (NDR/HDR) and RoCEv2 Ethernet — including switch configuration, firmware management, and topology validation. * Operate InfiniBand subnet management: subnet manager configuration and failover, partitioning (P\_Keys), routing engine selection, and topology verification against the intended fat\-tree or rail\-optimized design. * Troubleshoot fabric health with UFM and the OFED toolchain — ibdiagnet, ibnetdiscover, perfquery, port counters — to isolate symbol errors, link flaps, degraded optics, and bad cables to a specific port. * Tune and validate RoCE deployments: PFC and ECN configuration, lossless queue setup, and congestion control behavior under collective traffic. * Configure and maintain host\-side networking: RDMA and OFED stacks, NIC and HCA firmware, adapter tuning, bonding, VLANs, and out\-of\-band management networks. * Validate fabric performance after deployment and after change and maintain accurate port maps and topology documentation. * Operate the tenant\-facing side of the network alongside the AI fabric: VLANs and trunking, LACP port\-channels across an MLAG or VLT switch pair, enterprise switch CLI, and the firewall, NAT, VPN, DHCP, and DNS configuration that customer connectivity depends on. Verify tenant segmentation and isolation against the design before capacity is hand s, serials, port maps, firmware inventory, and lifecycle state. * Write and refine runbooks, install standards, and validation checklists so deployments are repeatable rather than improvised. **What you bring** * 4–7 years combining data center or infrastructure operations with Linux systems administration; time spent in both the aisle and the terminal. * Strong Linux administration skills in a production environment — RHEL, Rocky, or Ubuntu — including kernel and driver management, storage, networking, and shell\-level diagnostics. * Hands\-on experience with a bare\-metal provisioning system as an operator, not just an installer, including diagnosing nodes that fail to enlist, PXE, or commission. Comfort using Redfish and IPMI as automation interfaces for power, boot order, and firmware, not only as sources of event logs. * Demonstrated Tier 2/3 escalation experience: you have been the person a ticket lands on when the first two people could not solve it. * Server hardware root cause analysis experience — reading BMC, IPMI, and system event logs and correlating them with kernel and application symptoms to reach a defensible cause. * Hands\-on experience with high\-performance or data center networking: InfiniBand, RoCE, or high\-speed Ethernet fabrics, including switch configuration and link\-level troubleshooting. * Working knowledge of production L2 and L3 networking beyond the AI fabric, enough to isolate whether a customer problem is host, switch, firewall, or upstream. * Experience administering or supporting GPU or accelerated compute systems, including driver stacks and vendor diagnostic tooling. * Solid data center fundamentals: power distribution and redundancy, cooling and airflow, structured cabling, and rack layout. * Scripting ability in Python or Bash, and comfort with configuration management such as Ansible. * Clear technical writing — incident summaries, runbooks, and RCA document a customer or an executive can read. * Experience as the customer\-facing technical contact during a live incident, and experience directing remote hands or field technicians in writing at a site you are not standing in. * Availability for on\-call rotation and occasional after\-hours maintenance windows. **Nice to have** * Production experience with large\-scale GPU clusters — multi\-rack SXM deployments, NVLink/NVSwitch topologies, or rail\-optimized fabric designs. * Deep InfiniBand experience: UFM, subnet manager tuning, ibdiagnet\-driven fault isolation, adaptive routing, or SHARP. * Familiarity with HPC and AI workload schedulers — Slurm, Kubernetes with GPU operators, or Run:ai — and how scheduling interacts with node health. * Experience with parallel or high\-performance storage (Lustre, GPFS, WEKA, VAST, or NFS over RDMA). **Exposure to liquid\-cooled and high\-density deployments — rear\-door heat exchangers, direct\-to\-chip, CDUs.** Observability stack experience: Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM exporter, Elasticsearch, or equivalent. * Certifications such as RHCE or RHCSA, NVIDIA networking or InfiniBand credentials, CompTIA Server\+/Network\+, or Uptime Institute DCCA/DCCS. * Experience in a growth\-stage environment where standards are being written rather than inherited. **Working conditions and physical requirements** Part of this role is performed in an operating data center. Candidates should be able to, with or without reasonable accommodation: * Lift and maneuver equipment up to 50 lbs unassisted, and heavier items with team or lift assist. **Work at heights on ladders and in confined spaces, including under raised floors and in overhead cable trays.** * Stand, walk, kneel, and reach for extended periods in an environment with sustained noise, cold aisles, and limited natural light. * Wear required PPE and follow all electrical and site safety procedures. **Compensation and benefits** ● Negotiable – Depending on Experience Pay: From $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **About Tantalus Systems (TSX: GRID)** Tantalus is a technology company dedicated to helping utilities modernize their distribution grids by harnessing the power of data across all their devices and systems deployed throughout the entire distribution grid – from the substation to the EV charger located behind the meter. science, software development, AI/ML, business intelligence, or a related technical field. * Proficiency in Python, including experience using Python for data analysis, automation, reporting, or machine learning applications. * Experience querying, manipulating, and analyzing data using SQL. * Experience using data analysis, data visualization, or machine learning tools to develop reports, dashboards, or analytical solutions. * Internship, co\-op, academic project, or research experience involving data analytics, machine learning, software development, or reporting solutions is considered valuable. * Foundational understanding of statistics, machine learning, data analytics, and data visualization principles. * Experience building dashboards, reports, data pipelines, automated workflows, analytical applications, or internal tools. * Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and practical outputs. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively in a hybrid, cross\-functional environment. *Personal Attributes Required* * Curious and eager to learn, with a strong interest in AI, analytics, and emerging technologies. * Self\-motivated and able to work independently while managing competing priorities in a hybrid work environment. * Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to think critically and approach challenges with creativity and resourcefulness. * Detail\-oriented with a commitment to delivering accurate, high\-quality work. * Collaborative team player who enjoys working across departments and building relationships with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Customer\-focused mindset with a desire to understand customer needs and translate data into meaningful business outcomes. * Effective communicator with the ability to explain complex information in a clear and concise manner. * Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities and business needs may evolve.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Domain Knowledge
jobs.description: **Our company** At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. **What You’ll Do** We are seeking a Principal Engineer , Domian Knowledge, to define and build the next generation of enterprise\-scale data discovery, inventory, and metadata management capabilities across many verticals, such as Finance, Healthcare, etc. This is a highly strategic and hands\-on technical leadership role for an industry\-recognized expert who has successfully designed and deployed large\-scale data catalog platforms across complex enterprises. You will own the architecture, engineering, and evolution of systems that enable employees, analysts, data scientists, AI agents, and business users to discover, understand, trust, and govern data assets across the organization. Think of this role as building and operating the enterprise's "library index" or "parts catalog" for data, where every dataset, table, document, API, feature, metric, model, and knowledge asset can be found, understood, and evaluated for use. You will own the strategy and technical execution of Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine Domain Knowledge — developing enterprise\-leading capabilities to extract, curate, and continuously evolve structured metadata and business context supported by Teradata’s industry knowledge models to serve as a governed layer powering both human analyst acceleration and AI agent grounding. This role combines deep product thinking with ecosystem and platform leadership, spanning the full lifecycle from knowledge acquisition and curation to runtime delivery and continuous improvement. The Context Engine integrates robust database and catalog connectivity, intelligent query parsing, and Teradata's decades of industry knowledge — particularly in highly regulated enterprises — into a curated, continuously improving context layer. Context Engine is a platform that converts enterprise data estates into governed, agent\-ready knowledge. Built for organizations where AI reliability and auditability are non\-negotiable, Context Engine enables companies to deploy AI workflows on the data they already own — without rebuilding their infrastructure, without retraining their models, and without waiting for generic AI synthesis to learn the business terminology that took their analysts years to master. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in metadata management, distributed systems, data platforms, search and indexing technologies, governance, lineage, and data quality with a passion for creating exceptional discovery experiences at enterprise scale. Data Discovery \& Inventory Leadership * Design and build enterprise\-wide data catalog and metadata platforms that continuously discover, inventory, classify, and organize data assets. * Create systems that automatically scan and ingest metadata from databases, data lakes, warehouses, streaming platforms, APIs, BI tools, AI platforms, and SaaS applications. * Drive the vision for making organizational data as discoverable as products in an e\-commerce catalog or books in a modern library system. * Establish a unified metadata strategy spanning structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data assets. Search, Indexing \& Retrieval * Architect highly scalable metadata indexing and search systems supporting millions to billions of metadata entities. * Design semantic search, keyword search, metadata search, faceted navigation, and relevance\-ranking capabilities. * Leverage graph technologies, vector search, embeddings, and knowledge representations to improve discoverability. * Build intelligent recommendation systems that help users identify trusted and relevant data assets. Metadata \& Knowledge Engineering * Lead development of metadata models, business glossaries, taxonomies, ontologies, and enterprise information architectures. * Establish standards for technical, business, operational, and governance metadata. * Design lineage capture and metadata synchronization frameworks across heterogeneous ecosystems. * Build metadata knowledge graphs connecting datasets, pipelines, dashboards, reports, AI models, metrics, owners, and business domains. Trust, Governance \& Data Quality * Integrate data quality, stewardship, ownership, compliance, and governance indicators into catalog experiences. * Create mechanisms for trust scoring, certification, usage analytics, freshness monitoring, and policy enforcement. * Partner with governance, compliance, privacy, and security organizations to ensure catalog accuracy and regulatory alignment. * Drive enterprise\-wide adoptio anguage models * RAG architectures * Agentic workflows * Metadata enrichment using AI * Semantic retrieval systems * AI\-powered recommendations What Distinguished Candidates Demonstrate * Recognized leadership in the metadata, catalog, search, or knowledge management domains. * Experience building enterprise\-wide data discovery platforms adopted by tens of thousands of users. * Proven experience delivering knowledge management systems in on\-prem, regulated, sovereign and air\-gapped environments * Demonstrated ability to scale metadata systems across large, globally distributed organizations. * Strong product thinking around discoverability, trust, usability, and developer experience. * Ability to bridge data engineering, governance, AI, and business stakeholder communities. * History of driving transformational initiatives from concept through broad enterprise adoption. Success Metrics Within the first 12\-18 months, this leader will: * Deliver a unified enterprise inventory of critical data assets. * Improve discoverability and reuse of trusted datasets across business domains. * Increase metadata completeness, ownership coverage, and lineage visibility. * Enable AI\-assisted data discovery and self\-service analytics experiences. * Reduce time\-to\-find and time\-to\-trust for enterprise data assets. * Establish a scalable metadata foundation powering governance, analytics, and AI across the organization. **Why We Think You'll Love Teradata** We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are \#LI\-CP2 US Pay Rate: $182,700\.00 \- $228,400\.00 \- $274,000\.00 Annually Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on geographic location, internal equity, job\-related knowledge, skills, and candidate experience. Sales roles will be eligible for commission payments tied to quota achievement. All other permanent roles will be eligible for one of our annual incentive plans, which are based on company financial attainment and individual performance. Employees in this position are eligible to participate in the Company’s benefits programs, which generally include health care, life and disability insurance, retirement savings, and time\-off programs. We partner closely with Michigan Medicine, Michigan Engineering, and other institutional units to deliver services researchers can rely on. **Job Summary** --------------- We are hiring a full\-time Software Engineer to build the tools, applications, and platforms that help University of Michigan researchers develop, test, and evaluate AI in healthcare. jobs.title: Staff Control Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **About Thea Energy:** Thea Energy is leveraging recent breakthroughs in stellarator physics and engineering to create a faster and simpler approach to commercializing fusion energy. The company is reinventing the stellarator using computer\-controlled arrays of planar coils thereby replacing the intricate, complex modular magnets required in all other stellarator architectures. Thea Energy is on a mission to create a limitless source of zero emission energy for a sustainable future. **Position Overview:** Thea Energy is seeking a Staff Control Systems Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and test control, instrumentation, and data acquisition systems for the Integrated Eos Stellarator. This role combines hands\-on engineering with substantial technical contributions across real\-time control, industrial automation, supervisory control, machine protection, and high\-speed diagnostics. The Staff Control Systems Engineer will translate plant and physics requirements into implementable, testable solutions and collaborate with subsystem owners, engineers, vendors, and research partners to resolve technical interfaces. The role contributes throughout the engineering lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through implementation, integration, verification, and commissioning readiness. ### **Key Responsibility Areas:** * Design, develop, integrate, and verify control, instrumentation, and data acquisition solutions for assigned Eos systems, from requirements and architecture through commissioning readiness. * Share technical expertise and mentor control software, automation, instrumentation, and data acquisition engineers through design collaboration, code review, and troubleshooting. Coordinate technical work with colleagues across disciplines and locations. * Define functional, physical, software, and communication architectures that implement the plant control strategy and integrate cleanly with the overall Eos control system architecture. * Develop operating modes, control narratives, sequence logic, machine protection functions, safety interlocks, fail\-safe behavior, and emergency shutdown concepts for high\-value plant equipment. * Design and integrate EPICS, SCADA, PLC, DCS, HMI, real\-time embedded, and supervisory control solutions appropriate to subsystem performance and reliability needs. * Develop and document subsystem interfaces using protocols and services such as OPC UA, Modbus RTU/TCP, TCP/IP, and other deterministic or real\-time communication technologies. * Develop and integrate instrumentation and fast data acquisition solutions, including signal conditioning, isolation, grounding, shielding, low\-latency streaming, and FPGA\- or PXI\-based solutions where appropriate. * Translate physics, operations, and systems\-engineering requirements into specifications, interface control documents, architecture diagrams, control logic descriptions, validation plans, and test procedures. * Coordinate technical interfaces across vacuum, cryogenic, plasma heating, power supply, diagnostic, utility, safety, and supervisory\-control systems. * Work with suppliers and collaborators to evaluate proposed designs, resolve integration issues, and review control hardware and software packages against technical requirements and acceptance criteria. * Establish disciplined software and configuration\-management practices, including code review, automated testing, continuous integration, deployment, traceability, and release controls. * Contribute to design reviews, trade studies, and resolution of technical risks. Develop and execute factory and site acceptance tests, integrate systems, troubleshoot hardware and software, and support commissioning. ### **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in electrical engineering, control systems, computer engineering, physics, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. * 10 or more years of experience developing integrated control, automation, embedded, instrumentation, or data acquisition systems for complex, high\-reliability environments. * Demonstrated experience making substantial technical contributions to multidisciplinary engineering work, reviewing designs, mentoring engineers, and collaborating across disciplines or locations. * Demonstrated ability to architect and deliver systems that combine industrial controls, supervisory control, real\-time software, and hardware interfaces. * Hands\-on experience with EPICS or a comparable distributed\-control framework, SCADA/HMI systems, and PLC\-based automation. * Experience defining machine protection, interlock, fail\-safe, or emergency\-shutdown logic for valuable or safety\-significant equipment. * Proficiency in C or C\+\+, Python, and Linux or real\-time operating environments used for control and data acquisition. * Working knowledge of industrial and network protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus RTU/TCP, and TCP/IP. * Experience integrating instrumentation or high\-speed data acquisition, including at least one FPGA, PXI, CompactRIO, LabVIEW, or comparable hardware\-software platform. * Ability to produce clear specifications, interface control documents, architecture diagrams, test plans, operating procedures, and design\-review evidence. * Hands\-on experience with integration, acceptance testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning\-readiness activities involving internal teams and external suppliers. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and sound technical judgment in multidisciplinary engineering environments. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with nuclear fusion, particle accelerators, large scientific facilities, defense systems, advanced energy systems, or other first\-of\-a\-kind high\-reliability programs. * Experience delivering control systems for ITER, DIII\-D, JT60\-SA, or a comparable large\-scale scientific collaboration. * Knowledge of IEC 61508, IEC 61511, nuclear quality practices, or other safety\-related control\-system standards and workflows. * Experience with Siemens, Beckhoff, Allen\-Bradley, or comparable PLC platforms and with CS\-Studio or Phoebus operator interfaces. * Hands\-on experience with real\-time embedded Linux, RTOS\-based systems, deterministic control loops, digital signal processing, or FPGA development. * Familiarity with distributed timing and communication technologies such as DDS, PTP, White Rabbit, or comparable deterministic networking approaches. * Experience with MATLAB, Simulink, plant or subsystem dynamic modeling, or model\-based control design. * Experience using Git, Docker, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or comparable configuration\-management and continuous\-delivery tools in an engineering environment. * Exposure to predictive control, digital twins, machine learning, or data\-driven diagnostics for complex plant systems. ### **Company Benefits:** * Salary range: $180,000\-$230,000 * Comprehensive health benefits (e.g. medical/dental/vision) * Employee equity stock options * 20 days PTO It’s not necessary to meet all of the skillsets outlined above. Please feel free to send us a note and tell us why you would still be a great fit for this role or Thea Energy. **Diversity and Inclusion:**Thea Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a company of diverse backgrounds. By creating a diverse environment, we will bring new ideas and approaches to solving some of the world’s hardest (and most important) problems. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, family or marital status, age, disability, veteran’s status, or other characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Onsite at ThermoWorks in American Fork, Utah. Remote/hybrid schedule NOT available. ThermoWorks is looking for a hands\-on Senior Software Engineer to join our Product Development team. You’ll build and improve the software that brings our connected products to life, with a focus on embedded firmware and some backend programming to support our devices. You’ll contribute to multiple projects, taking software from requirements and prototypes through integration, validation, and delivery. Our connected temperature devices and gateways use technologies such as ESP32, C/C\+\+, Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy, MQTT, sensors, displays, and over\-the\-air firmware updates. You’ll work across device firmware and supporting backend services, collaborating with hardware, mobile, and cloud teammates to deliver reliable end\-to\-end products. We’re looking for a self\-starter who loves building products, can move work forward with limited day\-to\-day direction, and is comfortable solving open\-ended engineering problems. Familiarity with managing and leveraging multiple AI agents to accelerate software development workflows is expected. This is a firmware\-focused role, not a circuit\-design or PCB\-layout position. Occasional travel, including international travel, may be required. **Essential Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain embedded firmware for connected products, including sensor interfaces, connectivity, diagnostics, power management, and OTA updates. * Develop and maintain backend software and integrations that support connected devices, their data, and device\-facing features. * Take software features from requirements and implementation through unit, integration, and product testing; maintain clear technical documentation. * Integrate device software with sensors, displays, wireless networks, mobile applications, and cloud services in collaboration with the teams responsible for those systems. * Debug prototypes and field issues across firmware, connectivity, and hardware boundaries; improve product reliability and performance. * Contribute to multiple projects, communicating progress and risks, managing priorities, and working with product, hardware, cloud, mobile, and manufacturing teammates. * Support product releases, manufacturing readiness, and sustaining engineering. * Travel occasionally, including internationally, as project needs require. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional embedded software or firmware experience, including delivering products from development through release. * Strong C/C\+\+ skills and experience developing and debugging software for microcontroller\-based products. * Experience with real\-time or event\-driven systems and integrating firmware with hardware and connected services. * Experience or demonstrated ability in backend programming, such as developing services or APIs that support connected products. * Familiarity with collaborative software practices such as version control, code review, and testing. * Self\-directed approach, sound problem\-solving skills, and ability to make progress across multiple projects. * Clear communication and effective collaboration with cross\-functional teams. * Work onsite at ThermoWorks HQ. * Willingness and ability to travel occasionally, including internationally. Helpful Additional Experience * ESP32 and ESP\-IDF, FreeRTOS, or comparable embedded platforms. * Wi\-Fi, BLE, MQTT, device provisioning, secure communications, telemetry, or OTA\-update systems. * Experience integrating firmware with cloud services, APIs, mobile applications, or IoT platforms. * Temperature measurement, thermocouples, thermistors, RTDs, strain gauges, PID control, or instrumentation. * Battery\-powered products, low\-power firmware, and battery\-life optimization. * Hardware bring\-up and sensor or display interfaces. * Automated firmware testing, manufacturing test, reliability engineering, or production ramp experience. * Experience or familiarity with multi\-agent orchestration, agentic workflows, or integrating automated developer/task agents into CI/CD pipelines and software workflows.

jobs.title: Recommender Assurance Lead
jobs.description: San Jose Regular R\&D \- Security Job ID: A154898 to this job Responsibilities About the team: Content Assurance builds and operates the technical frameworks used to test whether high\-impact content systems behave within declared safety, quality, and governance boundaries. The team works independently from the product engineering organizations that build the systems it evaluates and produces evidence that can withstand executive, regulatory, and audit scrutiny. Content Assurance team partners with Trust \& Safety, Product, Engineering, Legal, Governance, Risk \& Compliance, and independent validation teams. We do not set content policy or make product trade\-off decisions. We translate approved objectives and obligations into repeatable tests, measurable controls, and defensible assurance outcomes. About the Role The Recommender Assurance Lead will own the assurance framework for recommendation systems, including retrieval, candidate generation, ranking, re\-ranking, and related optimization layers. This leader will establish how USDS JV independently determines whether recommender systems operate within committed bounds for relevance, safety, diversity, freshness, fairness, consistency, and harm reduction before and after release. This is a senior technical leadership role. The successful candidate will set assurance strategy, direct the engineering and operational program, defend methodology, and issue clear assurance findings on high\-risk recommender changes. The role does not own ranking algorithm design, content policy, engagement\-versus\-safety trade\-off decisions, or production uptime. Responsibilities \- Own the end\-to\-end recommender assurance framework, including control objectives, evaluation standards, release gates, evidence requirements, exception criteria, and post\-release re\-evaluation. \- Define independent evaluation methods for retrieval and ranking systems, including counterfactual replay, ranking\-quality benchmarks, harm\-exposure sampling, cohort analysis, and policy\-consistent ranking tests. \- Establish measurable acceptance thresholds for relevance, safety, diversity, freshness, population fairness, consistency, and declared harm\-reduction goals; require remediation or documented risk acceptance when systems fall outside committed bounds. \- Lead pre\-release assurance reviews for tiered recommender changes and issue evidence\-backed verdicts that clearly state scope, findings, limitations, residual risk, and required actions. \- Build the post\-release assurance program, including scheduled re\-evaluations, drift detection, harm\-exposure monitoring, adverse\-delta alerts, and incident forensics to determine whether ranking behavior remained within approved bounds. \- Direct the development of evaluation code, benchmark datasets, replay workflows, sampling strategies, and assurance telemetry on shared testing platforms. \- Set and report program measures, including assurance\-gated release coverage, high\-risk surface and cohort sampling coverage, evaluation freshness, and post\-release harm\-exposure deltas. \- Consume intervention\-effectiveness results where they affect ranking outcomes while maintaining a strict boundary between recommender behavior assurance and intervention\-firing assurance. \- Partner with Product Engineering, Trust \& Safety, Legal, GRC, and independent validation teams to convert approved objectives into testable requirements without assuming ownership of product design or policy decisions. \- Lead, develop, and hold accountable a multidisciplinary team of assurance engineers, applied scientists, and technical program owners; set technical direction and raise the quality of written findings and evidence. \- Represent recommender assurance in executive reviews, audits, investigations, and regulatory inquiries, and defend the methodology and evidence with precision. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. \- 8\+ years of relevant experience in machine learning, recommender systems, algorithm evaluation, AI assurance, integrity, or a closely related field, including experience leading senior technical teams or programs. \- Deep understanding of modern recommendation architectures, including retrieval, ranking, re\-ranking, embeddings, multi\-objective optimization, experimentation, and online/offline evaluation. \- Demonstrated ability to design statistically sound evaluation methods, sampling strategies, benchmarks, and monitoring for large\-scale production ML systems. \- Experience translating safety, policy, legal, or risk requirements into objective technical controls and defensible pass/fail criteria. \- Strong executive communication and written judgment; able to make firm calls under ambiguity and explain evidence, limitations, and residual risk. Preferred Qualifications \- Advanced degree in al leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure). The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice. For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates: Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: 1\. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues; 2\. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and 3\. Exercising sound judgment. About USDS TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025\. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision\-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale. On\-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real\-time decision\-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in\-person schedule up to 5 days a week. Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day. We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. Diversity \& Inclusion TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too. jobs.description: **We are** an American luxury lifestyle brand, founded in 2004\. Anchored in the casual elegance of American sportswear, Tory’s design philosophy is defined by effortless silhouettes, innovative materials, eclectic juxtapositions of color, and the tension of past and present. The collections include ready\-to\-wear, handbags, footwear, accessories, jewelry, home and beauty. Empowering women is the company’s guiding principle, expressed through Tory’s collections and reflected in the company culture as well as the work of the Tory Burch Foundation. Established in 2009, the Foundation provides women entrepreneurs in the United States with access to capital, education and community. **You are** seeking a work environment where people are encouraged to dream, explore, discover and, as important, laugh together. If you’re prepared to work hard, create impact, and have fun while doing it, we would love to have you join \#TeamTory. Apply today! **Life @ToryBurch is Special Because:** When you join us, you’re joining a global, purpose\-led company on an exciting growth journey with an amazing culture and great benefits. Our culture is welcoming and inclusive * \- everyone is empowered to make a difference. * We have the best team in the world and believe in paying competitively and rewarding for high performance. * Your overall well\-being is important to us; we offer generous benefits to help you take care of your mental and physical health, create financial security, and achieve wellness in all areas of your life. * We love seeing our employees wear our beautiful collections. You’ll receive a generous employee discount and access to exclusive sample sales. * We are invested in your professional growth – you’ll have access to free executive coaching on\-demand. * We believe in the importance of giving back and you’ll have many opportunities to do just that through the Tory Burch Foundation and paid volunteer days. **This Role is Tailor\-Made for You Because:** You’re a strategic, hands on engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of CRM/MarTech activation, enterprise data platforms, and large scale integration platforms. You balance long term architectural vision with the ability to deep dive into complex data pipelines, operational issues, or cross functional program blockers. You’ve scaled engineering organizations, led managers and hybrid teams, and built robust, API driven and event driven platforms that power personalized customer experiences across marketing, e commerce, stores, and client services. You’re passionate about shaping a Customer 360 that works across channels, building modern data platforms ready for AI/ML, enforcing data governance and privacy, and creating integration ecosystems that are reliable, observable, and secure. You take pride in translating business strategy into technical reality while creating a culture of clarity, accountability, innovation, and operational excellence. You’re also resourceful and collaborative with stakeholders and partner with Product Managers, Data Analysts, and cross\-functional teams to align data solutions with business needs. A sense of humor is a plus!**A Day in the Life:** The typical day is… atypical. Your Key Responsibilities may include. * Lead engineering strategy across CRM/MarTech, enterprise data, analytics, and integration platforms, ensuring a unified ecosystem aligned to business priorities. * Define architecture standards, canonical data models, API governance, data SLAs, and modernization roadmaps. * Build, lead, and scale high\-performing engineering teams, including internal leaders, technical program management, and vendor squads. * Oversee Customer 360, segmentation, clienteling, and email/SMS marketing platforms to enable personalized, cross\-channel customer engagement. * Advance enterprise data platforms, ingestion pipelines, data quality frameworks, metadata, lineage, BI capabilities, and AI/ML enablement. * Own and scale the enterprise integration backbone, including ESB, event streaming, integration standards, SLAs, and observability practices. * Manage the full integration lifecycle from planning and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live support. * Drive enterprise data governance, including data quality, access controls, retention, privacy, compliance, and secure platform operations. * Establish operational excellence practices such as incident management, runbooks, telemetry, reliability targets, and scalable support models. * Partner with executives, business stakeholders, technology teams, and vendors to align priorities, manage risks, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The consistent thread is that you’ll be working with an amazing team of women and men who share your passion for excellence. **To Land This Role:** **Technical Skills** * 18\+ years of overall experience in software/data engineering, with at least 10 years in leadership roles and 5 years managing managers or multi‑l ools (Tableau, MicroStrategy, Looker) and enabling self‑service analytics. * Experience with email and SMS marketing platforms, clienteling solutions, or customer engagement platforms. * Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, privacy, and compliance frameworks. **Leadership Skills** * Clear, concise communicator who adapts messaging for executives, engineers, and cross‑functional partners. * Strategic and critical thinker who can articulate multi‑year vision while delivering near‑term outcomes. * Hands‑on leader who can roll up their sleeves during design reviews, data investigations, or incident response. * Skilled in conflict resolution, cross‑team alignment, and leading through complex stakeholder landscapes. * Comfortable managing ambiguity and creating clarity during evolving priorities or organizational shifts. * Experienced managing managers and scaling hybrid orgs (internal \+ vendor teams) with outcome‑based performance frameworks. * Strong ability to set and communicate technical direction tied to measurable business KPIs. **Why You'll Want to Join Our Team:** Our Technology team has a clear mission: use technology to enable the business to operate efficiently while driving growth and profitability. We envision, we strategize, we engineer, we design, we build, we test, we support, and we serve. Our tools and systems impact every customer and every member of our team every day and our role is to make each engagement seamless and rewarding. As we build our in\-house engineering teams, we are focused on further modernizing our platforms, leveraging our data analytics capabilities and creating a transformational customer experience. Come join us!**How We Work Together** * Adaptable – We change before we have to * Entrepreneurial – We own it * Collaborative – There’s no “I” in Tory * Client \& Brand Focused – We put ourselves in Tory’s shoes * Live the Values – We show up for each other * Functional Expertise – We’re constantly learning and growing **\#TeamTory Values** We show up with honesty \& kindness, act with integrity \& compassion, work with passion \& humility and lead with excellence \& humor. **Compensation Range** The compensation range for this position is 255,000\.00 USD \- 320,000\.00 USD. Our offer will be based on your relevant experience and work location. **Benefits Information** We offer a generous set of benefits to help you take care of your health, create financial security, and achieve wellness in all areas of your life. Here are highlights of key benefits available to all eligible Tory Burch team members. ### **E****qual Employment Opportunity Statement** Tory Burch LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to an individual’s age, race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy) or sexual orientation, gender expression, military status, marital status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, disability or membership in any other protected class under applicable law. Likewise, we will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Ordinance No. 184652\. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment. **Disability Accommodation** Tory Burch is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require assistance or an accommodation with the hiring process, please contact thetalentteam@toryburch.com.

jobs.title: Sr. Architect | Offensive Security/ AI Testing/ Cloud Testing (Remote)
jobs.description: Who is **Trace3**? Trace3 is a leading Transformative IT Authority, providing unique technology solutions and consulting services to our clients. Equipped with elite engineering and dynamic innovation, we empower IT executives and their organizations to achieve competitive advantage through a process of Integrate, Automate, Innovate. Our culture at Trace3 embodies the spirit of a startup with the advantage of a scalable business. Employees can grow their career and have fun while doing it! Trace3 is headquartered in Irvine, California. We employ more than 1,200 people all over the United States. Our major field office locations include Denver, Indianapolis, Grand Rapids, Lexington, Los Angeles, Louisville, Texas, San Francisco. **Ready to discover the possibilities that live in technology?** **Come Join Us!** **Street\-Smart** **\-** ***Thriving in Dynamic Times*** We are flexible and resilient in a fast\-changing environment. We continuously innovate and drive constructive change while keeping a focus on the "big picture." We exercise sound business judgment in making high\-quality decisions in a timely and cost\-effective manner. We are highly creative and can dig deep within ourselves to find positive solutions to different problems. **Juice \-** ***The "Stuff" it takes to be a Needle Mover*** We get things done and drive results. We lead without a title, empowering others through a can\-do attitude. We look forward to the goal, mentally mapping out every checkpoint on the pathway to success, and visualizing what the final destination looks and feels like. **Teamwork \-** ***Humble, Hungry and Smart*** We are humble individuals who understand how our job impacts the company's mission. We treat others with respect, admit mistakes, give credit where it's due and demonstrate transparency. We "bring the weather" by exhibiting positive leadership and solution\-focused thinking. We hug people in their trials, struggles, and failures – not just their success. We appreciate the individuality of the people around us. **JOB SUMMARY:** The Senior Architect, Offensive Security is a senior technical contributor who leads advanced offensive security engagements for Trace3 clients, with a primary focus on cloud security testing (particularly Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365\) and AI/LLM security testing. This role uncovers vulnerabilities and realistic attack paths in modern cloud and AI\-enabled environments through adversary\-minded, manual testing that goes well beyond automated scanning, and delivers clear, actionable remediation guidance. The Sr. Architect will plan, execute, and report on complex assessments, serve as a technical escalation point for the team, and help build the testing methodologies behind the practice's cloud and AI service offerings. Mobile application testing experience is a plus. While general internal network, external network and web application penetration testing experience is valued and may be utilized, this role is focused on specialized testing. A key function of this role will be building deep relationships, gaining trust, and enabling client success. **SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Lead and execute cloud security assessments and penetration tests, primarily in Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 (and AWS or GCP as applicable), covering identity and privilege escalation, tenant and subscription attack paths, managed identities, Key Vault, storage, serverless, and container (AKS) workloads * Identify and exploit cloud identity weaknesses, including conditional access gaps, OAuth application and consent abuse, token theft and replay, and hybrid identity attack paths between on\-premises Active Directory and Entra ID * Assess cloud DevOps and infrastructure\-as\-code environments (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform) for pipeline compromise, secrets exposure, and privilege escalation paths * Perform security assessments of AI/ML and LLM\-enabled applications and agentic systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaking, sensitive data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency, RAG pipeline weaknesses, and model supply\-chain risk, aligned to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS * Assess the cloud platforms and infrastructure that host AI workloads (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock), including access controls, data exposure, network isolation, and integrations with enterprise data sources * Serve as technical lead on engagements: define the testing approach and rules of engagement, coordinate with client stakeholders, and direct and support other testers * Produce high\-quality reports that clearly communicate attack narratives, risk ratings, evidence, and prioritized remediation guidance, and present findings to audiences ranging from engineers to executives * Develop and maintain testing methodologies, playbooks, and checklists for cloud and AI security testing * Develop scripts, tools, and automation  d vector stores, tool\-calling, and model hosting platforms * Proficiency in scripting and development using languages such as Python, PowerShell, Go, or Bash * Solid foundation in traditional penetration testing (network, Active Directory, and web applications) and common tooling such as Burp Suite, BloodHound, and Metasploit * Excellent written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, client\-ready reports * Excellent oral communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present findings to C\-level executives and non\-technical audiences * Highly organized, detail\-oriented, excellent time management skills, and able to effectively prioritize tasks in a fast\-paced, high\-volume, and evolving work environment * Ability to approach client requests in a proactive and consultative manner; listen, understand client needs, and effectively deliver * Comfortable managing multiple and changing priorities, and meeting deadlines in an entrepreneurial environment * Motivated self\-starter who loves to solve challenging problems and feels comfortable working directly with clients * Ability to travel when needed **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Cloud\-focused certifications such as CARTP, CARTE, GCPN, or AZ\-500 * Offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSWE, OSAI, HTB COAE or GXPN * Hands\-on experience with AWS and/or GCP security testing in addition to Azure * Experience testing agentic AI systems, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and multi\-agent workflows * Mobile application penetration testing experience for iOS and Android (e.g., Frida, Objection, MobSF, jadx), aligned to OWASP MASVS and MASTG * Mobile\-focused certifications such as GMOB or eMAPT * Published security research, CVEs, conference talks, or contributions to open\-source offensive tooling * Experience with red team operations or adversary emulation **The Perks** * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents * 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match, 529 College Savings Plan, Health Savings Account, Life Insurance, and Long\-Term Disability * Competitive Compensation * Training and development programs * Major offices stocked with snacks and beverages * Collaborative and cool culture * Work\-life balance and generous paid time off **Our Commitment** At the core of Trace3's DNA is our people. We are a diverse group of talented individuals who understand the importance of teamwork and demonstrating leadership, character, and passion in all that we do. We're committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to grow. We recognize that embracing diversity drives innovation, improves outcomes, fosters collaboration, boosts teammate satisfaction, and builds a more inclusive culture. As an equal opportunity employer, Trace3 bases all employment decisions based on individual qualifications, merit, and business requirements. We do not engage in discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Any demographic information provided is strictly voluntary, kept confidential in accordance with Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) regulations, and will not be used in employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, or mentorship programs. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process or participate in an interview, please email recruiting@trace3\.com. **\*\*\*To all recruitment agencies:** Trace3 does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Please do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email addresses, Trace3 employees or any other company location. Trace3 is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

jobs.title: Product Design Engineer - Data Center
jobs.description: Site Fort Smith, Arkansas, États\-Unis d'Amérique Catégorie Ingénierie Id du poste JR\-19274 Commercial HVAC Americas Participez à notre mission ! En tant que leader mondial dans la création de solutions climatiques confortables, durables et efficaces pour les bâtiments, les habitations et les transports, il est de notre responsabilité de placer la planète au premier plan. Pour nous, chezTrane Technologies, et à travers nos activités, y comprisTrane®etThermo KingLa durabilité n’est pas simplement une façon de faire des affaires—c’est au cœur de notre activité. Osez\-vous regarder les défis mondiaux et y voir des opportunités porteuses d’impact ? Souhaitez\-vous contribuer à bâtir un avenir meilleur ? Si la réponse est oui, nous vous invitons à envisager de nous rejoindre pour repousser les limites du possible en faveur d’un monde durable. Découvrez nosavantagesconçu pour vous permettre de vous épanouir au travail comme à la maison. Nous avançons avec audace. **Où se trouve le travail :** Du lundi au jeudi, travaillez sur site avec vos collègues. Le vendredi, choisissez votre lieu de travail, en tenant compte des exigences de votre activité. We are seeking a high\-energy, technically proficient **Product Design Engineer \- Data Center** to join our team at the Fort Smith, AR facility to support the rapidly growing Data Center Fan Coil Wall product line. In this critical plant\-facing engineering role, you will act as the operational and design bridge between engineering and operations, spearheading the local execution of New Product Development (NPD) projects, resolving immediate shop\-floor manufacturing and field feedback issues, and managing change orders and BOM structures. Additionally, you will serve as the primary engineering liaison connecting the Fort Smith manufacturing facility with the core TCDC Pod engineering team. **Core Job Responsibilities:** * Serve as the central communication and technical bridge between the Fan Coil Wall development team and the Fort Smith plant operations, manufacturing engineering, and quality teams. * Spearhead the implementation, qualification, and pilot runs of New Product Development (NPD) programs for Data Center Fan Coil Wall products at the Fort Smith plant. * Actively participate in technical design reviews, DFM reviews, DFMEAs, and risk assessments to ensure next\-generation designs are optimized for assembly, throughput, and error\-proofing in production. * Act as the primary on\-site design authority for immediate shop floor troubleshooting, technician inquiries, fit\-up issues, and quality deviations. * Investigate field performance issues, warranty inquiries, and customer feedback; drive rigorous 8D/root cause corrective actions back into product design and assembly procedures. * Support factory testing, witness testing, and custom performance verification alongside visiting customers and quality personnel. * Drive, coordinate, and expedite Engineering Change Orders (ECOs / ECNs) through cross\-functional reviews to ensure timely implementation without production interruptions. * Direct and coordinate the configuration and upload of Bills of Materials (BOMs) into plant ERP/MRP systems, ensuring seamless component procurement and costing accuracy. * Identify cost\-out, weight\-reduction, and standardization opportunities within the active Fan Coil Wall production lines. * Review customer specifications, bid documents, and job requirements to generate tailored submittal packages and technical documentation. * Host and facilitate regular order coordination meetings between the plant, product management, sourcing, and customer\-facing teams. * Ensure engineering milestones and documentation are delivered on schedule to align with aggressive customer construction timelines. * Design custom HVAC systems to meet the customer demand and industry standards. * Manage project scope and bid documentation to identify job specific cost reduction opportunities. * Create submittal packages with the level of detail required by the specific customer. Direct consultation with the customer may be required. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering (BSME), Electrical Engineering (BSEE), or related engineering discipline. * Minimum of 3 years of engineering experience in product design, plant sustaining/RTS engineering, or manufacturing support. * Proven experience with 3D modeling and 2D drafting tools (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or Creo). * Strong proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio) and familiarity with ERP/PLM/PDM systems (e.g., Windchill, Oracle, SAP). * Willingness and ability to travel domestically up to 10% **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with custom HVAC equipment, air\-handling units (AHUs), or high\-density data center thermal management products (fan coil walls, CRAH/CRAC units). * Proven track record leading new product line introductions (NPI/NPD) into a high\-mix or rapid\-ramp manufacturing environment. * Knowledge of sheet metal fabrication, structural frames, electrical wiring/controls (3\-phase power), fans/motors (EC/VFD), cooling coils, and piping assemblies. * Master’s Degree in Engineering or MBA. **Key Competencies:** * Demonstrated capability to coordinate across functional and geographic boundaries (design engineers, plant technicians, sourcing, and project managers). * Fast\-paced troubleshooting mindset; capable of resolving urgent shop floor stops while maintaining engineering design rigor. * Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills for interacting with plant leadership, remote Pod teams, and customer representatives. * Self\-starter with high ownership, project management discipline, and the ability to manage competing priorities simultaneously. **Fourchette de salaire de base annuel ou fourchette de rémunération horaire de base :** $60,000\.00 \- $86,169\.99 **Type de rémunération :** Salaire **Admissible à l’incitation :** No **Éligible à la commission sur les ventes :** No **Avertissement**Nous nous efforçons d’offrir une rémunération compétitive pour ce poste, adaptée à divers facteurs. La rémunération effective dépendra notamment de l’ancienneté, du mérite, de la localisation géographique, du niveau d’études, de l’expérience, des exigences en matière de déplacements et de l’appartenance syndicale. Notre fourchette de rémunération est généralement basée sur la moyenne nationale du pays. Par ailleurs, les avantages peuvent varier en fonction de la région, de l’organisation de l’entreprise, de l’implication syndicale et du statut de l’employé. **Épanouissez\-vous au travail comme à la maison :** * Les avantages sociaux sont accessibles DÈS LE PREMIER JOUR pour vous et votre famille, notamment l’assurance santé et des programmes de bien\-être global offrant de généreuses mesures incitatives – NOUS OSONS PRENDRE SOIN DE VOUS ! * Les avantages liés à la fondation d’une famille comprennent la prise en charge des traitements de fertilité ainsi qu’une aide à l’adoption et à la gestation pour autrui. * Les congés payés comprennent jusqu’à 15 jours de congés, des jours fériés payés, des congés maladie et d’autres options pour soutenir le bénévolat et les congés parentaux. * Abondement au 401K, possibilités de formation et de développement grâce aux programmes de l’entreprise, ainsi qu’une aide aux frais de scolarité et au remboursement de la dette étudiante. Avis : Les avantages proposés peuvent varier selon le site, les conventions collectives et les réglementations locales/de l’État Poste à sensibilité en matière de sécurité No L’entreprise désigne certains postes comme étant sensibles à la sécurité. Les postes sensibles à la sécurité peuvent nécessiter la réussite de contrôles supplémentaires de dépistage de drogues. Ce poste est considéré comme sensible à la sécurité : Nous offrons une rémunération compétitive ainsi que des avantages et des programmes complets. Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances ; tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés pour un emploi sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d’orientation sexuelle, d’identité de genre, d’origine nationale, de grossesse, d’âge, de statut marital, de handicap, de statut de vétéran protégé ou de tout autre statut protégé par la loi.

jobs.title: Lead Data Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Family** IT \- General**About Us** At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms. **What We Do** Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs. Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** Provides technical leadership in the design, development, and delivery of enterprise analytics and reporting solutions. Partners with business and technology teams to translate complex data and reporting needs into scalable data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions. Establishes analytics standards, improves data quality and reporting processes, and serves as a technical resource for modern cloud data and visualization technologies.**Job Description** Responsibilities * Lead the design, development, implementation, and support of enterprise analytics, reporting, and dashboard solutions. * Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver datadriven insights that improve business outcomes. * Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into actionable recommendations. * Design, develop, and optimize SQL queries, data transformations, and analytical datasets to support reporting and decision\-making. * Create and maintain scalable data models, Power BI reports, dashboards, and other enterprise reporting solutions. * Develop and support SSRS, cloud\-based analytics platforms, and reporting environments, including AWS Athena, Snowflake, and Microsoft Fabric. * Collaborate with data architecture and engineering teams to enhance data pipelines, warehouses, cloud platforms, and reporting frameworks. * Establish and promote standards for data governance, quality, security, validation, performance, and reporting best practices. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex data and reporting issues while improving accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and scalability. * Provide technical leadership, design oversight, mentorship, and guidance for analytics modernization, cloud migration, and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience * 7\+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, reporting, or a related discipline * Advanced experience developing and optimizing SQL queries and working with Microsoft SQL Server * Experience developing and supporting enterprise reporting solutions using SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and Power BI * Experience with data modeling, data warehousing, data transformation, and data integration concepts and practices * Experience with cloud analytics technologies, including AWS Athena and Snowflake * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including pipelines, OneLake, and d plicants must possess legal authorization to work for our company in the U.S. without the need for immigration, sponsorship or otherwise serving as an employer of record for immigration employment purposes. At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration\-related employment authorization sponsorship. *This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The* *Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion.* *Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant* *requests or requires an accommodation in order to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business* *Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.* **What We Offer** For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well\-being of our employees. Compensation Benefits * Competitive Pay * Bonus for Eligible Employees Benefits Package * Pension Plan * 401k Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Insurance * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Employee Discounts * Career Training \& Development Opportunities Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits * Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service. * Ten (10\) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays). * Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars * Parental Leave – fifteen (15\) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child. * Adoption Assistance * Employee Assistance Program * Back\-Up Care Program * PTO for Volunteer Hours * Employee Matching Gifts Program * Employee Resource Groups * Inclusion and Diversity Programs * Employee Recognition Program * Referral Bonus Programs **Inclusion \& Diversity** We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women. To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company\-sponsored, employee\-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all. **Giving Back** We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994\. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work. **Transamerica’s Parent Company** Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999\. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23\.9 million people across the globe.\* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: **Helping people live their best lives.** As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity. * As of December 31, 2023

jobs.title: Data Product Lead, External Data
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it. **Compensation Overview** The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance\-based cash incentive awards. **Salary Range** $157,500\.00 \- $259,900\.00**Target Openings** 1**What Is the Opportunity?** Travelers Data Engineering team constructs pipelines that contextualize and provide easy access to data by the entire enterprise. As a Data Engineering Senior Director you will accelerate growth and transformation of our analytics landscape. In this role, you will lead teams designing and building data solutions that capture, explore, transform and utilize data to support Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and business intelligence/insights. In addition to ingesting data from multiple sources and relaying information to relevant partners, you will also mentor and develop a team of data engineers.**What Will You Do?** * Lead development of analytic data products, including pilots and proof of concepts. * Execute data strategies to support various consumption patterns and identify enterprise architecture, platform, and application infrastructure needs. * Drive the operationalizing and automating of all capabilities to ensure secure, supported and scalable solutions. * Present analysis and recommendations to help influence management and executive leadership decisions. * Guide and coach senior team members to accelerate career development. * Establish budgets, policies and practices with significant impact on area operations. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?** * Bachelor’s Degree in STEM related field or equivalent. * Eight or more years of related work experience. * Four or more years of team leadership experience. * Demonstrated experience partnering with data science teams to support analytical and modeling initiatives. * Proven hands\-on background in data
