jobs.title: PLC Programmer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated PLC programmer to join our custom automation team. This role is responsible for programming, testing, and troubleshooting PLCs and related controls for automated manufacturing systems. Day\-to\-day tasks include developing logic and control strategies, configuring hardware and software, and integrating PLC programs with sensors, drives, HMIs, and other automation components. The PLC Programmer collaborates with engineers and project teams to interpret electrical schematics, system requirements, and customer specifications, ensuring safe and efficient machine operation. The role also involves commissioning equipment on the shop floor, diagnosing issues during start\-up, documenting programs and changes, and providing ongoing technical support to operations Up to 10% travel required. Most trips are 3\-5 days max. **Qualifications** * Candidates should possess strong PLC programming and troubleshooting skills (e.g., ladder logic, structured text) and experience with common industrial PLC platforms. * Candidates should possess skills in industrial automation and controls, including working with HMIs, motion control, VFDs, sensors, and industrial communication networks. * Candidates should possess skills in reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation, with attention to safety and compliance. * Candidates should possess skills in project execution, including requirement gathering, documentation, testing, and commissioning of automated systems. * Candidates should possess strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve control system issues in a manufacturing environment. * Candidates should possess effective communication and teamwork skills, and be comfortable collaborating with engineers, technicians, and customers on\-site. * Relevant qualifications such as an associate or bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, automation, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, are beneficial. * Experience in industrial manufacturing environments and familiarity with safety standards and best practices (e.g., lockout/tagout, machine safeguarding) are beneficial. Pay: $35\.00 \- $48\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 – 50\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Holland, MI 49424

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Arcade (Backend)
jobs.description: The right candidate is passionate about building and has the ability and agency to drive projects to completion. You should be excited by the prospect of owning a large part of our engineering system, and continuously looking for more responsibility to take on. Being a backend engineer at Triumph is both demanding and rewarding, and your scope will cover (but not be limited to): * Building consumer facing features to help Triumph's core business metrics * Work closely with data team to solve difficult data driven problems, such as optimal matchmaking, anti\-fraud, etc. + Help drive these complex solution into production * Iterating on engineering processes to allow the growing team to ship fast \- eg. experimentation platforms, improving CI/CD Above all, we hire people for their slope, who are willing to match the pace and energy of the growth curve of the company. While we ask a lot, we regularly double down on our top people. **What You'll Work On (Arcade)** -------------------------------- Triumph Arcade is a mobile platform where players compete in skill\-based games for cash and prizes: async tournaments, real\-time 1v1 matches, streaks, leagues and daily challenges. Triumph earns a service fee on each competition. The backend decides who plays whom, scores every game, pays out winners and keeps play fair, across millions of games a week. You will work on: * **Game modes and tournaments.** Build and evolve async tournaments, blitz, streaks, leagues, challenges and new formats to engage in skill based games. * **Matchmaking.** Pair players by skill so matches are fast and fair, even in small pools. * **Real\-time multiplayer.** Own live matches end to end: spin up game servers, connect players with low latency, and settle results. * **Rewards and offers.** Build the personalization engine that gives each player the right reward or offer at the right time. * **Integrity.** Work with fraud and payments to detect collusion, score tampering and multi\-accounting. * **Scalability.** Build and improve backend scalability to support the next 10x of growth. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 3\+ years of experience as a backend engineer (Go is nice) * Experience with storage systems (e.g., databases, object stores, or distributed file systems) * Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across work streams within your team and contribute to your peers' success * A strong personal slope and desire to grow one's career **Why Triumph?** ---------------- * **High growth.** Build a high\-scale consumer platform that touches gaming, finance, and social with the autonomy to set our web direction. * **High agency.** Small, high\-impact engineering team that is growing rapidly with significant opportunity for leadership and growth. * **High energy.** Passionate team who are proud of our work and velocity. * **Competitive salary and benefits.** $400/mo lunch credit, healthcare, vision, dental, 401k, etc. Our team gathers 5 days a week at Triumph’s headquarters in San Francisco. Collaboration:** Partner with cloud architects, DevOps, infrastructure engineers, and security operations teams to integrate security into cloud deployments, support security assessments, and jobs.title: Dev Ops Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **Dev Ops Engineer** Hybrid – Paoli, PA The DevOps Engineer plays a critical role in Turn5's E\-Commerce development organization, owning the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and runtime environments that power our e\-commerce platform and supporting services. Reporting to the Sr. Technical Delivery Manager and working closely with developers, architects, and the IT support team, this role keeps development and production environments reliable, observable, and fast, and helps the team ship changes with confidence. **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines that provide reliable, repeatable builds, testing, and deployments for ASP.NET and C\# applications. * Manage and support Kubernetes clusters through Rancher, including workload deployment, scaling, upgrades, and overall cluster health. * Build, maintain, and optimize Docker images and container configurations for development and production workloads. * Administer our internal container and NuGet package repositories (ProGet), including feeds, access, retention, and package promotion across environments. * Configure and maintain load balancers to ensure high availability, proper traffic distribution, and consistent performance of production services. * Manage Cloudflare configuration, including DNS, caching, security rules, and traffic routing, to protect and accelerate our e\-commerce sites. * Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting across applications and infrastructure, respond to alerts, and tune thresholds to surface real issues without excess noise. * Troubleshoot and resolve production and development environment issues, partnering with developers to identify root causes and prevent recurrence. * Analyze performance and monitoring data, and funnel findings and improvement recommendations back to the development team. * Support the E\-Commerce Development team day to day by providing environments, tooling, and technical guidance that keep development work moving. * Work with the IT support team on networking, access, server, and environment needs, coordinating handoffs and resolving shared issues. * Document environments, deployment processes, and runbooks so knowledge is shared and incident response is consistent. * Participate in incident response and an after\-hours support rotation as needed for critical production issues. **What We’re Looking For** We value strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to grow. If you’re stronger on some of these and lighter on others, that’s perfectly fine – we’re more interested in your ability to solve problems, collaborate, and grow with the team. If you have a solid foundation and are excited to learn, we want to hear from you. * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows with a modern CI/CD platform. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes and a management platform such as Rancher, including deploying and troubleshooting containerized workloads. * Proficiency with Docker or similar container tooling and container\-based development and deployment practices. * Experience configuring and managing load balancers and web traffic routing. * Experience with Cloudflare or a similar CDN provider, including DNS, caching, and security features. * Experience managing private container registries and NuGet package repositories, such as ProGet or similar artifact management tools. * Experience with monitoring and alerting tools and practices, and a data\-driven approach to performance tuning. * Familiarity with ASP.NET Core on .NET 10 and C\# sufficient to build, debug, and troubleshoot application issues alongside developers. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to stay calm and methodical during production incidents. * Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, IT support, and non\-technical stakeholders. **Who You’ll Work With** You’ll join an eCommerce Development group made up of senior and mid\-level developers, and you’ll work closely with our IT Development and IT Support teams. We prioritize work\-life balance, clear communication, and helping each other succeed. **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * Hybrid schedule: * Local (within 50 miles of our HQ in Paoli, PA): typically 2 days onsite per month (yes, month!) * Remote: 2 weeks onsite per year * Competitive compensation in\-line with experience \& impact, plus a quarterly bonus program * Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision plus immediate vesting on your 401k match * A people\-first culture where curiosity, ownership, and collaboration are valued * Opportunities to grow your technical skillset and contribute to impactful, high\-visibility products **About Turn5** Turn5 is one of the largest and fastest growing eCommerce retailers in the Greater Philadelphia area. Best known for our award\-winning, eCommerce platforms, AmericanMuscle.com, ExtremeTerrain.com, and AmericanTrucks.com, we’ve been engaging muscle car, truck, and off\-road enthusiasts with exceptional products, services, and experiences since 2004\. With the acquisition of Eckler’s in 2022, a pioneer in classic car restoration \& modification for over 60 years, Turn5’s catalog of brands has expanded to now offer aftermarket automotive products for vehicles as classic as the Model T. Our purpose, however, extends beyond selling car parts. We have a commitment to creating meaningful customer experiences at every step of their journey. Whether it’s supplying a unique product that customizes the look and feel of their ride, providing thousands of educational videos for the DIYer or leveraging user generated content to inspire even the most experienced owner, we are obsessed with ensuring we reach as many like\-minded gearheads across the globe as we can.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Service Mesh & Networking
jobs.description: **About the Role** Every service at Uber relies on the service mesh to find, reach, and trust the services it depends on, and the 1M\+ concurrent trips Uber supports depend on it. The Service Mesh team builds and operates this layer across Uber's global infrastructure, where every millisecond the mesh adds contributes to the critical path of user\-facing requests, efficiency gains translate directly into compute capacity, and every change must be designed to roll out safely. As a Staff Software Engineer on the team, you will set technical direction for the proxy and networking infrastructure that carries Uber's service\-to\-service traffic. You will own problems end to end, from design through production rollout and long\-term operation, working across Uber's security, network, compute, and storage stacks and with the product engineering teams whose services run on the mesh. **What You'll Do** * Define the multi\-quarter technical roadmap for the service mesh forwarding layer, including how core components of a live system evolve incrementally while traffic keeps flowing. * Drive down the latency and compute cost of the forwarding path, from proxy performance to smarter load balancing across hosts and zones, and roll out improvements safely. * Evolve the forwarding layer toward a horizontally scalable, compartmentalized architecture so routing state and failures stay contained as the mesh grows. * Strengthen service identity and authorization in the mesh without regressing tail latency. * Build observability that makes the mesh explainable, from request\-level visibility to clear signals for service owners and on\-call engineers. * Partner with product engineering teams and the teams behind Uber's security, network, compute, and storage stacks to turn their needs into platform capabilities. * Lead through influence by writing design docs, setting standards, leading incident response and postmortems, mentoring engineers, and introducing automation, including AI\-based workflows, where it reduces toil. **About the Team** The Service Mesh team routes and load balances traffic between all Uber services across on\-premises data centers and multiple public clouds, providing discovery, overload protection, traffic shifting, and service identity on both proxied and peer\-to\-peer paths. We follow a few core principles: failures stay contained, changes are staged, observed, and reversible, and efficiency gains fund new capabilities. Our direction is a single Envoy\-based forwarding layer that runs natively on Kubernetes and aligns with open standards such as the Gateway API. The Service Mesh team is part of the Platform Engineering Team (PET), which includes Compute, Network, Storage, Reliability and Hardware Engineering, Corporate IT, and more. PET's mission is to "Empower One Uber to innovate by building a world\-class foundation that accelerates growth at scale." **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of software engineering experience. * Proficiency in one or more of Go, C\+\+, or Java. * Experience building and operating large\-scale, latency\-sensitive distributed systems or infrastructure in production. * Experience leading multi\-team engineering projects through their full lifecycle, working across infrastructure and product teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Strong working knowledge of networking protocols such as HTTP/2, gRPC, and TLS, as well as load balancing and traffic management. * Experience with proxies or service mesh technologies such as Envoy, and with Kubernetes networking. * Experience with service identity, authentication, and authorization, such as mTLS and SPIFFE. * Experience with safe change management for critical infrastructure, including staged rollouts, backward compatibility, rollback, and incremental migrations that keep old and new paths interoperable. * Contributions to open\-source projects such as Envoy or gRPC. * A track record of mentoring engineers and raising the hiring bar. jobs.title: CONSULTANCY - Senior Full-stack Software Developer - Climpact Modernization - SSA 2026-CRI-SSCD-4
jobs.description: **Background** Climate science information plays a critical role in supporting evidence\-based climate adaptation, risk management and sustainable development. The effective use of climate observations, analyses and indices enables National Meteorological and Hydrological Services (NMHSs) to contribute more effectively to national planning and decision\-making processes, particularly the development and implementation of National Adaptation Plans (NAPs) and Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs). Strengthening NMHSs' capacity to generate and communicate reliable climate science information is therefore essential to informing climate\-resilient policies, sectoral services and engagement, and investment decisions. To strengthen the capacities of Members, particularly in Least Developed Countries (LDCs) and Small Island Developing States (SIDS), the WMO has organized more than twenty training workshops on Climate Science Information for Climate Action (CSICA) and related topics over the past decade. These workshops provide practical methodologies and hands\-on training in climate data quality control and homogenization, climate indices calculation, co\-creation cross sectors, and the interpretation and application of climate information for adaptation planning and climate services. Climpact has been a core software tool supporting these activities, enabling NMHSs to the best\-available climate science information, calculate climate indices and generate information relevant to national and sectoral planning. Climpact evolved from international efforts to standardize climate extremes indices, initially advanced through the Working Group on Climate Change Detection (WGCCD) and subsequently the Expert Team on Climate Change Detection and Indices (ETCCDI). Building on RClimDEX, Climpact incorporated both core climate extremes indices and sector\-specific indices to support the growing demand for climate services. Over recent years, feedback from workshop participants and NMHSs has highlighted a growing need to modernize Climpact and improve its functionality, accessibility and user experience. In particular, the online version faces performance and stability challenges in countries with limited internet bandwidth, while the desktop version requires complex installation and dependency management, posing difficulties for users, particularly those working in Windows environments. Members have also expressed the need for more efficient quality control workflows, improved visualization and greater flexibility to incorporate new scientific functions. These challenges have reinforced the need for a more reliable, user\-friendly and sustainable software platform. This consultancy is looking for a full\-stack developer to redesign the Climpact web portal. The redesigned portal should consist of a Python\-based backend for calculating climate indices (based on user\-provided climate data), and a front\-end based on the latest internet standards for accessibility and security. Key priorities are interactive visualisations, bandwidth efficiency, low maintenance and modular code, scalable performance, containerization and an emphasis on open\-source technologies. In parallel, the consultant is also expected to work with climate indices scientific community on the scientific computing of climate indices. **Duties and Responsibilities** The Consultant will work under the overall supervision of the Chief of the Climate Research and Information Section and will report monthly to the Junior Professional Officer of the Section. The Consultant shall work collaboratively with WMO staff and external Climpact experts on technical requirements, software integration and scientific consultations. The development process will follow an iterative approach, with periodic joint reviews, testing and revisions coordinated by the WMO Secretariat. Under this structure, the consultant will: * **Review the existing Climpact software** , including its source code, architecture, dependencies, scientific calculation modules, user interface and deployment arrangements, and identify technical limitations and opportunities for modernization and reuse of existing components. * **Design a modern, modular, and maintainable back\-end architecture** for the upgraded Climpact, leveraging established open\-source scientific computing libraries, particularly the Python\-based xclim package. Define the core framework, data processing workflows, module interfaces, and integration strategy, ensuring compatibility with existing and future scientific functions. * **Develop and implement the core software functions** , supporting climate data calculation workflows for station\-based and gridded datasets, and enabling the modular integration of quality control, climate indices calculation and homogeneity assessment functions in collaboration with WMO climate indices experts. * **Develop a user\-friendly front\-end with interactive visualizations** , enabling users to  7 working days) * Online deployment of the initial Climpact application, integrating the developed software framework and essential functionalities, with consideration for accessibility, low\-bandwidth environments, system stability and future offline deployment compatibility. (Estimated 5 working days) Technical testing, documentation and handover, including unit and integration testing, verification of essential workflows, resolution of identified technical issues, source code and repository documentation, deployment instructions, and recommendations for further development and scientific validation. (Estimated 3 working days) * **Required Skills and Experience** **Education:** A university degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a closely related field. **Experience:** * At least five years of full\-stack experience demonstrated in designing, implementing and deploying modular and scalable web\-based applications, preferably involving scientific computing, to platforms such as Amazon web services. * Proven experience in Python programming and developing modular, containerized and maintainable software applications using open\-source libraries and frameworks. * Experience in developing user\-friendly web interfaces with a focus on data visualization functions and interactive data\-processing workflows. **Other Requirements:** * Familiarity with scientific computing libraries such as NumPy, pandas and xarray. Experience with climate data processing and visualisation, particularly including xclim or similar libraries would be an advantage. * Experience working with time\-series and gridded datasets, particularly NetCDF or other climate and environmental data formats, would be an advantage. * Knowledge of R programming and experience integrating R\-based functionalities into Python applications would be an advantage. * Good understanding of software quality assurance, dependency management, automated testing and open\-source development practices. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently, communicate effectively with scientific experts and deliver results within agreed timelines. **Languages:** Excellent command of written and spoken English required. Knowledge of another UN language is an asset. (Note: the official languages of the Organization are Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish.) **Salary and Allowances:** Pay band C \- USD 390\.\- / USD 560\.\- **Duration** : 40 days over a period of 6 months **Focal point:** Xinrui WU, xwu@wmo.int **Applications:** Applications should be made online through the WMO e\-recruitment system. Do not send your application via multiple routes. WMO no longer accepts applications via post or email. Only applicants for whom WMO has a further interest will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be required to sit a written test and/or an interview. **Statements:** WMO is committed to achieving diversity and a balanced workforce. Applications are welcome from qualified women and men, including those with disabilities. The statutory retirement age is 65\. Pursuant to WMO Standing Instructions, the minimum age to be eligible for consideration for vacant positions is 18, and the maximum age must enable the candidate to serve for at least the term of the contract before reaching mandatory age of separation. **Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority** WMO does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles. **Scam alert** WMO does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). WMO will not ask for applicants’ bank account information.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer II
jobs.description: Description: **FORGENT** Transformer Business **Mechanical Design Engineer II** Location: Waco, TX \| Reports to: Mechanical Engineering Manager \| Department: Engineering – Transformer Business **About Forgent** Forgent designs and manufactures liquid\-filled transformers that keep power moving for utilities, industrial customers, and communities across the country. We're a team that believes great products come from great people — people who are given the trust, the tools, and the runway to do their best work. Our culture is built on five values that show up in how we hire, how we lead, and how we get things done: Powered by People, You Belong, Own It, Think Boldly, and Winning Pace. **Position Summary** Forgent is seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer II to lead the mechanical design and drafting of our liquid\-filled transformer product line in Waco, TX. Building on solid transformer mechanical design experience, this engineer works independently on more complex designs — tanks, radiators, core/coil support structures, bushings, and hardware — owns assigned orders from concept through production release, and provides technical guidance to junior engineers and drafters. Reporting to the Mechanical Engineering Manager, the Mechanical Design Engineer II combines strong design execution with design\-for\-manufacturability and cross\-functional partnership across manufacturing, quality, and electrical engineering. **Key Responsibilities** Mechanical Design \& Drafting * Independently develop mechanical models and drawings for transformer tanks, radiators/cooling systems, core and coil support structures, bushings, and hardware, including more complex and custom units. * Own assigned orders from concept through detailed drawings, bills of materials, and documentation to production release. * Perform and verify structural, thermal, and dimensional calculations to ensure designs meet requirements. * Review and approve mechanical drawings, cross\-checking work before release, and ensure conformance to design standards. Design\-for\-Manufacturability \& Support * Drive design\-for\-manufacturability (DFM) improvements to reduce cost, improve build quality, and shorten cycle time on the shop floor. * Lead root\-cause analysis and corrective action on mechanical issues surfaced from manufacturing, test, or the field. * Provide expert mechanical support to the factory floor and resolve fit, dimension, and hardware issues. * Mentor and check the work of the Mechanical Design Engineer I and drafting staff. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Partner with Electrical Engineering to ensure mechanical designs support electrical performance requirements. * Work with Quality to resolve mechanical nonconformances and support investigations. * Collaborate with Supply Chain on component selection, supplier drawings, and make/buy decisions. * Support customer\-facing engineering requests, including drawing reviews and technical clarifications. **What Success Looks Like** * Complex mechanical designs are released on time, manufacturable, and require minimal rework on the shop floor. * Mechanical issues are caught and resolved quickly, with clear root\-cause thinking and durable fixes. * Junior design engineers and drafters grow in capability with the Design Engineer II's guidance and review. * Engineering, Manufacturing, and Operations stay aligned on assigned orders. **How You'll Live Our Values in This Role** * **Powered by People:** You'll mentor junior engineers and drafters and collaborate across the plant, giving and receiving the trust and support that make great work possible. * **You Belong:** You'll help create a team environment where every engineer and drafter feels heard, valued, and set up to contribute. * **Own It:** You'll take full ownership of your designs from concept to production release, standing behind their quality. * **Think Boldly:** You'll challenge legacy design assumptions and push for better, smarter, more manufacturable transformer designs rather than defaulting to “how it's always been done.” * **Winning Pace:** You'll keep mechanical output moving at the speed the business needs, balancing urgency with the rigor required for equipment that has to perform in the field for decades. **Position Details** * Location: Waco, TX (on\-site). * Travel: Occasional (approximately 5–10%) to supplier or other Forgent facilities as needed. * Reports to: Mechanical Engineering Manager. * Direct reports: None (provides technical guidance to junior engineers and drafters). * Compensation: Competitive base salary, commensurate with experience \[insert range], plus bonus eligibility and full benefits. Forgent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Requirements: **Qualifications** Required * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field (required). * 3–5 years of mechanical design experience, ideally in transformer or heavy electrical equipment / power products. * Strong working knowledge of mechanical design principles as applied to structural, thermal, and manufacturing considerations for large industrial equipment. * Proven ability to independently create and approve detailed mechanical drawings and specifications. * Proficiency with SolidWorks and AutoCAD. * Strong communication skills across manufacturing, quality, and electrical engineering. Preferred * Direct experience designing liquid\-filled power or distribution transformers (tanks, radiators, core/coil structures, bushings). * Track record of driving DFM or cost\-reduction initiatives on the shop floor. * Familiarity with relevant industry design standards and codes applicable to liquid\-filled transformers. * Experience mentoring junior engineers or drafters.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Connect
jobs.description: * Engineering * San Francisco * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About the Role:** ------------------- Vercel Connect helps developers give agents and AI\-built apps secure access to the data, tools, and events they need—without wrestling with OAuth, credentials, and integration complexity. We’re currently building two things: 1\) a platform for managing agent identity, access and permissions and 2\) a set of rich connectors for the 1000s of systems (like Linear, Slack, GitHub, Google, etc.) that agents will need to talk to. We’re solving core problems like agent identity and delegated access, tool approval and standards around making agents aware of changes on 3rd party platforms. As a senior engineer on this team you'll not only own our APIs, token infrastructure, authorization, SDKs, and more, but work with external companies to make it easier for developers to build agents that integrate with their products. You’ll need to balance both high uptime and fast performance with flexibility to allow for seamless connection to many systems that weren’t designed with agents in mind. If you’re looking for a role that will put you at the center of how agent identity and credentials work, this is it! This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, in the office on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. **What You Will Do:** --------------------- * Ship provider integrations end to end — auth flows, token exchange, app registration, and the configuration UI — from generic API\-key and OAuth presets through bespoke cases like Snowflake Partner Connect, Slack manager apps, and Microsoft Entra. * Own and improve our infrastructure (uptime, performance, secure storage of credentials and keys) and developer experience for Connect * Work with industry leaders within and outside of Vercel to propose and implement new authentication and authorization protocols for AI era * Build and harden event forwarding — signature verification inbound, project\-scoped identity outbound, delivered to the right deployment and environment. * Make Connect the obvious way to give an agent a credential, extending the SDKs , consent\-redirect flow, and framework adapters. * Reduce the cost of the next hundred integrations, so most new providers become configuration rather than code. **About You:** -------------- * 6\+ years building and operating production backend or full\-stack systems, with a track record of owning a service or platform surface rather than a feature. * You deeply understand your users problems and work in a focused manner to address them, leveling up the product you’re working on over time. * Deep, practical understanding of OAuth 2\.0/2\.1, OIDC, and JWTs — not just wiring up a client library, but reasoning about authorization codes, PKCE, refresh semantics, audience and scope restriction, token exchange, and what each of those actually protects against. * A security instinct for integration code specifically — SSRF and DNS rebinding, confused\-deputy and mix\-up attacks, redirect\-URI validation, webhook signature verification, tenant isolation. jobs.title: Software Engineering Senior Manager
jobs.description: **About this role:** We are seeking a **Software Engineering Senior Manager** to lead engineering teams responsible for Digital Experience Protection (DEP) capabilities that protect customer interactions from sophisticated bots, account abuse, fraudulent automation, and emerging agent\-driven threats. This is a senior technical leadership role combining engineering leadership, architectural depth, software\-engineering expertise, production ownership, and digital threat protection. The successful candidate will move comfortably between organizational leadership, architecture and design reviews, implementation discussions, production reliability, threat analysis, and technology strategy. This leader will help evolve DEP beyond traditional bot detection toward protecting interactions among humans, applications, automated systems, and autonomous agents, while advancing scalable platforms and AI\-enabled detection capabilities. This position is intended for an **engineering leader who manages, rather than a general manager who happens to lead engineering teams**. The successful leader will combine strong people leadership and technical judgment engaging constructively with architects and senior engineers, bringing alternative perspectives and respectfully challenging assumptions when appropriate. They will guide platform and AI strategy, and make consequential decisions involving customer experience, protection effectiveness, and production reliability. They will have the prowess to guide the engineering of AI\-native detection capabilities, not simply manage the adoption of AI technologies. **In this role, you will:** * **Provide Technical and Architectural Leadership** + Lead engineering teams responsible for business\-critical DEP platforms, services, APIs, detection capabilities, and integrations. + Establish technical strategy aligned with business needs, customer experience, and the evolving threat environment. + Lead architecture and design reviews covering scalability, resiliency, security, latency, observability, and maintainability. + Maintain sufficient coding and technical depth to review implementations, APIs, detection logic, and AI\-enabled solutions. + Guide development of modular, API\-first architectures that enable rapid integration of new signals, models, rules, vendors, and internal capabilities. + Lead modernization of legacy and vendor\-dependent capabilities while maintaining production stability and protection effectiveness. * **Advance Bot, Automation, and Abuse Defense** + Lead engineering strategy for detecting bots, scripted automation, credential\-based attacks, account abuse, automated fraud, and emerging machine\-driven threats. + Guide layered detection and decisioning using network, device, behavioral, identity, account, transaction, and historical risk signals. + Translate attack patterns, control gaps, and adversary behavior into scalable technical capabilities. + Partner across fraud, cybersecurity, authentication, digital product, architecture, infrastructure, and application engineering. + Balance protection effectiveness with customer experience, latency, operational complexity, and business risk. + Measure control effectiveness and adapt defenses as adversaries evolve. * **Lead AI\-Native Detection and Agent Strategy** + Lead development of AI\- and LLM\-based solutions that interpret user activity, behavioral signals, interaction sequences, and telemetry to identify suspicious or emerging behaviors. + Determine where LLM reasoning, machine learning, deterministic rules, and behavioral analytics should be used independently or together. + Guide production AI architecture, including model integration, grounding, tool calling, evaluation, observability, security, reliability, latency, and appropriate deterministic controls. + Establish methods for measuring the accuracy, explainability, operational performance, and protection value of AI\-based capabilities. + Drive experimentation while establishing clear criteria for moving AI solutions into production. + Prepare DEP for interactions involving humans, traditional automation, software agents, and autonomous AI agents. + Develop approaches for evaluating automated interactions based on identity, intent, provenance, authorization, behavior, trust, and risk. + Apply AI to improve detection engineering, investigation, threat analysis, testing, software delivery, and operational support. * **Build and Lead Strong Engineering Teams** + Recruit, develop, and retain engineers, technical leads, architects, and engineering managers. + Build a culture in which leaders remain technically engaged and teams understand both the platforms and threats they address. + Establish expectations for code quality, automated testing, deployment safety, observability, vulnerability remediation, documentation, and production ownership. + Develop technical leaders capable of independently owning complex platforms and architectural decisions. + Reduc e Labs, Akamai Bot Manager, or comparable platforms. * Experience with behavioral biometrics, anomaly detection, risk engines, or fraud\-detection platforms. * Experience designing or operating production AI/LLM solutions, particularly those interpreting behavioral, event, transaction, or telemetry data. * Experience combining LLM reasoning with deterministic rules, machine learning, or behavioral analytics. * Working knowledge of LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, model gateways, tool calling, AI agents, evaluation, and AI\-assisted engineering. * Understanding of adversarial AI and how generative AI and autonomous agents can change automated threats. * Experience modernizing high\-volume platforms or building internal capabilities that reduce reliance on proprietary technologies. **Job jobs.title: Sr. Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Westlake offers you the potential to enrich your work life and career experience in an entrepreneurial environment. We work together to enhance peoples' lives through our products and presence in the communities in which we operate.** **SUMMARY** The primary role of this position is to provide the necessary engineering and technical support to continuously improve plant rotating equipment integrity, reliability, cost and economic performance. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** *May include, but are not limited to, the following:* * Provide technical support to production and maintenance departments. * Learn and understand maintenance and production work processes, methods, cost points, etc. * Longview Site resource for polymers processing equipment, including gearboxes, extruders, mixers, melt pumps and rotary feeders. * Develop and maintain reliability improvement / tracking programs for critical assets. * Serve as leader and/ or member of cross\-functional teams to resolve equipment problems, investigate incidents, and improve reliability * Perform root cause failure analysis on critical equipment failures and failures that result in economic impact greater than $ 100,000\. * Perform component failure analysis as required. * Participate in the maintenance budgeting process. * Witness repairs to critical equipment and performance testing of new equipment as needed. * Initiate capital projects to maintain / enhance business goals * Assist in the development and monitoring of the preventative maintenance program * Participate actively in department/plant safety and environmental programs * Investigate and evaluate new methodologies, work practices, and technology * Develop / Review / Maintain equipment specifications as related to purchasing, installation, operation, and maintenance / repairs. * Develop and implement alteration and revisions to equipment to improve business performance of the operating units. * Lead equipment PM programs from a technical perspective * Provide administrative and technical support to the maintenance organization concerning improvement\-oriented efforts. * Perform duties in a manner that protects personal safety as well as the safety of all personnel on site. Whenever appropriate, promptly report Safety, Health or Environmental incidents or issues to management so the situation can be corrected. Attend Monthly Safety Meetings to help prevent off site and job accidents. **EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferably Mechanical Engineering. * Preferred: 15\+ years of relevant industry experience. * Required: Minimum 8 years of experience in rotating equipment engineering, reliability, or maintenance within the petrochemical, chemical, or related process industries. * Experience with reliability improvement programs, root cause failure analysis (RCFA), and rotating equipment troubleshooting. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** This job is performed mainly in control room or office setting; physical presence is required. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; stand; walk; have full use and range of motion of arms, hands and fingers to reach, grasp, hold, push or pull, twist, and work with tools; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to perform tasks that may require bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, lying down or working from elevated platforms. The employee must be able to move safely over uneven terrain or in confined spaces. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. The employee must be able to see details of objects that are more/less than a few feet away; see differences between colors, shades and brightness and determine the distance between objects. This job requires response to audible emergency alarms inside of the plant. Employee must be able to evacuate when required. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** The employee must be able to work in a normal factory environment, including enclosed spaces and exposure to various hazards. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate as normally based in an office. Some of the work may be required in the operating units which can require usage of required PPE including safety glasses, hearing protection, flame retardant clothing, etc. May also result in exposure to outside elements and may require usage of stairs and elevators. Travel including air travel or auto travel may occasionally be required. Westlake is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristics protected by applicable legislation. **If you are an active Westlake employee (or an employee of any Westlake affiliates), please do not apply here. You will apply via the Jobs Hub application in Workday.**

jobs.description: Wizard is the AI\-native platform for creative work, starting with professional video: a native C\+\+ editor and headless media runtime that humans, agents, and developers all operate. *Own transcription, AI\-assisted editing features and local model serving so Wizard's AI works in real time on the desktop.* **Why this role matters** ========================= Our GTM plan hinges on a five\-minute demo: raw footage in, Oz assembles a cut, a finished trailer comes out — and the trailer's quality is the test of whether any of this actually works. You're building the transcription and inference layer underneath that demo: the thing that has to be fast, accurate, and running locally on somebody's desktop, not a cloud API with a spinner. **About the role** ================== You'll own the transcription pipeline, AI\-assisted editing features, and model integration (local and API) that make Wizard's AI features actually work in real time on desktop. We think we're at the start of the next one, and we intend to build the company that defines it. Wizard is the AI\-native platform for creative work, starting with the hardest creative workflow: professional video. In roughly six months, our team built a native C\+\+ editor and a headless media runtime that humans, agents, and developers all operate. Oz, our agent, ingests footage at roughly 300× real time and edits at 30–60× real time, and every change it makes stays inspectable, editable, and reversible. Set the direction for Wonder's autonomous development agents and cloud agent solutions, including access controls and guardrails. * Bring Outside Patterns In: Bring a sharp point of view on where AI\-assisted development actually creates leverage across review, testing, code generation, and documentation, and translate the best emerging practices into standards that fit Wonder's stack, scale, and constraints. * Raise the Ceiling on Review: Set the strategy for pre\-review and triage tooling that clears and automates mechanical and policy issues before a human looks, and define standards for reviewing AI\-generated code across Wonder Engineering. * Instrument for Efficiency, Not Just Adoption: Define the strategy and architecture for the systems that optimize AI costs across the org and abstract model selection away from engineers' day to day, so the platform routes each task to the right model at the right cost without every engineer having to reason about it. Define and measure developer velocity, tying AI spend to the outcomes it produces. * Guide Technical Outcomes: Set technical direction for developer tooling and ensure each team's deliverables add up to a complete cross\-team solution, weighing tradeoffs (including build vs. buy, cost, and risk) and partnering with platform, infrastructure, and application teams and engineering leadership to land it in production. * Communicate Effectively: Write clear strategy docs, specs, and documentation, and provide, seek, and incorporate feedback from a team and organization still defining its own practices. Translate complex technical tradeoffs for audiences across departments and leadership levels, and mentor senior engineers in building durable, auditable AI\-assisted engineering practices. **What You Bring to the Table** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including recent, hands\-on work building with or on top of LLM\-based tooling (agents, MCP servers, coding assistants, or similar). * Direct experience integrating AI tools into real development workflows — code review, testing, code generation, or documentation — beyond individual use as an end user, ideally at organizational scale. * Strong system design skills and a track record of owning tools or platforms end\-to\-end, from design through adoption across multiple teams. * Comfort operating with ambiguity: this is a new team without established playbooks, and you'll be shaping them. * Experience designing and consuming APIs, webhooks, or other integration/message\-based systems. * Experience building developer tooling, internal platforms, CI/CD systems, or other software used by engineers as its primary users. * Experience with Java/JVM and/or Python is a plus, though not required. * A pragmatic approach to problem solving and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical obstacles. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to drive technical discussions with engineers and leaders across multiple teams, up to the senior director level. Illinois Base Salary: $244,000 \-$253,500\. Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience. **Benefits** The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands. Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here. **A Final Note** At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E\-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. The organization's scope spans from the Gateway to the persistence layer, delivering the scalability, reliability, and efficiency needed to support Workday’s rapidly evolving product landscape. Joining our team means embarking on a journey of opportunity to advance your career and contribute to impactful solutions that shape industries. Whether you thrive with solving sophisticated business problems, collaborating with agile teams, or championing innovation and software design, Workday offers an environment where your talents can thrive. **About the Role** We are seeking a **P4 Senior Development Engineer** to help design, build, optimize, and operate core platform services that power Workday at scale. Automate repetitive operational tasks and support development teams by troubleshooting builds, deployments, runtime issues, and configuration problems. * **Platform Reliability and Operations:** Help design, build, and operate highly available platform capabilities across AWS, GCP, and Workday data centers. Deploy, scale, and optimize containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes with a focus on availability, reliability, security, and resource efficiency. * **Design and Architect High\-Performance Services:** Lead the technical design of core features and microservices, ensuring they are decoupled, horizontally scalable, and optimized for low latency and high throughput. * **Write Core, Highly Efficient Code:** Act as a primary individual contributor, writing clean, production\-ready code for critical paths and refactoring legacy components for maximum efficiency. * **Diagnose and Resolve Performance Bottlenecks:** Conduct deep\-dive profiling, memory footprint analysis, and CPU utilization reviews using APM tools to proactively find and fix bottlenecks before they impact production. * **Optimize the Data Layer:** Own the efficiency of data flow, including designing caching strategies, optimizing database schemas and queries, and selecting efficient serialization formats. * **Pa Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, New Relic, or ELK. * Experience with CI/CD and GitOps tools such as Jenkins, Helm, Argo CD, Argo Workflows, or Kustomize. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively with platform, infrasturcture, and product engineering teams. Experience supporting Java\-based applications and build tools such as Maven or Gradle. * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. jobs.title: Senior CloudOps Engineer
jobs.description: Opportunity Information: **Position Overview** Worldpac is seeking a highly experienced Senior CloudOps Engineer to design, build, operate, and continuously improve the cloud platforms that power our high\-volume wholesale distribution and automotive aftermarket business. As a member of the IT Infrastructure team, this role will be a key hands\-on contributor to Worldpac's cloud infrastructure direction, strategy and operations, delivering the secure, scalable, observable, and cost\-effective cloud foundations required to support our enterprise network, AI, data, and core enterprise applications. The ideal candidate is a seasoned cloud operations engineer who combines deep Microsoft Azure and/or AWS expertise with strong automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, and site reliability skills, and who thrives in a production\-first, 24x7 distribution environment. The successful candidate will drive complex cloud projects to completion, provide thought leadership, and contribute to the development of junior other infrastructure team members in CloudOps areas. **Key Responsibilities** **Cloud Platform Engineering \& Operations** * Design, build, and operate Worldpac's hybrid cloud environment including both Microsoft Azure and AWS, including Landing Zones, subscriptions/accounts, networking, and identity integration. * Own day\-to\-day cloud operations, including provisioning, configuration, patching, scaling, performance tuning, and lifecycle management of cloud compute, storage, database, and PaaS services. * Engineer secure and resilient cloud connectivity between data centers, distribution centers, branches, and cloud environments (e.g., ExpressRoute, VPN, VNet/VPC peering, hub\-and\-spoke), in partnership with Network Engineering. * Integrate cloud workloads with core enterprise platforms, including Microsoft Active Directory/Entra ID, Okta, Nutanix HCI, VMware, and Windows and Linux server environments. * Support container and Kubernetes platforms (e.g., AKS, EKS), including cluster operations, upgrades, and standards aligned with core infrastructure. **AI \& GenAI Platform Enablement** * Build and operate secure, scalable cloud infrastructure for AI and GenAI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock and AgentCore, Google Vertex AI, AI gateways, and MCP servers). * Partner with AI Engineering, Data Strategy \& Analytics, and Software Development teams to rapidly provision environments, GPU/compute capacity, data connectivity, and deployment pipelines for AI use cases. * Implement networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and cost controls that enable safe, governed adoption of generative and agentic AI technologies. * Design and support AI solutions connecting to enterprise systems such as Oracle Fusion, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, IBM i (iSeries), and enterprise data platforms including Snowflake and/or Data Bricks. **Automation, Infrastructure\-as\-Code \& DevOps** * Champion infrastructure\-as\-code and automation (e.g., Terraform, Bicep/ARM, Ansible, PowerShell, Python) to deliver repeatable, version\-controlled, and policy\-compliant cloud deployments. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) for infrastructure and platform changes. * Develop reusable modules, templates, and runbooks that reduce manual effort and accelerate delivery of new cloud services. **Reliability, Monitoring \& Incident Response** * Implement enterprise cloud monitoring and observability (e.g., Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, CloudWatch, SolarWinds) to drive proactive alerting, root\-cause analysis, and capacity planning. * Define and track availability, performance, and reliability metrics (SLOs) for cloud services supporting mission\-critical systems. * Design and test cloud backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities for critical workloads. * Participate in major incident response, problem management, and post\-incident reviews; follow ServiceNow ITSM change, incident, and CMDB processes. * Periodic on\-call rotation (via PagerDuty) serving as a high\-level escalation point for our managed service provider (MSP) during critical system emergencies. **Cloud Security \& Compliance** * Apply cloud security best practices, including Zero Trust principles, least\-privilege access, network segmentation, encryption, and secure configuration baselines, in partnership with Cybersecurity. * Implement and maintain cloud governance guardrails using Azure Policy, AWS Organizations/SCPs, tagging standards, and role\-based access control. * Remediate cloud vulnerabilities and configuration findings, and support compliance and audit requirements (e.g., NIST CSF, SOX ITGC, PCI DSS). **Collaboration \& Technical Leadership** * Independently plan and deliver complex cloud engineering projects from design through implementation and post\-deployment optimization, providing regular status updates to leadership. * Provide indirect leadership, technical mentoring, and direction to junior engineers and contractors. * Produce and maintain clear architecture diagrams, standards, and operational documentation. * Work with the PMO (Project Management Office) to support and drive Cloud FinOps discipline, including expertise to improve cost visibility, tagging, rightsizing, reservations/savings plans, and budget alerting, with regular reporting to leadership. * Work effectively with cloud providers, managed service partners, and vendors, ensuring accountability for service quality, scope, and cost. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** * 10\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud engineering, or cloud operations roles, including at least 5 years hands\-on with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS in production environments. * Deep hands\-on expertise in Microsoft Azure (Landing Zones, VNets, Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, compute, storage, and PaaS services), with working knowledge of AWS. * Experience enabling infrastructure for AI/GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Platform Vertex AI), AI gateways, MCP servers, and agentic AI technologies. * Strong experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and automation tools such as Terraform, Bicep/ARM, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python. * Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and Git\-based workflows. * Experience with containers and Kubernetes (AKS and/or EKS) in production. * Solid understanding of cloud networking, including hybrid connectivity (ExpressRoute, VPN), DNS, load balancing, routing (BGP), and network security controls. * Strong knowledge of cloud security, identity and access management, and governance best practices. * Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident management tools and ITIL\-aligned processes (e.g., ServiceNow, PagerDuty). * Experience with cloud FinOps practices and tools. * Proven track record of independently leading and successfully delivering complex cloud infrastructure projects from conception to completion. * Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across multi\-vendor hybrid environments. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across IT, security, AI, and business teams. * Self\-starter with a proactive mindset and the ability to drive initiatives with minimal supervision. * Flexibility for after\-hours planned maintenance and emergency escalation support, including nights and weekends. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in the automotive aftermarket or other high\-volume distribution/wholesale industries. * Experience supporting IBM i (iSeries), Oracle Fusion Cloud, Snowflake, and warehouse technology environments. * Experience with Nutanix HCI, VMware vSphere, Palo Alto Networks cloud NGFW, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike, and Okta. **Education / Certifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, jobs.title: Enterprise AI and Data Architect
jobs.description: **Company Description** Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI\-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership\-based and service\-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences. **Job Description** **About the opportunity** You’ll be the enterprise architect for data and AI across all seven of our business units. You’ll set the architecture, standards and shared platform that every team builds on, so business units can focus on building products that set them apart, within clear guardrails for security, governance and interoperability. A big part of the job is drawing the line between what we build once centrally (the shared foundation, platform services and standards) and what each business unit owns and builds for itself. You’ll be accountable for making sure our AI and data investments deliver measurable business results and a lasting competitive advantage. This is a hands\-on role. You’ll spend 60 to 80% of your time building. **What you’ll do** ***Architecture and standards*** * Own the enterprise target architecture for data and AI, and publish and maintain reference architectures, standards and decision records * Set architectural principles: modularity, API\-first design, interoperability, reuse, portability and lifecycle management * Decide what’s central by default, what becomes central once reuse is proven, what stays with business units, and what’s jointly owned * Give clear guidance on which technologies, models and patterns to use for which job * Keep a forward\-looking view of AI technologies, vendors, models and frameworks ***Agentic AI platform*** * Help shape the reference architecture for model access, context management, orchestration, retrieval, evaluations, guardrails, identity and telemetry * Help design multi\-tenancy patterns that scale to 130,000\+ businesses, including agents built by customers and partners * Set release requirements for agents: approvals, versioning, rollback, guardrails as policy code and evaluation gates ***Data architecture*** * Set enterprise data standards on Snowflake: semantic layer, governed metrics, data contracts, quality rules, lineage, retention and deletion * Define the split between central standards and business\-unit domain models, and review those models for consistency * Define the technical criteria for data readiness used in product planning * Work with Legal and Privacy on the data architecture for our industry insights product, covering rights, aggregation, consent and lineage ***Standards for AI\-assisted development*** * Turn standards into context that AI coding agents use: repository instruction files, reusable skills and prompts, MCP tool definitions and starter templates * Build architecture rules into CI: policy as code, fitness functions, scans on AI\-generated code, and evaluation gates before release * Define what coding and runtime agents can do in each environment, including tool allow\-lists, least\-privilege access, no secrets or card data in prompts or logs, and human review based on risk * Set patterns for wrapping legacy products with MCP and for AI\-assisted migration * Track delivery metrics such as PR\-to\-production rate, rework within 21 days, change failure rate and AI cost per accepted change ***Security, privacy and responsible AI*** * Work with the AI Security Architect, CISO, Legal and Privacy to build security into every reference architecture: threat models, least privilege, tenant isolation, prompt\-injection defences and server\-side action validation * Make sure the architecture supports data residency, tenant isolation, retention, deletion and contractual data\-use limits * Assess risks from model providers, external AI services, open\-source models, training data, dependencies and third\-party integrations ***Cost, observability and reliability*** * Design cost control into the platform: cost tracking by business unit, product and workflow, token and latency budgets, caching and kill switches * Optimise token use, model choice, context size, retrieval efficiency and compute * Define a standard telemetry schema in Datadog covering outcome, quality, cost and security signals * Set service\-level objectives for central platform services ***Governance and vendors*** * Set up an AI and data governance framework covering ownership, accountability, decision rights, data quality and escalation * Chair the fortnightly Data and AI Architecture, Security and Risk Council, and present trade\-offs to the Executive AI Steering group * Lead technical evaluation of AI platforms, models and data tools, and reduce overlap and lock\-in (one gateway, abstraction layers, a tested exit plan) * Set technical standards for consultants, including code in Xplor repos, pairing with our engineers and k Modernised legacy monoliths, including wrapping them with APIs so agents can use them At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersection of differences \- people of different cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you don’t quite tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply. **Additional Information** **Values and Life at Xplor** Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day: * Find a better way * Do the right thing * Say it straight * Win together * Own the outcome If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor. As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed. **Some of our perks and benefits are:** * Paid Parental Leave benefit programs * \#GiveBackDays/Commitment to social impact – 3 extra days off to volunteer and give back to your local community * Ongoing dedication to Diversity \& Inclusion initiatives such as D\&I Council, Global Mentorship Program * Access to free mental health support * Flexible working arrangements **Ready to apply?** To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Please include the word **"moonshot"** at the top of your message to the Hiring Manager so that we know you took the time to read our job ad. **Before you apply** To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is advertised. This applies to remote roles too. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage. Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly. We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process xplor.com/recruitment\-faqs/. **Interview Recording and Background Checks** As part of our hiring process, successful candidates will be asked to complete background and identity verification checks. Many of our roles are remote, and to protect both candidates and our business from recruitment fraud, we may record video interviews during the process. We keep any recordings and related data only for as long as the hiring process is active and do not retain them afterwards. **EEO and Artificial Intelligence** We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system with artificial intelligence\-enabled features to support our recruitment process, but our recruitment team makes all hiring decisions after human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here. Xplor is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We're dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status and age. jobs.title: Software Engineer III
jobs.description: **Who is Taco Bell?** Taco Bell was born and raised in California and has been around since 1962\. We went from selling everyone's favorite Crunchy Tacos on the West Coast to a global brand with 7,500\+ restaurants, 350 franchise organizations, that serve 42\+ million fans each week around the globe. We're not only the largest Mexican\-inspired quick service brand (QSR) in the world, we're also part of the biggest restaurant group in the world: Yum! Brands. Much of our fan love and authentic connection with our communities are rooted in being rebels with a cause. From ensuring we use high\-quality, sustainable ingredients to elevating restaurant technology in ways that haven't been done before... we will continue to be inclusive, bold, challenge the status quo and push industry boundaries. We're a company that celebrates and advocates for different, has bold self\-expression, strives for a better future, and brings the fun while we're at it. We fuel our culture with real people who bring unique experiences. We inspire and enable our teams and the world to Live Más. ***At Taco Bell, we're Cultural Rebels. Want to join in on the passion\-fueled fun? Learn more about the career below.*** **About the Job** The SOFTWARE ENGINEER III is responsible for developing, testing, deploying, and supporting scalable software and integration services within Taco Bell's Customer Middleware platform, helping connect digital ordering, loyalty, customer identity, messaging, and restaurant experiences. In this role, you will contribute to technical design, implement solutions within established architecture and engineering patterns, and help strengthen the reliability and maintainability of Taco Bell's customer technology ecosystem alongside an experienced team of engineers. The SOFTWARE ENGINEER III will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering as an individual contributor. **The Day\-to\-Day** * Build, test, deploy, and maintain cloud\-based APIs, event\-driven services, integrations, and data\-processing workflows that support customer identity, loyalty, digital ordering, messaging, customer care, and restaurant experiences. * Contribute to translating product and business requirements into technical designs, API contracts, implementation plans, and well\-defined engineering stories, working with senior engineers, architects, and partner teams to identify integration dependencies, edge cases, and operational risks. * Partner with software engineers, quality engineers, product leaders, platform teams, vendors, and external delivery teams to coordinate implementation, testing, defect resolution, and production validation across connected systems (including E\-Commerce, Braze, Akamai, and AWS). * Participate in code and technical design reviews, provide actionable feedback to peers, and apply and contribute to established engineering standards for reliability, security, maintainability, observability, automated testing, and deployment. * Investigate and help resolve complex production and non\-production issues using application logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and test results; collaborate with engineering and platform teams on remediation of environment\-dependent behavior, rate limits, integration failures, and security findings. * Contribute to improvements in the engineering lifecycle by addressing technical debt, applying reusable software patterns, expanding automation, documenting system behavior, and supporting secure, dependable releases through CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code practices. **Is This You?** * At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience developing and supporting production applications, APIs, distributed services, or integration platforms, with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent years of experience. * Hands\-on experience with a modern server\-side programming language and ecosystem (preferably TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js), including automated unit and integration testing, debugging, dependency management, and maintainable software\-development practices. * Experience developing and integrating REST or GraphQL APIs, asynchronous events, queues, and service\-to\-service integrations, with an understanding of authentication, error handling, retry behavior, idempotency, and API\-contract management. * Experience building or operating applications on a major cloud platform, preferably AWS, using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS, CloudWatch, or comparable managed services. * Experience with modern delivery and engineering tools and practices such as Git, GitLab CI/CD, infrastructure as code (AWS CDK or CloudFormation), Jira, Confluence, API specifications, and observability platforms. * Demonstrated experience collaborating with product, QE, platform, security, senior engineers, and partner engineering teams to move work from technical discovery and implementation through testing, production deployment, monitoring, and operational support in high\-volume transactional systems. **Work\-Hard, Play\-Hard** * Hybrid work schedule and year\-round flex day Friday * Onsite childcare through Bright Horizons * Onsite dining center and game room (yes, there is a Taco Bell inside the building) * Onsite dry cleaning, laundry services, carwash * Onsite gym with fitness classes and personal trainer sessions * Up to 4 weeks of vacation per year plus holidays and time off for volunteering * Tuition reimbursement and education benefits * Generous parental leave for all new parents and adoption assistance program * 401(k) with a 6% matching contribution from Yum! Brands with immediate vesting * Comprehensive medical \& dental including prescription drug benefits and 100% preventive care * Discounts, free food, swag and... honestly, too many good benefits to name **Talent Acquisition Salary Range** **$117,800 \- $140,000 annually \+ bonus eligibility \+ equity (if applicable) \+ benefits** The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition.
