jobs.title: VP, Engineering
jobs.description: Yugabyte is the company behind **YugabyteDB**, the AI\-ready, multi\-modal, distributed PostgreSQL database for cloud\-native apps. Trusted by industry leaders including Shopify, Paramount\+, GM, Kroger, Fiserv, and NPCI, YugabyteDB has been deployed in over 100 countries and powers more than 5 million clusters worldwide. Together, our hard\-working team of experts and our industry\-leading technology are uniquely positioned to meet the demands of modern workloads: geo\-distributed, ultra\-resilient, and built to scale without limits. Our Yugabeings (distributed, like our database) span 12\+ countries and multiple time zones, sharing expertise from diverse backgrounds and industries. Yugabyte is the company behind YugabyteDB, the AI\-ready, multi\-modal, distributed PostgreSQL database for cloud\-native apps. Trusted by industry leaders including Shopify, Paramount\+, GM, Kroger, Fiserv, and NPCI, YugabyteDB has been deployed in over 100 countries and powers more than 5 million clusters worldwide. Together, our hard\-working team of experts and our industry\-leading technology are uniquely positioned to meet the demands of modern workloads: geo\-distributed, ultra\-resilient, and built to scale without limits. At Yugabyte, we are on a mission to build an open source, high\-performance, distributed, and fault\-tolerant PostgreSQL\-compatible database for powering global, internet\-scale applications. Our Database\-as\-a\-Service (DBaaS) organization brings YugabyteDB to customers wherever they run: as a fully managed service on the major clouds with YugabyteDB Aeon, inside their own cloud accounts with Aeon BYOC, in their own data centers and Kubernetes environments with YugabyteDB Anywhere, and on a developer's laptop with yugabyted. As the VP of Engineering for DBaaS, you will lead the teams that build, ship, and run every way customers consume YugabyteDB as a service. You will own the roadmap delivery, quality, and operation of YugabyteDB Aeon, Aeon BYOC, YugabyteDB Anywhere, and yugabyted. You will work across a modern cloud stack: Kubernetes on GKE, EKS, and AKS, Java frameworks, Python and shell automation, Terraform, and observability tooling across AWS, GCP, and Azure. You will be the executive owner of production for Aeon, setting the standard for incident response, on\-call health, and the reliability our customers count on. You will also own the Security and SRE charters for the DBaaS organization. That includes product and cloud security, vulnerability management, compliance programs such as SOC 2, and the SRE practices that keep Aeon highly available, performant, and cost\-efficient around the clock. You will take responsibility for the resiliency, security, and cost of the architectural choices made across the organization, and stay close enough to the technology to lead design reviews and major incidents with your engineers. You will lead a global organization of engineers, managers, and SREs across several geographies reporting to the SVP of Engineering. You will hire and grow strong leaders, mentor and assess your managers, and build an organization where people do their best work and stay for the long run. You will partner closely with Product, the core database team, Support, and the field, and represent engineering to the executive team. We are looking for a leader who exemplifies collaboration, teamwork, and empathy, and who leads by example. We enjoy working with people who are driven, thrive in a fast\-paced environment, and want to build an internet\-scale, extensible database platform with a strong emphasis on simplicity and user experience. **Responsibilities** * Lead and grow the DBaaS engineering organization, including hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, and developing the next generation of engineering leaders * Own delivery of the roadmap for YugabyteDB Aeon, Aeon BYOC, YugabyteDB Anywhere, and yugabyted, in partnership with Product * Own the availability, performance, and cost efficiency of YugabyteDB Aeon, using SLOs and SRE golden signals to guide priorities * Establish and lead the process for incident response, postmortems, and on\-call across databases and infrastructure * Lead the Security charter, including secure design, encryption and key management, vulnerability management, and compliance certifications * Build shared platform foundations for provisioning, upgrades, backups, observability, and automation across all DBaaS products * Partner with Support and the field on customer escalations and turn what we learn into product improvements * Own headcount, budget, and cloud spend, and report progress clearly to the executive team **Requirements** * 15\+ years in software engineering, including several years leading managers and organizations of 50\+ engineers across multiple locations * Strong track record of building and operating a mission\-critical cloud service or SaaS platform, ideally for data infrastructure * Experience owning or partnering closely with Security and SRE, including incident management, SLOs, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001 * Technical depth in distributed systems and fault\-tolerant designs, with the judgment to guide architecture and cost trade\-offs * A record of hiring strong leaders and building engaged, high\-performing teams * Clear, direct communication with engineers, executives, and customers * Experience with: * Public cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) * Containerization tooling, theory and design (Docker, Kubernetes) * Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred) * Monitoring and observability systems (Prometheus preferred) * CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions preferred) * Relational database systems (PostgreSQL preferred) * Willingness and ability to learn new technologies and concepts **Nice to have** * Experience with databases or other stateful distributed systems * Experience building a BYOC or hybrid deployment model, or a self\-managed product alongside a managed service * Experience at an open\-source company and enthusiasm for working with the community We work in a hybrid model, with the team together in our Sunnyvale office 2–3 days per week. We feel strongly about equal pay for equal work, and transparency in compensation is one way to help achieve that. The cash compensation for this role is market competitive, with a range of USD 280,000\-USD 310,000, inclusive of variable/incentive for some roles. As well as equity (when applicable), and benefits including health plans, retirement plans, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). The pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. The actual pay will vary based on factors including experience, qualifications, and skill level. Regarding visa sponsorship: Due to recent changes in U.S. immigration policy, we're currently unable to sponsor new H\-1B visas for candidates outside the United States. We're happy to consider candidates who need an H\-1B transfer or extension, as well as candidates in the U.S. on F\-1 status (including CPT or OPT) who would need to change to H\-1B status. Candidates with other types of valid work authorization are also welcome to apply. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**: As an equal opportunity employer, Yugabyte is committed to a diverse workforce. Employment decisions regarding recruitment and selection will be made without discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, genetic information or characteristic, gender identity and expression, veteran status, or other non\-job related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state and local laws. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Perception Verification and Validation team. The team is responsible for verifying and validating the perception stack of our autonomous driving system by building the metrics, datasets, and analyses that tell us how perception performance translates into driving behavior. As a senior member of the team, you will own the evaluation strategy for major perception capabilities from start to finish, partnering with perception and ML engineers, systems and safety engineers, and autonomy leadership to decide what to measure, how to measure it with statistical rigor, and what the results mean for release decisions. Your work will directly shape how Zoox safely and efficiently ships perception improvements to our fleet, connecting model\-level performance to end\-to\-end system behavior. You will also help raise the bar for the team by mentoring other data scientists and setting technical direction for how we validate perception. **In this role, you will...** ----------------------------- * Lead the design of metrics and evaluation frameworks for new perception capabilities, partnering with perception engineers early in model development to define what "ready to ship" means and how it connects to end\-to\-end driving behavior. * Drive cross\-team validation projects, bringing together perception, systems, safety, and autonomy stakeholders to build consensus on metrics, evaluation datasets, and release criteria. * Develop rigorous statistical methods for uncertainty quantification, error estimation, and error propagation (frequentist, bootstrap, and Bayesian) so teams know when changes in performance are real. * Build evaluation datasets and analyze large\-scale, highly geospatial fleet and simulation data to uncover perception failure modes, then turn findings into clear recommendations for engineering and executive leadership. * Mentor and guide a small group of data scientists by defining tasks, reviewing their work, and raising the team's technical bar. ### **Requirements:** * Master's degree with 7\+ years of experience, or PhD with 3\+ years of experience, in data science, applied science, or a related quantitative role (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field). * Expert proficiency with SQL and/or Spark (PySpark or Scala) and Python, with a track record of building production\-quality analyses and pipelines on large\-scale (terabyte\+) distributed data. * Deep expertise in statistical modeling, inference, and decision making, including uncertainty quantification, and a history of connecting point and uncertainty estimates to high\-stakes decisions. * Experience designing metrics and validating ML models, such as computer vision, sensor\-based, or perception models, including discovering and measuring failure modes. * Demonstrated track record of leading technical projects across teams, mentoring other data scientists or engineers, and presenting results and recommendations to senior leadership. ### **Bonus Qualifications:** * Experience with autonomous driving, robotics, or other safety\-critical systems, including system\-level verification and validation or simulation. * Experience analyzing geospatial data and/or working with embeddings (e.g., similarity search, representation learning). * Skilled at using AI tools to improve development efficiency and quality. **Compensation:** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance. **About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. jobs.description: The Collision Avoidance System (CAS) is Zoox's independent safety layer. You will shape how CAS sees the world, combining interpretable geometric methods with machine learning, and you will own the architecture and roadmap that take these capabilities from idea to safe, real\-time deployment on our fleet. Your work will directly affect the safety of every rider and road user around our vehicles. ### **In this role, you will:** * Serve as the technical lead and architect for CAS perception, defining how lidar, radar, and camera data become reliable obstacle detection, tracking, and collision\-risk estimates under tight latency and compute budgets * Design, implement, and ship both machine learning technical bar across CAS ### **Qualifications** * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent experience * At least 10 years of experience in both machine learning (detection, segmentation, fusion) and classical methods (geometry, state estimation, tracking) * Strong C\+\+ or Python skills and a track record of shipping efficient, reliable real\-time software to production * Experience leading the architecture and technical roadmap of a complex production system across multiple teams ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Conference or Journal publications in Machine Learning or Robotics\-related venues * Experience with safety\-critical systems or functional safety practices (e.g., ISO 26262, SOTIF), collision avoidance, emergency braking, prediction, or planning systems for autonomous vehicles * Experience optimizing and deploying models or algorithms on onboard compute (e.g., GPU / CUDA, TensorRT) There are three major jobs.title: Software Integration Engineer - Associate
jobs.description: **About the Role** iCapital is looking to hire a Software Integration Engineer \- Associate to join the Annuities Platform Team. This role develops, tests and supports well\-defined integration solutions that connect client and product systems. The work spans application, API, and database layers and follows established engineering, quality and integration standards. This role will provide exposure to ownership of development, testing, deployment support and troubleshooting over time. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain integrations of moderate complexity independently using C\#, .NET, REST APIs, XML, JSON, Entity Framework, LINQ and SQL. * Clarify integration requirements, API contracts, data mappings, validations and expected system behavior by taking an active part in story grooming and technical discussions. * Develop, consume, and validate REST APIs, applying knowledge of HTTP methods, request and response structures, status codes, authentication concepts, headers and error handling. * Use Postman to test different payloads, analyze API responses and troubleshoot integration failures. * Work with XML and JSON data structures, mappings, transformations and validation, and troubleshoot malformed or unexpected data. * Apply Entity Framework and LINQ for application data access, querying and manipulation * Use SQL to investigate data\-related issues, validate integration results, troubleshoot application behavior and support development and testing activities. * Troubleshoot integration issues and resolve defects across development, QA, UAT and production support scenarios within established team processes. Analyze application logs, API requests and responses, XML and JSON payloads, database records, configuration and error messages. * Manage source control in Git, including branching, committing, pulling, merging, resolving basic conflicts and following established source\-control practices. * Use Azure DevOps for CI/CD activities, builds, deployments, work tracking and troubleshooting basic pipeline or deployment issues. * Understand and make basic React frontend changes when integration functionality requires matching UI updates. * Manage assigned Jira tickets and follow issues through development, testing and deployment. * Take part in peer code reviews, applying coding, security, maintainability and integration best practices. * Build knowledge of core product and integration workflows and the business domain. * Support critical production issues, deployments and business\-critical activities during occasional weekends or off\-hours, as needed. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of software development or integration engineering experience, preferably involving API\-based and enterprise application integrations * Strong working knowledge of C\#, .NET, object\-oriented programming and common design principles * Hands\-on experience developing and consuming REST APIs, with an understanding of API error handling, logging, validation, authentication, configuration management and reusable integration practices * Strong working knowledge of XML and JSON, including parsing, validation, data mapping and troubleshooting payload\-related issues * Good working knowledge of SQL, including joins, filtering, data validation and troubleshooting application or integration\-related data issues * Experience using Postman for API testing, request configuration, payload validation, authentication and response analysis * Solid understanding of Git, including branching, commits, pull requests, merging and resolving basic merge conflicts * Agile and Scrum processes, sprint planning, story grooming and iterative software delivery * Strong problem\-solving skills, and able to trace failures across systems rather than focusing only on individual application components. This includes troubleshooting across the API, application code, XML and JSON payload, database, configuration and deployment layers * Able to work with the Product, QA, DevOps, Integration and Support Teams to investigate and resolve end\-to\-end integration issues * Willingness to work occasional weekends or off\-hours on rotation, as required. * Hands\-on experience with Entity Framework and LINQ for retrieving and manipulating application data is *nice to have.* * Working knowledge of Azure DevOps, including repositories, build and release pipelines, work items and basic CI/CD concepts is *nice to have.* * Familiarity with React and modern web application concepts, and able to understand or support integration\-related frontend changes is *nice to have,* * Experience using Visual Studio and standard debugging, logging and error\-analysis techniques is *nice to have.* * Able to write clean, maintainable, testable code and create appropriate unit tests using frameworks such as NUnit or xUnit is *nice to have* * Working knowledge of Jira or similar ticketing systems is *nice to have* * Familiar with Copilot or similar AI\-assisted development tools for development, troubleshooting and productivity is *nice to have* **Benefits** The base salary range for this role is $80,000 to $95,000 USD. This position is paid on an hourly basis and is classified as non\-exempt. Employees in this role are eligible for overtime pay in accordance with applicable law. iCapital offers a compensation package that includes equity for all full\-time employees and an annual performance bonus. Employees also receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes an employer\-matched retirement plan, generously subsidized healthcare with 100% employer\-paid dental, vision, telemedicine, and virtual mental health counseling, parental leave, and paid time off (PTO). We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office Monday\-Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday. This position is based in our Salt Lake City office. For additional information on iCapital, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us X: @icapitalnetwork \| LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital\-network\-inc \| Awards Disclaimer: https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about\-us/recognition/ iCapital is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. We're hiring Software Engineers who own problems end to end — not a single layer of the stack. You'll ship production software that powers Mecka's data platform and the tools our operators, researchers, and customers use every day: web apps, APIs, internal products, and the plumbing underneath. This is a builder seat for engineers with roughly 3–7 years of experience. Ideal backgrounds are SaaS product engineering and startup/scale\-up environments where you scoped ruthlessly, shipped v1s, and owned features in production. You'll turn fuzzy requirements into reliable, usable software. You'll land on a focus area based on strength and business need (see Nice to haves). Breadth, product sense, and ownership matter more than matching every bullet. **What you'll be doing:** ------------------------- * **Ship end to end.** Take features from design through implementation, testing, and production — frontend, backend, and the integrations between them. * **Build tools people use.** Internal products, dashboards, and workflow apps for labeling, capture, delivery, QA, and ops — interfaces that are fast and clear for non\-technical users. * **Own services and APIs.** Backend services with correct permissions, retries, data integrity, observability, and background workflows for data\-heavy operations. * **Work close to the data.** Help package, validate, index, and serve large video/sensor datasets so labeling, QA, research, and customer delivery stay reliable. * **Automate the manual.** Replace spreadsheet\-heavy or one\-off scripts with durable tools and processes alongside the teams who live in those workflows. * **Iterate with users.** Get a v1 in front of operators and stakeholders quickly; harden what proves out. **Who you are:** ---------------- * **3–7 years** building and shipping production software (or equivalent impact), ideally in **SaaS** and **startup / scale\-up** environments. * Comfortable owning a feature **across the stack** — modern frontend (e.g. TypeScript/React) and at least one backend language (e.g. Python, Node, Go). * Strong product sense and a bias to ship: scope ruthlessly, put work in users' hands, iterate. * Design and build high\-throughput services upload/ingest huge amounts of data, processing, indexing, retrieval, and access control. * Practical experience with databases (e.g. SQL/PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and production APIs (REST/GraphQL). * Ownership of systems in production: monitoring, debugging, and root\-cause fixes — not just greenfield demos. * Clear communication with non\-technical partners (ops, product, finance, delivery). **Even better if you bring:** ----------------------------- Lean into one or more of these — they map to how the current openings differ. Strong fit in any one area is enough; you don't need all of them. * **Internal products / 0 1 delivery tooling**: dataset review \& QA UIs, delivery\-tracking dashboards, export/validation workflows for ego\-data deliveries to AI labs. * **Full\-stack ops applications**: labeling, capture, and country/ops management apps; clean UX for international, non\-technical teams. * **Web \& media / SDK**: viewers and players for egocentric capture (multi\-stream playback, timeline sync, large\-media performance); API/SDK design for hardware and data consumers. * **Data platform backend**: high\-throughput ingest, processing, indexing, and serving of large video/sensor datasets; reliability, cost, and observability at scale. * **Payments \& revenue systems**:payouts, payment orchestration, reconciliation, invoicing, and finance tooling where correctness and auditability matter. * **AI as a force multiplier**: daily use of AI coding tools; practical LLM integrations in internal tooling (validation, search, workflow triggers). * Early/founding engineer experience, video/media systems, cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) \+ CI/CD, or fintech/transactional backends. **Why Mecka** ------------- * Real surface area from day one on problems that are still greenfield. * Direct impact across delivery, operations, research, and the frontier labs that depend on our data. * Hybrid work with teams in Toronto, New York, and San Francisco to build the infrastructure for physical AI as it moves from lab demos into the world. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs. We may use AI\-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered. Compensation Range: CA$165K \- CA$200K

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Traffic Studies
jobs.description: **About Obvio AI** ------------------ Each year, more than 40,000 people in the U.S. leave home and never make it back due to traffic crashes. At Obvio, we believe these deaths are preventable. We deploy solar\-powered, AI\-assisted cameras to enforce traffic laws where pedestrians are most vulnerable, automating enforcement in ways that traditional systems cannot. Our approach has already led to a 50% reduction in reckless driving in early partner cities. Founded by the team behind Motive's AI dashcam and backed by Bain Capital Ventures and Khosla Ventures, we are building the intelligence layer for safer streets globally. **About The Role** ------------------ Obvio's traffic studies team runs short, camera\- and radar\-based data studies that measure speeding, red\-light, stop\-sign and crosswalk behavior at specific locations in a city before any enforcement program starts. Cities rely on these results, so accuracy and timely delivery matter. Today the pipeline works, but it scales with people rather than software. We are hiring a **Full\-Stack Engineer** to change that. You will own the software that takes a study from field deployment to a published report, make the routine path repeatable and largely automated, and make ad\-hoc requests (a new city, a new sensor, a new metric, a tighter timeline) something the system takes on through configuration and small extensions rather than one\-off engineering effort. You will work alongside computer\-vision engineers who hand you detectors and trackers, an annotation team that reviews and audits the results, field operations who deploy the hardware, and a go\-to\-market team that sets delivery dates with cities. Your job is the connective tissue between them. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own the traffic\-study backend end to end:** ingestion from multiple sensor types, vision\-pipeline orchestration on our ML servers and cloud compute, event extraction, annotation hand\-off, statistics, and publishing to the city\-facing portal (e.g., Python services on AWS ECS/EC2, S3 event data, Postgres). * **Scale the routine path:** turn manual steps (stats entry, reprocessing, report assembly) into automated, auditable ones so a study runs the same way every time with minimal engineer involvement. * **Handle ad\-hoc requests:** new sensors (each with its own data layout and quirks), new metrics, new report formats and shorter timelines. Design the system so these become configuration and small extensions rather than rewrites. * **Design and evolve the data model:** schema design, indexing, and query performance on growing Postgres datasets that back both the pipeline and the internal tools built on top of it. * **Own pipeline health:** maintain monitoring and alerting for the vision and event\-extraction services, catch stuck or failed studies early, and drive fixes to root cause. * **Make the numbers defensible:** implement counting and violation logic from written specifications, version it, and make every reported figure traceable to the raw data and the logic that produced it. * **Coordinate across teams:** work with the annotation team on intake, view\-quality gates and delivery dates, and with field operations on deployment timing and data hand\-off; give the go\-to\-market team realistic capacity and lead\-time answers. * **Support internal tooling as a backend:** expose the APIs and data endpoints that the annotation and operations teams' tools (e.g., built in Retool) consume — presentation and review managers, calibration tools, audit dashboards, capacity and status views. **Who You Are** --------------- * **An end\-to\-end owner:** you prefer to be accountable for a whole system and its output rather than a single layer of it. * **Pragmatic:** you balance shipping fixes quickly with leaving the codebase in better shape than you found it. * **Automation\-minded:** when you see a recurring manual step, your instinct is to design it out of the process. * **Rigorous with data:** you understand that an inaccurate count delivered to a city is a credibility problem, and you build for traceability and auditability from the start. * **A clear communicator:** you write things down, make requirements explicit before implementing them, and work well across engineering, annotation, operations and go\-to\-market teams. * **Comfortable with ambiguity:** priorities shift with customer needs, and you can re\-plan without losing momentum. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience with meaningful full\-stack ownership: backend services and data pipelines, plus the internal tools and front ends people use to operate them. * Experience building and operating services on a major cloud (AWS preferred: ECS/EC2, S3, IAM). * Solid database skills: schema design, indexing and query performance on growing datasets (Postgres or similar). * Experience building internal tools or dashboards, whether on a low\-code platform such as Retool or with a modern web framework. * Experience running production systems: monitoring, alerting, incident response and post\-incident fixes. * Experience orchestrating batch or compute\-heavy workloads (job queues, workers, GPU/ML servers, or similar). * Based in Islamabad or Lahore and able to work from the office. **Bonus Points** * Experience with pipelines that consume computer\-vision or sensor outputs (detections, tracks, radar), or with video and imagery at volume. * Experience with data\-quality, annotation or audit workflows. * Familiarity with IoT or edge devices and their operational quirks (timestamps, connectivity, uploads). * Startup or small\-team experience where you owned a system end to end. **Why Obvio** ------------- * Your work will help save lives and improve road safety * Series A of $54M * Fast\-moving startup environment with meaningful ownership * Competitive compensation and early\-stage equity Obvio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Obvio considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. Obvio is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Full Stack AI Engineer** **Remote Opportunity** As the industry's pioneering value\-based care (VBC) technology platform, Reveleer is purpose\-built to solve the most pressing real\-world challenges faced by providers and health\-plan organizations today. By unifying retrieval, clinical intelligence, risk adjustment, quality improvement, and member management solutions into one intelligent, AI\-powered system, Reveleer streamlines fragmented workflows to supercharge productivity, enhance care quality, and optimize performance on high\-priority value\-based initiatives. **About the Team:** You will be joining a small team within Reveleer AI division, in charge of developing the next generation agentic model for clinical prospective suspecting. As a full stack software developer in our team, you will be working in the unique environment of a small team with large scale impact to enable the expansion of our product and fast growth of our users. **Responsibilities** * Apply first\-principles thinking to break down hard problems and ship durable solutions. * Understand business needs and build end\-to\-end product experiences across the stack — backend services, data pipelines, and frontend interfaces. * Build, scale, and maintain infrastructure — containerized microservices, orchestration pipelines, cloud\-native architecture. * Develop and continually improve observability of systems and infrastructure at scale. * Partner closely with clinical experts and other engineers to build highly scalable, clinically accurate systems that surface actionable insights. * Challenge the status quo. If something is slow, fragile, or over\-engineered, fix it. * Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve production issues daily. Own the problem from alert to root cause to prevention. **Required Skills** * 5\+ years of experience building high\-quality code and infrastructure. * 3\+ years of experience working with large\-scale distributed systems — microservices, event\-driven architecture, or pipeline orchestration. * 2\+ years of experience with AWS or Google Cloud. * Hands\-on experience building across the stack: backend services (Python, Node, or similar) and frontend interfaces (React, TypeScript, CSS). * Familiarity with containerization, cloud\-native deployment patterns, and common architectural patterns for scalable systems. * Strong debugging instincts — you can trace a problem through multiple services, read logs, form hypotheses, and fix things under pressure without relying on an LLM to do the thinking for you. * Proven curiosity with the latest generative AI advances and a thoughtful perspective on where AI tools help and where they don't. * High ownership and accountability. You treat the systems you build as yours **Nice to Have** * Experience in healthcare, clinical data, or value\-based care. * Experience with pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or similar). * Experience with Firestore, BigQuery, or other GCP data services. **WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE:** * Competitive salary * Medical, Dental and Vision benefits * 401k match * Generous PTO plan Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Reveleer E\-Verifies all new hires. Reveleer is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: Process Control Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title: Process Controls Engineer** **Location:** North Carolina (Primary); Travel to New York site as needed **Reports to:** Direct to the North Carolina Plant Manager (and will support the CI/Engineer Manager on Projects) **FLSA Status:** Exempt (Salaried Position) **Position Overview:** We are seeking a highly skilled and versatile **Process Controls Engineer** to support our North Carolina manufacturing facility and provide cross\-site assistance to our New York location. This dual role position is ideal for a technically strong individual with hands\-on experience in automation, controls systems, and industrial maintenance.
